tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //mi chi/hā sbya muḥ/2rtsa 'jiciXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog

ra/ bcos/ 'od gas la rdo rje thes nga 'i la ma// chang la ma/ nor ye shes/ chos/ dbyings ngang ༈ /'gyur med klong du ma/ngon nga ra byang chub pa/ /dpa la lda na bla ma dar/ pa 'bas brten sasol/ /mdo sngags thub bsta na 'jam/ gling yangs pa'i zhing / /rgya cher spel ba lu nga rtogs dam/ pa'i chos// /brtse ba'i 'od zer 'gro la ston ma/khas pa/ /dpa la ldan bla ma dam pa zhabs brten sasol/ /zhes/ dpa la sprul nga/d+ma nor bus 2001lo'i zla ba 5pa 'i tshes 1nyin bris/
rog /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos spyod thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor sngon 'gro rang rgyud sbyong byed bzhugs so/ /

sngag /kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi sngon 'gro thun mong ma yin pa/ /rang rgyud sbyang bar byed pa'i khrid rim bzhil /dang po thog mar tho rang gi dus su ma rig pa'i gnyid kyis nyon mongs pa las slang bar bya ba ni/ /o rgyan rin po ches chos spyod chen mo nas gsungs pa ltar brjod par bya'o/ /kye ma kye ho skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /ma rig gti mug dbang gis ma non par/ /brtson 'grus ngar bskyed da lta yar longs dang / /thog ma med nas da lta thug gi bar/ /ma rig dbang du nyal yun des

༄sha /chog gis/ /da ni ma nyal sgo gsum dge la 'bad/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal mi shes sam/ /de ring tsam yang rtag pa'i go skabs med//bsgrub la brtson 'grus bskyed pa'i dus la babs/ /da res gcig po brtan bde bsgrub dus 'dir/ /snyoms las ngang la bsdod pa'i dus ma yin / /'chi ba bsam la sgrub pa mtha' ru skyol/ /tshe la long med 'chi rkyen bsam mi khyab/ /de tshe mi 'tsher gdeng zhig ma thob na/ /skyes bu khyod nyid gson pas ci zhig rung / /chos rnams bdag med stong zhing spros dang bral/ /sgyu ma smig sgyu rmi lam gzugs brnyan dang / /dri za'i grong khyer brag cha lta bur spyod/ /chu zla chu sbur mig yor sprul pa sogs/ /shes bya sgyu ma'i dpe bcu de bzhin du/ /'khor 'das chos rnams khyod kyis

shes par gyis/ /chos rnams rang bzhin skye ba med pa ste/ /gnas med 'gag med 'gro 'ong med pa ste/ /dmigs med mtshan ma med cing bsam brjod bral/ /don 'di rtogs par bya ba'i dus la babs/ /ces brjod cing / na mo gu ru bh+ya/ na mo dhe wa bh+ya/ na mo ḍāk+ki bh+ya/ ces bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsar gdab la/ o rgyan rin po che'i chos spyod chen mo nas gsungs pa las skyabs yul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye ma kye ma mi rtag 'khor ba'i chos/ /thar med las kyi rgya mtsho'i dong ring du/ /las kyi mnar ba'i 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par byin gyis rlobs/ /ma rig las kyi mnar ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /bde ba 'dod phyir sdug bsngal las la spyod/ /thabs mi mkhas pa'i 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /nyon mongs las sgrib dag par

jug /byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag 'dod gzung 'dzin bcings pa'i brtson ra 'dir/ /ri dwags rgya tshud slar yang 'jug pa ltar/ /ma rig gti mug can rnams snying re rje/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs par byin gyis rlobs/ /thar med las kyi grong khyer drug po 'dir/ /gcig nas gcig tu zo chu'i 'khyud mo bzhin/ /thar med 'khor ba'i 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /rigs drug skye sgo chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /skye rga na dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /ci tsam mthong yang mi 'jigs snying sran can/ /yengs ma lam la dal 'byor mi tshe zad/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtag blo gtad med par ma shes pas/ /da rung 'khor ba 'di la zhen cing chags/ /skyid 'dod ngang la mi tshe sdug

gis 'da'/ /'khor bar zhen pa log par byin gyis rlobs// /snod kyi 'jig rten mi rtag me chus 'jigs/ /bcud kyi sems can mi rtag lus sems 'bral/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid nam zla'i dus mi rtag /skyo shes gting nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /na ning da lo nam zla'i stod smad dang / /zhag dang nyin mtshan skad cig dus mi rtag legs par bsams na rang nyid 'chi bas gtugs/ /bsgrub pa snying rus nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed dka' yang / /'chi bdag nad kyi nye bar btab pa'i tshe/ /chos med 'gro rnams stong lo sang snying re rje/ /long med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /kye ma kye hud dkon mchog thugs rje can/ /rgyal ba khyed la brtse ba'i mthu mnga' bas//

༄ga /bdag sogs rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /da lta nyid du thar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i skyabs 'gro ni/ khams gsum rigs drug mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum du/ /rgyun chad med par 'gro la dgongs mdzad pa'i/ / bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su 'chi/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo mtshan dang dpe byed brgyan/ /phrin las mi zad nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su 'chi/ /zhi ba chasas bral don dam bden pa'i chos/ /theg pa gsum gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i lam/ /bka' gter lung dang man ngag bstan bcos sogs/ /dam chos rnams la phyag 'tshal

skyabs su 'chi/ /ma/ nor lam gnas tshogs mchog kun gyi zhing / /nyon mongs dri mas rab dben 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /byang sems nyan rang rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin mchog /dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su 'chi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso/ /byin rlabs thugs rjes 'gro kun 'dren mdzad pa/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su 'chi/ /chos sku skye med spros pa'i mtha' bral yang / /'gro ba'i don phyir zhi dang khro bor sprul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gter mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal skyabs su 'chi/ /chos nyid mkha' la thugs rjes shugs kyi 'gro/ /dag pa'i gnas mchog bde chen mchog rtsol cing / /dam tshig

༄sto /can la dngos grub gter mdzad ma/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal skyabs su 'chi/ /ye shes las grub mngon shes rdzu 'phrul can/ /legs nyes ltang 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod cing / /bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzad ma/ /dam can rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su 'chi/ /ye nas stong nyid spros dang bral ba la/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje ka nas dag /mnyam rdzogs klong yangs chen po'i rang bzhin la/ /'dzin med blo 'das ngang du skyabs su 'chi/ /lhun grub rang bzhin ye shes sku lnga'i bdag /dbyings rig stong gsal thig le'i dkyil 'khor du/rang rig 'od gsal rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /rtog med rang gsal rjen par skyabs su 'chi/ /ma 'gags rang rtsal kun khyab thugs rje can/ /shar

grol 'gags med rig rtsal rol pa'i zer/ /rtog med ngang nas 'gro blo'i mun sel ba/ /dus gsum thog mtha' med par skyabs su 'chi/ /de nas theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed ni/ kye ma chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med kyang / /de ltar ma rtogs sems can snying re rje/ /snying rje'i gnas rnams byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag gi sgo gsum dge la bskul bar bya/ /'gro drug sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob par/ /bdag gcig ma yin 'gro kun don gyi phyir/ /byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed par bya/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho da pag tu med pa'i nang / /rang gi rang bcings chos med snying re rje/ /snying rje'i gnas rnams bde la bkod bya'i phyir/ /byang chub mchog

༄sha /tu sems ni bskyed par bya/ /bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas rang bzhin yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid chen po ru/ /byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed par bya/ /'jig rten 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgyu ma bzhin/ /'dus byas thams cad rtag pa ma yin te/ /ngo bo stong pa bdag med yin pa la/ /de ltar ma rtogs byis pa 'di dag rnams/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis srid pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams/ /ming dang gzugs kyi 'dam la chags pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas thob phyir bdag gi lus dang ngag /yid dang gsum po dge la bskul bar bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin

sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i sems can ji snyed pa/ /ma lus 'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig /de nas tshad med bzhi bsgo ma pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /kun kyang sdug bsngal rgyu dang bral gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde dang ldan gyur ji ga /chags sdang med pa'i btang snyoms sanas gyur cig /sdig sgrib sbyang phyir yig brgya 'dren nga ni/ spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng du/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ /sku mdog shel 'dra'i thugs ka nas/ /zla steng hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor/ /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun tshangs bug bab/ /bdag gi nyams chags sdig sgrib dag /bcom ldan dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /bdag dang

༄sha /'gro ba sems can ma lus pa/ /sdig sgrib sbyang phyir ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /da lta nyid du bdag la stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su tostso me bha wa/ a nu rasto me bha wa/ su pusto me bha wa/ sarba sirnyizle pra yats+tsha/sarba kurma su tsa me tsirta she yaṃ/ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra ma rmā muñtsa badz+re bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥbadag ni mi shis gti mug rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig bsrung mtshams la ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon po khyed kyis skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i brtse ba'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag sogs skyabs mdzod cig /

sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs bcas kun/ /ma lus byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag nyid kyang / /rdo rje sems dpa' deng 'dir 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la myur du 'khod par shog /rdo rje sems dpa' khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe tshad dang zhing khams dang / /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog /de nas mchod pa 'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi a hūm̐/ gzhi ma dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhir gyur/ oṃ badz+ra re khe ā hūm̐/ phyi rol rin chen lcags ris 'khor yug gyur/ /dbus su ri rgyal ri bo mchog rab nyid/ /rin chen sna lnga las grub lhun chags shing / /dbyibs

sngag /legs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa la/ /gser gyi ri bdun rol mtsho bdun gyis bskor/ /shar du lus 'phags lho ru 'dzam bu'i gling / /nub tu ba lang spyod kyi gling gis bskor/ /byang du sgra mi snyan gyi gling rnams la/ /lus dang lus 'phags rnga yab rnga yab gzhan/ /g.yo ldan lam mchog 'gro dang sgra mi snyan/ /sgra mi snyan gyi zla dang gling phran brgyad/ /nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan dus me dang / /lha mi'i longs spyod dpal 'byor phun tshogs 'di/ /bla ma dkon mchog 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥlha/ phyi snang snod bcud stong gsum gzhal yas su/ /ri rab gling bcas rdul snyed mchod sprin gtib/ /lha mi'i longs spyod dpag med ci snyed kun/ /bla ma

dkon mchog sprul sku'i zhing du 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te bzhes nas kyang / /'gro kun sprul sku'i zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ āḥlha/rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i gzhal yas su/ /dbang po rnam lnga bkrag dang mdangs kyi brgyan/ /khams dang skye mched yongs su dag pa 'di/ /bla ma dkon mchog longs sku'i zhing du 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te bzhes nas kyang / /'gro kun longs sku'i zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ āḥsbyo/ sems nyid chos sku dag pa'i gzhal yas su/ /dmigs med stong gsal 'dzin med ngang du gnas/ /gdod nas dag pa'i gnyug ma'i ye shes 'di/ /bla ma dkon mchog chos sku'i zhing du 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te bzhes nas kyang / /'gro kun chos sku'i zhing

༄ga /du skye bar shog /oṃ āḥsbyi/ mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di 'bul bas/ /byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /dus gsum bde gshegs dgongs pa rtogs pa dang / /srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas shing / /nam mkha' mnyams pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /oṃ āḥsbyi/ ma hā gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni rat+na maṇ+ḍal la pu tsa me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra na sa ma ye āḥlha/ zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ri/ thog ma'i mgon po chos sku kun tu bzang / /drug pa'i bdag nyid rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /'dren pa'i gtso bo thugs mchog rdo rje sems/ /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog dga' rab rdo rje'i zhabs/ /rgyal ba'i sras mchog gu ru shrī seng / /rdo rje'i

sku mnyes 'chi med pad+ma 'byung / /rig 'dzin brda brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gter mnga' bdag kurma gling pa dang / /thugs kyi sras mchog chos rje mtshan can dang / /snyigs dus 'gro mgon sur+ya tsaṇ+ḍa'i zhabs/ /gang zag snyan brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang stong dbyer med yi dam zhi khro dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang la gang 'dul bka' rgyud bla ma rnams/ /khyed kyi bstan pa shin tu nyams smad nas/ /dus 'dir skyes bu'i rnal 'byor yid pham na/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drang du gsol/ /smre sngags gdungs pa'i nga ros khyed 'bod na/ /sngon gyi dam bca' gnyen po da dgongs la/ /

༄sha /mkha' dbyings klong nas mtshan dpe'i zhal bstan 'tshal/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drang du gsol/ /grags stong tshangs pa'i gsung gi sgra sgrogs la/ /khyed kyi thugs mdzod gter gyi sgo phyes la/ /mkhyen rab thugs rje'i 'od zer rab bkyes nas/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drang du gsol/ /dus mtha'i 'gro rnams ma lus da sgrol cig /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i chu bo da bskul cig /nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i rgyud bzhi da sgrol cig /'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drang du gsol/ /bde gshegs sku bzhi'i 'bras bu da rtsol cig /mtha' yas pha ma khams gsum sems can rnams/ /ma lus 'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig /'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drang du gsol/ /ces brgyud pa'i

gsol 'debs dang d+ku gsum gsol 'debs ma sogs mos gus drag po'i sgon nas gdab/ 'dod don gsol 'debs gang shes bya/ de nas dbang bzhi zhu ba'i dgongs pa ni bla ma yab yum spyi gtsug nas / /oṃ dkar 'od zer dang bcas pa/ /bdag gis smin mtshams mdzod spur babs/ /bum dbang thob nas lus sgrib dag /sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bla ma yab yum mgrin pa nas/ /a dmar 'od zer dang bcas pa/ /bdag gis lce'i dbang po babs/ /gsung dbang thob nas ngag sgrib dag /gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bla ma yab yum thugs ka nas/ /hūm̐ mthing 'od zer dang bcas pa/ /bdag gis snying gi dkyil du babs/ /ye shes dbang thob yid sgrib dag /thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bla ma yab yum lte ba nas/ /hrī ljang

༄ga /'od zer dang bcas pa/ /bdag gis lte ba'i dkyil du babs/ /sgo gsum tha dad 'dzin sgrib dag /dbyer med lhan skyes dbang bzhi thob / /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi snying khar pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la/ /'bral ba med par rtag par bzhugs nas kyang / /bdaka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ /sku gsurngo thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams sogs/ /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra bar/ /de 'drar kho na bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog /ces pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /'di dag zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi sngon 'gro rang rgyud sbyong byed kyi lhan thabs sbyar yang rung zhing / bla med theg pa chen po'i chos spyod gter ston kurma gling pa'i sras kyi thu bochos rje gling pa'i zhal gdams/ ku ru sur+ya tsaṇ+ḍas yi ger bkod pa/ dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /dbe'o/ /
༄ga /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: chos spyod bag chags rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

sngag /oṃ āḥsbyi: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang : dam pa rigs brgya 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: gus pas phyag 'tshal bar dor grol nas kyang : 'gro kun sku gsum don la gnas gyur cig: skal ldan las can skyes bu dad ldan rnams: zhi khro 'dus pa'i chos spyod rab gsal 'di: dus gsum kun tu ma brjed bsgom bzlas bya: dang po tshogs bsags yan lag bcu pa ni: skyabs yul dkon mchog

sngag /gsum dang rigs brgya'i lha: mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs nas 'di skad do: i āḥlha: nam mkha'i mthar thug zhing khams rab 'byams na: bde gshegs rgya mtsho zhi khro rab 'byams dang : dkon mchog rin chen gsum dang yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro rgya myo/tsho dam can tshogs bcas la: deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar: 'bral ba med par gus pas skyabs/ su mchi: skyabs su 'gro ba'i yan lag bo: chos nyid dbyings kyi rab 'byams klong yangs nas: shes rab thabs dang thugs rje'i skur sprul pa: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i zhi khro rab 'byams rnams: gnas 'dir 'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol: spyan 'dren pa'i yan lag go: snang srid rnam dag ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir: rin chen

seng ge la sogs khri steng du: thabs shes dri med nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : zag med dgyes pa chen por bzhugs su gsol: bzhugs su gso la ba'i yan lag go: kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga la: kun tu bzang po zag pa med pa'i bde: rol ba'i ye shes rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: phyago 'tshal ba'i yan lag go: bde gshegs zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho la: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag med rnams:dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: 'gro ba'i don du 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol: mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag go: thog med dus nas dug gsum dbang gyur te: sgo gsum sdig sgrib bag chags bcas pa rnams: ngan song 'khor ba'i rgyu bsags thams cad kun: rab tu gnong

mug /zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: sdig sgrib bshags pa 'i yan lag go: chos dbyings kun khyab snang srid bde chen zhing : 'gro don mdzad dang bsod nams byang chub sems: bsod nams ye shes don 'byung thams cad la: dga' ba chen pos rjes su/ ye rang ngo : rjeX su yi rang ba'i yan lag goḥ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rdul snyed ston pa rnams: sems can don du thugs dam rgyud bskul te: nam mkha'i mthar thug dbyangs kyis rab gang ba'i: chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor bar bskul: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i yan lag go: ji srid 'khor ba'i 'jig rten ma stongs par: de srid 'gro ba rgya chen don byed cing : mtha' yas sangs rgyas ston pa ma lus kun: mya ngan mi 'anga' bzhugs par gsol ba

'debs: mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i yan lan go: bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa: nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can kun: bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas: zhi khro rab 'byams go 'phang myur thob thog: bla med theg pa chen por bsngo ba'i yan lag goḥ o āḥlha: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhartu ā: i ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo sbyi: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings zhing khams nas: 'gag med gsal dag thig le'i gzhal yas su: rin chen khri rkang pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : rang sems ma bcos stong pa'i rang rtsal las: rang rig gsal stong rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bcas bzhad: phyag g.yas rig stong rdo rje thugs kur 'dzin: g.yon pas

sngag /snang stong dril bu dku la brten: dbu la bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs: longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen brgyan: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs: thugs kur rdo rje hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor: o badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭhaḥ 2 ḍho me bha wa: su tosto me bha wa: a nu rasto me bha wa: su pusto me bha wa: sarba sidhisme pra yats+tsha: sarba kurma su tsa me cilta shri yi: ku ru sa: ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān: sarba ta thā ga ta: badz+ra ma rmā muñtsa badz+re bha wa: ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas nas rtog sgrib sbyangs: ma yengs dam pa rigs brgya'i yang snying 'di: sgrib gnyis sbyangs phyir ci nus bzlas par bya: de ltar

sgrib pa sbyongs pa'i rjes su zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs rnams lus dkyil du bsgo ma zhing gsol ba btab bar do'i smon lam gdab par 'dod na 'di skad do: de nas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' yi: tsit+ta rin chen snying gi sa'/la yas su: dngas ma lnga ldan 'od lnga'i thig ler gsal: yeshes lnga ldan gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor du: seng ge glang chen rta mchog rma bya dang : shang shang pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng : sangs rgyas zhi ba sum cu so drug ni: stong gsal ma 'gags 'od lnga'i sku ru sa/sal: o āḥbh+yo: tsit+ta snying dbus thig le'i mkha' klong du: thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku: chos sku kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing : chos dbyings kun tu bzang mo sku mdog dkar: skyil krung mnyam bzhag gnyis med 'khril sbyor rol:

༄dzo /gsal stong pa d+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: dus gsum sangs rgyas spyi mes chen po la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid dag pa'i 'od gsal 'char dus der: gzhi gnas ma rig klong du brgyal ba'i tshe: gzhi snang spros bral dag pa'i 'od lam la: kun tu bzang po yab kyis mdun bsus shig: kun tu bzang mo yum gyis mtha' brten cig: kun bzang dbyer med sa la drang du gsol: tshe 'das kyi don du smon lam 'debs na: bdag sogs tshe 'phos zhes pa'i sa ra tshe 'das zhes bcug par bya'o: o āḥlha: tsit+ta snying gi dbus phyogs rtsa 'dab la: chos dbyings ye shes gsal ba'i 'od klong du: rnam snang dbyings phyug dkar gsal 'khril

sbyor rol: 'khor lo dril 'dzin skyil krung gsal stong bzhugs: dbus phyogs sangs rgyas rigs kyi gtso bo la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: gti mug drag ngo/sa 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: chos dbyings ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad kyis lam sna drongs:yum mchog dbyings phyug ma yis rgyab nas skyol: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: i āḥsbyi: tsit+ta snying gi shar phyogs rtsa 'dab la: me long ye shes gsal ba'i 'od klong du: rdor sems spyan ma mthing gsal 'khril

༄ga /sbyor rol: rdo rje dril 'dzin skyil krung gsal stong bzhugs: g.yas su sa snying myu gu dril 'dzin dkar: g.yon tu byams pa klung shing dril 'dzin dkar: mdun du lā su me long phyed skyil dkar: rgyab tu pulpe me tog phyed skyil dkar: rdo rje rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug po la:phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs 'chi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: zhe sdang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: me long ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas lam sna drongs: yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan mas rgyab nas skyor: bar dor 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs

rgyas sa ru skyol: i āḥlha: tsit+ta snying gi lho phyogs rtsa 'dab la: mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: rin 'byung ma tī ser gsal 'khril sbyor rol: rin chen dril 'dzin skyil krung gsal stong bzhugs: g.yas su kun bzang snye ma dril 'dzin ser: g.yon du nam/ snying ral gri dril 'dzin ser: mdun du mā lbā phreng 'dzin phyed skyil ser: rgyab tu sbruspru spos phor phyed skyil ser: rin chen rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug po la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: nga rgyal drag pos 'khor bar mkhyams pa'i tshe: mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rin chen

jug /'byung ldan gyis lam sna drongs: yum mchog mā ma ki yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ru skyol: o āḥlha: tsit+ta snying gi nub phyogs rtsa 'dab la: sor rtogs ye shes gsal ba'i 'od klong du: snang mtha' gos dkar dmar gas la 'khril sbyor rol: pad+ma dril 'dzin skyil krung gsal stong bzhugs: g.yas su spyan gzigs pad+ma dril 'dzin dmar: g.yon tu 'jam dpal ral gri dril 'dzin dmar: mdun tu ghirti pi waṃ phyed skyil dmar: rgyab tu ā lo mar me phyed skyil dmar:pad+ma rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug po la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma

thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: 'dod chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: sor rtogs ye shes gsa'/ ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas kyis lam sna drongs: yum mchog gos dkar mo yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: o āḥsbyi: tsit+ta snying gi byang phyogs rtsa 'dab la: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i 'od klong du: don grub sgrol ma ljang gsal 'khril sbyor rol: rgya gram dril 'dzin skyil krung gsal stong bzhugs: g.yas su sgrib sel po te dril 'dzin ljang : g.yon tu phyag rdor rdo rje dril 'dzin ljang : mdun tu garnye dung phor phyed skyil ljang : rgyab tu rmārti zhal zas phyed skyil

༄gi /ljang : las kyi rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug po la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: phrag dog drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan don yod grub pas lam sna drongs: yum mchog dam tshig sgrol mas rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: i āḥs: tsit+ta snying gi shar sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: rnam rgyal lcags kyu 'khril sbyor 'dor stabs dkar: tsit+ta snying gi lho sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: gshin rje zhags pa 'khril sbyor 'dor stabs ser: tsit+ta snying gi nub

sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: rta mgrin lcags sgrog 'khril sbyor 'dor stabs dmar: tsit+ta snying gi byang sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: bdud rtsi dril bu 'khril sbyor 'dor stabs ljang : sprul pa'i sgo ba yab yum brgyad rnams la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar ngo'i snang ba shar dus der: bag chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: ye shes bzhi sbyor gsal ba'i 'od lam la: khro chen sgo ba bzhi yis lam sna drongs: yum mchog sgo ma bzhi yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: o āḥs: spyi gtsug bde chen rtsa 'dab 'od klong du: dkar

༄sha /gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor na: lha yi thub pa brgya byin pi waṃ dkar: nga rgyal lha yi skye sgo bcad du gsol: ltag rtsa ba men rwa 'dra'i 'od klong duḥ ljang gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor na: lha mi thub pa thags bzang go mtshon ljang : phrag dog lha min skye sgo bcad du gsol: srog rtsa shel gyi sbu gu'i 'od klong du: ser gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor na: mi yi thub pa shāka thub gseg gshang ser: 'dod chags mi yi skye sgo bcad du gsol: lte ba rtsa 'khor 'khyil ba'i 'od klong du: mthing gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor du: byol song thub pa seng ge po ti mthing : gti mug byol song skye sgo bcad du gsol: gsang gnas bde skyong rtsa 'dab 'od

klong du: dmar gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor du: yi dwags thub pa kha 'bar sgrom bu dmar: ser sna yi dwags skye sgo bcad du gsol: rkang mthil rtsa 'khor 'khyil pa'i 'od klong du: nag gsal thig le gsal 'tsher dkyil 'khor du: dmyal ba'i thub pa chos rgyal me chu nag: zhe sdang dmyal ba'i skye sgo bcad du gsol: 'gro don mdzad pa'i sprul sku thub drug la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: srid pa bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: bag chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: ye shes bzhi sbyor gsal ba'i 'od lam la: thub chen gong ma gsum gyis lam sna drongs: thub chen 'og ma gsum gyis rgyab

༄sha /nas skyor: ma dag rigs drug 'od lam bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: i āḥlha: zhi ba'i lha tshogs ba'i bcu rtsa gnyis ni: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul zhi ba'i sku: mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan rnams mdzes tshul ldan: zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs:bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: dug lnga drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe:ye the/sa lnga ldan gsal ba'i 'od lam la: zhi ba yab rnams kun kyis lam sna drongs: dbyings kyi yum chen rnams kyis rgyab nas skyor: sgo ba

sgo ma rnams kyis mtha' nas brten: sprul sku thub pa drug gis skye sgo khogs: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: i āḥlha: skye gnas bar dor gnas pa'i dus 'di ru: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis lha tshogs rnams:bdag lus tsit+ta snying gi gzhal yas su: 'od lnga tshom bu'i sku ru gsal bar bzhugs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: zhi ba'i lha tshogs snying gi nang nas thon: mdun gyi mkha' la nam mkha' gang bar 'char: rgyan dang cha lugs gtso 'khor grangs med pa:'ja' 'od klong nas gsal stong 'od lnga'i sku: ye shes lnga yi 'od lam zer thag 'tsher: lnga ldan thig le 'ja' 'od zer du 'phro: gsal

tshog /'tsher lhun sdug mdangs ldan rang sgrar bcas: bdag gi snying gar zug pa'i tshul du 'char: ye shes lnga yi 'od dang lhan cig tu:ma dag 'khrul pa rigs drug 'od lam drug: bdag la 'char bar gyur pa'i dus kyi tshe: bcom ldan zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs rje can: thugs rje can rnam/sa thugs rje der ma chung : ye shes bzhi sbyor lam la bdag drongs shig: ma dag rigs drug lam nas bzlog tu gsol: i āḥlha: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab la: 'ja' dang 'od du 'thibs pa'i klong dkyil du: longs spyod 'khor lo dbus kyi rtsa 'dab la: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin chen po ni: pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug 'od lnga'i mdangs: ye shes mkha' 'gro mar gsal bde stong

'khril: gri gug thod khrag phyag rgya nam mkhar bsgyur: sku yi rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'gro ba skyobs: o āḥs: mgrin pa longs spyod shar gyi rtsa 'dab la: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin chen po ni: dkar gsal mdzes 'dzum mkha' 'gro dkar mo 'khril: gri gug thod khrag phyag rgya nam mkhar bsgyur: thugs kyi rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'gro ba skyobs: i āḥlha: mgrin pa longs spyod lho yi rtsa 'dab la: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin chen po ni: ser gsal mdzes 'dzum mkha' 'gro ser mo 'khril: gri gug thod khrag phyag rgya nam mkhar bsgyur: yon tan rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'gro ba skyobs: o āḥlha: mgrin pa longs spyod nub kyi rtsa 'dab la: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin chen po ni:

༄sha /dmar gsal mdzes 'dzum mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'khril: gri gug thod khrag phyag rgya nam mkhar bsgyur: gsung gi rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'gro ba skyobs: o āḥ:: mgrin pa longs spyod byang gi rtsa 'dab la: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po ni: ldang gsal khro 'dzum mkha' 'gro ljang gu sbyor: gri gug thod khrag phyag rgya nam mkhar bsgyur: phrin las rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'gro ba skyobs: i āḥlha: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: bag chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: lhan skyes ye shes gsal ba'i

'od lam la: dpa' bo rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'a/ma sna drongs: yum mchog mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: dag pa mkha' spyod zhing khams de ru skyol: o āḥlha: skye gnas bar dor gnas pa'i dus 'di ru: rig 'dzin dpal bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams: bdag lus mgrin pa longs spyod gzhal yas su: 'od lnga tshom bu'i sku ru gsal bar bzhugs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: rig 'dzin lha tshogs mgrin pa'i nang nas thon: nam mkha' gang bar mdun gyi mkha' la 'char: rol mo'i sgra dang gar stabs sna tshogs bsgyur: 'jig rten kham/sa kun shig shig yom yom 'gul: lhan skyes ye shes 'od

sngag /lam zer thag 'tsher: gti mug dud 'gro'i lam sna 'char dus der: rig 'dzin lha tshogs thugs rje der ma chung : gti mug dud 'gro'i lam las bzlog tu gsal: lhan skyes ye shes lam la 'gro ba drongs: bar do rang ngo shes par thugs rjes zungs: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su dbang bskur cig: o āḥlha: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i spyi bo ruḥ klad pa dung khang 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su: 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: khrag 'thung lha tshogs tshom bu'i sku ru bzhugs: o uḥbhūḥ klad pa dung khang dbus kyi rtsa 'dab tu:'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru ma: zhal gsum phyag drug smug nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas

gsum rdo rje kha ṭaṃ rnge'u chung bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags bsnams: gro dhi shwa ri gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: gtso bo yab yum gnyis kyis 'gro kun drongs: i āḥsbyi: dung khang dbus gyi rtsa 'dab khri rkang steng : 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: rnam par snang mdzad bud+dha he ru ku: zhal gsum phyag drug dmar smug dkar dmar zhal: sayas gsum 'khor lo ral gri dgra sta bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu thong gshol bhan dmar bsnams: bud+dha gro dhe gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: khrag 'thung bde gshegs rigs kyis 'gro kun drongs: i āḥbhūḥ klad pa dung khang shar gyi rtsa 'dabs su: 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: rdo rje sems

༄ga /dpa' badz+ra he ru ma: zhal gsum phyag drug mthing nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum rdo rje bhan+dha dgra sta bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol bsnams: badz+ra kro dhi gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: khrag 'thung rdo rje rigs kyis 'gro kun drongs: o āḥlhaḥ klad pa dung khang lho yi rtsa 'dab su: 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: rin chen 'byung ldan rat+na he ru sa: zhal gsum phyag drug ser nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum rin chen kha ṭ+wāṃ be con bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar tri shul bsnams: rat+na gro dhi gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: khrag 'thung rin chen rigs kyis 'gro kun drongs: o āḥstuḥ klad pa dung khang nub kyi rtsa 'dab su:

'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du: snang ba mtha' yas pad+ma he ru ku: zhal gsum phyag drug dmar nag dkar sngo zhal: g.yas gsum pad+ma kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar rnge'u chung bsnams: pad+ma gro dhi gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: khrag 'thung pad+ma rigs kyisa'agro kun drongs: i āḥdh+riḥ klad pa dung khang byang gi rtsa 'dabs su: 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i 'od klong du:don yon grub pa kurma he ru ku: zhal gsum phyag drug ljang nag dkar dmar zhal: g.yas gsum ral gri kha ṭī dbyug tho bsnams: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol bsnams: karma gro dhi gnyis med dgyes pa 'khril: khrag 'thung las kyi rigs kyis 'gro kun drongs:

༄sha /oṃ āḥsbyi: khrag 'thung gtso bo yab yum bcu gnyis la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos 'u sa brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: 'khrul snang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: ye shes lnga rdzogs gsal ba'i 'od lam la: khrag 'thung khro rgyal rnams kyis lam sna drongs: dbyings phyug khro mo'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: o āḥlha: dung khang shar gyi rtsa 'dab 'od klong du: ko'u rī dkar mo zhing dbyug bhan+ta 'dzin: dung khang lho yi rdza 'dab 'od klong duḥ tso'u rī ser mo mda' gzhu 'gengs shing 'phen: dung

khang nub kyi rtsa 'dab 'od klong du: pra mo dmar mo chu srin rgyal mtshan phyar: dung khang byang gi rtsa 'dab 'od klong du: be ta nag mo rdo rje bhan+dha 'dzin: dung khang shar lho'i rtsa 'dab 'od klong duḥ puk+ka dmar ser rgyu ma 'dren cing gsol: dung khang lho nub rtsa 'dab 'od klong du:ghasma ljang nag rdo rje bhan dmar dkrug: dung khang nub byang rtsa 'dab 'od klong du: tsaṇ+ḍa ser skya tsit+ta bam chen za: dung khang byang shar rtsa 'dab 'od klong du: smi sha mthing nag bam ro mabo lus phral: o āḥrdu: gnas kyi ko'u rī ma mo brgyad rnams la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: 'khrul snang

mug /drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: sgra 'od zer gsum gsal ba'i 'od klong du: ko'u rī ma mo bzhi yis lam sna drongasaḥ puk+ka ma mo bzhi yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: o āḥlha:dung khang shar gyi rtsa 'dab phyi ma la: sing ha smug nag seng gdong khar ro thogs: dung khang lho yi rtsa 'dab phyi ma la: bya tri dmar mo stag gdong lag gnyis bsnol: dung khang nub kyi rtsa 'dab phyi ma la: sri la nag mo wa gdong rgyu ma za: dung khang byang gi rtsa 'dab phyi ma la: sha na mthing nag spyang gdong bam ro 'dred: dung khang shar lho'i rtsa 'dab phyi ma la: kyi ta dkar ser rgod mgo zhing phrag gzar: dung khang lho

nub rtsa 'dab phyi ma la: kang kā dmar nag kung mgo zhing chen khur: dung khang nub byang rtsa 'dab phyi ma la: kha khwa nag mo bya rog bhan gri gdong : dung khang byang shar rtsa 'dab phyi ma la: hū lu mthing skya 'ug gdong rdo rje 'dzin: yul bdag sing ha phra med brgyad rnams la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: 'khrul snang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: rang snang yul brgyad dag pa'i 'od lam la: sing ha phra men bzhi yis lam sna drongs: kyi ta phra men bzhi yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pas 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru

sngag /skyol: i āḥdh+riḥ klad pa dung khang shar sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu bhan+dha 'dzin: glad pa dung khang lho sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: phag gdong ser mo zhags pa bhan+dha 'dzinaḥ klad pa dung khang nub sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: seng gdong dmar mo lcags sgrogs bhan+dha 'dzinaḥ klad pa dung khang byang sgo'i rtsa 'dab la: sbrul gdong ljang gu dril bu bhan+dha 'dzin: sprul pa'i ye shes sgo ma bzhi rnams la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: 'khrul snang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: skye ba rnam bzhi 'khrul ba'i sgo chod la: phrin las rnam bzhi dag pa'i sgo phyes nas:

lcags kyu zhags pa ma yis lam sna drongs: lcags sgrog dril bu ma yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol:yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: i āḥlha: dung khang shar gyi phyi khyams rtsa phran la: zhi ba'i las mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug drug: srin mo dkar smug g.yag gdong rdo rje 'dzin: tshangs pa dkar ser sprul gdong pad+ma 'dzin: lha chen dkar ljang gzig gdong tri shul 'dzin: gtogs 'dod dkar sngo sre gdong 'khor lo 'dzin: gzhon nu dkar dmar dred gdong mdung thung 'dzin: brgya byin dkar mo dom mgo rgyu zhags 'dzin: shar nas zhi ba'i las mdzad rnal 'byor drug: bar do 'jigs skrag zhi ba'i las mdzod cig: i āḥlha:

༄sha /dung khang lho yi phyi khyams rtsa phran la: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug drug: rdo rje ser mo pha waṃ spu gri 'dzin: zhi ba dmar ser chu srin bum pa 'dzin: bdud rtsi dmar ser sdig gdong pad+ma 'dzin: zla ba dkar ser khra mgo rdo rje 'dzin: be con ser ljang wa gdong dbyug to 'dzin: srin mo ser nag stag gdong thod khrag 'dzin: lho nas rgyas pa'i las mdzad rnal 'byor drug: bar do ye shes rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig: i āḥrgyu: dung khang nub kyi phyi khyams rtsa phran la: dbang gi las mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug drug: za ba dmar ljang rgod mgo be con 'dzin: dga' ba dmar mo rta gdong khog chen 'dzin: stobs chen dmar skya khyung gdong dbyug to 'dzin:

srin mo dmar mo khyi gdong rdo rje 'dzin: 'dod pa dmar mo pu shud mda' gzhu 'gengs: nor srung dmar ljang sha mgo bum pa 'dzin: nub nas dbang gi las mdzad rnal 'byor drug: bar do rang dbang thob pa'i las mdzod cig: i āḥlha: dung khang byang gi phyi khyams rtsa phran la: drag po'i las mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug drug: rlung lha ljang sngon spyang gdong ba dan 'phyar: mi mo ljang dmar skyin gdong gsal shing 'dzin: phag mo ljang nag phag gdong mche zhags 'dzin: dga' byed ljang dmar khwa gdong zhing chung 'dzin: sna chen ljang nag glang chen bam chen 'dzin: chu lha ljang sngon sbrul gdong sprul zhags 'dzin: byang nas drag po'i las mdzad rnal 'byor drug: bar do 'khrul snang

sngag /brlag pa'i las mdzod cig: i āḥdh+riḥ dung khang shar sgor khu byug lcags kyu dkar: dung khang lho sgor ra gdong zhags pa ser:dung khang nub sgor seng gdong lcag sgrog dmar: dung khang byang sgor sbrul gdong dril bu ljang : sprul pa'i las mdzad dbang phyug sgo ma bzhi:bar do skye sgo bkag pa'i las mdzod cig: i āḥlha: rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: chos nyid bar do'i snang ba shar dus der: 'khrul snang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: sgra 'od zer gsum gsal ba'i 'od lam la: shar gyi dbang phyug bdun gyis lam sna drongs: lho yi dbang phyug bdun gyis

rgyab skyor: nub kyi dbang phyug bdun gyis mtha' nas brten: byang gi dbang phyug bdun gyis gshed dang phrol: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: o āḥlha: skye gnas bar dor gnas pa'i dus 'di ru: khrag 'thung drug cu tham pa'i lha tshogs rnams: spyi bor klad pa dung khang gzhal yas su: 'od lnga tshom bu'i sku ru gsal bar bzhugs: bdag sogs tshe 'phos lus brjes gyur ma thag: khrag 'thung lha tshogs klad pa'i nang nas thon: stong gsum 'jig rten ma lus gang bar 'char: rgyan dang chu lugs gtso 'khor 'jigs tshul can: sgra 'od zer gsum klong nas khro bo'i sku: sgog pa dpa' ba 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can: rnod dang

sngag /gshe dang rngams pa'i nga ro sgro gas: snying rje khro dang gtum pa'i zhe sdang 'bar: thal chen khrag thig zhag gi zo ris brgyan: ko rlon g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thabs gsol: thod phreng sprul chun brgyan cing me dpung 'bar: gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad dang :theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur ston pa: ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa rgyob sod 'brug stong ldir: mgo brnyan sna tshogs phyag 'tshan ston cing bsgyur: stong gsum rab 'byams shig shig yom yom 'gul: sgra 'od zer dang dngangs skrag 'jigs snang kun: bdag la 'char bar gyur pa'i dus kyi tshe: khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha tshogs thugs rje can: thugs rje can rnams thugs rje der ma chung : bag chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams

pa'i tshe: dngangs skrag 'jigs snang spangs pa'i 'od lam la: khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs kyis lam sna drongs: dbyings phyug khro mo'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: ko'u seng sgo ma'i tshogs kyis mtha' nas brten: sgor byed chen mo brgyad kyis gnas nas spor: dbang phyug mgo brnyan tshogs kyis bar chad sol: sgo ma chen mo bzhi yis skye sgo khog: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: o āḥlha: dga' ba'i grogs dang bral nas gcig pur 'khyams: rang snang stong pa'i gzugs brnyan 'char dus der: sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs rje'i shugs phyung nas: sngangs skrag bar do'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung shog: ye shes gsal ba'i 'od

sngag /lnga 'char dus der: mi 'jigs mi skrag rang ngo shes par shog: zhi dang khro bo'i sku gzugs 'char dus der: mi 'jigs gdeng thob bar do ngo shes shog: las ngan dbang gis sdug bsngal myong tsam na: yi dam lha yis sdug bsngal sel bar shog: chos nyid rang sgra 'brug stong ldir tsam na: theg chen chos kyi sgra ru 'gyur bar shog: skyabs med las kyi rjes su 'brang dus der: thugs rje chen pos bdag sogs bskyab tu gsol: bag chags las kyi sdug bsngal myong dus der: 'od gsal bde ba'i ting 'dzin 'char bar shog: 'byung lnga'i khams rnams dgra ru mi ldang zhing : sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : zhi khro

rab 'byams lha tshogs thugs rje dang : bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus: smon lam ci btab deng 'dir 'grub par shog:ces zhi khro'i chos spyod smon lam dang bcas pa 'di la dus gsum du brtson pa sa 'phrad par gyur na: mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'i sdig sgrib kyang tshe 'di nyid la 'dag cing : na rag dmyal ba'i gnas kyang dong nas sprugs te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du skye bar the tshom med do: bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po nyid kyis bka' las kyang : gang zhig sgyu 'phrul zhi khro yi: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal na: nyams chags kun kyang byang gyur te: mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang byang : na rag gnas kyang dong sprugs te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags: zhes pa sa chos spyod de ltar tshul bzhin du byas nga 'i phan yon ni de lta bur ha cang yang che ste: dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'di rnams kyi mtshan lan gcig rna bar thos pas kyang ngan song gi gnas su mi skye zhing mthar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur gsungs te: dang la kun tu bzang po nyid kyis zhal nas kyang : gal te rnal 'byor pho mo gang zhig bis dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'di rnams kyi mtshan rna bar lan gcig thos pa tsam gyis kyang na rag chen por mi ltung ngo : zhes gsung pa dang : yang rang bzhin sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor la: gang zhig gus nga ra phyag 'tshal na: nyams chags kun kyang byang bar 'gyur: dam tshig bskang nas dngos grub 'thob: ces sasungs pa'i phyir: phan yon brjod las 'das pa yod pas: de lta bas na bdag lus zhi khro'i lha tshogs su gsal gdab cing : chos spyod la brtson par gyis shig: tshe 'di nyid la yang mchog thun mong bi dngos grub thob cing : tshe 'phos nas kyang chos nyid bar dor zhi khro'i sna nga ba 'char

ra༅gi /ba'i tshe: sanyis su med pa ra thim nas sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro: nyams su longs shig: gshed ma brgyas bdas kyang 'di'i tshig yid la ma brjed par gyis shig: zungs shig: chongs shig: klogs shig: kun chub par gyis shis: tshul bzhin du yid la gyis shig: zhi khro 'dus pa'i chos spyod rab gsal: bar do thos grol gyi nyams len: zhi khro'i las byang tshor ba rang grol gyi snying po: bar do gas nga dbang rig pa rang grol gyi cha rkyen: bskang bshags nyams chags rang grol gyi dngos gzhi: skyes bu skal ldan rnams kyi thar lamaḥ chos spyod bag chags rang grol zhes bya ba: 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du ma rdzogs so: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: grub thob kurma gling pa sa gter nas gdan drangs pa'o: maṅgal:
rog /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: gsol 'debs sku gsum klong yangs rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

༄sha /rnam dag chos dbyings gdal khyab klong yangs nas: chos sku'i chos sku kun tu bzang po la: ma bcos klong yangs ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: ka dag lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: ma bcos chos dbyings lhun grub klong yangs nas: chos sku'i longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen la: skye 'gags dbyer med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: bde chen lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: 'gags med gsal dag

sngag /this/ le'i klong yangs nas: chos sku'i sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa' la: rig stong dbyer med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: snang stong lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: rang snang bkod pa lhun grub klong yangs nas: longs sku'i chos sku rnam snang gangs chen la: snang stong dbyer med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: dag snang lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: gsal dag bde chen lhun grub klong yangs nas:longs sku'i longs sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la: gsal stong dbyer med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: bde stong lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: yang dag rang snang ye shes klong yangs nas: longs sku'i sprul sku phyag na rdo rje la: grags stong dbyer med ngang nas gsol ba

'debs: ye grol lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: rang snang ye shes 'od gsal klong yangs nas: sprul sku'i chos sku rdo rje sems dpa' la: dran stong dbyer med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: shar grol lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: rang snang spros bral lhun grub klong yangs nas: sprul sku'i longs sku rigs gsum mgon po la: rang grol lhun grub ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: mkhyen brtse lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: rang snang 'gag med sna tshogs klong yangs nas: sprul sku'i sprul sku thub chen drug po la: rtog tshogs rang grol ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: sna tshogs rang grol ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: dri med pad+ma 'od kyi klong yangs nas: rdzus skyes sprul sku pad+ma 'byung

༄gi /gnas la: zung 'jug bde chen ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: mdzad pa lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: bde chen ye shes lhun grub klong yangs nas: ma gcig mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la: thabs shes gnyis med ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: dag snang lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: rang rig ye shes thugs gter klong yangs nas: gter ston sprul sku brgyud pa'i bla ma la: mos gus gdung ba'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: 'gags med thugs rje'i ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: chos dbyings mkha' ltar dag pa'i klong yangs nas:zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol la: dmigs med khyab gdal ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: rang rig rang grol ngang nas byin gyis

rlobs: rang snang dag pa kun gzhi'i klong yangs nas: bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma la: dad mos drag po'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: rang sems chos sku'i klong nas byin gyis rlobs: ma hā a nu a ti yo ga gsum: chos sku'i gsu/nga mchog gsu/ma la gsol ba 'debs: khyab gdal klong yangs ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: kṛ ya u pa ya dang yo ga gsum: 'o ngas sku 'i gsung mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs: bskyed rdzogs dbyer med klong nas byin gyis rlobs: 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa sde snod gsum: sprul sku'i gsu/nga mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs: 'gro don lhun grub ngang nas byin gyis rlobs: theg dgu'i dgongs pa rtogs par thugs rjes zungs: rdul gcig steng

༄sha /na rdul snyed sangs rgyas te: chos sku'i 'khor tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs: 'khor tshogs khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs:sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' dpag med de: longs sku'i 'khor tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs: 'khor tshogs khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs: byang sems nyan thos sde bzhi la sogs te: sprul sku'i 'khor tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs: 'khor tshogs khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs: ma spangs yongs rdzogs skye med spros dang bral: chos sku'i thugs dgongs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: sna tshogs mi gnyis gsal stong rang bzhin med: longs sku'i thugs dgongs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: dri med seng ge dpa' bar 'gro la sogs:

sprul sku'i thugs dgongs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: zhing khams 'jig rten nam mkhas gar khyab pa: chos sku'i gdul bya bdag gis thob par shog: gzhi dang snying po me tog brgyan pa'i zhing : longs sku'i gdul bya bdag gis thob par shog: stong gsum mi mjed bye ba phrag brgya ru: gang la gang 'dul sprul nas don byed pa'i: sprul sku'i gdul bya bdag gis thob par shog: zab chos zhi bro dgongs pa rang grol gyi gsol 'debs sku gsum klong yangs rang grol zhes bya ba: ji srid 'khor ba'i 'jig rten ma stongs par: de srid dam pa'i chos 'di'i bstan pa ma rdzogs shig: maṅga lo:
tshog /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: zhi khro 'dus pa'i las byang rtsar phreng tshor ba rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

༄ga /kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang : dam pa rigs brgya 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: gus pas phyag 'tshal rang rig grol nas kyang : 'gro kun sku gsum don la gnas gyur cig: bdag 'dra u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: skal ldan skyes bu las can rnams kyi don: bde gshegs zhi khro 'dus pa'i las byang bstan: 'di ltar nyams su longs shig rigs kyi bu: 'di la spyi don bco brgyad bstan: bka' bsgo mtsham sa gcod phyag rgya bzung : sngon 'gro yan las bcu nga dang : sman raka gtor gsum byin brlab dang : gzhal yas khog dbub lha bskyed dang : spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal zhing : mchod gtor bstod bshags tshigs las bya: bskul dang chad mdo sgo dbye dang : gtor skyong gtor bro smon lam gdab: le'u bco brgyad las byang grangs: skal ldan rnams kyis

gug /nyams su longs: dang ngo bshegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: lha: nga nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad kun: rang rig stong gsal rig pa'i mdangs: kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje sems: rab 'jigs khrag 'thung sprul pa'i tshogs: snang la rang bzhin med pa yis: rab tu gang nas 'od 'phros pas: lus ngag sems la gnod byed cing : mchod pa'i mdangs 'phrog ma rig bgegs: nyon mongs ma rig rgyu las byung : rgyu drug 'khor ba'i lam dgag phyir: 'di ru ma 'dug rang sar dengs: lha hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: gnyis nga mtshams gcod 'di skad do: sbyi: rang rig rdo rje sems dpa' ste: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku: gzi brjid ldan

pa'i thugs ka ru: drag po'i byin rlabs rig rtsal las: gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin: sangs rgyas kun kyis dbang bskur zhing :gdug pa 'dul bar rab bsngags pas: thugs kyi sprul pas stong gsum khyab: de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer tshul: sbyi 'phros shar phyogs rdo rjes gtams: rta 'phros lho phyogs rin chen gtams: hrīḥ'aphros nub phyogs pad+mas gtams: āḥ'aphros byang phyogs rgya gram gtams: o 'phros steng phyogs 'khor los gtams: ro 'phros phyi rol me dpung 'bar: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : rgya gram 'khor lo me ri'i gur: rim pa drug gi tshul du bskor: bskal pa stong kyang mi 'jig cing : 'byung po'i gnod pas tshugs mi 'gyur: khro tshogs sprul pa dpag med kyis:

sngag /rab tu gtams shing mtshams bcad do: o hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ ro hūm̐ bh+rūṃ dhi ro: badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: gsum pa phyag rgya bzung ba niḥ rdo rje g.yas la dril bu sayo naḥ las tu thogs la 'di ska da do: lha: chos nyid skye ba med pa las: ma 'gags thabs shes brda' mtshon phyir: rdo rje gsol zhing dril bu dkrol: 'gro ba sems can thams cad kun: sad nas sangs rgyas sar 'jug phyir: yang dag nyid du brdas mtshon no: zung 'jug lam la ma brten par: mthar phyin 'bras bu thob mi srid: thabs shes yang dag nyid la 'jug: i badz+ra gan+dhe dharma hūm̐ āḥ bzhi pa yan lag bcu pa niḥtshogs zhing nam mkhar dmigs byas laḥ o āḥrgyu: nam mkha'i mthar thug zhing khams rab 'byams na: bde gshegs rgya mtsho zhi khro rab 'byams dang :

dkon mchog rin chen gsum dang yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dam can tshogs bcas la: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob par:'bral ba med par gus pas skyabs su mchi: skyabs su 'gro ba'i yan la ga bo: chos nyid dbyings kyi rab 'byams klong yangs nas: shes rab thabs dang thubs rje'i skur sprul pa: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i zhi khro rab 'byams rnams: gnas 'dir 'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol: spyan 'dren pa 'i ya na la ga so: snang srid rnam dag ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir: rin chen seng ge la sogs khri steng du: thabs/ shes dri med nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : zag med dgyes pa chen por bzhugs su gsol: gzhugs su gso la ba'i yan lag so: kun tu bzung mo gsang ba'i bha ga ru: kun tu bzang po

༄sna /zag pa med pa'i bde: rol ba'i ye shes rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: phyag 'tshal pa'i yag las so:bde gshegs zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho la: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag med rnams: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: 'gro ba'i don du 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol: mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag go: thog med dus nas dug gsum dbang gyur te: sgo gsum sdig sgrib bag chags bcas pa rnams: ngan song 'khor ba'i rgyu bsags thams cad kun: rab tu gnod zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag so: chos dbyings kun khyab snang srid bde chen zhing : 'gro don mdzad dang bsod nams byang chub sems: bsod nams ye shes

don 'byung thams cad la: dga' ba chen pos rjes su yi rang ngo : rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag go: phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rdul snyed ston pa rnams:sems can don du thugs dam rgyud bskul te: nam mkha'i mthar thug dbyangs kyis rab gang ba'i: chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor bar bskul: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bskul ba'i yan las go: ji srid 'khor ba'i 'jig rten ma stongs bar: de srid 'gro ba rgya chen don byed cing : mtha' yas sangs rgyas ston pa ma lus kun: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs nga 'i yan lag goḥ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa: nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams: bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas: zhi khro

ramin /rab 'byams go 'phang myur thob shog: bla med theg nga chen por bsngo ba'i yan la ga goḥ lnga pa zu/chod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: gyer sgom dal bar 'di r+yā da do: lha:dmigs bsam brjod bral ngang nyid las: thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid: sman raka gtor mchod dngos po rnams: rtog gnyis bdag 'dzin bral ba las: ro yaṃ khaṃ gsum me rlung chus: bdag 'dzin rtog pa'i dri ma sbyangs: me rlung chu yang 'od du zhu: sman raka gtor mchod dngos por gyur: rtog gnyis dag nas snod bcud rnams: 'dod pa'i yon tan du mar gyur: bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa niḥ dh+riḥ dpa' bo 'bru lngas rgyu byas nas: dpa' mo 'bru lngas rkyen byas te: thabs shes gnyis med bdud rtsi'i chu: sku gsum thugs dang mnyam sbyor ba'i:

dkar dmar mthing gsum bdud rtsir gyur: o āḥtsū sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: o hūm̐ tram̐ hrīḥ.ā: spru lī māṃ ṭ+wāṃ shā: āḥtsū hrīḥ rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni: ྈ: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che: dug gsum stong gsal ma 'gags ngang : rgyu rkyen rnam dag rak+ta 'khyil: i āḥlha ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la tsū hrīḥṭha: gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni: lha: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes lngar bsgral ba'i: sha chen lnga yi brda bstan gtor chen po: ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin rnam par dag: myo āḥtsū ma hā bha lo ta te dz+wa bha li ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: phyi mchod 'dod yon rnam lngar byin gyis brlab pa ni: o āḥstu: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: gnas su dag phyir yul snang rnam par dag: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab

sngag /bshos: gnas yul rnam dag mchod pa chen po'o: o badz+ra phusne āḥrdu: myo badz+ra duspru āḥrdzu: o badz+ra āḥlo ke āḥlha: o badz+ra gan+dhe āḥsbyi: myos baja( nai wir+ya sto/ཿsbyi: skyes brngardu shabha stoniḥrgyu: zhes pas gyer bsgoms dal bar bya'o: zhi khro 'dus pa'i las byang tshor ba rang grol gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: drug pa zhi khro'i bsgom khog ni: thog mar ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum las: dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa ni: gyer bsgom ldan pas 'di skad do: skyon ched34 par rtog gsum bral ba yi: dmigs med brjod bral de bzhin nyid: ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na sa ma ti aḥ gnyis pa kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa ni: āḥrtog bral ngang las rang byung rtsal: stong nyid snying rje kun tu snang : badz+ra ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sa ma ti aḥ gsum pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms nga ni: lha

gsal stong snying rje'i ngang nyid las: rang sems rig rtsal 'gag med 'di: mthing nag rgyu yi yi ge aḥ badz+ra tsit+ta rtsu aḥ bzhi pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs bsgoms pa ni: stong gsal rang bab gdos bcas bral: snang la rang bzhin ma grub par: nam mkha'i gzugs can 'od zer 'phro: a las 'od zer e ru chad: e las chos 'byung zur drug ldan: de steng a las yaṃ 'phros pas: ye shes lnga ldan rgya gram rlung : dkar ser dmar ljang mthing kha'i mdog: chos sku'i rang rtsal shugs ldan gnas: de steng a las baṃ 'phos pas: bo las ye shes 'byung ba chu: bcud ldan shin tu gzugs mdzes pa: kha dog ma nges rgya mtshor 'khyil: lam 'phros rin chen sa gzhi brdal: gser g.yu mu tig zangs lcags

sngag /tshogs: zur bzhi logs brgyad khri rkang dang : rin chen lnga yi ri rab brtsegs: a las bh+rūṃ 'phros gzhal yas khang : rat+ta lnga las grub pa yi: zur bzhi log bzhi sgo bzhi ldan: lha chen brgyad kyis ka gdung byas: lha bran dral phyam rin chen thog: rus sbal chu srin ka ba'i gdan: mu tig 'od phreng rin chen brgyan: gza' brgyad ka zhu rgyu skar 'degs: pha gu rin chen mig tshags phreng : dril bu rtsa brgyad mchod rten bskor: mi nub rgyal mtshan bcu yis brgyan: ri dwags chos nyan chos 'khor ldan: gdugs dang dar dpyangs bkra shis rdzas: phyi rim dur khrod gnas brgyad dang : rdo rje mtshon cha me ris bskor: stong pa'i dbyings su 'ja' ltar shar: phyi dang nang med zang thal gsal:

yid 'od mdzes ldan gzhal yas khang : rgyal ba zhi khro'i bzhugs gnas so: lha bi shwa bi shudhe dz+nyā na tsakra lha: a e yo baṃ lam̐ bh+yo: bi sha bi shurnye aḥ rdzu hūm̐ bh+rūṃ hūm̐ lhaḥ lnga pa lha tshogs 'khor bcas bskyed pa ni: lha: bdag nyid tha mal rang sems 'di: rtog pas ma chod so ma'i ngang : bsam bral ngang las sems nyid 'di: rdo rje mthing nag a yis mtshan: rdo rje ar bcas 'od zer 'phros: yar mar 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus rdo rje ar bcas pa: 'od zhu ma rig nyon mongs sbyangs: rin chen gzugs sku blugs pa ltar: bdag nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su:kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing : chos nyid bzang mo sku mdog dkar: mnyam bzhag skyil krung gnyis med 'khril: ye shes rin chen sna

༄sha /tshogs dang : nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lha badz+ra tsit+ta a: badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra so: de ltar kun bzang yab yu ma gyi thugs ka nas rnam snang yab yumabaskyed pa dang ཿ kun bzang yab yum rnam snang yab yum gyi spyi bor gtegs la bzhugs su gsol ཿ de nyid thugs las o lī 'phros: rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad ni:dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas 'khor lo thugs kur 'dzin: g.yon shel dril bu yum la 'khyud: yum mchog dbyings phyug dkar dmar la: cha lugs yab 'dra dgyes par 'khril: seng chen nga/da nyi rin chen steng : snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: o dzi na dzika: dzā te shwa ra ti sa: a kun bzang thugs nas hūm̐ sum̐ 'phros: rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' ni: mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis

pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kur 'dzin: g.yon shel dril bu yum la 'khyud: yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan mthing skya: cha lugs yab 'dra dgyes par 'khril: glang chen pad nyi rin chen steng : snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: lha badz+ra sgrika: sbyi dha tu shwa rī :: yab kyi thugs nas k+ṣi mi 'phros: spyi zhu g.yas su sa snying dkar: myu gu dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: mi zhu g.yon du byams pa dkar: klu shing dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: yum gyi thugs nas hūm̐ hūm̐ 'phros: lhu zhu mdun du lā su dkar: me long gtso bstan phyed skyil bzhugs: lha zhu rgyab tu pukhye dkar: me tog gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: rdo rje rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgomaḥ k+ṣi hi rā tsa

sngag /ya swā hā: mi tri dh+wa ra ni swā hā: lha lā su sa ma ya sa: lha 9PROB a we sha ya sa: a kun bzang thugs nas swā māṃ 'phros: rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan ni: ser gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas nor bu thugs kur 'dzin: g.yon pas dril bu yum la 'khyud:yum mchog mā ma ki ser skya: cha lugs yab dang mtshungs par 'khril: rta mchog pad nyi rin chen steng : snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: swā rat+na sgrika: shrī mo ha ra ti / yab kyi thugs nas hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ 'phros: lha zhu kun bzang dmar ser g.yas: snye ma dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: rta zhu g.yon du nam snying ser: ral gri dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: yum gyi thugs nas tram̐ dza 'phros: rta zhu mā le ser skya

mdun: phreng ba gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: dza zhu rnyuspe ser mo rgyab: spos phor gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: rin chen rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgoms: snru swa rā tsa ya swā hā: rta a gar+bha ya swā hā: rta mā le sa ma ya ho: dza sbruspru pra we sha ya sa: a kun bzang thugs nas āḥdzā 'phros: bdag nyid snang ba mtha' yas ni: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas nga/d+ma thugs kur 'dzin: phyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'khyud: yum chen gos dkar dmar skya la: rgyan cha yab dang mtshungs par 'khril: rma bya pad nyi rin chen steng : snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: rmāḥ.a ro lika: dzā rā ga ra ti ste: yab kyi thugs nas hrīḥsbyi 'phros: hrīḥ'u

mug /spyan gzigs dkar dmar g.yas: pad+ma dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: sbyi zhu 'jam dpal dmar ser g.yon: ut+pal dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: yum gyi thugs nas hrīḥrba 'phros: hrīḥ'u ghirti dmar skya mdun: pi wang sgra sgrogs phyed skyil bzhugs: rba zhu ā lo dmar mo rgyab: mar me gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: pad+ma rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: hrīḥhā hūm̐ pad+ma bha ta ma swā hā: sbyi shrī a raṃ gha ya sa hā: hrīḥgīrti rā ga ya ho r+sā: rba dhī paṃ su ki ni sa ma ya sa: a kun bzang thugs nas hā rta 'phros: bdag nyid don yod grub pa niḥ ljang gsal zhul gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas rgya gram thugs kur 'dzin: g.yon pas dril bu yum la

'khyud: yum chen sgrol ma ljang skya la: cha lugs yab 'dra dgyes par 'khril: shang shang pad nyi rin chen steng : snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: hā pradz+nyā sgrika: rta badz+ra ra ti sa: yab kyi thugs nas lha rnyi 'phros: smyu zhu sgrib sel ljang gu g.yas: po ti dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: sto zhu phyag rdor ljang gu g.yon: rdo rje dril 'dzin sems dpa'i skyil: yum gyi thugs nas ho a 'phros: ho zhu gan+dhe ljang gu mdun: dung phor gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: a zhu rmārti ljang gu rgyab: zhal zas gtso 'bul phyed skyil bzhugs: las kyi rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: smyu sa raṃ pā ya swā hā: lha ku ru pā ṇi hriḥswā hā: hoḥgan+dhe tsit+ta ya ho: a rmārti rā ga ya nī

sngag /sa: zhi ba'i lha tshogs de dag kyang : dbu rgyan stod g.yogs smad dkris dang : sku rags phyag gdub dpung rgyan mdzes: cod pan snyan cha mgul chun bcas: do shal rin chen phreng bas brgyan: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: mnyen lcugs 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar: snang la rang bzhin med pa la: 'dzin med ma bcos rang gsal bsgom: aḥ bdag nyid kun bzang thugs ka nas: skru pre r+ghaṃ k+ṣe s+t+waṃ ye 'phros: de drug zhu bas thub drug sku: steng du brgya byin pi waṃ dkar: 'og tu chos rgyal che chu nag: shar lhor thag bzang go mtshon ljang : lho nub shāka thub gseg shang ser: nub byang seng ge po ti mthing : byang shar kha 'bar sgrom

bu dmar: mgro don mdzad pa'i thub pa drug: pad rkyang steng na bzhengs thabs sku: gsal la 'dzin pa med par bsgom: o mu ṇi kro swā hā: i mu ṇi pre swā hā: i mu ṇi hūm̐ swā hā: o mu ne k+ṣe swā hā: o mu ne sum̐ swā hā: i mu ne ye swā hā: sa ma ya lti: a: bdag nyid kun bzang yab yum gyi: thugs las sa bon phyogs bzhir 'phros: lhu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥsbyi dang : rba hoḥ'abru brgyad zhu ba la/sa: shar sgor rnam rgyal lcags kyu dkar: lcags kyu dril 'dzin 'dor stabs 'gying : myo badz+ra gro ta bi dza ya lha: badz+ra e ku shā dza: lho sgor gshin rje zhags pa ser: dbyug to zhags 'dzin 'dor stabs 'gying : chu badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka lha: badz+ra pā sha lha: nub sgor rta mgrin lcags sgrog dmar: lcags sgrog dril

sngag /'dzin 'dor stabs 'gying : o pad+ma gro ta h+ya kṛ wa lha: badz+ra sbo ṭa bo: byang sgor bdud rtsi dril bu ljang : rgya gram dril 'dzin 'dor stabs 'gying : o badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī lhu: badz+ra garnye ho: tshad med bzhi ldan yab yum brgyad: thod skam rin chen dbu la brgyan:cod paṇa snyan cha mgul chun bcas: thod phreng tshar gsum sbrul zhags brgyan: glang chen mi lpags stod g.yogs dang : thal chen tshom bu khrag thig spras: zhag gi zo ris stag lpags dkris: sgog pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung : dgod dang gshe dang rngam par ston: snying rje zhe sdang gtum pa/ra bzhugs: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni: lha nyid kun kyi rang snang la: rang snang kun

kyang lha ru gsal: snod bcud zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: ye nas lhun grub chen por bzhugs: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: i āḥlhani: 65 sto/ཿlha/: 6〈 stosaḥlha/: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi: sgom khos tshor ba rang grol lo: de ltar zhi ba'i lha tshogs kun: bdag bskyed mdun bskyed dkyil bskyed dang : snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang : gang ltar bsgom kyang khyad par med: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: de nas khro bo'i lha tshogs bskyed pa ni: :: rang byung rang shar dkyil 'khor dbus:kun bzang yab yum thugs las lha: zhu bas zhu lugs zhun sku ltar: bdag nyid che mchog he ru ku: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhir bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus smug nag: rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon: yum chen gro ti shwa

sngag /rī ma: rgyan cha sku mdog yab 'dra la: gzig sham dung dmar yab la stob: mkha' lding khyung chen rin chen brag: sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan steng du: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: i ma hā kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: ma hā kro ti shwa rī sa: lha: che mchog yab yum thugs ka nas: lha hūm̐ 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: zhu bas zhu lugs zhun sku ltar: bdag nyid bhud+dha he ru ma: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus smug nag: 'khor lo dgra sta ral gri g.yas: dril bu thong gshol bhan dmar g.yonaḥ bhud+dha gro ti shwa rī ma: rgyan cha sku mdog yab 'dra la: gzig sham dung dmar yab la stob: byol song gtso brgyad rin chen brag:

pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: o bud+dha gro ta ma hā shrī ha ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: bud+dha gro ti shā rī sa: :: rang byung dkyil 'khor shar dbus su: che mchog yab yum thugs las lha: lha zhu zhu lugs zhun sku ltar: bdag nyid badz+ra he ru ku: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag: rdo rje bhan+dha dgra sta g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol g.yon: badz+ra kro ti shwa rī ma: rgyan cha sku mdos/ yab 'dra la: gzig sham dung dmar yab stob 'khril: byol song gtso bor rin chen brag:sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan steng du: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: o badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra kro ti shwa rī :: sbyi:

sngag /rang byung dkyil 'khor lho dbus su: che mchog yab yum thugs las lha: lhu zhu zhu lugs zhun sku ltar: bdag nyid rat+na he ru sa:zhal gsu/ma phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ser nag: rin chen kha ṭ+wāṃ be con g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar tri shul g.yon: rat+na gro ti shwa rī ma: rgyan cha sku mdog yab 'dra la: gzig sham dung dmar yab stob 'khril: byol song gtso bo rin chen brag: sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan steng du: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: o rat+na gro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: rat+na gro ti shwa rī sa: :: rang byung dkyil 'khor nub dbus su: che mchog yab yum thugs las :: : zhu zhu lugs zhun sku ltar: bdag nyid pad+ma he ru

ga: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon mthing dbus dmar nag: pad+ma kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rnge'u chung g.yon: pad+ma kro ti shwa rī ma: rgyan cha sku mdog yab 'dra la: gzig sham dung dmar yab stob 'khril: byol song gtso bo rin chen brag: sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan steng du: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: o pad+ma kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: pad+ma gro ti shwa rī sa: lha: rang byung dkyil 'khor byang dbus su: che mchog yab yum thugs las lha: : zhu zhu lugs zhun sku ltar: bdag nyid kurma he ru ku: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang nag: ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to g.yas: dril bu

)sna /bhan dmar thong gshol g.yon: karma kro ti shwa rī ma: rgyan cha sku mdog yab 'dra la: gzigs sham dung dmar yab stob 'khril: byol song gtso bo rin chen brag: sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan steng du: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: o kurma gro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: karma gro ti shwa rī snyi: khrag mthung gtso bo yab yum bcu: khro gnyer spyan rtsa sdang mig bgrad: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil: sma ra ag tshom tsha tsha 'phro: thod skam rin chen dbu la brgyan: cod paṇa snyan cha mgul chun sbrul: glang chen mi lpags stod g.yogs dang : thal chen rak+ta'i thig les brgyan: phyag gdub zhabs gdub stag gzig sham: rlu tra che chung sku rags mdzad: sgog pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung

ni rgod dang gshe dang rngams pa dang : snying rje zhe sdang gtum par bzhugs: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: de nas ko'u rī ma brgyad bskyed pa ni: ྈ: bdag nyid che mchog thugs dkar nas: ha brgyad 'od 'phros zhu ba las: shar phyogs ko'u rī zhing dbyug dkar: lho phyogs tso'u rī mda' 'gengs ser: nub phyogs pra mo chu srin dmar: byang phyogs be ta bhan dmar ljang : shar lhor puska rgyu 'dren ser: lho nub kusma bhan dmar ljang : nub byang tsan+ta rgyu za ser: byang shar sme sha ro za mthing : ska rī la sogs ma mo brgyad: zhing chen gdan la gar stabs 'gying : ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgoms: o badz+ra ko'u rī ha: o badz+ra tso'u rī ha: o badz+ra dra mo tī ha: i badz+ra be ta lī ha: o badz+ra puska

jug /sī ha: o badz+ra kusma rī ha: o badz+ra tsan+ta lī ha: i badz+ra sme sha nī ha:de nas seng ha ma brgyad bskyed pa ni: lha: bdag nyid che mchog yab yum gyi: thugs nas te brgyad 'phros nas zhu: dkyil 'khor khyams kyi shar phyogs su: seng ha seng gdong ro za smug: dkyil 'khor khyams kyi lho phyogs su: byu kri stag gdong lag bsnol dmar: dkyil 'khor khyams kyi nub phyogs su: sri la wa gdong spu gri nag: dkyil 'khor khyams kyi byang phyogs su: shā na spyang gdong ro thogs mthing : rang snang dkyil 'khor shar lho'i khyams: kyi ha bya rgod rgyu 'dren ser: rang snang dkyil 'khor lho nub khyams: kang kā dur bya zhing phrag dmar: rang snang dkyil 'khor nub byang khyams: khu kha bya rog bhan gri nag: rang snang

dkyil 'khor byang shar khyams: hu lu lug gdong lcags kyu mthing : seng ha ma mo brgyad rnams kyang : zhing chen gdan la gar stabs 'gying : snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: i badz+ra sidha mu khā 'o: i badz+ra byā kri mu khā te: i badz+ra sri la mu khā te: o badz+ra shwa na mu khā te: i badz+ra kṛ ta mu khā he: o badz+ra gaṅka mu khā te: i badz+ra kha khā mu khā te: o badz+ra hu lu mu khā he: de nas sgo ma bzhi bskyed pa ni: :: che mchog rigs bzhi'i thugs ka nas: dzaḥbhū baṃ hoḥ'abru bzhi 'phros: 'bru bzhi 'od du zhu ba las: shar du rta gdong lcags kya dkar: lho ru phag gdong zhags pa ser: nub tu seng gdong lcags sgrog dmar: byang du sbrul gdong dril bu ljang : tshad med bzhi ldan

༄sto /sgo ma bzhi: zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: gar stabs 'gying bag tshul du bzhugs: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom:oṃ badz+ra e ku sha dza: i badz+ra pā sha lha: o badz+ra sbo ṭa bo: o badz+ra gan+dhe ho: de nas dbang phyug nyer brgyad bskyed pa ni: rdzu: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs ka nas: 'od zer nyer brgyad bh+yo 'phros pas: rim par bh+yo nyid 'od zhu bas: shar phyogs zhi ba'i las byed bdun: srin mo g.yag gdong rdo rje smug: tshangs pa sbrul gdong pad+ma ser: lha chen gzig gdong tri shul ljang : gtogs 'dod sre gdong 'khor lo sngo: gzhon nu dred gdong mdung thung dam/ra: brgya byin dom mgo rgyu zhags dkar: zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: lho ru rgyas pa'i las byed bdun: rdo rje

pha wang spu gri ser: zhi ba chu srin bum pa dmar: bdud rtsi sdig gdong pad+ma dmar: zla ba khra mgo rdo rje dkar: be con wa gdong dbyung to ljang : srin mo stag gdong thod khrag nag: zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: nub tu dbang gi las byed bdun: za ba bya rgod be con ljang : dga' ba rta gdong khog chen dmar: stobs chen khyung gdong dbyug to dkar: srin mo khyi gdong rdo rje dmar: 'dod pa pu shud dma' 'gengs dmar: nor srung sha mgo bum pa ljang : zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: byang du drag po'i las byed bdun: rlung lha spyang gdong ba dan ljang : mi mo skyin gdong gsal shing dmar: phag mo phag gdong mche zhags nag: rdo rje khwa gdong zhing chung dmar:

༄sha /sna chen glang chen bam chen ljang : chu lha sbrul gdong sbrul zhags ljang : zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: dkyil 'khor phyi rim shar sgo ru: rdo rje khu byug lcags kyu dkar: dkyil 'khor phyi rim lho sgo ru: rdo rje ra gdong zhags pa ser: dkyil 'khor phyi rim nub sgo ru: rdo rje seng gdong lcags sgrog dmar: dkyil 'khor phyi rim byang sgo ru: rdo rje sprul gdong dril bu ljang : zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang : ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgoms: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: phyi snod gzhal yas khang chen nyid: nang bcud lha dang lha mor gsal:

rang nyid lha la lha nyid rang : dbyer med du ma ro gcig gnas: dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: snang ba rang bzhin med par bsgoms:bde gshegs zhi khro'i sgom khog 'diḥ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed thol bskyed dang ཿ 'bru bskyed bum bskyed gang byed kyang : sgom khog blo la byang ba gces: zhi khro 'dus pa'i sgom khog tshor ba rang grol zhes bya baḥs ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ bdun pa lha tshogs spyan 'dren pa niḥ seng ge'i nga ros 'di skad doḥ rdu: dpe med bsam brjod bral ba'i dbus phyogs su: bla ma rin chen kun bzang chos kyi sku: nyag gcig gsal dag mtha' bral lu gu rgyud: lhun grub ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor du: nyon mongs lnga dag sku lngar 'du 'bral med: 'gro don yid snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir byon: i gu ru badz+ra yaṃ ku sha dzaḥlha: :: dpe med bsam brjod bral ba'i phyogs lnga ru: bla ma kun bzang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes lnga dang ldan: phung lnga rnam dag bcom ldan rigs lnga

༄sha /yab: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum mchog lnga dang sbyor: sku gsum yon tan gsal la 'gags pa med: tshogs brgyad gnas dag byang chub sems dpa' brgyad: yul brgyad gnas dag sems ma chen mo brgyad: rigs lnga (bzhi )yab yum gtso 'bor grangs med tshogs: 'gro don yid snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir byon: o āḥrdu: o hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ sbyi lī māṃ māṃ rta: e ku sha dzaḥlha: lha: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i phyogs mtshams nas: 'gro don rdzogs mdzad thub pa drug rnams dang : tshad med bzhi ldan rtag chad nu bzhi bral: phrin las 'gro don sgo ba yab yum brgyad: 'gro don yid snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir byon: zhi khro dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen por 'dir: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa

gnyis spyan 'dren no: 'gro kun byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: sa ma ya: de nas khro bo'i lha tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni: gyi ling mtsher skad dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: lha: sangs rgyas kun kyi rang bzhin sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal: bcom ldan dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru ma: gnyis med yul chen gro ti shwa rī 'khril: nyon mongs 'joms phyir khrag 'thung sprul 'khor bcas: 'gro don yid snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir byon: lha: sangs rgyas kun kyi rang bzhin sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal: bcom ldan dpal chen rigs lnga he ru ga: gnyis med yul chen gro ti shwa rī lnga: dug lnga 'joms phyir khrag 'thung sprul 'khor bcas: 'gro don yid

༄dzo /snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir byon: lha: sangs rgyas kun kyi rang bzhin sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las bsgrub mdzad pa'i: ko'u rī la sogs gnas bdag ma mo brgyad: sing ha la sogs yul bdag phra men brgyad: rta gdong la sogs ye shes sgo ma bzhi: dkyil 'khor mu ran dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: bka' srung gter bdag dam can chos skyong tshogs: 'gro don yid sna nga dag pa'i gnas 'dir byon: 'gro kun byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol: rdu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ sbyi: lhu hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ lha: ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha: he he te he he he he te: dzaḥbhū baṃ ho: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: bh+yo

bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: sa ma ya: badz+ra e ku sha dza: dzaḥlha bam̐ ho: khro bo khrag 'thung spyan 'dren le'u'o: sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gtad rgya: sbas rgyaḥ zab rgyaḥ brgyad pa lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol ba ni: chu bo'i rgyun dbyangs ring pos 'di skad do: rdu: sgyu ma gzugs brnyan chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : seng ge glang chen rta mchog rma bya dang : shang thang rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: chos sku kun bzang sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las lnga yi rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: bcom ldan dpal chen rigs lnga yab yum bcu: sems dpa' sems ma bcu drug 'khor dang bcas: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: lha: sgyu ma gzugs brnyan chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : sna

jug /tshogs rin chen nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : kun bzang zhi rgyas dbang drag cho 'phrul las: tshad med bzhi ldan lcags kyu zhags pa dang :lcags sgrog dril bu mu bzhi gnas dag pa'i: rnam thar brgyad ldan sgo ba yab yum brgyad: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: lha: sgyu ma gzugs brnyan chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : rin chen nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i steng : chos sku kun bzang zag med cho 'phrul las: 'gro ba'i rnam rtog rigs drug rtsad gcod phyir: bcom ldan thub drug lha tshogs dpag med 'phros: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: e yaṃ baṃ lam̐ bh+yo: rat+na maṇ+ḍa la: po nga/d+ma maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+t+ra maṇ+ḍa la: ma srur+ya

maṇ+ḍa la: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha wāPROBPROB PROBPROB PROBPROBPROB rgyas zhi ba'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu gnyis: rang snang gnas yul dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du: phyogs mtsham sa rang rang bzhugs pa'i gdan khri la: chu nyid la ni chu nyid thim pa ltar: du ma so sor snang yang ngo bor gcig: gnyis med rang bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol: o āḥrdu: rdu hūm̐ hūm̐ :: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: khrag 'thung lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol ba ni: lha: zhi ba longs sku'i rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: dug lnga 'joms pa'i lha tshogs dpag med 'phros: bcos ldan phrag 'thung che mchog he ru ma: gro ti shwa rī dbyings phyug yum dang 'khril: sprul pa'i khrag 'thung rigs lnga he ru ku: shes rab dbyings phyug kro ti lnga dang 'khril: yab yum sras dang bka' sdod sprul

sngag /'khor bcas: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: lha: khro rgyal sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i lha: rang snang dbang po tshogs brgyad gnas dag pa'i: ko'u ri la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol:sbyi: khrag 'thung sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i lha: rang snang dbang po yul brgyad gnas dag pa'i: seng ha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad: rang snang dag pa 'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: rgyu: khrag 'thung rigs bzhi'i thugs las sprul pa'i lha: tshad med bzhi ldan ye shes sgo ma bzhi: phyogs bzhir zhing rkyang rang rang gdan steng du: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: :: khrag 'thung sku

gsung thugs las spru' pa'i lha: dkyil 'khor phyi rim mu ran skyong mdzad ma: sprul pa'i las mdzad dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: lha: sgyu ma smig rgyu chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin: rang las byung zhing rang byung rang thim ltar: gnyis med zung 'jug dbyer med chen po ru: du ma ro gcig brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sgro e yaṃ baṃ lam̐ sgro: rat+na tsakra sti ra bo: pe pad+ma snyi ra ya:ma srur+ya sti ra bo: a tsan+d+ra sti ra bo: o āḥlha: o āḥ:: o āḥlha: : tsū lha: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dgu nga lha la gus phyag 'tshal ba ni:stag chung bung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: lha: yid shes rnam dag kun tu bzang po yab: chos khams rnam dag kun tu bzang mo yum: dus gsum

༄ga /sangs rgyas kun kyi spyi mes lha: kun bzang yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo: lhu: gzugs phung rnam dag bcos ldan rnam snang mdzad: rnam shes rnam dag bcom ldan rdo rje sems: tshor ba rnam dag bcom ldan rin chen 'byung : 'du shes rnam dag bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: 'du byed rnam dag bcom ldan don yod grub: phung lnga rnam dag ye shes lnga dang ldan: longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: rdu: nam mkha' rnam dag yum mchog dbyings phyug maḥ sa khams rnam dag yum mchogs sangs rgyas spyan: chu khams rnam dag yum mchog mā ma khri: me khams rnam dag yum mchog na bza' dkar: rlung khams rnam dag
