yum mchog dam tshig sgrol: khams lnga rnam dag bde chen yab la sbyor: gsang ba'i yum mchog bde ster rigs lnga la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: lha: tshogs brgyad gnas dag byang chub sems dpa' brgyad: sa snying byams pa kun bzang nam mkha'i snying :spyan gzigs 'jam dpal sgrib sel phyag rdor brgyad: sems dpa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: nye ba'i sras mchog sems dpa' brgyad rnams la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: rgyu: yul brgyad gnas dag sems ma chen mo brgyad: lnga gye put+pa mā le 6spru maḥ gīrti ā lo gan+dhe rmārti brgyad: sems ma'i sar gnas dgyes pa skong mdzad ma: gsang ba'i lha mo sems ma brgyad rnams la: rang snang

mug /gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: lha: nyon mongs drug dag rigs drug gnas nas 'dren: brgya byin thag bzang shāka thub seng ge brtan: kha 'bar chos rgyal rigs drug dong nas sprugs: 'gro ba'i don byed mdzad pa bsam mi khyab: sprul pa'i sku mchog thub pa drus rnams la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: rgyu: mu bzhi gnas dag tshad med bzhi dang ldan: rnam rgyal gshin rje rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma: sgo ba yab yum brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya : lhu: ma rig rtsad gcod che mchog he ru ma: gro ti shwa rī dbyings phyug yum dang sbyor: khrag 'thung rje btsan che mchog yab yum la: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag

'tshal lo: sbyi: gti mug rtsad gcod bud+dha he ru ga: zhe snang rtsad gcod badz+ra he ru sa: nga rgyal rtsad gcod rat+na he ru ga: 'dod chags rtsad gcod pad+ma he ru ku: phrag dog rtsad gcod kurma he ru ga: dbyings kyi yul chen kro ti lnga dang sbyor: khrag 'thung khro bo yab yum bcu rnams la: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: sbyi: rnam rtog gzhom phyir khro mo ko'u rī ma: thabs shes gnyis med khro mo tso'u rī ma:'khor bar mi gtong khro mo pra mo hā: chos nyid 'gyur med khro mo be ta mā: nyon mongs gnas 'dren khro mo puska sbi: 'khor ba zhal gsol khro mo kusma dri: log rtog phral mdzad khro mo tsan+dha bī: rten dang phral phyir khro mo sme sha rmā: gnas kyi ko'u rī ma mo brgyad rnams la: gnyis su med

༄sto /pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: lha: 'khor ba ka dag sidha mu khā ma: 'khor ba zhe gnon byā kri mu khā ma: nyon mongs gnas dag sri la mu khā ma: 'khor ba dong sprugs shwa na mu khā ma: dug gsum rtsad gcod kṛ ta mu khā ma: 'khor ba dang len shaṅka mu khā ma: nyon mongs gsol phyir kha khā mu khā ma: log rtog phral phyir hu lu mu khā ma: yul bdag sing ha phra men brgyad rnam/sa la: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: rdu: snying rjes 'dren phyir rta gdong ñtsa gas kyu ma: byams pas 'ching phyir phag gdong zhags pa ma: dga' bas sdom phyir seng gdong lcags sgrog ma: btang snyoms 'bebs phyir sprul gdong dril bu ma: tshad med bzhi ldan sgo ma bzhi rnams la: gnyis su med pa'i tshul

gyis phyag 'tshal lo: lhu: dkar mo nyon mongs zhi ba'i las mdzad bdun: ser mo sku gsum rgyas pa'i las mdzad bdun: dmar mo mchog dang thun mong dbang sdud bdunaḥ ljang gu drag po'i phrin las sgrub mdzad bdun: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad la: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo: lha: chos sku nam mkha' lta bur kun la khyab: longs sku nyi 'od lta bur so sor 'phro: sprul sku 'ja' tshon lta bur 'gro don mjordod: rgyal ba zhi khro'i byonas/sa la phyag 'amyodrol lo: sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ bcu pa phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul ba niḥ dang ngo phyi mchod rdo rje dril stabs kyis: chu bo'i rgyun dbyangs snyan pos 'di skad doḥ sbyi: srid par gtogs pa'i me tog sna tshogs rigs: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing gsal mdangs dang ldan: dngos

༄sna /su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med me tog kun: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: snang stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: i āḥ badz+ra puspe sa: lha: srid par gtogs pa'i bdug spos sna tshogs rigs: tsan+dan du ru ka dang a ka ru: srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med ngad ldan spos: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: tshor stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: o āḥbadz+ra sbruspru sbyi: sbyi: srid par gtogs pa'i snang gsal sna tshogs rigs:'bru mar rtsi mar shing ras 'od kyi mdangs: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing gsal mdangs chen 'od: srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med

snang gsal kun: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: gsal stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: o āḥbadz+ra ā lo ke sbyi: lha: srid par gtogs pa'i dri chab sna tshogs rigs: 'o ma chu sna rtsi dgu sbyar ba'i chu: rang byung rang shar byug pa bde byed tshogs: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: bde stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: i āḥbadz+ra garnye lha: sbyi: srid par gtogs pa'i zhal zas sna tshogs rigs: rang byung lhan cis skyes dang sbyar ba'i zas: rtsi bcud zhal zas 'bru sman sna tshogs kun: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnams sprul te: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul:

༄gi /myong stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: o āḥbadz+ra nai wir+ya :: :: srid par gtogs pa'i rol mo sna tshogs rigs: rnga ting g.yer kha dril bu rdza rnga dung : 'byung lnga'i rang sgra glu gar rol mo dbyangs: dngos 'byor yid sprul dpag med sgra snyan kun: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: grags stong 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: i ā ཿbadz+ra shabha lha: lha: bla ma kun bzang rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs:dpag med nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs la: dag pa rnam gsum yid kyis mchod pa'i sprin: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: snang stong rig stong gsal stong bde stong dang : dran stong grags stong tshor stong mchod pa'i tshogs: me tog bdug spos dri zhal rol mor bcas:

bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol: o badz+ra praḍū duspru ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wir+ya shabha pū tsa ho: nge nas nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: rol mo sna tshogs sgro gas la 'di skad do: ྈ: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshos/sa bcas la: lha rdzas nang mchod 'bul ba ni: lha: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul gzugs mchod 'di: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: o āḥbadz+ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha sa:sbyi: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul sgra mchod 'di: kun bzang zhi khro'i

sngag /tshogs la 'bul: i āḥbadz+ra shabha lha: lha: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul dri mchod kun: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: o āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe sbyi: lha: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul zhal zas kun: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: o āḥbadz+ra nai wir+ya lha: lha: snod bcud snang srid thams cang kun: rdo rje reg ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul reg bya'i tshogs: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: i āḥbadz+ra sparnye lha: sbyi: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje chos ma'i tshogs sprul nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul dpag

med kun: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: o āḥbadz+ra dharme sa: de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul pa ni: pa da bskor phyag rgya ldan pas 'di skad doḥ sbyi: gsang mchog sku yi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog dkar mdzes me long pad+ma bsnams: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: o āḥbadz+ra dar+sha sbyi: rgyu:gsang mchog gsung gi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog dmar mdzes rnga zlum sgra sgrogs ma: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: o āḥbadz+ra mu rartse sbyi: lha: gsang mchog thugs kyi bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog mthing

)sna /mdzes pi wang sgra sgrogs ma: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: o āḥbadz+ra wi ni lha: lha: gsang mchog yon tan bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog ser mdzes cang zhil sgra sgrogs ma: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul : gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod nga/ bzhes su gsol: i āḥbadz+ra waṃ se lha: :: gsang mchog phrin las bde chen rig ma ni: sku mdog ljang mdzes rdza rnga'i sgra sgrogs ma: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: gsang mchog bde ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: i āḥbadz+ra me dhe ke lha:sa ma ya:rgya rgya rgya:bzhi pa sman raka gtor gsu ma 'bul ba ni:dang po bdud rtsi blangs la 'di skad doḥ lha: rigs lnga yab yum gnyis kyis rgyu

byas te: sku lnga ye shes lnga yis rkyen byas nas: thabs shes rgyu la ma 'gags rkyen sbyar ba'i: dam pa rigs brgya'i 'bru bcud bdud rtsi 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: o āḥbhū sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: lha tshogs kun la rkang thon du 'bur bar bya'o:dam pa rigs brgya'i so so'i mtshan zhabs su a sbo ta khā hi btags la 'bul: rgyal kun spyi myes kun bzang rdo rje 'chang : rdo rjes sems dpa' dga' rab shrī seng : u rgyan yab yum rje 'bangs lo paṇa dang : karma gling pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥ:: nyi zla chos rje nyi zla 'od zer mtshan: nam mkha'i mtshan sogs bka' babs brgyud ldan gyi: rtsa brgyud bla ma skyabs mchog kun 'dus dngos: drin chen bla ma'i zhal

sngag /du oṃ āḥlha: 'khor 'das dmigs med sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sprin: zhi ba rdor dbyings 'bar ba khrag 'thung dang : dag pa rig 'dzin 'kha' 'gro chos skyong bcas: mchod par 'os rnams zhal du oṃ āḥ:: de nas bdud rtsi dngos grub blang ba ni: :: rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun: mtshan dang ldan pa dbyings kyi bhan+dha ru: ye shes lnga ldan rigs 94 'i bdud rtsi 'khyil: snying po med la dngos grub snying po blang :kā ya sid+dhi o: wak+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sirnyi :: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: gnyis pa rak+ta blangs la 'di skad do: :: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru bsgral ba'i khrag: snang stong gsal stong bde stong dran stong dang : gnyis med 'dzin bral gsang ba'i khrag chen 'di: bla ma kun bzang

zhi bro'i tshogs la 'bul: i āḥdh+riḥm hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: lha tshogs rnams kyi mtshan gyi mthar rak+ta khā hi btags la 'bul: gsum pa gtor ma 'bul ba 'di skad do: i āḥlha: gzugs phung rnam das bhan+dha ru: tshor ba rnam dag gtor chen bshams/: 'du shes rnam dag theb kyus bskor: 'du byed rnam dag rgyan gyis brgyan: rnam shes rnam dag gtor chen po: kun bzang chos kyi sku la 'bul: e:stong nga/ 'gag med bhan+dha ru: gsal ba ye shes gtor chen bshams: thugs rjes 'u/sa/ brgyud gtor rgyan spras: zhi ba longs spyod rdzogs la 'bul: o āḥlha: phyi snod 'jig rten gtor gzhod du: nang bcud sems can gtor ma bshams: rtsi bcud 'bras bu sman gyis brgyan: zhi khro sprul nga/'i sku la 'bul: o āḥlha:gu ru dhe wa

sngag /ḍāk+ki nī ma hā ba dzi ta grihā kha kha khā hi khā hi: o āḥlha:bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhartu ā: o ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo rgyu: e rda bha li ta kṛ hā 9pre khas ta/ /ste ta/ /he: gzhan yang lha tshogs thams cad kyi mtshan gyi mthar bha li ta khā hi btags la 'bul bar bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rga rgya: bcu gcig pa bstod pa bya ba la bzhi ste: dang po kun tu bzang po'i don bstod ni: chu bo'i gnyer dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: o:bla ma kun bzang chos kyi sku: mtshan ma tshig bral zang thal sku: bsam brjod yul 'das kun bzang mo: dug lnga rang grol ye shes sku: nyas/ gcig mtha' bral lu gu brgyud: kun bzang yab yum sku la bstod: āḥ grags stong rang byung chos kyi gsung : sgra grags stong pa cir mi dgongs: sna tshogs rang grags dmigs gtad bral: rjes su 'dzin pa'i dngos ngo sa stong :

'gro 'dul gsung mchog cir yang ston: kun bzang yab yum gsung la bstod: sbyi: rang rig dran stong gdos bcas bral: sna tshogs shar grol 'asags pa med: dngos med dngos bral gzung yul bral: dgongs pa gnas yul rang sar grol: dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med thugs: kun bzang yab yu/ma thugs la bstod: sā: thams cad ma btsal gzhi la rdzogs: lhun grub 'od gsal 'od dpag med: bsam brjod dpe bral yon tan rdzogs: kun bzang yab yum yon tan bstod: hā: thugs rje'i rang 'od ye shes rgyas: ma btsal rdzogs ldan thig le'i sku: dpag med phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal: kun bzang yab yum phrin las bstod: sanyis pa ye shes lnga la bstod pa ni: lha lha: rig pa zang

sngag /thal 'od kyi sku: nyag gcig gsal 'tsher lu gu rgyud: 'gyu 'phrig dngos med ngo bos stong : stong pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od gsal:gsal ba'i thugs rje 'gag pa med: zhe sdang rang grol dkar gsal dang : me long lta bu'i ye shes la: gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nas bstod: lha sa: rig pa zang thal 'od kyi sku: nyag gcig gsal 'tsher lu gu rgyud: 'gyu 'phrig dngos med ngo bos stong : stong pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od gsal: gsal ba'i thugs rje 'gag pa med: nga rgyal rang grol ser gsal ngang : mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la: gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nas bstod: sbyi āḥ rig pa zang thal 'od kyi sku: nyag gcig gsal 'tsher lu gu rgyud: 'gyu 'phrig dngos med ngo bos

stong : stong pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od gsal: gsal ba'i thugs rje 'gag pa med: 'dod chags rang grol dmar gsal ngang : so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la: gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nas bstod: rdu hāḥ rig pa zang thal 'od kyi sku: nyag gcig gsal 'tsher lu gu rgyud:'gyu 'phrig dngos med ngo bos stong : stong pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od gsal: gsal ba'i thugs rje 'gag pa med: phrag dog rang grol ljang gsal ngang : bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la: sa/zung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nas bstod: lha o: rig pa zang thal 'od kyi sku: nyag gcig gsal 'tsher lu gu rgyud: 'gyu 'phrig dngos med ngo bos stong : stong pa'i rang bzhin rang 'od gsal: gsal ba'i thugs rje 'gags pa med:

༄sna /gti mug rang grol mthing gsal ngang : chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la: gzung 'dzin bral ba'i ngang nas bstod: gsum pa zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa sanyis laḥ dngas pa'i sem sa kyis bsto da pa bya ba ni: i: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag nga/'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs/ pa'i cho 'phrul las: zhe sdang rnam shes rang grol me long sku: mthing gsal mdangs ldan longs spyod rdzogs nga/'i dpa la: sna tshogs 'dzin bral rdo rje sems dpa' shar: thabs shes gnyis med sa khams spyan mar 'khril: glang chen khri/ rkang nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : dug lnga ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i tshul:mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul zhi ba'i sku: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs: yab kyi cha 'dzin sa snying byams pa

dkar: yum gyi cha 'dzin lā su puspe ma: ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i gtso 'khor drug: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod:i: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag pa'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i cho 'phrul las: nga rgyal tshor ba rang grol mnyam nyid sku:ser gsal mdangs ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal: gsal stong 'dzin bral rin chen 'byung ldan shar: thabs shes gnyis med chu khams mā kir sbyor: rta mchog khri rkang nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : dug lnga ma spang gnas su dag pa'i tshul: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon nu bum pa can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs: yab kyi cha 'dzin kun bzang nam snying dang : yum gyi cha 'dzin mā le sbruspru

༄ga /ma: ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i gtso 'khor drug: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: o: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag pa'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i cho 'phrul las: 'dod chags 'du shes rang grol sor rtogs sku: dmar gsal mdangs ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal: bde stong 'dzin bral snang ba mtha' yas shar: thabs shes gnyis med me khams gos dkar sbyor: rma bya khri rkang nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : dug lnga ma spang gnas su dag pa'i tshul: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon nu bum pa can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs: yab kyi cha 'dzin spyan gzigs 'jam dpal dang : yum gyi cha 'dzin gīrti ā lo ke: ma bcos lhun

gyis grub pa'i gtso 'khor drug: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: o: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam ngag pa'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i cho 'phrul las: phrag dog 'du byed rang grol bya grub sku: lngang gsal mdangs ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal: grags stong 'dzin bral don yod grub pa shar: thabs shes gnyis med rlung khams sgrol mar sbyor: shang shang khri rkang nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : dug lnga ma spang gnas su dag pa 'i tshul: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon nu bum pa can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs: yab gyi cha 'dzin sgrib sel phyag rdor dang : yum gyi cha 'dzin garnye rmārti ma: ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa 'i gtso 'khor drug:

༄sha /yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: i: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag pa'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i cho 'phrul las: gti mug gzugs phung rang grol chos dbyings sku: dkar gsal mdangs ldan longs spyod rdzogs ngage 'i dpal: dran stong 'dzin bral rnam par snang mdzad shar: thabs shes gnyis med nam mkha'i dbyings phyug sbyor: seng chen khri rkang nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : dug lnga ma spang gnas su dag pa'i tshul: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul zhi ba'i sku: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs: rigs bzhi yab yum sems dpa' sems mar bcas: yab yum sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: oḥ gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag

pa'i: kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i cho 'phrul las: nyon drug rang grol sprul sku thub drug shar: brgya byin thag bzang shākya thub pa dang :seng ge rab brtan kha 'bar chos kyi rgyal: rnam rgyal gshin rje dbang chen bdud rtsi 'khyil: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrogs dril bu ma:bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba'i thugs dam can: 'od kyi lus la ye shes snying po can: stong gsal mdangs lnga ldan la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas gdung dbyangs snyan po sa bstod pa ra bya: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi don bstod chen mo'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgyaḥ bzhi pa khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la: don bsto da chen mos gus par bstod pa niḥ la sa tu rnga chen thogs la rngams pa'i dbyangs: bgyings dang ngar du ldan pas 'di skad do: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: chos sku zhi ba'i rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: nyon mongs 'joms mdzad khrag 'thung he ru ga: mthu rtsal thogs med dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: thabs mchog sku la shes

sngag /rab khro mo 'khril: rlu tra pho mo rin chen khri rkang dang : byol song pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng : theg nga/ rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa: sgog pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang : nod dang gshe dang 'jigs par ston pa dang : snying rje rngams dang zhi ba la sogs/ pa: bcom ldan dpal chen 'khor 'das rdzogs la bstodaḥ dhūḥ snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cho 'phrul las: gti mug 'joms mdzad bud+dha he ru ku: bud+dha gro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: byol so/nga rū tra nga/d+ma nyi zla'i steng : gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad dang : theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa: sku mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal

bstod: lha: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba longs sku'i thugs kyi cho 'phrul las: zhe sdang 'joms mdzad badz+ra he ru ku: badz+ra gro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: byol song rū tra pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad dang : theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa: thugs mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba longs/ sku'i yon tan cho 'phrul las: nga rgyal 'joms mdzad rat+na he ru ga: rat+na kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: byol song rū tra pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad dang : theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa: yon tan he ru ka la

sngag /phyag 'tshal bstod: lha: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba longs sku'i gsung gi cho 'phrul las: 'dod chags 'joms mdzad pad+ma he ru ma: pad+ma kro ti gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: byor song ru tra pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad dang : theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa: gsung mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung dkyil 'khor du: zhi ba longs sku'i phrin las cho 'phrul las: phrag dog 'joms mdzad kurma he ru ma: karma gro ti gnyis/ med dgyes par 'khril: byol song rū tra pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : gar gyi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad dang : theg pa rim dgu rdzogs pa'i

skur bstan pa/: phrin las he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: :: sgog pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang : rnod dang gshe dang 'jigs nga ra ston pa dang : snying rje rngams dang zhi ba gar dgur ldan: thal chen rak+ta zhag gi zo ris dang : ko rlon g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thams dang : thod phreng sbrul chun me dpung chas dgus brgyan: gar gi nyams dgu dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha:zhi ba longs sku'i rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: ha ha phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dkyil 'khor nas: thugs rje sprul pa'i cha 'dzin ko'u rī brgyad: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'i cho 'phrul las: ko'u rī tso'u rī pra mo be ta āḥ puska kusma sme sha tsan+ta bī: sku mdog phyag

sngag /mtshan cir yang ston cing bsgyur: phrin las ko'u rī brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: he te: shar lho nub byang phyogs mtshams dkyil 'bor nas: thugs rje sprul nga/'i cha 'dzin seng ha brgyad: rnam shes yul brgyad dag pa'i cho 'phrul las: seng ha byā kri sri la shwa na ma: kṛ ta kyang kā kha khā hu lu ma: sku mdog phyag mtshan mgo brnyan ston cing bsgyur: zhi rgyas dbang drag rang rtags phrin las rnams: mdzad pa'i seng ha brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzaḥsbyi: shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi nas: rta gdong phag gdong seng gdong sbrul gdong ma: snying rje byams pa dga' ba btang snyoms tshul: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma: 'gugs 'chings sdoms dgyes rang rang phrin las

kun: mdzad pa'i sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ dkar mo chen mo zhi ba'i las byed bdun: ser mo chen mo rgyas pa'i las byed bdun: dmar mo chen mo dbang gi las byed bdunaḥ ljang mo chen mo drag po'i las byed bdun: sprul pa'i mabo brnyan phyag mtshan ston cing bsgyur: dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pa rgyal ba zhi gro'i lca tshosas la ཿ bstod nga sazhan yang ci bder bstod na le gas: sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgya: de nas bcu gnyis pa bshags pa bya ba niḥ gnong 'gyod drag ngo 'i se mas kyis 'di skad doḥ o āḥsbyi: bla ma kun bzang chos kyi sku: nyag gcig zang thal longs spyod rdzogs: shar grol 'gag med sprul pa'i sku: rgyal ba zhi khro sprul 'khor dgongs: bdag dang 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyis: gti mug 'khrul

༄gi /sems dpag med blangs pa nas: da lta tshe 'di'i lus blangs yan chad du: rig dang ma rig 'khrul pa'i las dbang gis: sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig chags nyams 'gal 'khrul gyur pa kun: mi gsang mi sbed gnong 'gyod mthol lo bshags: klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par gsol: o badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭhaḥ dri ḍho me bha wa: su tosto me bha wa: a nu rasto me bha wa: su posto me bha wa: sarba sirnyizlem yats+tsha: sarba kurma su tsa me: tsin+ti shri ya: ku ru lha: ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga ldan:sarba ta thā ga ta: baja( mā me muñtsa: bajirdo bha wa: ma hā sa ma ya satwa aḥ gzhan yang zhi khro'i lta ba'i klong bshags sogs: rgyas bsdus gang 'os ska bas dang bstu na la bshags:zhi khro 'dus nga 'i las byang tshor ba rang grol gyi dngos gzhi'i las kyi rim pa i thi: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bcu ba/sum pa tshogs kyi las rim bcu yis bstan: 'gegs bskrad bsang sbyangs spyan 'dren mchod bshags

bsgralaḥ zhal du bsta ba rol yar gnas mar gnas bcuḥ 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad dngos su bshamasaḥ bsang chu 'thor zhing thos ma ra bgegs bskrad ni: :: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: lus ngag sems la gnod byed pa'i: dug lnga dug gsum rnam rtog bgegs: nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'dreḥ khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'dre bo che: lan chags gnas 'dir ma 'dug par: nga yi bka' las khyod ma 'da': rang rang gnas su myur du dengs: lha hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: gnyis pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa/ niḥ bhūḥ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpar gsal: sems dpa'i skur gsal thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor byin gyis brlab pa yi: o dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing 'phros: zhal zas dngos ngo/ thams/ cad kun: o āḥlha

༄ga /gsum ngo bor gyur: gzhan yang phyi nang snod bcud kyi: zhal zas bcud ldan ro mchog rnams: yi ge gsum gyi ngo bor gyur: yi ge gsum las me 'bar bas: tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin dri ma bsreg: me yi shugs las rlung byung bas: tshogs kyi bag chags rnam rtog gtor: me rlung 'thab pas chu byung bas: tshogs kyi gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog bkrus: o āḥsbyi: ro yaṃ kho: me dang rlung dang chu dang gsum: 'od du ltem gyis zhu ba las: sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi ni: dka/ra dmar mthing ga gsum du gyur: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs: mnyes mchod bdud rtsi chen por gyur: i āḥrgyu: lhu hūm̐ hrīḥha hoḥ gsum pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa 'di ska da do: :: 'og min chos dbyings pho

brang nas: chos sku kun tu bzang po la: rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dag pa dbyings kyi gzhal yas nas: yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: so so'i rigs kyi tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mo nas: u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la: rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: u rgyan rang byung dur khrod nas: mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo la: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho la: so so'i rigs kyis tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs/

༄༅na /la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: de nas tshogs phud rim pa gsum du bcad byas la: tshogs phud dang po mchod pa 'di skad do: lha: bla ma kun bzang thig le'i sku: nyag gcig zang thal longs spyod rdzogs: cir mi dgongs pa sprul pa'i sku: rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhi khro'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprul 'khor bcas: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: tshogs phud bar pa'i bshags pa 'di skad do: lhu: bdag cag 'khor ba'i sems gzhi blangs pa nas: tha ma da lta'i dus 'di yan chad du: rig dang ma rig bag chags dbang gyur pas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnams: zhal zas tshogs 'bul bskang zhing bshags par bgyi: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par stsal du gsol: yi be brgya pa na rag la so gas 'don: skabs 'dir zhi khro'i mdangs bska nga la sogs dang : bskang bshags gzhan yang ci rigs bklag par bya: tshogs phud tha ma bsgral zhing bstab pa ni: tshogs zan nya bo hom khung nang du bcug: bdag nyid che mchog sku ra bsgom

bden sto bas brjod: dgug gzhug lan gsum rjes la 'di skad do: lha bh+yo: mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs mdzad pa: drag ngo/'i phrin la sa mdzad pa'i dus la bab: mi mngon dbyings nas bdag gi grogs la byon: dang po bla srog rten la bkug pa ni: lha: khrag 'thung sku yi lha tshogs thugs dam can: drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus 'a/ bab: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan rnams: bla srog rnam shes rten la myur du khug: o bud+dha kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: dgra bgegs dz+ra tri e ku sha dza: hoḥ dpal chen po bhud+dha he ru ma'i lha tshogs

)sto /'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di rnams skad cig nyid la myur du khug cig: gnyis pa lha dang phral ba ni: sbyi: khrag 'thung thugs kyi lha tshogs thugs dam can: drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di: mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha dang phral bar gyis: o badz+ra gro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka lha:phaṭa: a mṛ trag rak+ta mā ra ya phyes: ma ma trag rū tra mā ra ya phyes: ho: dpal chen po badz+ra he ru ku'i lha tshogs rnams kyis yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di rnams mgon skyabs byed pa'i lha dang phral bar gyis shig: gsum pa byad du bcug pa niḥ sbyi: khrag 'thung yon tan lha tshogs thugs dam can: drag

po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la babs: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di: lus ngag yid gsum gru gu thul du chings: o rat+na kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: dgra bgegs dz+ra tri a pa na ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ho dpal chen po rat+na he ru ku'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs 'di lus ngag yid gsum gru gu thul du byad du chug cig: bzhi pa satun tu brdung ba ni: sbyi: khrag 'thung gsung gi lha tshogs thugs dam can: drag ngo/'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyis: i pad+ma kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: dgra bgegs ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ho: dpal chen po pad+ma he ru

mug /ku'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di rnams rdo rje tho bas rdul du brlag par gyis shig: lnga pa smyo rugazhug pa ni: :: khrag 'thung phrin las lha tshogs thugs dam can: drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di: lus dgra yid gsum smyo zhing brgyal du chug: o kurma gro ta ma hā he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: dgra bgegs dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ho: dpal chen po kurma he ru ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs las ngan 'di rnams smyo zhing brgyal nas rengs su chug cig: drug pa pho nya bskul zhing bsgral ba ni: sbyi bh+yoḥ phog par rgyob cig ma mo ko'u rī ma: snying la gzir zhig ma mo tso'u rī ma: dbang

du bsdus shig ma mo pra mo ha: glo snying phyungs shig ma mo be ta bī: rgyu zhags drongs shig ma mo puska sbi: snying khras 'thung zhig ma mo kusma 'i:tsit+ta phyung cig ma mo sme sha ni: mgo lus phrol zhig ma mo tsan+ta mā: sha la rol zhig phra men sedha ma: rus pa 'cho zhis phra men byā kri ma: wags rlon bshus shig phra men sri la ma: sha khrag rol zhig phra men shwa na maḥ klad khrag 'thung zhig phra men kri ta ma: nang rol zo zhig phra men gaṅka ma: mig tshil brus shig phra men khwa kha ma: glo snying zo zhig phra men hu lu ma: snying nas drongs shig rta gdong lcags kyu ma: mgul nas chings shig phag gdong zhags pa ma: yan lag sdoms shig seng gdong lcags sgrog ma: rdul du rlogs shig sbrul gdong dril bu ma: sha khrag don snying

༄sha /nang rol ma lus pa: dpal chen zhal du stobs shig dbang phyug rnams: zhes pas nya bo'i phung po bsgral bar bya: bdun pa phung po zhal du bstab pa ni: lha:dang po'i sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum la: dam nyams bsgral ba'i yid chos mchod pa 'bul: zhi ba longs sku'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga la: dgra bo'i phung po rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: gsang ba'i bde ster yum mchog lnga po la: dgra bo'i sha khrag 'byung lnga'i mchod pa 'bul:nye ba'i sras mchog sems dpa' brgyad rnams la: dgra bgegs rnam shes tshogs brgyad mchod pa 'bul: gsang ba'i lha mo sems ma brgyad rnams la: dgra bgegs dbang po yul brgyad mchod pa 'bul: sprul pa'i sgo ba yab yum brgyad rnams la: yan lag nywa bzhi tshigs bzhi'i

mchod pa 'bul: sprul pa'i sku mchog thub pa drug rnams la: rnam shes dbang po tshogs drug mchod pa 'bul: sbyi: bcom ldan khrag 'thung che mchog yab yum la: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i nyon mongs zhal du bstab: sprul pa'i khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum la: dgra bgegs dug lnga phung lnga zhal du bstab: gnas kyi ko'u rī ma mo brgyad rnams la: dgra bgegs don snying nang rol zhal du bstab: yum gyi sing ha phra men brgyad rnams la: dgra bgegs phyi sha lhu tshigs zhal du bstab: rta gdong ye shes sgo ma bzhi rnams la: dgra bgegs yan lag rnam bzhi zhal du bstab: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad la: sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa brgyad zhal du bstab: gzhan yang bka' yi srung ma thams cad

mulga /la: sha rus lpags pa rtsa rgyus la sogs pa: phung po lhag ma med par zhal du bstab: bstab bo bzhes shig rol zhig khā raṃ kha hi:khyod kyi thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur nas: bdag la tshe dbang longs spyod dngos grub stsol: rnal 'byor 'khor dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod: dgra bgegs rnam shes bde gshegs sras gyur cig: dgra bgegs dam sri'i ma hā rmā sā la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hrī: ma hā keng ni ri ti la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ces pas phung po gtor mar bstab nga ra bya: brgyad pa rnal 'byor pho mo tshogs la rolaḥ las kyi slob bus tshogs bteg la 'di skad doḥ ho: rnal 'byor pho mo mched dang lcam dral rnams: zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs rang bzhin sku:

dga' ldan lha yi tshogs mchod dpag tu med: 'khrul dga' lha yi ting 'dzin yid kyis sprul: tshogs mchod dag pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'di: dgyes pa mchog gi longs spyod rnam par rol: a la la ho: bla mas pad bskor phyag rgyas 'di skad blangasaḥ ho: sku rdo rje mi 'gyur ba'i dngos grub:gsung rdo rje mi 'gags pa'i dngos grub: thugs rdo rje spros bral gyi dngos grub: sku gsung thugs rdo rje mi 'gyur ba'i dngos grub dam pa a 95 95 lharmo: zhes pas rnal 'byor ma ched lcam du yod kunaḥ che chung pham rgyal med par rol bar byaḥ de nas tshogs kyi lhag ma'i cho ga niḥ yar gnas mar gnas rnam pa gnyis su bstanaḥ dgu pa yar sanas gtsang lha ga sator mar bsta baḥ sbyi: chos dbyings skye med nam mkha'i rang bzhin las: longs sku 'gag med bde gshegs zhi khro'i tshogs: tshogs phud

༄sha /bgyes pa chen pos yar bzhes la: mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: rdu: dang po gtsang ma'i phud kyis mi mchod du: rgyal ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis phud la dgyes: bar du bcu ldan tshogs la mi rol du: khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i tshogs kyang tshogs la dgyes:tha ma tshogs kyi lhag mas mi brngan du: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad lhag la dgyes: phud la dgyes pa'i bde gshegs phud la rol: tshogs la dgyes pa'i khrag 'thung tshogs la rol: lhag la dgyes pa'i bran g.yog lhag la rol: so so'i thugs dam gnyan po skongs gyur cig: de nas phud dang lhag ma bsres laḥ lha: bar du gnyis med gcig tu mi bsre rgyu: chos dbyings rnam dag ye nas rgyu 'bras gcig: de nas tshogs lhag kha phrus btab nas niḥ

lha: tha ma lhag mar kha chus mi 'debs rgyu: khyod dang nga gnyis rdo rje'i tha tshig gcig: sngon tshe dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan snga ru: dbus la mi 'tshal dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong : phud la mi 'tshal lhag ma'i zhal chab zhu: ci bgyis bka' nyan bsgrub ces khas blangs bzhin: lhag ma'i bshal chu gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du phrin las mdzod: bcu pa lha ga ma gnas bskul ba ni: bh+yo: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol ba'i lhag sdud ma: shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: sku mdog dkar nag mgo brnyan cir yang ston: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grims shing tshogs khang nyul: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon nas bhan+ta thogs: sgom bzang rak+ta 'thung zhing ro la za: dam

༄sha /tshig srung mar rgyu zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su nyams pa'i shwa dang khrag la dgyes: las su dgra bgegs gsod dang gcod la brtson:lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol ba'i lhag sdud ma: lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: sku mdog ser nag mgo brnyan cir yang ston: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grims shing tshogs khang nyul: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon nas bhan+dha thogasaḥ skom bzang rak+ta 'thung zhing ro la za: dam tshig srung mar rgyu zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su nyams pa'i sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su dgra bgegs gsod dang gcod la brtson: lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo: dpal gyi

bka' nyan rol ba'i lhag sdud ma: nub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: sku mdog dmar nag mgo brnyan cir yang ston:gnas bzang dur khrod 'grims shing tshogs khang nyul: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon nas bhan+dha thogs: sgom bzang rak+ta 'thung zhing ro la za:dam tshig srung mar rgyu zhing mkha' la 'gro: zas su nyams pa'i sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su dgra bgegs gsod dang gcod la brtson:lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bdun: sku mdog ljang nag mgo brnyan cir yang ston: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grims shing tshogs khang nyul: gos bzang

jug /g.yang gzhi gyon nas bhan+dha thogs: sdom bzang rak+ta 'thung zhing ro la za: dam tshig srung mar rgyu zhing ma/kha' la 'gro: zas su nyams pa'i sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su dgra bgegs gsod dang gcod la brtson: lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces pas lhag ma'i gtor ma bskul bar bya'o: zhi khro 'dus pa'i tshogs mchod las rim 'di: skal ldan skyes bu rnams kyis brtson par gyis: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas bcu bzhi nga thugs dam bskul ba ni: rnam nga gsu ma ste zhi khro pho nya sasum: dang po zhi ba bzhi bcu'i spyi bskul ni: rdu bh+yo: rnam dag chos dbyings khyab bdal klong yangs nas: kun bzang che mchog rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: mi mngon dbyings nas skur bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: log 'dren sems can 'dul ba'i grogs la byon: lha: zhi ba lhun gyi grub pa'i pho brang nas: rgyal ba kun kyi spyi mes kun tu bzang : rgyal ba'i bskyed yum chos nyid bzang mo yum: gnyis med rol ba'i lcam dral

byung ba ni: rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa' rin chen 'byung : mtha' yas don yod grub pa rigs lnga yab: dbyings phyug sangs rgyas spyan dang mā ma kyi: gos dkar sgrol ma la sogs yum mchog lnga: thog ma'i dus kyi thugs dam nyer dgongs la: mi mngon dbyings nas sems can don la byon: lha: gnyis med sprul pa'i sems dpa' lcam dral ni: sa snying byams pa kun bzang nam mkha'i snying : spyan gzigs 'jam dpal sgrib sel phyag rdor brgyad: khā su praḍū mā le sbruspru maḥ gīrti ā lo gan+dhe rmārti brgyad: sems dpa' yab yum lcam dral bcu drug kyang :thog ma'i dus kyi thugs dam nyer dgongs la: mi mngon dbyings nas sems can don la byon: lha: gnyis med rol ba'i 'gro 'dul sprul

༄sha /sku drug: brgya byin thag bzang shāka thub seng ge brtan: kha 'bar chos rgyal rigs drug 'dul mdzad drug: 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i thub chen drug po yang : thog ma'i dus kyi thugathe dam nyer dgongs la: mi mngon dbyings nas 'gro drug don la byon: lha: gnyis med rol ba'i sgo srung yab yum brgyad: rnam rgyal gshin rje rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyizlo: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog 'dril 'khrol ma: 'gugs 'ching sdom dgyes las mdzad sgo ma rnams: thog ma'i dus kyi thugs dam nyer dgongs la: mi mngon dbyings nas bdag gi grogs la byon: khyed kyi bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na: ma rungs snyigs ma'i sems can 'dul dka' bas: khyod kyi dam bca' dus 'dir ma

dgongs na: bstan pa'i rū tra yan par shor ta re: 'gro ba sems can ngan 'gror ltung nga re: rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub par gyur ta re:yab yum sras dang bka' sdod srung mar bcas: so so'i thugs dam gnyen po'i dus la babs: gnyis pa khras 'thung drug cu'i spyi bskul ni: lha lha: chos sku zhi ba'i rig rtsal cho 'phrul las: nyon mongs gdug pa 'dul ba'i khrag 'thung 'phros: bh+yoḥ khrag 'thung rol ba'i dur khrod chen po nas:khro rgyal rje btsun che mchog he ru ma: gnyis med yum chen dbyings phyug khro mo 'khril: 'khril sbyor rol ba'i khrag 'thung byung ba ni: budha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma dang : karma he ru ka sogs khrag 'thung lnga: sangs rgyas rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi dbyings phyug la sogs gro ti lnga:

༄sto /khyod kyi bstan la gdug pa'i dgra dar bas: drag po khros pa'i tshul gyis grogs la byon: lha haḥ gnyis med rol ba'i ma mo sprul pa ni: ko'u rī tso'u rī pra mo be ta āḥ puska kusma sme sha tsan+dha li: gnas kyi ko'u rī ma mo brgyad rnams kyang : sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba'i dgra dar bas: za byed rngam pa'i tshul gyis grogs la byon: snru teḥ gnyis med rol ba'i phra men sprul pa ni: sing ha byā kri sri la shwa na ma: kyi ta kyang ka kha khā hu lu ma: yum gyi sing ha phra men brgyad rnams kyang : bstan pa gnyan la snang ba'i dgra dar bas: gsod byed 'jigs pa'i tshul gyis grogs la byon: lha dzaḥ gnyis med rol ba'i sgo srung sprul pa ni: rta gdong phag gdong seng gdong sbrul gdong bzhi: 'gug

'chings sdom dgyes phrin las bzhi mdzad ma: bstan pa gnyan pa sdang ba'i dgra dar bas: yab yum sras dang bka' sdod sprul 'khor bcas: sgrol byed 'khyug pa'i tshul gyis grogs la byon: lhu bh+yoḥ gnyis med rol ba'i yang sprul pho nya ni: shar nas zhi ba'i las mdzad dbang phyug bdun: lho nas rgyas pa'i las mdzad dbang phyug bdun: nub nas dbang gi las mdzad dbang phyug bdun: byang nas drag po'i las mdzad dbang phyug bdun: sprul pa'i mgo brnyan rdzu 'phrul cir yang ston: bka' yi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i: myur mgyogs/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ldan pa rnams: bstan pa gnyan la sdang ba'i dgra dar bas: dgra bgegs bsgral phyir bdag gi grogs la byon: lha bh+yo:

༄dzo /zhi khro rigs brgya'i bka' nyan las byed rnams: sngon tshe spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: deng 'dir khyod kyi bstan pa nub la nye: bstan pa gnyan la sdang ba'i dgra dar bas: yab yum sras dang bka' sdod sprul 'khor bcas: khyod kyi thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la babs: myur zhing rings pa'i tshul kyis 'dir gshegs la: bstan pa'i da gra bgegs brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: mi mthun rkyen tshogs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: bcol ba'i phrin las myur mgyogs 'grub par mdzod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa pho nya sgos su bskul ba niḥ bhū bh+yo: bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas su: zhi khro'i sprul pa yang sprul dang : dka' nyan las byed srung ma'i tshogs: la las bstan pa'i gzhi 'dzin

mdzad: la las bka' yi bya ra mdzad: la las chos mdzad srung ma mdzad: la las gtsug lag dkor khang bsrung : 'a/ las yul dgon dben gnas bsrung : la las dam tshig las rjes gcod: la las sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzad: la las stong gsum khyab par nyul: la la bsam gtan ngang la gnas: la las skye 'gro'i bla tshe ku: la la srog gcod srin po'i rigs: la la gtsang sbra bram ze'i rigs: la la rims dang nad kyi bdag: la la ltas ngan cho 'phrul bdag: sprul pa yang sprul bsam mi khyab: 'khor dang las byed bye ba 'bum: kun kyang zhi khro'i cho 'phrul te: rig rtsal rol pa thogs med 'phro: khyed cag sngon gyi tha tshig can: rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin: da lta bstan

༄ga /la dgra dar bas: ma g.yel bka' yi srung ma rnams: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs rnams:yud tsam gyis ni brlag par mdzod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgyaḥ bco lnga bka' yi chad mdo 'di skad do: lha: dus gsum dus med ka dag dus kyi tshe: rnam dag chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs su: kun tu bzang po grol gzhi'i dus kyi tshe: thog ma'i sangs/ rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba yi: ma bcos rang shar rang dam bcas pa bzhin: 'khor 'das gzhi nas grol bar ma chad dam: 'khrul pa ka nas dag par ma chad dam: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par ma chad dam: ye grol gshes kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: kun gzhi klong nas grol ba'i phrin las mdzod: sbyi: sngon tshe 'das dus

bskal pa'i thog ma la: rnam dag 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du: thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po yis: rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' lcam dral la: chos sku'i dgongs pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe: zhi khro ra ba 'byams lha tshogs thams cad kyis: so so'i sku gsung thugs su bstan nas kyang : phung khams gnas su dag par ma chad dam: rigs drug dbyings su sgrol bar ma chad dam: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par ma chad dam: rtog tshogs rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ci ltar khas blangs dam bcas de bzhin du: 'khor ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod: lha: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i dbus ma la: 'og min gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: kun tu bzang po che

sngag /mchog he ru sha: khrag 'thung rigs lnga zhi khro sprul 'khor gyis: dregs pa rū tra'i sde dpon btul ba'i tshe: dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang : dregs pa can gyi 'khor tshogs thams cad kyis: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam: rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bzlog par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma 'di bzhes phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sbyi: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i phyi ma la: bod yul kha ba can gyi yul ljongs su: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i tshe:

bod kyi lha srin dregs pa thams cad kyis: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam: rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bzlog par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma 'di bzhes phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sbyi: de 'og bskal pa'i phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : shes rab yum chen mkha' 'gro 'tsho rgyal gyis: zab chos mtha' dag gter du sbas pa'i tshe: gter bdag chos kyi srung ma thams cad dang : dregs pa sde brgyad bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang : bka' yi

༄ga /gtor ma len par ma chad dam: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam: rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bzlog par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma 'di bzhes phrin las 'grub par mdzod: lha: da dus snyigs ma'i dus la bab pa'i tshe: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung sanas kyis: sprul pa yang sprul sum sprul bkyes nas su: zab chos mtha' dag gter nas bton pa'i tshe: srung ma dam can rgya mtsho thams cad dang : gsang sngags chos kyi srung ma thams cad kyis: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe

bsring bar ma chad dam: rgyu sbyor rkyen ngan bzlog par ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma 'di bzhes phren las 'grub par mdzod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bcu drug pa sgo dbye ba 'di skad do: rdu dza: shar phyogs sgo ma rta gdong ma: snying rje tshad med lcags kyi yis: me long ye shes shar sgo phyes: zhe sdang dgra bgegs tshar chod la: 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba dang : gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bsgyur:hūm̐ sbyi: lho phyogs sgo ma phag gdong ma: byams pa tshad med zhags pa yis: mnyam nyid ye shes lho sgo phyes: nga rgyal dgra bgegs tshar chod la: bsod nams ye shes rgyas pa dang : gtor ma'i zor kha dgra la bsgyur: lha bo: nub phyogs sgo ma seng gdong ma: dga' ba tshad med

mulga /lcags sgrog gis: sor rtogs ye shes nub sgo phyes: 'dod chags dgra bgegs tshar chod la: khams gsum dbang du 'du ba dang :gtor ma'i zor kha dgra la bsgyur: lha ho: byang phyogs sgo ma sbrul gdong ma: btang snyoms tshad med dril bu yis: bya grub ye shes byang sgo phyes: phrag dog dgra bgegs tshar chod la: mi mthun rkyen ngan dgra la bzlog: gtor ma'i zor lam dgra la bsgyur: lha: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcu: de na phyogs skyong bcu po bzhugs: phyogs skyong pho rnams khrag tu bskyug: phyogs skyong mo rnams 'bog cing brgyal: phyogs skyong phru gu dmyal thag gcod: der yang snying rjes zor mi 'phenaḥ zor 'phen sdang ba'i dgra la 'phen: dgra dpung bdun

brgyud rtsad nas chod: bor 'phen gnod pa'i bgegs la 'phen: bgegs dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bcu bdun pa gtor skyong bya ba 'di skad do: rgyu bh+yo: bstan pa skyong mdzad ma sring tshogs: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang : 'dzam gling brtan ma bcu gnyis rnams: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: shar nas zhi ba'i las byed bdun: 'di gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma longs:dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: ā+o nas rgyas pa'i las byed bdun: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: bsod nams rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: nub nas dbang gi las byed bdun: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'o/ngas: 'khor 'das dbang sdud phrin las

༄sha /mdzod: byang nas drag po'i las byed bdun: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma longs: dgra bgegs tshar gcod phrin las mdzod:bod khams bstan ma bcu gnyis dang : g.ya' ma skyong ma'i tshogs rnams kyang : bshal chu'i gtor ma 'di longs la: sngon tshe rgyal ba zhi khro'i bka': de rjes slob dpon pad+ma'i bka': da lta rnal 'byor bdag gi bka': bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar: gtor ma 'di bzhes phrin las mdzod: slob dngo/na pad+ma'i spyan snga ru: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam tshig 'di las khyod ma 'da': dam tshig 'di las khyod 'das na: rdo rje khro bo gnod sbyin gyis: snying khrag 'thung nas brlag par byed: de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: bcol

ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bco brgyad pa gtor bro brdungs pa ni: mched lcam zhi khro khrag 'thung skur bsgo ma zhing ཿ lag pa rdo rje lu gu brgyud du sbrel: ma rig nyon mongs dgra bgegs ma 'u sa pa: dgug gzhug thar med gnas su mnan par bsamaḥ gtor gzhong kha sbubs de steng 'di skad do: lha: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i dbus phyogs nas:gti mug 'joms pa'i chos dbyings ye shes gsal: mthing gsal sgyu ma'i lha dang lha mos bskor: dbus phyogs bde gshegs rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: gti mug mgo la 'od gsal chems se chem: bro yang chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i bri: gru yang chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i glu: chos dbyings ye shes glu blangs bro brdungs pas: rnam rtog mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: lha: phyogs med phyogs dang

༄sha /bral ba'i shar phyogs nas: zhe sdang 'joms pa'i me long ye shes gsal: dkar gsal sgyu ma'i lha dang lha mo'i bskor: shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: zhe snang mgo la rang grol chems se chem: bro yang me long ye shes chen po'i bri: gru yang me long ye shes chen po'i glu: me long ye shes glu blangs bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: lha: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i lho phyogs nas: nga rgyal 'joms pa'i mnyam nyid ye shes gsal: ser gsal sgyu cha 'i lha dang lha mo'i bskor: lho phyogs rin chen rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: nga rgyal mgo la gsal stong chems se chem: bro yang mnyam/ nyid ye shes chen po'i bri: gru yang mnyam nyid ye shes chen po'i

glu: mnyam nyid ye shes glu blangs bro brdungs pas: nga rgyal mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: lha: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i nub phyogs nas: 'dod chags 'joms pa'i sor rtogs ye shes gsal: dmar gsal sgyu ma'i lha dang lha mo'i bskor: nub phyogs pad+ma rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: 'dod chags mgo la bde stong chems se chem: bro yang sor rtogs ye shes chen po'i bri: gru yang sor rtogs ye shes chen po'i glu: sor rtog ye shes glu blangs bro brdungs pas: 'dod chags mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: lha: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i byang phyogs nas: phrag dog 'joms pa'i bya grub ye shes gsalaḥ ljang gsal sgyu ma'i lha dang lha mo'i bskor: byang

)sto /phyogs las kyi rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: phrag dog mgo la grags stong chems se chem: bro yang bya grub ye shes chen po'i bri: gru yang bya grub ye shes chen po'i glu: bya grub ye shes glu blangs bro brdungs pas: phrag dog mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar grol: i lo: āḥlo:hūm̐ lo: swā lo: hā loni ༈ bha ya nan: sarba sha r+ghaṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta s+t+waṃ bha ya rna: rgya rgya rgya: de nas nang du log nas bkra shis dang : bsngo ba smon lam rjes kyi las rim niḥdang po bshags pa bzod gsol bskang ba niḥ bdag gi spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng du: dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' shel gyi mdog: rdo rje dril 'dzin phyed skyil bzhugs pa yi: thugs kur zla steng hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor: bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs nyams chags sdig sgrib kun: ma lus dag

nas shel sgong lta bur gyur: i badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: sogs yi ge brgya pa/ satwa ā: a ā: yi ā: u u: ri dzā: bla ā: e rtse: o ā: e āḥka kha ga gha nga : tsa tsha dza dzha nya: ṭa ṭha ḍa ho ṇa: ta tha da dha na: pa pha ba bha ma: ya ra la wa: sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa: kun gzhi ma bcos klong yangs ngang nyid las: rang rig gsal stong ye nas kun tu bzang : gdod nas ma skyes bde chen kun bzang mo: dbyer med ma bcos bde ba chen po la: bskang dang bshags pa'i yul las ye nas 'das: 'di ltar rtogs na bskang bshags mchog tu 'gyur: de nas lha la bzod nga ra gsol bani: ho: gang yang bdag blo ma rig gti mug pas: ye nas ka dag chen po'i rang bzhin la: de ltar ma rtogs gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa yis:

༄ga /cho ga lhag chad nor 'khrul ci mchis pa: klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par gsol: tshangs par mdzad nas dngos grub stsal du gsol: gnyis pa bkra shes brjod pa 'di skad do: o: stong zhing bdag med ka dag lhun gyis grub: kun tu bzang po'i bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: āḥ gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro: rigs lnga yab yum bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: :: thugs rje'i rgyun gyis rigs drug gnas nas 'dren: sprul sku thub drug bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: hrī: stong nyid snying rjes 'khor ba'i 'gro ba skyob: sems dpa' sems ma'i

bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: dzaḥ srin las rnam bzhis gdul bya'i re ba skong : sgo ba sgo ma/'i bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: lha: sna tshogs thabs kyis log 'dren rū tra 'dul: khrag 'thung lnga bcu'i bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: hrī: skye 'chi med par tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas bkra shis sang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: āḥ mthong thos dran reg skad cig sangs rgyas thob:dgongs pa rang grol bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: gzhi yi bkra shis rang rgyud dul bar shog:

༄sto /lam gyi bkra shis gzhan rgyud sbyong bar shog: 'bras bu'i bkra shis gzhi thog smin par shog: dmigs med mtha' bral lta ba'i bkra shis shog: yengs med rkyen thub bsgom pa'i bkra shis shog: phyogs med rnam rgyal spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu'i bkra shis shog: sasum pa bsngo ba smon lam gdab pa niḥ na mo 'khor gsum yongs dag rab dkar dge ba 'dis: khams gsum rigs drug sems can ma lus pa: kun tu bzang po'i gzhi thog grol bar shog: longs sku zhi khro'i go 'phang thob par shog: sprul sku thub drug gdul bya rdzogs par shog: sku gsum 'bras bu myur du smin par shog: bzhi pa lha tshogs gshegs su gsol ba niḥ i: khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad: rtogs pa mngon

gyur dngos grub stsol: don la gshegs bzhud mi mnga' yang : chos dbyings klong du gshegs nas kyang : 'gro ba sems can don slad du:bdag gis spyan 'dren gsol 'debs du: chos sku'i dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: o badz+ra muḥ rjes su rdzogs pa 'i rim pa bsgom pa ni: gzugs snang thams cad zhi khro'i lha tshogs gsal: lha tshogs nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar: snang stong gnyis med mtha' bral ngang la bzhag: sgra grags thams cad zhi khro'i lha tshogs gsung : grags stong nam mkha'i 'brug sgra yal ba ltar: grags stong brjod med ngang la mnyam par bzhag: dran bsam thams cad zhi khro'i thugs su shar: shar grol klong thim mkha' la sprin dengs ltar:

༄sha /thugs dgongs ma bcos skye med ngang la bzhag: bsam du med de sems nyid nam mkha' che: brjod du med de rnam shes gzugs dang bral: a a ā: de nas spyod lam rnam bzhi'i rjes thob dus: skad cig stong gsal chen po'i ngang nyid las: rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal ma bral bar:snang stothong lha/ skya/ shāsti sdi/:re ngang nas /glerngadi: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab chos zhi khro dbongs pa rang grol las: zhi khro 'dus pa'i las byang rtsar phreng tshor ba rang grol zhes bya ba: u rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma /spra r+sha k+ta/ kā rdidī judī dzosmi sdu ༷r+sha ༵ ༵ ༵༵༵ ༵༵ sbyi /sdu // t+t+waṃ rdzogs so: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: 'phrad nas 'gro ba ma lus 'dren par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: grub thob kurma gling
tshog /las byang rnams kyi sngon du 'gro ba bzhi bdag dang thogegs la gtor ma 'bul thabs bzhugs so/ /

tshog /snod gtsang mi nang du dkar gtor pad 'dab bzhi nga dang : nag phyogs gzhi bdag la dmar gtor : de gnyis la bsangs sbyangs spel la 'bul:dkar gsum mngar gsum rin chen gsel skyems bdar: rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su bsgom/ thugs ku'i 'od kyi bgegs dang gzhi bdag rnams spyan drangs gtor ma phul bas dgyes par gyur/ oṃ swā bha washud+dha sarba dharmāḥswā bha wa shurnyo3rta/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod kyi nang du

༄sha /gtsang ldan gyi gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum las grub pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥsbyi/ lan gsum:i a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇi ār+ya nud pe natwate oṃ āḥlha phaṭa swā hā:lan gsumaḥtsū tshangs pa brgya byin rgyal chen bzhi/ /lha chen thams cad 'khor dang bcas/ /dga' bo 'jog po dung skyong sogs/ /klu rnams ma lus 'khor dang bcas/ /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' rnams ma lus 'khor dang bcas / /sa bdag sa yi lha mo sogs/ /sa bdag ma lus 'khor dang bcas/ /mgur lha dge bsnyen bstan ma'i tshogs/ /phyogs skyong rnams dang gnod bzhin dang / /srin po sha chen za ba dang / /dri za gshin rje ma mo'i tshogs/ /'byung po rnams dang yi dwags dang / /sde brgyad phyi

nang gsang ma'i tshogs/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /stobs chen phyag na rdo rje dang / /slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gi/ /bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /rnam bzhi'i las kyi dngos grub stsol/ /bdag gi byang chub ma thob par/ /phrin las bsgrubs la rog ldan mdzod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bzlog /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces dkar gtor dang dmar gtor 'bul: de nas bgegs kyi gtor ma bran la sbyong : i badz+ra gro ta h+ya kṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭa: o swā bha wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswā bha wa shurnyo3rta/ stong pa nyid du gyur/stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod kyi nang du bgegs kyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa rnams su gyur/ oṃ āḥlha/ lan
jug /gsum: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te: i sam+bha ra sam+bha ra lha: lan gsum/

༄sna /hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ma ning nag po yang 'khor brgyad: pho rgyud thams cad dgra la bh+yo: e ka tsa ti ma mo'i tshogs: mo rgyud thams cad dgra la bh+yo: lha mo dpal 'bar nad bdag tshogs: ma mo 'bum sde dgra la bh+yo: shan pa srog bdag sde bzhi'i tshogs: srog gcod ma mo dgra la bh+yo: gza' rgod khyab 'jug gdong mo bzhi: sde brgyad dmag dpung dgra la bh+yo: rdo rje legs pa bstan mar bcas: 'gong po'i dmag dpung dgra la bh+yo: shan pa dmar nag gnod sbyin tshogs: srog gcod dmag dpung dgra la bh+yo: skyes bu dam can sde bdun kyang : so so'i g.yog 'khor sprul par bcas: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bo'i yul du dmag dpung chos: bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar bas: rnal 'byor bdag gi ra
mda' rgyug: ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la thong : dgra dpung bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod: bgegs dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

phrin /drug pa zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod kyi mchod pa ni/ :: bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dang : mkha' 'gro dam can ma ning nag po dang : e ka tsa ti dpal 'bar srog bdag dang : khyab 'jug gnod sbyin dam can thig le rtsal: brtan ma bcu gnyis dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang : yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di 'bul bas: dgyes par dgongs la dngos grub stsal du gsol: ma hā ga na tsakra pū tsa la khā hi: bdun pa bshags par bya ba ni: lha: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dgongs: bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin gyis: nyon mongs dbang gyur sku gsung thugs la sogs: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun: gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshags
bzod par gsol:tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: o badz+ra satwa sa ma ya:sogs:

༄pho /mchod pa ni/ :: bla ma kun bzang rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: dpag med nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs la: dag pa rnam gsum yid kyis mchod pa'i sprin: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: snang stong rig stong gsal stong bde stong ngang : dran stong grags stong tshor stong mchod pa'i tshogs: me tog bdug spos dri zhal rol mo bcas: bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol:bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol:chu badz+ra duḍū 6spru a lo ke gan+dhe nai wir+ya shabha pū tsa ho:bstod pa ni/brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso: thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya chen sprul pa'i sku: zhi khro sku gsum lha la phyag
'tshal bstod:

༄gi /gzhung gi bum pa la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa tshul ldan bya sgong : khyad par tshe 'das kyi rus sbyangs lta bu la: bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bum pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul: bdag dang lha rnams las 'od zer 'phros rigs drug gi gnas dang bar do gang na gnas pa'i tshe 'das de yi lus la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib sdug bsngal thams cad sangs kyis dag cing byang nas: rnam par shes pa rgyangs kyis lha'i dkyil 'khor 'dir byung nas lus sems la bde ba khyad par can skyes par yang yang sgoms shing : rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pa'i mthar: o badz+ra satwa sa ma ya so gas yi ge brgya pa dang / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sarba dun te/ pa ri sho dha ni rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/

tabya thā/ o sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pa paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shudhe bi shudhe/ sarba kurmā a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ na mo rat+na tā yā ya/ oṃ kai ka ni kai ka ni / ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tā sa/ ni tā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba kurma pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba satwa nan tsa ye swā hā/ tshe 'das kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad shan+ti ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ slar yang / rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ na mo ༵༵t+na tā ya ya sogs/ tshe 'das kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad sharnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ ces stong ngam brgya rtsa re la so gas ci mang bzlas par
sngag /zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi 'dzab bzlas tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs 'khor 'das rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

༄gi /bstod bshags dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs yig brgya tshar gcig brjod mthar/'dzab ni/ lha tshogs zhi ba rnams kyi thugs kur zla ba dang / khro bo rnams kyi thugs kur nyi ma'i gdan la rang srog sa bon gyi mthar zhi ba la bho dhi tsit+ta dang khro bo la ru lu'i sngags sam rang sngags rnams kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lhal phog /de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ dus gsum bde bshegs rnams kyi thugs rgyud

jug /bskul/ byin rlabs thams cad 'od phung gi rnam par sngags phreng la thim/ 'od zer 'bar slar yang thugs ma'i 'od zer bka' srung dam can rnams la phog /sngon gyi dam bca' dran pas ci bsgo ba'i las thams cad thogs med du bsgrub/ sems can thams cad la 'od zer phog pas snang srid dag pa lha yi zhing dang rtsa ba gsum gyi rang bzhin tu gyur par bsams la / o āḥbhū bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhartu āḥ i ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo rgyu: zhes spyi dril bsnyen pa bye ba 'bru 'bum sogs bzla zhing : gzhan yang rang sngags: lha badz+ra tsit+ta āḥ badz+ra sa man+ta bha dra o: o dzi na dzika: rmā te shwa ra ti sa: : badz+ra sgrika: spru dhā tu shwa rī ste: swā rat+na sgrika: shrī mo ha ra ti sa: slo a ro blaka: rgya rā ga ra ti sa: hā pradz+nyā sgrika: dzā badz+ra ra ti sa:

k+ṣi hi rā tsa ya swā hā: mi tri dhā ra ni swā hā: lha lā mye sa ma ya sa: rdu phusne a we sha ya sa: lha swa rā tsa ya swā hā: dzā a gar+bha ya swā hā: dzā ma le sa ma ya hoḥ dz+waPROBPROBPROB pra we sha ya sa: hrīḥhā hūm̐ pad+ma bha ta ma swā hā: rlu shrī a raṃ ghā ya swā hā: hrīḥshīrti rā she ya ho rta: po dhī paṃ su ki ni sa ma ya sa: smyu ni sa raṃ pā ya swā hā: lha ku ru pā ṇi hrīḥswā hā: ho gan+dhe tsit+ta ya ho: a rmārti rā ga ya mi :: i mu ne kre swā hā: i mu ne pre swā hā: o mu ne hūm̐ swā hā: o mu ne k+ṣ-i swā hā: o mu ne sum̐ swā hā: o mu ne ye swā hā: sa ma ya sa: i badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya lha: badz+ra e ku shā dza: i badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka rgyu: badz+ra pā sha rgyu: o pad+ma kro ta h+ya kṛ wa lha: badz+ra sbo ṭa bo: o badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī sbyi: badz+ra garnye ho: o ma hā gro ta ma hā

jug /shrī he ru ka tsū phaṭa: ma hā kro ti shwa rī sa: o bud+dha gro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: bud+dha gro ti shwa rī ste: e badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra gro ti shwa rī sa: o rat+na gro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka tsū phaṭa: rat+na kro ti shwa rī :: i pad+ma kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: pad+ma gro ti shwa rī sa: o kurma kro ta ma hā shrī te ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: karma kro ti shwa rī ste: i badz+ra kau rī ha: o badz+ra tso rī ha: o badz+ra pra mo dhā ha: o badz+ra be ta lī ha: o badz+ra puska sī ha: o badz+ra kusma rī ha: o badz+ra tsan+dha lī ha: o badz+ra sme sha nī ha: o badz+ra sedha mu khā te: o badz+ra byā kri mu khā he: i badz+ra sri la mu khā he: i badz+ra shwa na mu khā he: i badz+ra kri ta mu khā he: o badz+ra gaṅka mu khā te: i badz+ra kha khā mu khā he: i badz+ra hu lu mu khā he: i

badz+ra yaṃ ku sha dza: i badz+ra pa sha lha: i badz+ra sbo ta bo: i badz+ra gan+dhe ho: o ma nu rak+ṣa sī bh+yo: o pra ma nī bh+yo: i re'u tri ma bh+yo: o bha na bh+ya bh+yo: i ki'u rī ma bh+yo: o in+d+ra ya ni bh+yo: i sedha ka la ni bh+yo: o a mṛ haṃ bh+yo: o si'u ni bh+yo: o ta na haṃ bh+yo: o rak+ṣa si bh+yo: i bka sī bh+yo:oṃ ra tri ma bh+yo: i re tri re ma tri bh+yo: sna e ka tsa ra ma bh+yo: i ma nu ha ra ma bh+yo: i si ti ka bh+yo: i bā ya bī bh+yo: o ma hā mā ra na bh+yo: i asne ye bh+yo: o pā ra tī bh+yo: i tsa mun tri bh+yo: i bu ta rna bh+yo: o pa nī badz+ra bh+yo: o badz+ra ma hā kā la bh+yo: o tsa kā la badz+ra bh+yo: o badz+ra sum̐ pa ka ra na bh+yo: skyes bajardo lo po dha rā na bh+yo: ces pa rnams bzla ba dang : yang na yig brgya: skyes badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: sogs nas satwa āḥ ces bzla zhing spyi dril sngags sham du: nad

mug /gdon bar chad sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sharnyi ku ru ye swā hā: tshe bsod dang la 'byor ye shes yon tan thams cad paṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā: lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor longs spyod thams cad wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gnod byed dgra bgegs dug lnga dug gsum thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa: ces pa rnams rim pa ltar sngags sham du 'dog cing dmigs rim bsgyur to: yang lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs kur hūm̐ yig gsal bas 'od zer 'phro 'du la dmigs te hūm̐ gi bzlas pa bya ba rang gzhung bi dgongs pa yin pas gang 'os bzla'o: rjes la ā li kā li rten 'brel snying po dang bcas te bzlas pa bya'o: dbang sogs dang 'brel tshe bum bzlas ni: rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros gzungs thag la 'a khril te bum pa'i nang du song bas lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: 'od zer 'phro

'dus don gnyis mdzad: sku'i cha thams cad nas byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab nga/sa bum pa gang bar bsams la: snying po rnams ci rigs bzla: las bum du rdo rje sems dpa' skad cig gis gsal ba'i thugs ku'i 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis mdzad: sku'i cha thams cad nas dag byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur par bsams la: i badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: sogs yig brgya dang : i badz+ra satwa lha: zhes nye snying bzla bas nus ldan du bsgrub: mthar dbyangs gsal byed rten 'brel snying po sogs bzlas zhing mchod cing bstod nas: i āḥsbyi zhes dung chos kyi chu mchod yon du phul bas lha rnams bde stong chen po'i ngo bor (spri ba bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bltas: de nas bdag 'jug dngos grub len pa ni: mdun bskyed lha tshogs sngar ltar gas la ba'i sku yi gnas gsum nas 'od

༄ṣ+ṭhan /zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung ba bdag bskyed kyi gnas gsum la thim pas dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob par bsams la: lha: bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyig/'gyur med sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'gags med gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol / /yon tan re skong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /phrin las 'gro 'dul dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rtsa sngags dang kā ya wakā tsit+ta sarba sirnyi :: ces dngos grub blang ngo / /de nas dam can sde bdun tshogs bskang sogs bya'o/ /'di ltar 'dzab bzlas rang gzhung sor gnas la/ /rnying lusas rigs mthun rnams kyi phyag gzhes dang / /mthun par chos 'di 'khrul bral la ma bzang du/ /rlom nas bgyis so mkhas mchog rnams kyis gzigs / /'di'i bskyed rim skabs tshig tshogs 'os min sna tshogs mi 'don par las byang gi mngon rtogs gcig pu de gyer pa'i khongs nas bdag mdun dus mnyam du bdag bskyed dor sems kyi thugs kur zhi ba'i lha tshogs dang spyi bor khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs rnams lus dkyil du gsal ba dang / mdun bskyed phyi dkyil las byang ltar bsgom pa

grub thob nga d+ma rig 'dzin gyi bzhed pa rje nam mkha'i ma tshan can gyi zhal nas thos pa khungs btsun par mthong zhing / rang gzhung gi rgyun spyod tshogs byin rlabs sogs du ma nas dngos bstan dang / dbang khrus sogs nas bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu bzang po sogs tshig ris sna tshogs 'byung ba'i dbos don yang bdag bskyed rdor sems lus dkyil can gyi ting 'dzin du gsal na der 'dus par snang mod/ 'di yi bskyedarim skabs bdag bskyed la rnam snang yab yu ma dbus kyi kun bzang yab yum gyi 'og dang mdun bskyed la kun bzang yab yum gyi mdun du gsal ba nyid 'thad do/ /'di ga'i bum bzlas sogs phal cher ni gter ༵༵༵ /zlo pa //dri /kā rgan rnams kyis gsang sngags bla med lugs phyag gzhes su mdzad nga ltar yod pas yid ches kyis gnas su nges pa ra mdzod/ 'dzab skong dang tshig cha shas 'di ban sprang pad bstan pas

༄ga /zab chos zhi khro dgongs nga/ rang grol gyi bka' srung dam can sde bdun gyi phrin las chos skyong kun 'dus dgra bgegs gdus pa rang grol gyi las byang chung ba bzhugs so: kun bzang che mchog zhi kro rab 'byams dang : sngags bdag gter srung dam can tshogs la 'dud: bstan pa srung phyir dam can kun 'dus kyi: las byang dgra bgegs rang grol chung ba bstan: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i spyi gtor zlum po che ba gcig gi mthar: ma ning pho rgyud spyi yi dpal gtor gcig: sngags srung mo rgyud spyi gtor snying gi mtshan: lha mo ma mo'i spyi gtor ling gas mtshan: srog gcod las byed spyi gtor gru gsum gcig: khyab 'jug ste brgyadaspyi gtor gza' bshos gcig: dam can brtan ma'i spyi gtor mkhar thabs ra: shan dmar gnod sbyin spyi gtor tel bas mtshan: tha ma sde brgyad gzhi bdag gtor mas bskor: sman raka spyan gzigs mchod pa ci'abyor bshams: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mchod pa byin gyis rlabs: de nas bdag bskyed rim pa bsgo ma pa ni: stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod gzhal yas dbus: bdag nyid bde gshegs kun 'dus he ru ku: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: dbyings phyug gro ti yum dang gnyis med 'khril: rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rje'u chung g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal gyi chas rnams rdzogs: ye shes khro

bo spyan drangs gnyis med gyur: mdun du pad nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng : dpal mgon ma ning pho rgyud kun 'dus sku: mthing nag g.yas g.yon ru mtshon snying zhags bsnams: dar nag ber gsol snying sbrul thod phreng brgyan: tsan+dan bing chen sked btsugs lha dmag sdud:yang 'khor sde brgyad 'khor gyi tshogs bcas gsal: g.yas su sngags srung mo rgyud kun 'dus sku: mthing nag g.yu spyang 'gyed cing tsit+ta gsol: smug nag ye shes ma mo 'khor bcas gsal: g.yon du lha mo ma mo kun 'dus ma: dkar mo rgya bong chibs nas mi lpags gsol:g.yas g.yon ral gri bhan+dha khrag bkang bsnams: las kyi ma mo ma nga po 'khor bcas gsal : shar du srog bsgrub shan pa kun 'dus ma: nag mo

mug /gcer bu mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: g.yas g.yon ral gri snying dang nad rkyal bsnams: srog gcod sde ba'i las byed tshogs bcas gsal: lho ru gza' bdud sde brgyad kun 'dus sku: dud kha dbu dgu bya rog sbrul mjug 'khyil: phyag bzhi ral gri mda' gzhu chu srin zhags: gza' gdong sde brgyad rgyu skar pho nyar gsal: nub tu rdor legs btsan 'gong kun 'dus sku: seng zhon dar dmar rdo rje tsit+ta bsnams: ber nas dang ni prog zhu dbu la gsol: btsan dang bstan ma g.yog dang bcas par gsal: byang du shan dmar gnod sbyin kun 'dus sku: dmar nag khrag ral phyag bzhi ral gri dang : gri gug snying zhags thod phreng bhan+dha thogs: shan pa srog gcod tshogs dang bcas pa

gsal: gtso dang 'khor g.yog lha mi'i khrom ltar bskyed: gnyis pa spyan drangs nga ni 'di skad do:lha: chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid las: gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bu'i skur bzhengs pa: bla ma bde gshegs yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: lha:gter bdag dpal mgon ma ning gtso dang 'khor: e ka tsa ti lha mo re ma ti: shan pa srog bsgrub gza' bdud rā hu la: rdo rje legs pa gnod sbyin dmar nag dang : so so'i rigs dang g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcas: bstan pa srung phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: gsum pa bzhugs su sasol ba ni:lha: bla ma bde gshegs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang : dregs pa pho mo ming sring 'khor dang bcas:

jug /dur khrod rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bzhi pa/ phyag 'tshal bani:rdu: sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i lha: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang : bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la:lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo:a ti pu ho:pra ti dza ho:lnga pa ra/chod pa 'bul ba ni:lha:bla ma bde gshegs zhi khro dang :ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dang : dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la:me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan rol mo'i tshogs: sma na raka gtor gsum gsang ba'i rdzas: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs: thugs dam gnyen po bskang phyir 'bul: ma hā pañtsa sarba pu tsa ho:

drug pa zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa ཿbdun pa bshags pa bcas ni gzhan du phyung ཿbrgyad pa bstod nga bya ba ni:lha:byin rlabs dngos grub 'dod ster rol pa can:bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dang : mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho tshogs rnams la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal/ bstod: lha: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru: khas/ blangs dam bcas rin chen gter gyi bdag: bod khams skyong ba'i lha rabs brtan mar bcas: gzhi bdag srung ma 'khor dang bcas la bstod:de nas bskul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni:lha bh+yoḥm ning nag po yang 'khor brgyad: pho rgyud thams cad dgra la bh+yo: e ka tsa ti ma mo'i tshogs: mo rgyud thams cad dgra la bh+yo: lha mo dpal 'bar nad bdag tshogs: ma mo 'bum sde dgra la bh+yo: shan pa srog bdag

sngag /sde bzhi'i tshogs:srog gcod ma mo dgra la bh+yo:gza' rgod khyab 'jug gdong mo bzhi:sde brgyad dmag dpung dgra la bh+yo:rdo rje legs pa bstan mar bcas:'gong po'i dmag dpung dgra la bh+yo:shan pa dmar nag gnod sbyin tshogs:srog gcod dmag dpung dgra la bh+yo:skyes bu dam can sde bdun kyang : so so'i g.yog 'khor sprul par bcas: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bo'i yul du dmag dpung chos:bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar bas: rnal 'byor bag gi ra mda' rgyug: ltas ngan cho 'phrul dgra la thong : dgra dpung bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: bgegs dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:zhi khro dgongs pa/ rang grol gyi bka' srung dam can sde bdun chos skyong kun 'dus kyi las byang chung ba nyung bsdus dgra bgegs gdug pa rang grol zhes bya ba nam mkha' rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o//
༄sto /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las/ stong bshags nyams chags rang grol thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa bzhugs so/ /

mug /kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab chos zhi khro dbongs pa rang grol gyi bskang bshags nyams chags rang grol nyams su len par 'dod pas/gnas yid dang mthun par phyag dar skyang nul byas la/ stegs bu nag 'jam mkhregs pa 'i steng du zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bri/ dbang bskur bar 'dod na bum pa lnga dang dbang rdzas rnams sta gon bya/ cho ga la'ang rnam rgyal bum pa dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag go/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bsko ra du/ bhad+dha brgya dang rgya brgyad rak+ta brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ lha bshos brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ thabs shes tshogs rdzas sha zan brgya dang rgya brgyad/ snang gsal mar me brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyis bskor / bla cha/ yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa la gtor ma bzang du bshams/ de'i phyi rol du phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa rgyas nga/ra bshams/ bla ma yi dam zhi khyo rab 'byams kyi sku rten yod na'ang bkram/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon 'dus pa rgya mtsho dang bcas pa bde ba'i sta na la 'khod la

༄gi /skyabs su 'gro ba dang sngon 'gro gser skyems nas bzung ste/ las byang tshor ba rang grol ltar bstod pa yan chad rgyas pa ra bya/ de nas rdo rje slob dngo na gyis 'dus pa rgya mtsho rnams la sngon gyi bram ze dung gi phreng ba can gyi lo rgyus dang / na raka dong sprugs kyi lo rgyus bshad/ dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ 'gyod tshangs bshags pa'i rim pa dang thugs dam bskang ba'i rim nga dang / dbang bskur gnas spar gyi rim pa'o /dang po 'gyod tshangs bshasas pa'i rim pa la'ang bzhi ste/ lus kyi sgo nas mos gus phyag gi bshags pa dang gcig /ngag gi sgo nas byin rlabs sngags kyi bshags pa dang gnyis/ yid kyi sgo nas rtog tshogs lta ba'i bshags pa dang gsum/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas smre sngags 'gyod tshig gi bshags pa dang bzhi'o/ /lus kyi sgo nas mos gus phyag gi bshags pa ni/ brgya phyag sdig zhib rang grol ltar 'tshal lo/ /ngag ge sgo nas byin rlabs sngags kyi bshags pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor bsgo ma zhing yi ge brgya nga ci nus bzla zhing ye shes sku mchog kyang bya'o/ /yid kyi sgo nas rtog tshogs lta ba'e bshags pa ni/ lta ba'i klong bshags ltar bya'o/ /lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas spre sngags 'gyod tshig gi bshags pa ni/ rū tra'i smre sngags dang klong bshags brjod pa rang grol nang nas gang yod rdzogs par bya/ yang na dri med bshags rgyud las gsungs pa'i smre sngags chen mo ltar bya'o/ /de dag ni 'gyod tshangs bshags pa 'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa la'ang bzhi ste/ phyi thun mong mchod pa'i rdzas kyis bskang ba dang / nang thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas kyis bskang ba dang / gas/nga ba khyad par bla med tshogs kyis bskang ba dang / de kho na don dam byang chub sems kyis bskang ba'o/ /skabs 'dir tshogs kyi yo byad thams cad bathams la/ bsangs sbyangs byinagyis rlabs la bzhag /dang po phyi thun mong mchod pa 'i rdzas kyis bskang ba ni/ yon chab/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams mched lcam rnams kyis bzung nas dkyil 'khor

bskor zhing / yid kyis kun tu bzang ngo 'i mchod sprin ltar dmigs shing / dbyangs snyan ngo/'i 'di ska da do/ /hūm̐ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchog gi yon chab 'di / /rgyu rkyen rnam par dag pa'i rdzas / /bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'dis/ /bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang / /dam can rgya ma/tsho la sogs pa 'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /hūm̐ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchog gi me tog dang / /lha rdzas mchog gi bdug spos 'di/ /rgyu rkyen rnam par dag pa'i rdzas/ /bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'dis/ /bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang / /dam can rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang

༄sha /dngos grub stsol/ /hūm̐ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchog gi snang gsal dang / /lha rdzas mchog gi dri chab 'di/ /rgyu rkyen rnam par dag pa'i rdzas/ /bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'dis/ /bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang / /dam can rgya mtsho la so gas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /hūm̐ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchog gi zhal zas dang / /lha rdzas mchog gi rol mo 'di/ /rgyu rkyen rnam par dag pa'i rdzas/ /bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'dis/ /bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dang / /dam can rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub

stsol / /nyams chags thams cade skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ces phyi mchod kyi thugs dam bskang ngo / /gnyis pa nang thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas kyis bskang ba la'ang bzhi ste/ dang po bdud rtsi sman gyi bskang ba ni/ mched lcam rnams kyis lag pa g.yas su bdud rtsi bzung / g.yon pa'i srin lag gis bdud rtsi 'thor zhing dkyil 'khor bskor la 'di skad do/ /hūm̐ kun gzhi klong yangs bhan+dha ru/ /byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang / /bskang ba'i rdzas mchog bla na med/ /chos kyi sku yi thugs dam bskang / /blo mdangs gsal ba'i bhan+dha ru/ /ye shes sgrib med bdud rtsis bkang / /bskang ba'i rdzas mchog bla na med/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i thugs dam bskang / /mchog gi 'od gsal bhan+dha ru/ /thig le 'bar ba'i bdud rtsis bkang / /bskang ba'i rdzas mchog bla na

jug /med/ /sprul pa sku yi thugs dam bskang / /ye shes rtsa yi bhan+ta ru/ /skye med a dkar bdud rtsis bkang / /bskang ba'i rdzas mchog bla na med / /zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /ye shes lnga yi bhan+dha ru/ /shes rab rang gsal bdud rtsis bkang / /bskang ba'i rdzas mchog bla na med / /bro bo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /stong gsum snod kyi bhan+dha ru/ /rang rtsal bcud kyi bdud rtsis bkang / /bskang ba'i rdzas mchog bla na med/ /bkrams pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib tham/sa cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos

grub stsol/ /zhes bdud rtsis thusas dam bskang ngo / /gnyis pa rak+tas thugs dam bskang ba ni/ mched lcam rnams kyis lag pa g.yon pas rak+ta bzung zhing / g.yas pas rak+ta 'phyar zhing dkyil 'khor bskor la 'di skad do/ /hūm̐ spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru/ /sdug bsngal rnam par grol ba'i rak+tas bkang / /gnyis med bde ba chen po'i chags nga/sa bskyed / /'di ya nga rmad byung bskang ba'i rak+ta ste/ /bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru/ /sna tshogs yid las grol ba'i rak+tas bkang / /gnyis med bde ba chen po'i chags pas bskyed/ /'di yang rmad byung bskang ba'i rak+ta ste/ /bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos

༄sha /grub stsal du gsol / /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru/ /bsam gtan blo las grol ba'i rak+tas bkang / /gnyis med bde ba chen po'i chags pas bskyed/ /'di yang rmad byung bskang ba'i rak+ta ste/ /bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i bhan+ta ru/ /nyon mongs rtsa mdud grol ba'i rak+tas bkang / /gnyis med bde ba chen po'i chags pas bskyed/ /'di yang rmad byung bskang ba'i rak+ta ste/ /bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo'i bharnya ru/ /ye shes bde ba thig le'i rak+tas bkang / /gnyis med bde ba
