chen po'i chags pas bskyed/ /'di yang rmad byung bskang ba'i rak+ta ste/ /bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /nyam/sa chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsumyo/ 'khor ba sto/ngas gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /zhes rak+tas thugs dam bskang ngo / /gsum pa gtor ma sa thugs dam bskang ba ni/ rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir bzung la 'di skad do/ /hūm̐/ bhan+dha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du / /shangs kyi rlung sgrom dpal bshos btsugs/ /'khor lo 'bar ba'i mtheb kyus bsgron/ /sgron ma mig gi dza gad gsal/ /dbang ngo/ lnga yi

༄ga /rak+tas bran/ /bskang ba'i gtor ma bla na med/ /zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /nyi zla ga 'u'i gtor gzhong du/ /tsit+ta 'bar ba'i dang/la bshos btsugs/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad mtheb kyus bsgron/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad dza bad gsal / /rtsa chen ba'i yi rak+tas bran/ /bskang ba'i gtor ma bla na med/ /zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang / /sgongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /gdal khyab pags pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /rus pa rang gsal dpal bshos btsugs/ /rang snang sha yi mtheb kyus bsgron/ /bkrag dang gzi mdangs dza gad gsal/ /khrag dang chu ser rak+tas bran/ /bskang ba'i gtor ma bla na med/ /zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam

bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /khog pa stong pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /mchin par rang gsal dpal bshos btsugs/ /glo mtsher mkhal ma'i mtheb kyus bsgron/ /ghu h+ya nang rol dza gad gsal/ /rang snang mkhris pa'i rak+tas bran/ /bskang ba'i gtor ma bla na med/ /zhi khro rab 'byam sa thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku sasum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol / /zhes gtor mas thugs dam bskang ngo / /bzhi nga snang gsal mar mes thugs dam bskang ba ni/ mched lcam rnams kyis mar me re re thogs la dkyil

jug /'khor bskor zhing 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ gdal khyab lpags pa'i kong bu ru/ /khrag dang chu ser mar khus gtams/ /sha dang rus pa'i sdong bu gtsugs//rang gsal bkrag mdangs sgron me sbar/ /'di yang rang byung zhun mar te/ /bskang ba'i zhun chen bla na med/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /bhan+dha 'bar ba'i kong bu ru/ /go ro tsa na'i mar khus gtams/ /gsal byed rtsa yi sdong bu gtsugs/ /dbang po lnga yi sgron me sbar/ /'di yang rang byung zhun mar te/ /bskang ba'i zhun chen bla na med/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /tsit+ta 'bar ba'i kong bu ru/ /snying tshil dkar dmar mar khus gtams/ /pad+ma 'dab

brgyad sdong bu gtsugs/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad sgron me sbar/ /'di yang rang byung zhun mar te/ /bskang ba'i zhun chen bla na med/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /dngas ma lnga yi kong bu ru/ /sgrib med 'od lnga'i mar khus gtams / /don snying lnga yi sdong bu gtsugs/ /'gyu byed dbugs kyi sgron me sbar/ /'di yang rang byung zhun mar te/ /bskang ba'i zhun chen bla na med / /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /a wa dhū ti'i kong bu ru/ /rang gsal 'od kyi mar khus gtams/ /'khor lo bdun brtsegs sdong bu gtsugs/ /byang chub sems kyi sgron me sbar/ /'di yang rang byung zhun mar te/ /bskang

)sto /ba'i zhun chen bla na med/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /mi shigs thig le'i kong bu ru/ /skye med ye shes mar khus gtams/ /rtsa bran bcu yi sdong bu gtsugs/ /rig pa rang byung sgron me sbar/ /'di yang rang byung zhun mar te/ /bskang ba'i zhun chen bla na med/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ye shes rtsa yi kong bu ru/ /a dkar rtsa gcig mar khus gtams/ /ye shes 'od zer sdong bu gtsugs/ /shes rab 'bras bu'i sgron me sbar/ /'di yang rang byung zhun mar te/ /bskang ba'i zhun chen bla na med/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /

mchog gi 'od gsal kong bu ru/ /gdangs gsal 'od kyi mar khus gtams/ /thig le 'bar ba'i sdong bu gtsugs/ /ye shes lnga yi sgron me sbar//'di yang rang byung zhun mar te/ /bskang ba'i zhun chen bla na med/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /kun gzhi klong yangs kong bu ru/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi mar khus gtams/ /byang chub sems kyi sdong bu gtsugs/ /sku lnga lhun grub sgron me sbar/ /'di yang rang byung zhun mar te/ /bskang ba'i zhun chen bla na med/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cis /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag

༄gi /gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /zhes snang gsal mar mes thugs dam bskang ngo / /de nas mched lcam rnams kyi lag tu mar me re re thogs la/ dkyil 'khor tha ma bskor zhing mgrin gcig tu dbyangs kyis 'di skad smon lam gdab pa ni/ oṃ āḥlha/dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje slob dpon gnyen gyi dbu bzung nas/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob mched dang lcam dral rnams / /nam zhig byang chub lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe/ /'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing / /ma rig mun pa'i nang du mi 'thum la/ /gcong rong zab mo'i nang du mi skye dang / /dmyal ba'i zangs khar lam du mi ltung zhing / /gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad mi grags te/ /las

kyi mtshon rnon dbal gyis mi phog shog /bshes gnyen dam pa bka' drin che ba dang / /dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje mched grogs dang / /shes rab gnyen gyis 'brel ba'i gzung ma gsum/ /tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rgyud thams cad du/ /mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis/ /sa bcu rim gyis khyad par bsgrod par shog /nam zhig tshe 'phos lus brjes dus byung tshe/ /ma rig gti mus rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por ltung srid na/ /gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung / /snang ba'i bo 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di/ /rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon zhig /zhe snang mnar ba'i las kyis sdug bsngal gyis/ /dmyal ba'i zangs khar lam/ du ltung srid pas/ /

༄ga /gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung / /snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di/ /rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon zhig /nga rgyal khro gtum khengs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad thos srid pas/ /gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung / /snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di/ /rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon zhig /'dod chags 'dzin pa las kyi sdug bsngal gyis/ /gcong rong zab mo'i nang du skye srid pas/ /gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung / /snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di/ /rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon zhig /phrag dog zus rngu'i las kyi sdug bsnga la gyis/ /mtshon cha gdug pa'i dbal gyis phog

srid pas/ /gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung / /snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di/ /rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon zhig /sa bcu'i khyad par rim gyis bsgrod pa'i tshe/ /nyon mongs bag chags ma lus der byang nas/ /'gro don thogs pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /sa bcu gcig char rdzogs par gyur nas ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mdun bcu/sa shig /byang chub sems ma/ rnams kyis mtha' skyor zhig /khro bo khro mo rnams kyis rgyab brten zhig /sa bcu'i khyad par rtse mor phyin pa'i tshe/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dngos grub der thob po/ /kun tu 'od kyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis shul mtshon zhig /bkra shes lha mo brgyad kyis mtha' skyor zhig /

༄sha /ye shes ting nge 'dzin gyis rgyab brten zhig /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la phyin pa'i tshe/ /gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ shul mtshon zhig /mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mtha' skyongs shig /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rgyab brten zhig /pad+ma can gyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe/ /shes rab ting nge 'dzin gyis shul mtshon zhig /sgo ba chen po rnams kyis mtha' skyongs shig /ta krita chen po rnams kyis brgyab brten zhig /'khor lo tshogs chen sa la phyin pa'i tshe/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnamyo/sa kyis mdun bsus shis /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis rgyab brten zhig /ma tshogs dbang phyug rnams kyis ma/tha' skyongs shig /bkod pa rab rdzobs sa la phyin nga/'i tshe/ /ye shes khro bo rnams kyis zhal mthong nas/ /rig

'dzin rnams kyi zhing du skyes nas kyang / /bla med sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog /shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus byang nas ni/ /yi ge gsum gyis gol sa der bkag go/ /de ba ko sha'i sa la phyin pa'i tshe/ /che mchog he ru ka yis mdun bsus shig /gro ti shwa rī yum gyis mtha' skyongs shig /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis srog brten zhig /thar pa chen ngo/'i grong du phyin tsa na/ /gzi brjid 'od dpag med kyis mdun bsus shig /gnyis med shes rab yum gyis mtha' skyongs shig /yi dam lha yis rgyab nas srog skyobs shig /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ming 'dzin sar phyin tshe//gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis shul mtshon zhig /mnyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis mtha' skyongs shig /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis rgyab brten

༄ga /zhig /lcang lo can gyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe/ /dbyer med ting nge 'dzin gyis shul mtshon zhig /grub pa'i 'bras bu mchog gi mtha' skyongs shig /rdzogs pa bla med sa la phyin pa'i tshe/ /khyab gdal ting nge 'dzin gyis shul mtshon zhig /'ub chub ting nge 'dzin gyis mtha' bsdus shig /srid gsum ngang rdzogs sa la phyin pa'i tshe/ /thig le chen po'i ngang du lhun grub nas/ /'od zer 'phrul bzhad chen ngo/ra mtha' bsdus shig /bya rtsol gnyis med sa la phyin pa'i tshe/ /chos sku skye ba med pa'i don rtogs nas/ /sna tshogs longs sku thabs mkhas thugs rje yis/ /ma 'gags sprul pas 'gro don byed par shog / ces pa la so gas nga 'i smon lam dang / sa'an yang theg pa chen ngo 'i smo na lam gang zhes gdab pa ra bya'o/ /gsu ma pa sasang ba khyad nga ra bla med tshogs kyis

bskang ba ni/ tshogs rdzas rnams mched lca ma rnams kyis btegs la/ tshogs kyi spyan 'dren dang / tshogs phud 'bul ba rnams las byang ltar byas la/ oṃ āḥsbyi bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhartu ā ཿoṃ ru 'u/ ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ zhes 'dzab dbyangs sgro gas la tshogs bshags bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dbus nas badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ /rdo rje rigs kyi thugs dam las/ /zhe snang dam tshig nyams so 'tshal/ /'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags/ /shar nas bai ro tsā na o/ /de bzhin rigs kyi thugs dam las/ /gti mug dam tshig nyams so 'tshal/ /'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags/ /lho nas rat+na saṃ bha tram̐/ /rin chen rigs kyi thugs dam las/ /nga rgyal dam tshig nyams so 'tshal/ /'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags/ /nub nas pad+ma dhe wa trī/ pad+ma rigs kyi thugs dam las/ /'dod chags dam tshig

༄dzo /nyams so 'tshal/ /'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags/ /byang nas kurma sirnyi āḥ las kyi rigs kyi thugs dam las/ /phrag dog dam tshig nyams so 'tshal/ /'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags/ /o gha na tsakra satwa sa ma ya zhes sogs tshogs kyi yig brgya bzlas shing / tshogs phud gtor mar 'bul/bsgral ba dang mchod pa la sogs las byang ltar bya/ de nas zhi khro'i mdangs bskang ni/ mched lcam rnams kyis bdud rtsi sbreng / rak+ta phyar/ rol mo dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bsko ra zhing / dang ngo zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang ba 'di ska da do/ /hūm̐ rnam shes phung po gnas dag pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dam bskang / /gzugs kyi phung po gnas dag pa'i / /rnam pa/ra snang mdzad thugs dam bskang / /tshor ba'i phung po gnas dag pa'i/ /rin chen 'byung ldan thugs dam bskang / /'du shes phung po gnas dag pa'i/ /snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskang / /'du byed phung po gnas dag pa'i/ /don yod grub pa'i thugs dam bskang //

nam mkha'i ngo bo gnas dag pa'i/ /kun tu bzang mo'i thugs dam bskang / /sa yi ngo bo gnas dag pa'i/ /sangs rgyas spyan ma'i thugs dam bskang / /chu yi ngo bo gnas dag pa'i/ /mā ma ki yi thugs dam bskang / /me yi ngo bo gnas dag pa'i/ /na bza' dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang / /rlung gi ngo bo gnas dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang / /rigs lnga yab yum gnas dag pa'i/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /khams dang skye mched

༄sha /gnas dag pa'i/ /sems dpa' sems ma'i thugs dam bskang / /mig gi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i/ /sa yi snying po'i thugs dam bskang / /rna ba'i rnam shes gnas dag pa'i/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs dam bskang / /sna yi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dam bskang / /lce yi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang / /mig gi dbang po gnas dag pa'i/ /byams pa mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /rna ba'i dbang po gnas dag pa'i/ /sgrib pa rnam sel thugs dam bska nga / /sna yi dbang po gnas dag pa'i/ /kun tu bzang po'i thugs dam bskang / /lce yi dbang po gnas dag pa'i/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i thugs dam bskang / /nye ba'i sras mchog

sems dpa' brgyad/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /la sa ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /gzugs su snang ba gnas dag pa'i/ /rdo rje sgeg mo'i thugs dam bskang / /sgra ru grags pa gnas dag pa'i/ /phreng ba ma yi thugs dam bskang / /dri ru mnam pa gnas dag pa'i/ /glu dbyangs ma yi thugs dam bskang / /ro bro'i ngo bo gnas dag pa'i/ /rdo rje gar ma'i thugs dam bskang / /'das dus rtog pa gnas dag pa'i/ /praḍū ma yi thugs dam bskang / /da lta'i rtog pa gnas/ dag pa'i/ /juspru ma yi

mulga /thugs dam bskang / /ma byon rtog pa gnas dag pa'i/ /ā lo ke yi thugs dam bskang / /'byung ba ma nges lha mo ni/ /gan+dhe ma yi thugs dam bskang / /dgyes pa bskong mdzad sems ma brgyad/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /lus kyi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i/ /gshin rje gshed po'i thugs dam bskang / /lus kyi dbang po gnas dag pa'i/ /stobs po che yi thugs dam bskang / /lus kyi reg bya gnas dag pa'i/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang / /

lus kyi reg shes gnas dag pa'i/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i thugs dam bskang / /rtag par lta ba gnas dag pa'i/ /lcags kyu ma yi thugs dam bskang / /chad par lta ba gnas das pa'i/ /zhags pa ma yi thugs dam bskang / /bdag tu lta ba gnas dag pa'i/ /lcags sgrog ma yi thugs dam bskang / /mtshan mar lta ba gnas dag pa'i/ /dril bu ma yi thugs dam bskang / /sprul pa'i sgo ba yab yum brgyad/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyam sa chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtos sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /nyon mongs nga rgyal

༄gi /gnas dag pa'i/ /lha yi thub pa'i thugs dam bskang / /nyon mongs phrag dog gnas dag pa'i/ /lha min thub pa'i thugs dam bskang / /nyon mongs 'dod chags gnas dag pa'i/ /mi yi thub pa'i thugs dam bskang / /nyon mongs gti mug gnas dag pa'i/ /byol song thub pa'i thugs dam bskang / /nyon mongs ser sna gnas dag pa'i/ /yi dwags thub pa'i thugs dam bskang / /nyon mongs zhe sdang gnas dag pa'i/ /dmyal ba'i thub pa'i thugs dam bskang / /rigs drug dong sprugs thub pa drug /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /

'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /yid kyi rnam shes gnas dag pa'i/ /rgyal ba kun bzang thugs dam bskang / /chos khams sna tshogs gnas dag nga 'i/ /kun tu bzang mo'i thugs dam bskang / /zhi ba sangs rgyas bzhi bcu gnyis/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /de nas khro bo'i lha tshosas kyi thugs dam bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ rang rig nyon mongs gnas gyur pa'i/ /che mchog he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang / /ma rig nyon mongs gnas gyur pa'i/ /

mug /yum chen gro ti'i thugs dam bskang / /khrag 'thung gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig/'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /sko ngas gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /rnam shes zhe sdang gnas gyur pa'i/ /badz+ra he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang / /gzugs phung gti mug gnas gyur pa'i/ /bud+dha he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang / /tshor ba nga rgyal gnas gyur pa'i/ /rat+na he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang / /'du shes 'dod chags gnas gyur pa'i/ /pad+ma he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang / /'du byed phrag dog gnas gyur pa'i/ /

marma he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang / /phyin ci log rtog gnas gyur pa'i/ /rak+ta he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang / /myong byed rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i / /sa nu he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang / /skye gnas rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i/ /gu h+ya he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang / /reg bya'i rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i/ /yak+ta he ru ka yi thugs dam bskang / /khrag 'thung gtso bo he ru dgu/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /hūm̐ nam mkha'i bkrag mdangs gnas gyur nga 'i/ /

༄sha /badz+ra gro ti'i thugs dam bskang / /sa khams sha chen gnas gyur pa'i/ /bud+dha kro ti'i thugs dam bskang / /chu khams khrag chen gnas gyur pa'i/ /rat+na kro ti'i thugs dam bskang / /me khams drod chen gnas gyur pa'i/ /pad+ma gro ti'i thugs dam bskang / /rlung khams dbugs chen gnas gyur pa'i/ /kurma gro ti'i thugs dam bskang / /drod skyes rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i/ /rak+ta kro ti'i thugs dam bskang / /mngal skyes rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i/ /sa nu gro ti'i thugs dam bskang / /rdzus skyes rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i/ /gu h+ya kro ti'i thugs dam bskang / /sgong skyes rtog pa gnas gyur pa'i/ /yak+ta gro ti'i thugs dam bskang / /yum chen gro ti shwa rī dgu/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams

chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ha/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i/ /ko'u rī ma yi thugs dam bskang / /yid kyi rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i/ /tso'u rī ma yi thugs dam bskang / /nyon mongs rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i/ /pra mo hā yi thugs dam bskang / /lus kyi rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i/ /be+e ta lī yi thugs dam bskang / /mig gi rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i/ /puska sī yi thugs dam bskang / /rna ba'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i/ /kusma rī yi thugs dam bskang / /sna ya'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i/ /sme sha nī yi

jug /thugs dam bskang / /lce yi rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i/ /tsan+ta lī yi thugs dam bskang / /gnas kyi kau'u rī ma mo brgyad/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /he/ don dam sems su gnas gyur pa'i/ /sedha ma yi thugs dam bskang / /chos kyi khams chen gnas gyur pa'i/ /byā kri ma yi thugs dam bskang / /bag chags 'thug po gnas gyur pa'i/ /sri la ma yi thugs dam bskang / /reg bya'i ngo bo gnas gyur pa'i/ /shwa na ma yi thugs dam bskang / /

gzugs kyi ngo bo gnas gyur pa'i/ /kri ta ma yi thugs dam bskang / /sgra grags ngo bo gnas gyur pa'i/ /gaṅgā ma yi thugs dam bskang / /dri mnams ngo bo gnas gyur pa'i/ /kha khā ma yi thugs dam bskang / /ro bro'i ngo bo gnas gyur pa'i/ /hu lu ma yi thugs dam bskang / /yul gyi sedha phra men brgyad/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /dzaḥ rtag par 'dzin pa gnas gyur pa'i/ /lcags kyu ma yi thugs dam bskang / /chad par 'dzin pa gnas gyur pa'i/ /

jug /zhags pa ma yi thugs dam bskang / /bdag tu 'dzin pa gnas gyur pa'i/ /lcags sgrog ma yi thugs dam bskang / /mtshan mar 'dzin pa gnas gyur pa'i/ /dril bu ma yi thugs dam bskang / /rta gdong ye shes sgo ma bzhi/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig/'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /hūm̐/ stong khams gnas nas spor ba'i phyir/ /nyi zer zhags 'phen ma yi thugs dam bskang / /mi rnams gnas nas spor ba'i phyir/ /mdung thung 'phen ma'i thugs dam bskang / /stong khams gnas nas

spor ba'i phyir/ /dril 'khrol ma yi thugs dam bskang / /lha rnams gnas nas spor ba'i phyir/ /khyung thogs ma yi thugs dam bskang / /lha min gnas nas spor ba'i phyir/ /skar mda' 'phen ma'i thugs dam bskang / /yi dwags gnas nas spor ba'i phyir/ /glog phreng 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang / /byol song gnas nas spor ba'i phyir/ /glag sha rdeb ma'i thugs dam bskang / /dmyal ba'i gnas nas spor ba'i phyir/ /ral gri 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskang / /rigs drug spor byed chen mo brgyad/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu

༄ga /sku gsum thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /bh+yoḥ snal tshig nyer brgyad gnas gyur pa'i/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad thugs dam bskang / /zhi ba'i las rnams mdzad pa'i phyir/ /darka/ra mo ma bdun thugs dam bskang / /rgyas pa'i las rnams mdzad pa'i phyir / /ser mo ma/ bdun thugs dam bskang / /dbang gi las rnams mdzad pa'i phyir/ /dmar mo ma bdun thugs dam bskang / /drag po'i las rnams mdzad pa'i phyir/ /ljang mo ma bdun thugs dam bskang / /dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong mdzad ma/ /dbang mo nyer brgyad thugs dam bskang / /khrag 'thung lha tshogs bdun cu drug /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /mchog chen

mchog phran mtshan ldan dang / /zal le 'bri dang shel sgong lug /tsa ra mkha' lding mdangs kyis bskang / /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang / /rak+ta dmar gyi arnya dang / /rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang / /rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang / /sha chen lang ling sna tshogs dang / /snang gsal zhun gyi mar me dang / /sha chen gsur gyi dud pa dang / /thod pa ltag sprod rnga sgra dang / /rkang chen dung gi gling bu dang / /thun mong mchod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /zhi khro'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /khyed kyi thugs dam skongs gyur nas/ /bdag gi g.yar dam sor stsol cig /g.yar dam skong la rkyen dbang bzlog /de nas rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang ba ni/ hūm̐/ snang srid phur bus gdab pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje gzhon

༄sna /nu'i thugs dam bskang / /yab yum gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs thugs dam bskang / /gnyis med thugs las sprul pa'i phyir/ /phular pa sras kyi thugs dam bskang / /phyogs bcur sprul pa 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /khro bo pha bcu'i thugs dam bskang / /yab kyi dgyes pa bskong ba'i phyir/ /khro mo ma bcu'i thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi sprul pa 'gyed pa'i phyir: za byed pha bcu'i thugs dam bskang / /yum gyi thugs la sprul pa'i phyir/ /gsod byed ma bcu'i thugs dam bskang / /chos kyi dbyings las sprul pa'i phyir/ /shwa na ma bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /sha khrag kun la dbang byed phyir/ /bse mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang / /gling bzhi kun la dbang byed pa'i/ /bdag nyid ma bzhi'i

thugs dam bskang / /dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir/ /skyes bu ging bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /khrag gi rgya mtsho skems pa'i phyir/ /ma bdun sring bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /rū tra rnam gsum sgrol ba'i phyir/ /ging chen bco brgyad thugs dam bskang / /thugs kyi sprul pa 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /'bar ma dgu yi thugs dam bskang / /phyogs bcur pho nya 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /pho nya drug bcu'i thugs dam bskang / /rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang / /nyams chags thams cad skongs gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig /khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsu/ma thob gyur cig /skongs gyur dbang dang

nonan /dngos grub stsol/ /zhes pa dang / gzhan yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi bska nga ba mang du bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dngo na 'dus pa rgya mtsho dang bcas pa rnams kyis tshogs la rol/ nyams skyong rdo rje'i glu gar la sogs pa 'gasas med kyi spyod pa bskyangs/ tshogs lhag kyang bsdus la gtso bo'i zhal chab bran/ lhag ma bsngos te btang ba'am/ yang na lha ga ma ma btang ba'i gong du/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid don dam byang chub sems kyi bskang ba ni/ rnal 'byor pho mo mched lcam rnams rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ dpa' brtul gyi nyams bskyed dbang po la hur bton phyag rgya gar dang stangs sta bas bsgyur zhing /hūm̐ dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskang / /snang ba ye shes chen po'i klong du bskang / /gsal ba shes rab 'ba' ba'i klong du bskang / /sdug bsngal ka dag chos nyid klong du bskang / /kun rdzob don dam gnyis med klong du bskang / /khams dang skye mched gnas dag pa'i/ /zhi ba'i lha tshogs klong du bskang / /nyon mongs rtog tshogs gnas gyur pa'i/ /khro po'i lha tshogs klong du bskang / /mchod du med de gnyis med

rol pas mchod/ /bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskangs/ /sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor/ /bsgrol du med de mnyam nyid dbyings su sgrol/ /ye sbyor ye sgrol chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /zhes pas bskang / a la la ho: i āḥdh+ri hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings na bzhugs shing dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nas byon pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro/ rang rtsal rig pa'i klong nas rang byon pa'i bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ bka' srung pho nya las mkhan dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dgongs su gsol/ 'di ltar bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral 'dus pa rgya mtsho

༄sha /rnams kyis/ bla med yang dag mchog gi mchod pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba la brten nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad khams gsum du 'khor zhing rigs drug gi duḥkha la spyod pa rnams kyi dam tshig chags nyams 'gal 'khrul nyes ltung thams cad/kun bzang yangs pa'i klong du skongs shing bde chen chos nyid kyi dbyings su sor chud par gyur cig /ma hā sirnyi sa ma ya e ma ho/ ā ā āḥces pas bskang bar bya/ lhag ma bskyal lo/ /de dag ni thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa'o/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba rnams ni 'og tu shes par bya'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba rnams la bskul ba dang / dpang gzu/ sgo dbye/zor brdeg /brtan skyong / gtor bro/ dngos grub blang ba bzod gsol/ bkra shis/ bsngo ba/ smon lam/ gshegs gsol/ rdzogs rim la sogs pa rnams ni/ las byang ltar rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun la bya'o/ /bskang bshags nyams chags rang grol gyi thugs dam bskang ba'i rim pa 'di nyid u rgyan pa d+ma 'byung gnas kyis zhi khro'i mdangs bskang mdzad pa la brten nas rang 'dra blo dman rnams kyi don du 'grig chags su bkod pa 'di ni khyi lo hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes la rgya ra ba nam mkha' chos kyi rgya mtshos dpapal chos mkhar rtse ru bris so//
)rdzo
tshog /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi bka' srung dam can sde bdun chos skyong kun 'dus kyi mdangs bskang gdug pa rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gagi /o ā rdu: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byam sa dang : mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'dud: dam can sde bdun chos skyong kun 'dus kyi:mdangs bskang gdug pa rang grol 'dir bshad bya: mchod rdzas bskang rdzas tshogs par bshams nas su : dam can sgos mchod srung ma spyi bskang gnyis: dang podam can sgos su mchod pa ni: ྈ: ma hā ka la thugs dam can: khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: rin chen snod dmabhan+dha ru: bshos nag 'bar ba khrag gis byug: tsit+ta snying gi rgyal mtshan btsugs: g.yag 'u ga nag po khyi

༄sha /yis mtshan: dgra bo'i sha rus thod tshil spungs: rak+ta dmar gyi zham chu 'bab: dam rdzas gtor chen 'bar ba 'dis: dpal mgon nag po'i thugs dam bskang : gzhan yang thugs dam skong ba'i rdzas: bdud rtsi sman gtor rak+ta dang : sha sna snying sna khrag sna dang :chibs rta 'gel g.yag rten lug dang :bing dang ru mtshon gsang ba'i rdzas: mthun rdzas du mas thugs dam bskang : ma ning nag po mched gsum gyi: thugs dam gnyan po skongs gyur cig: lha: dpal ldan sngags kyi bsrung ma la: mthun pa'i rdzas kyis bskang ba ni: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang : rak+ta dmar gyi arnya dang : zhun chen mar me gsur dud dang : zhal zas tshogs

kyi mchod pa yis: smug nag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : lha: yum mchog lha mo dpal 'bar ma: khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba ni:sha khrag dmar gyi rak+ta dang : khyad par mthun pa nal bu'i rdzas: mthing gi gur dang rak+ta'i mtsho: mi rta'i sha khrag dron mo yis: yum mchog lha mo 'khor dang bcas: ma mo yongs kyi thugs dam bskang : rdu: shan pa srog bdag 'khor dang bcas: khyed dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: dpal gtor sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan: spos dang zhun chen mar me dang : dgra bo'i sha khrag glo snying ni: khrag 'dzag dron mo rlangs pa 'thulaḥ klad khrag rus par bcas pa yis: srog bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : lha: gza' bdud nag po 'khor bcas la:

sngag /khyed dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: dmar gtor bshos bu dgus bskor dang : dgra bo'i sha khrag rus pa dang : me tog stong dang chu sna stong : sman sna stong dang sha sna stong : snying sna stong dang khrag sna stong : gsur chen rol mo sna tshogs kyis: drang srong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : lha: dam can skyes bu thig le rtsal: khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba ni: mkhar thabs bshos bu ra yis mtshan: sha khrag sman gtor rak+ta dang : ra yi sha khrag gsur chen dang : snyag rgod khrab byang rnga khra dang : mdzes pa'i glu gar rol mo dang : mthun rdzas du mas thugs dam bskang : lha: gnod sbyin dmar nag 'khor bcas la: mthun pa'i dam rdzas bshos bu dang : phyi mchod rin chen sna lnga dang :

nang mchod bdud rtsi rnam lnga dang : gsang mchod sman raka gtor gsum dang : sha khrag 'dod yon rnam lnga dang : sil snyan glu gar rol mo dbyangs: spyan gzigs dkor nor thugs dam bskang : sbyi: gzhan yang dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sngags bdas sde dpon sum cu dang : gter srung bstan ma bcu gnyis dang : dbe bsnyen nyer gcig gzhi bdag dang : gzhan yang slob dpon pad+ma yi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: dge bsnyen yul lha gzhi bdag rnams: spos dang mar mes thugs dam bskang : sman gtor rak+tas thugs dam bskang :mthun rdzas du mas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam skongs la phrin las mdzod: de nas bka' srung dam can spyi yi bskang ba ni: kye: dgongs shig dam can

༄sha /rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma hā kā la dgongs su gsol: ma ning nag po dgongs su gsol: lha chen dpal 'bar dgongs su gsol: srog bdud nag po dgongs su gsol: me dbal nag po dgongs su gsol: dpal ldan sngags srung dgongs su gsol: yum mchog lha mo dgongs su gsol: shan pa srog bdag dgongs su gsol: gza' bdud nag po dgongs su gsol: rdo rje legs pa dgongs su gsol:gnod sbyin dmar nag dgongs su gsol: dam can rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: brtan ma bcu gnyis dgongs su gsol: kye: do nub dpal gyi dam zhig bsre: do nub snga ma'i gtang rag gtong : do nub phyi ma'i zhu don 'bul: do nub las kyi gnyer zhig gtad: do nub

nyams chags zhig ral gso: do nub thugs dam gnyen po bskang : do nub mnyes pa'i zas shig 'dren: zas kyi ngo zhig khyod kyis mdzod:chad pa'i gzhung ni nga yis bsrang : bcol ba'i las 'di khyod kyis mdzod: gnyis ka las kyi gnyer blangs 'tshal: srung ma dam can khyed rnams kyang : rgyang nge g.yel le ma mdzad par: brtse gdung gdungs sems che bar mdzod: gtad do gnyer ro thugs dam can: gsol lo mchod do srung ma'i tshogs: phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod: lha: yang cig dpal gyi thugs dam bskang : dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : dregs pa pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: g.yab dar nag pos thugs dam bskang : brten

sngag /pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: phyar dar nag pos thugs dam bskang : bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: nyi zla pad+mas thugs dam bskang : dgyes pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: dmar chen gtor mas thugs dam bskang : mthun pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: sha sna snying snas thugs dam bskang : btung ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: rak+ta khrag snas thugs dam bskang : bgo ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir:zhing chen g.yang gzhis thugs dam bskang : rgyan gyi dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: thod phreng mi mgos thugs dam bskang : 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: rkang gling thod rngas thugs dam bskang : drag po'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: thun dang zor gyis thugs dam bskang : khyad

par dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: gri rgod snying gis thugs dam bskang : dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir: bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang : shangs kyi mchod pa yin pa'i phyir: gsur chen dud pas thugs dam bskang : dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir: zhal zas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor dam tshig bskang ba'i phyir: 'dod yon lnga yis thugs dam bskang : dug lnga gnas su gzhom pa'i phyir: su ra chang gis thugs dam bskang : spyan gyi mchod pa yin pa'i phyir: spyan gzigs dkor chas thugs dam bskang : snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: rol mo sgra yis thugs dam bskang : rtag tu mi 'bral 'grog pa'i phyir: rtag gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang :

༄sha /rgyun du phrin las bcol ba'i phyir: rgyun gtor nar mas thugs dam bskang : dam nyams dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phyir: 'khor tshogs sprul pa'i thugs dam bskang ཿ skongs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: g.yar dam skongs la rkyen dbang bzlog: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: de nas bathags pa bya ba ni: lha: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang : mkha' 'gro dam can sde bdun dgongs: srung ma dam can khyed rnams kyi: thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa gang : do nub bskang zhing bshags par bgyi: mthol bshags ngang du bzhes nas kyang : rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: chags che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul rgyas pa dang : phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par

mdzod: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang : 'khor dang gdul bya phrin las dang : bkra shis bde 6pegs 9/sdo/ba pazag myosajordzurngani: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi: bka' srung dam can sde bdun chos skyong kun 'dus kyi mdangs bskang gdug pa rang grol zhes bya ba 'di ni: lus lo khyi yi zla ba'i yar tshes bzang po la: dang la rin chen gling du bris pas: 'gro ba sems can tham sa cad kyis zab chos 'di nyid la longs spyod nas mthar thug sku gsu ma lhun grub kyi 'bras bu thob par gyur cig:
sngag /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: brgya phyag sdig sgrib rang grol zhes bya ba: bar do thos grol gyi cha lag bzhugs so:

mug /kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang : dam pa rigs brgya 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: gus pas phyag 'tshal sdig sgrib kun byang nas: 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod pa ra shog: dam pa rigs brgya zhi khyo rab 'byams la: sdig sgrib sbyang phyir brgya phyag 'tshal ba'i thabs: phyag 'tshal sdig sgrib rang grol 'di bstan gyi: dus gsum kun tu 'di la 'bad par gces: na mo dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku: yid shes rnam dag sangs rgyas kun kyi yab: nam mkha'i mdog can mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: kun bzang chos

)rdzo /kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum: chos khams rnam dag dri med shel ltar dkar: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: yum chen kun tu bzang mor phyag 'tshal lo: seng chen khri steng gti mug ma spangs dgaci gzugs phung rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes ngang : dung mdog phyag na 'khor lo dril bu bsnams: sku mchog rnam snang sku la phyag 'tshal lo: glang chen khri steng zhe sdang ma spangs dag: rnam shes rnam dag me long ye shes ngang : mthing mdog phyag na rdo rje dril bu bsnams: thugs mchog rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal lo: rta mchog khri steng nga rgyal ma spangs dag: tshor ba rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes ngang : gser mdog phyag na rin

chen dril bu bsnams: yon tan rin chen 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo: rma bya'i khri steng 'dod chags ma spangs dag: 'du shes rnam dag sor rtog ye shes ngang : zangs/ mdo phyag na pad+ma dril bu bsnams: gsung mchog snang mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo: shang shang khri steng phrag dog ma spangs dag: 'du byed rnam dag bya grub ye shes ngang : g.yu mdog phyag na rgya gram dril bu bsnams: phrin las don yod grub la phyag 'tshal lo: nam mkha' rnam dag sangs rgyas rigs kyi yum: zla ba'i mdog 'dra 'khor lo dril 'dzin ma: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: yum chen dbyings phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo: sa khams rnam dag rdo rje rigs kyi yumaḥ bai ḍūr mdog 'dra rdo rje dril 'dzin

༄sha /ma: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: yum chen sangs rgyas spyan la phyag 'tshal lo: chu khams rnam dag rin chen rigs kyi yum: btso ma'i mdog 'dra rin chen dril 'dzin ma: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: yum chen mā ma tī la phyag 'tshal lo:me khams rnam dag pad+ma rigs kyi yum: me shel mdog 'dra pad+ma dril 'dzin ma: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: yum chen gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal lo: rlung khams rnam dag las kyi rigs kyi yum: in+d+ra'i mdog 'dra rgya gram dril 'dzin ma: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: yum chen dam tshig sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo: mig gi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: gangs ri'i mdog can myu gu

dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: sa yi snying po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: rna ba'i rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sprin dkar mdog 'dra klu shing dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: byams nga/ mi tri'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: sna yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: sprur len mdog 'dra snye ma dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: kun tu bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: lce yi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su das: gser chen mdog 'dra ral gri dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: nam ma kha'i snying po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal/ lo: lus kyi rnam shes ma spangs

sngag /gnas su dag: bye ru'i mdog 'dra klu shing dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: spyan ras gzigs dbang zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: yid kyi rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: li khri'i mdog can ut+pa dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: kun gzhi'i rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: kun+da'i mdog can po ti dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: sgrib pa rnam sel zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: nyon yid rnam shes ma spangs gnas su dag: mar gad mdog can rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: phyag na rdo rje'i

zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: gzugs su snang ba ma spangs gnas su dag: chu shel mdog can me long dril bu 'dzin: dus gsum bde gshegs spyan la mchod 'bul ma: khā se dkar mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: 'das pa'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: mu tig mdog can pad dkar dril bu 'dzin: dus gsum bde gshegs mchod pas mnyes byed ma: phusne dkar mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: chos can rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: gur gum mdog can phreng ba dril bu 'dzin: dus gsum bde gshegs phyag rgyas mnyes byed ma: mā le ser mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: dri ru snoms pa ma spangs gnas su dag: rat+na'i mdog can dri zhim spos phor bsnams: dus gsum bde gshegs/

༄sha /shangs la mchod 'bul ma: sbruspru ser mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: sgra ru grags pa ma spangs gnas su dag: ha lo'i mdog can pi wang sgra sgrogs ma: dus gsum bde gshegs snyan la mchod 'bul maḥ gīrti dmar mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'ong rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: pad+ma'i mdog can snang gsal mar me 'dzin: dus gsum bde gshegs spyan la mchod 'bul ma: ā lo dmar mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: da lta'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: ut+pal mdog can dri yi dung phor 'dzin: dus gsum bde gshegs thugs la mchod 'bul ma: gan+dhe ljang mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: ro bro'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: rgya mtsho'i mdog can bcud ldan zhal

zas bsnams: dus gsum bde gshegs ljags la mchod 'bul ma: rmārti ljang mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: rtag par lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog dkar po dbyug to dril bu 'dzin: khro bo'i gzugs kyis shar sgo'i bar chad srung : rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: chad par lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog ser po thod dbyug dril bu 'dzin: khro bo'i gzugs kyis lho sgo'i bar chad srung : gshin rje gshed po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag tu lta ba ma spangs gnas su dag: sku mdog dmar po lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: khro bo'i gzugs kyis nub sgo'i bar chad srung : rta mgrin rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: mtshan mar lta ba ma spangs gnas su

jug /dag: sku mdog ljang gu rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: khro bo'i gzugs kyis byang sgo'i bar chad srung : bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: snying rje tshad med rigs drug gnas nas 'dren: sku mdog dkar mo 'gugs byed lcags kyu 'dzin: khro bo'i sku la gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: rdo rje lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal lo: byams pa tshad med 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma: sku mdog ser mo 'ching byed zhags pa 'dzin: khro bo'i sku la gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: rdo rje zhags pa ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dga' ba tshad med 'gro ba dang du len: sku mdog dmar mo sdom byed lcags sgrogs 'dzin: khro bo'i sku la gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: rdo rje lcags sgrogs ma la phyag 'tshal lo:

btang snyoms tshad med 'gro la nye ring med: sku mdog ljang gu 'bebs byed dril bu 'dzin: khro bo'i sku la gnyis med dgyes par 'khril: rdo rje dril bu ma la phyag 'tshal lo: nga rgyal rnam dag lha yi 'jig rten 'dren: sku mdog dkar po sgra snyan pi wang 'dzin: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: lha dbang brgya byin zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: phrag dog rnam dag lha min 'jig rten 'dren: sku mdog ljang gu skyob byed go mtshon 'dzin: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: thags bzang ris kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: 'dod chags rnam dag mi yi 'jig rten 'dren: gser mdog phyag na lhung bzed mkhar gsil 'dzin: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i:

༄ga /shākya thub pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: gti mug rnam dag byol song 'jig rten 'dren: sku mdog mthing ga po ti glegs bam 'dzin: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: seng ge rab brtan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: ser sna rnam dag yi dwags 'jig rten 'dren: sku mdog dmar po rin chen sgrom bu 'dzin: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: bcom ldan kha 'bar zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: zhe sdang rnam dag dmyal ba'i 'jig rten 'dren: nag po'i phyag na bsil drod me chu bsnams: sprul sku'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: lnga/ smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar zhal: rdo rje kha ṭī rnge'u chang g.yas na

'dzin: dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams: che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: dmar smug zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar zhal: 'khor lo dgra sta ral gri g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu thong gshol bhan+dha g.yon na bsnams: bud+dha he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar zhal: rdo rje bhan+dha dgra sta g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu bhan+dha thong gshol g.yon na bsna mas: badz+ra he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: ser nag zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar zhal: rin chen kha ṭ+wāṃ be con g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu bhan+dha tri shul g.yon na bsnams: rat+na he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug dkar sngo zhal: pad+ma kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to g.yas na 'dzin: dril

༄ga /bu bhan+dha rnge'u chung g.yon na bsnams: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: lngang nag zhal gsum phyag drug dkar dmar zhal: ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to g.yas na 'dzin: dril bu bhan+dha thong gshol g.yon na bsnams: karma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo dbyings phyug mthing nag rdo rje 'dzin: dmar chen bhan+dha yab kyi zhal du stobs: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: gro ti shwa rī ma la phyag 'tshal lo: bde gshegs dbyings phyug dmar smug 'khor lo 'dzin: dmar chen bhan+dha yab kyi zhal du stobs: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril:bud+dha gro ti ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rdo rje dbyings phyug mthing skya rdo rje 'dzin: dmar chen bhan+dha yab kyi zhal du stobs: bde ba chen pos yab la

dgyes par 'khril: badz+ra kro ti ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rin chen dbyings phyug ser skya rin chen 'dzin: dmar chen bhan+dha yab kyi zhal du stobs: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: rat+na gro ti ma la phyag 'tshal lo: pad+ma dbyings phyug dmar skya pad+ma 'dzin: dmar chen bhan+dha yab kyi zhal du stobs: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: pad+ma gro ti ma la phyag 'tshal lo: las kyi dbyings phyug ljang skya rgya gram 'dzin: dmar chen bhan+dha yab kyi zhal du stobs: bde ba chen pos yab la dgyes par 'khril: karma gro ti ma la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo dkar mo zhing chen gdan la 'gyings: 'khor ba'i rnam rtog gzhom phyir zhing dbyug 'phyar: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad

༄sha /pa'i: shar phyogs ko'u rī ma la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo ser mo zhing chen gdan la 'gying : thabs shes gnyis su med phyir mda' gzhu 'gengs: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: lho phyogs tso'u rī ma la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo dmar mo zhing chen gdan la 'gyings: 'khor ba mi gtong chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: nub phyogs pra mo hā la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo ljang nag zhing chen gdan la 'gying : chos nyid 'gyur med rdo rje bhan+dha 'dzin: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: byang phyogs be ta lī la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo dmar ser zhing chen gdan la 'gyings: nyon mongs gnas nas 'dren phyir rgyu ma

gsol: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: shar lho puska sī la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo ljang nag zhing chen gdan la 'gyings:'khor ba zhal du gsol phyir dung khrag 'thung : ma mo 'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: lho nub gasmu rī la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo ser skya zhing chen gdan la 'gyings: log rtog phral phyir bam ro mgo lus phral: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: nub byang tsan+dha lī la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo mthing nag zhing chen gdan la 'gyings: 'khor ba rten dang phral phyir bam chen phral: ma mo'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: byang shar sme sha ni la phyag 'tshal lo: smug nag seng ge'i gdong can kha ro thogs: 'khor ba gting nas sprugs

༄gi /phyir ral pa gsigs: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: seng ha mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dmar mo stag gdong lag gnyis thur du bsnol: 'khor ba zhe la gnon phyir 'bru tshugs blta: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: byu kri mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: nag mo wa yi gdong can spu gri phyar: nyon mongs gnas su dag phyir glo snying za: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: sri la mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: mthing nag spyang mo'i gdong can bam ro 'drad: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs phyir 'bru tshugs blta:phra men gzugs gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: shu na mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dkar ser bya rgod mgo can bam ro thogs: dus gsum

rtsad nas gcod phyir rgyu ma 'dren: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: gri ta mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dmar nag dang ku'i mgo can bam ro khur: 'khor ba dang du len phyir 'phrag la gzar: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: kaṅka mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: nag mo bya rog gdong can ral gri 'phyar: nyon mongs bsgral zhing gsol phyir dung khrag 'thung : phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: khu kha mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: mthing nag 'ug pa'i gdong can lcags kyu 'dzin: 'khor ba'i log rtog 'dren phyir bhan+dha thogs: phra men gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i mdzad pa'i: hu lu mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: shar sgor rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin: snying

mug /rje tshad med 'khor ba gnas nas 'dren: sgo ma'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: rta gdong lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal lo:lho sgor phag gdong ser mo zhags pa 'dzin: byams pa tshad med log rtog 'ching bar byed: sgo ma'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad nga/'i: phag gdong zhags pa ma/ la phyag 'tshal lo: nub sgor seng gdong dmar mo lcags sgrogs 'dzin: dga' ba tshad med ma rig nyon mongs bsdom/sa: sgo ma'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: seng gdong lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo: byang sgor sbrul gdong ljang gu dril bu 'dzin: btang snyoms tshad med dug lnga'i rtog pa 'joms: sgo mi'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: sbrul gdong dril bu

ma la phyag 'tshal lo: chos nyid rnam dag cir yang snang ba yi: srid gsum zhing du sbyor ba'i g.yang gzhi gsol: stong khams gnas spor nyi zer zhags pa 'phen: spor byed zhags 'phen ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnam rtog nad rnams rtag tu bsal ba'i phyir: nyon mongs lnga sbyong thod khrag mdung thung 'phen: thugs rje thabs mkhas mi rnams gnas nas spor: spor byed mdung thung 'phen la phyag 'tshal lo: ma rig sems can dbyings la gzud pa'i phyir: stong khams dbang sdud dung khrag thugs kur bskyil: brjid pa'i rol pas stong khams gnas nas spor:spor byed dril 'khrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo: mdog bzang dkar ser zhi rgyas ldan pa'i sku: 'dod lnga dbang mdzad dung khrag thugs kur

༄dzo /bskyil: lha rnams gnas spor rdo rje khyung chen 'dzin: spor byed khyung thogs ma la phyag 'tshal lo: mthing nag chen mo rngams pa'i sku mnga' zhing : g.yul chen rab bzlog rdo rje skar mda' 'phen: lha min gnas spor dung khrag zhal du gsol: spor byed skar mda' 'phen la phyag 'tshal lo: sku mdog dmar nag dbang drag 'dzoms pa'i zhal: phyi nang sgrib gnyis sbyangs nas bde ba'i phyir: rdo rje glog phreng yi dwags gnas nas spor: spor byed glog phreng 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo: dkar nag phyed ma zhi drag ldan pa'i sku: gti mug stong mdzad thod khrag zhal du gsol: byol song gnas spor rdo rje glag sha rdeb: spor byed glag sha rdeb la phyag 'tshal lo: sku mdog ser nag drag ngo rgyas pa'i

sku: dmyal ba stong mdzad thod khrag zhal du gsol: dmyal ba'i gnas spor rdo rje ral gri 'dzin: spor byed ral gri 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo:rnal 'byor dkar smug rdo rje bhan+dha 'dzin: srin mo g.ya ga mgo ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dkar ser rdo rje pad+ma 'dzin: tshangs pa sbrul mgo ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dkar ljang rdo rje tri shul 'dzin: lha chen gzig mgo ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dkar sngo rdo rje 'khor lo 'dzin: gtog 'dod sre mong mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dkar dmar rdo rje mdung thung 'dzin: gzhon nu dred gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dkar mo rdo rje rgyu zhags 'dzin: brgya byin dom mgo ma la 'phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ser mo rin chen spu

jug /gri 'dzin: rdo rje pha wang mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar ser rin chen bum pa 'dzin: zhi ba chu srin mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar ser rin chen pad+ma 'dzin: bdud rtsi sdig gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dkar ser rin chen rdo rje 'dzin: zla ba khra mgo ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ser ljang rin chen dbyug to 'dzin: be con wa gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ser nag rin chen thod khrag 'thung : srin mo stag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar ljang pad+ma be con 'dzin: za ba bya rgod mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar mo pad+ma khog chen 'dzin: dga' ba rta gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dam ra skya pad+ma

dbyug to 'dzin: stobs chen khyung gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar mo pad+ma rdo rje 'dzin: srin mo khyi gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar mo pad+ma mda' gzhu 'dzin: 'dod pa pu shud mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor dmar ljang pad+ma bum nga/ 'dzin:nor srung sha ba'i mgo la phyag 'tshal lo : rnal 'byor ljang sngon rgya gram ba dan phyar: rlung lha spyang mo'i mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ljang dmar rgya gram gsal shing 'dzin: mi mo skyin gyi mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ljang nag rgya gram mche zhags 'dzin: phag mo phag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ljang dmar rgya gram zhing chung 'dzin: rdo rje khwa ta'i mgo la phyag 'tshal lo : rnal 'byor ljang nag rgya

༄sha /gram bam chen 'dzin: sna chen glang chen mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor ljang gu rgya gram sbrul zhags 'dzin: chu lha sprul gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: sgo ma dkar mo rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin: rdo rje khu byug mgo la phyag 'tshal lo: sgo ma ser mo rin chen zhags pa 'dzin: rdo rje ra gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: sgo ma dmar mo pad+ma lcags sgrog 'dzin: rdo rje seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: sgo ma ljang nag gya gram dril bu 'dzin: rdo rje sprul gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: zhes pa rnal 'byor mched lcam du yod kun: gcer bur phyung ste brkyang phyag gus cing ra 'tshal: ngag gis tshig dbyangs snyan pos bstod byas nas: yid kyis dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams: gnong 'gyod tshul gyis brgya phyag gus pas 'tshal: zhi khro'i lha phyag brgya dang bcur longs pa'i: sgrib sbyangs khyad 'phags sdig sgrib rang grol 'di: na raka bskang bshags la sogs gang byed kyang : 'di bzhin byas pas bsod nams tshad las 'das: de phyir brgya phyag 'di la rab tu 'bad: 'i kro dam pa rigs brgya'i brgya phyag sdig sgrib rang grol zhes bya

ba 'khor ba ma stongs bar du ma rdzogs so: bar do'i thos grol gyi cha lag: na raka bskang bshags kyi cha rkyen: zhi khro las byang gsum gyi don 'dus: 'in tu zab par bstan pa 'di ni: kun la spel zhing dus gsum du ma chags pa ra brtson par gyis shig: sa ma ya: karma gling pa'i gter ma'o:spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng du: bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: sku mdog shel 'dra'i thugs ka ru: zla steng hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor:bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun tshangs bug babs: bdag gi nyams chags sdig sgrib dag: bcom ldan dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi: bdag dang sdus ༵ saX dron ma lus pa: sdig sgrib sbyangs phyir ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun: da lta nyid du bdag la stsal du gsol: o badz+ra sa twa sa ma

murdza /bdag ni mi shes gti mug rmongs pa yis: dam tshig srung mtshams las ni 'gal zhing nyams: bla ma mgon po khyod kyis skyabs mdzod cig: gtso bo dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' ste: thugs rje chen po brtse ba'i bdag nyin can: 'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag sogs skyabs mdzod cig: sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun: ma lus byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol: dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag nyid kyang :rdo rje sems dpa' deng 'dir 'grub gyur nas: 'gro ba sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa: de yi sa la myur du 'god par shog: rdo rje sems dpa' khyed sku ci 'dra dang : 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang : khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba: de 'dra kho nar bdag
sogs 'gyur bar shog:

jug /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol la sa: gshin don gyi cho ga gang rung la sbyar chog pa'i gri khrol man ngag /byang bur dgugs bstim zin 'phral/ mdun du til dang / sayas su me/ g.yon du chu bshams nas/tshe 'das rnam shes a yig dkar po dang : bh+yaḥyig sngo skya k+ṣa yig dmar skya yi: dra bas rus pa lpags pa'i tshul tu btums: bdag gi thugs las hūm̐ yig dkar po dang : phaṭa yig dmar ser dpag med 'phros pa yis: gro dang k+ṣa yi drwa ba dngos med bshig: til la ma yungs dkar ming byang la bsko ra/ me chu la dor zhing / a n-i k+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: brgya rtsa brgyad dam bdun sogs brjod: dkon mchog gsum dang zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: thams cad rigs 'gre yin: mi 'khrugs rgyal po yi: 'od dpag med mabon gyi: bden pa chen po'i tshe 'das 'di nyid kyi: 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor skrag dngangs 'ur 'jigs kyi: bag chags ngan pa'i gri lcags bral lcu/ra cig: sol mo bsnol ba la phyir grol ba'i phyag rgyas/ cos bajordo bhan+dha tra tha: myos baja( dhi tā tha: de nas las bum gyi ku shas mtshan byang la gtor zhing / las sngags/ me chu

nang du blugs la / byang bu la la na gsum bskor zhing / oṃ badz+ra ging tra tha: ces phyir dor/ dri gos ra/tshan byang cedro 'das lus su gsal: pra we sha ya phaṭa ces lus sgo phyes: bh+yaḥ a we sha ya āḥzhes brjod pa yis: rnam par shes pa āḥyig dngul chu'i mdog: lus la zhugs pas tshe 'das dngos gyur pa'i: snying khar ye shes rdo rje rtse lnga pa: lho bar hūm̐ yig dkar pos mtshan pa la: dzaḥhū bam̐ hoḥmi 'gyur rgyas btab gyur: rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya ming byang spyi bor bzhag la:lus la rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lugs su brkon par gyur: i badz+ra ka la sha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa: ming byang spyir bor rdo rje bzhag la/ phyi rol rdo rje'i gur khang chen por gyur: baja( rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sbyi: zhes 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor gri rigs gang yang rung ba de gri khrol ma byas na/ tshe 'das la dge rtsa thob du mi 'jug pa 'i bar chad byed ces/ rgyud gzhung nas gsungs 'don byar rata gling thugs rje gsang 'dus cha lags las/kurma chags med kyis bsgribs pa 'di bzhin 'gro don byed mkhan rnams nas phyag len 'debs pa gal che/

mug /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa wa ād+ma ko3lha: mdun gyi rten snang rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang : bh+yaḥlas tshe 'das gzugs phung skye mched gsal: gzhin tshul pus btsug thal sbyar me tog 'dzin: zhi tshul ras dkar gos gyon bla ma lhar: dad cing gus pa'i tshul gyis gnas par gyur:
༄ga /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: na raka bskang bshags nyams chags rang grol gyi cha lag tshe 'das gnas 'dren 'gro drug rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

mug /zhi khro rab 'byams lha la phyag 'tshal lo: zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol cha rkyen las: tshe 'das bar do'i rnam shes drang ba'i phyir: na rag bskang bathags nyams chaṭa rang grol gyi: dbang bskur gnas spar 'gro drug rang grol bstan: 'di la spyi don rnam pa bcu yin te: dang po tshe 'das gshed dang 'phral ba dang :gnyis pa rigs drug gnas nas dgug pa dang : gsum pa rnam shes rten la bstim pa dang : bzhi pa sgrib sbyangs dug khrus bya ba dang : lnga pa rgyud lnga'i lha la skyabs 'gro dang : drug pa dkyil 'khor dal du 'jug pa dang : bdun pa dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs bskur ba dang : brgyad pa zhing du smon lam gdab nga dang :dgu pa nad dang sgrib pa sbyang ba dang : bcu pa lam bstan gnas spar bya'o: dang po tshe 'das gshed dang phral ba ni: rolam rus nga 'am ni mtshan byang la:

zhun/tshe 'das dngos bskyed rnam shes bkug pa ni: lha: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: rtsa las 'od 'phros tshe 'das rnam shes de: rigs drug gang na yod pa'i sa de nas: bdag gi 'od kyis reg ma thag tu ni: rnam shes groḥde a dkar cig tu gyur: mdun du bkug nas mtshan byang rten la bstim: ngag tu: o badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: yig brgya tshar gcig brjod pa'i rjes nyid du: gruḥyo dzaḥ badz+ra e ku sha dza: na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' yi bden pas: tshe las 'das pa'i che ge mo'i rnam par shes pa: sa 'og sa steng sa

bla 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga gar yod pa'i sa nas mtshan byang 'di la khug cig: ces lan gsum brjod la: rten de tshe 'das dngos su bskyed do: de nas tshe 'das gshed dang phral ba ni: tshe 'das snye 'brel gcig gi mtshan byang bzung : tshe 'das dngos su bsam nas slob dpon gyis: che mchog khro bo'i sku ra bskyed 'di skad do: lhu: tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : byams sdug brtse ba'i gnyen bshes grogs rnams dang : rtag tu 'grogs pa'i skal dang dbang med pas: mi lus tshe 'phos 'jig rten snang ba nub: rnam shes sems ni mi rtag tshul bstan te: las kyi dbang gis pha rol lus shig blangs: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa yi: skye gnas bzhi por ltung ba'i sar skyes kyang : gar skyes gang na gnas pa'i sa phyogs nas: brtse gdung yid

༄sha /la gcag pa'i nye 'brel gyis: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song mthu rtsal dang : sangs rgyas mthu stobs chen po'i byin rlabs dang : chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang : sngags 'chang rtse gcig sgrub pa'i byin rlabs dang : zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs thugs rje yis: lus med stong gzugs bar do'i rnam shes khyod: las dang nyon mongs dbang gis gar 'khyams kyang : dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas 'dir khug cig: ྈ/ sa dang lam la bar du gcod byed pa'i: srog gcod mdangs 'phrog gshed ma'i bgegs tshogs rnams: mthu stobs byin rlabs mthu yis gzhan du dengs: lha: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: steng 'og phyogs

mtshams thams cad kun: rang rig stong gsal rig pa 'i mdangs: kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje sems: rab 'jigs khrag 'thung sprul pa'i tshogs: snang la rang bzhin med pa yis: rab tu gang nas 'od 'phros pas: tshe 'das 'di la gnod byed cing : srog gcod mdangs 'phrog gshin lcags bgegs: nyon mongs ma rig rgyu las byung : rgyu drug 'khor ba'i lam dgags phyir: 'di ru ma 'a dug gzhan du dengs: lha hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: i sum+bha ni sum+bha ni lha: groṇ+ḍa grihā rdu: groṇ+ḍi pā ya: griṇ+ḍa pā ya stu: ā na ya ho: bha ga wān bibya rā dza gro ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod rdo rje gsor zhing yungs kur gtoraḥ gnyis pa rigs drug gnas nas dgus pa niḥ slob dpon rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gsal zhing ཿ lag pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas nas ཿ

༄sha /sa: tshe 'das lus brjes bar do'i rnam shes khyod: gar skyes gang na gnas pa'i sa phyogs nas: kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams thugs rje yis: 'og min gnas su sangs rgyas skur bskyed kyi: lus dang sems su bral ba'i tshe 'das khyod: ming bzhi'i phung po thogs pa med pa'i lus: dngos po gzugs med gnas su phyin pa de: rgyal ba'i 'od zer lcags kyu rnon po yis: mi lus nyams dga'i gnas su dgug bya'i phyir: re dog med pa'i sems kyis 'dir shog cig: a ni su tri tre du ma ma e ku sha dza: de nas gsum pa rten la bstim pa ni: ming byang lag tu bzung la 'di skad do: kye ma dbang med las kyis pha rol tshe 'phos khyod: mi yi yul du skye ba grangs med kyang : las kyis 'brel ba'i 'dug sa 'di

yin pas: 'phan phran mdzes pa 'di ni lus kyi rten: sa/ser byang ming bris 'di ni ngag gi rten: me long gsal ba 'di ni sems kyi rten:ras phrug dri med 'di ni gos kyi rten: gdugs chen 'bar ba 'di ni gzhal yas khang : leb phying dkar po 'di ni 'dug pa'i gdan: sba smyug ldem pa 'di ni 'ju ba'i shing : thogs med 'ja' tshon 'dra ba'i yid lus khyod: dmigs pa'i rten 'dzug 'di la gnas par gyis: tshe las 'das pa che ge mo tiṣ+ṭha baja( sa myo/ ya lhan: zhes brjod mtshan byang nyid la bstem nga yisaḥ tshe 'das de nyid dngos su gsal bar bskyed: de nas bzhi nga dug khrus gsol ba niḥ mtshan byangame long ngos la bstan nas suḥ las bum las tu thogs la 'di skad do: lha: 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu: ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: sbyin pa nyid la legs

༄ga /'god chu: sbyin pa'i chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: i badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: ces sogs yi ge brgya pa'i mthar: na ma:sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye :: 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu: 'chal ba'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: tshul khrims nyid la legs 'god chu: tshul khrims chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: o badz+ra satwaḥ namaḥsarbarnga 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu: khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: bzod pa nyid la legs 'god chu: bzod pa'i chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: o badz+ra satwaḥ namaḥsarbarnga 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu: le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: brtson 'grus nyid la legs

'god chu: brtson 'grus chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: o badz+ra satware namaḥsarbarnga 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu: g.yeng ba'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: bsam gtan nyid la legs 'god chu: bsam gtan chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs/ mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: o badz+ra satwaḥ namaḥsarbaḥ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu: gti mug dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: shes rab nyid la legs 'god chu: shes rab chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: i badz+ra satwaḥ na maḥsarbarnga 'di ni thabs kyi rang bzhin chu: thabs kyi dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: thabs chen nyid la legs 'god chu: thabs kyi chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la

༄sha /phyag 'tshal lo: o badz+ra satwaḥ na maḥsarbarnga 'di ni stobs kyi rang bzhin chu: stobs kyi dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: stobs chen nyid la legs 'god chu: stobs kyi chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: o badz+ra satwaḥ na maḥsarbarnga 'di ni smon lam rang bzhin chu: smon lam dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: smon lam nyid la legs 'god chu: smon lam chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: i badz+ra satwaḥ namaḥsarbarnga 'di ni ye shes rang bzhin chu: mi shes dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: ye shes nyid la legs 'bod chu:ye shes chu yis dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: o badz+ra satwa'i namaḥsarbarnga 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mus gsum:

'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: rdo rje sems dpa' dug mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo: bden pa gang gis sangs rgyas rnam sa: 'jig rten kun tu bla na med: bden pa'i mchog ni 'di dag gis: khyod kyi zhe snang dug rnams ni: rang bzhin med par das gyur cig: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: rnam par snang mdzad dug mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo: bden pa gang gis sangs rgyas rnams: 'jig rten kun tu bla na med: bden pa'i mchog ni 'di dag gis:khyod kyi gti mug dug rnams ni: rang bzhin med par dag gyur cig: 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug

༄ga /gsum ste: rin chen 'byung ldan dug mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo: bden pa gang gis sangs rgyas rnams :'jig rten kun tu bla na med: bden pa'i mchog ni 'di dag gis: khyod kyi nga rgyal dug rnams ni: rang bzhin med par dag gyur cig:'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: snang ba mtha' yas du ga mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo: bden pa gang gis sangs rgyas rnams: 'jig rten kun tu bla na med: bden pa'i mchog ni 'di dag gis: khyod kyi 'dod chags dug rnams ni: rang bzhin med par dag gyur cig: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste:

don yod grub pa dug mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pas dus/ bcom mo: bden pa gang gis sangs rgyas rnams: 'jig rten kun tu bla na med: bden pa'i mchog ni 'di das gis: khyod kyi phrag dog dug rnams ni: rang bzhin med par dag gyur cig: bsdus par byed na: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pas dus bcom mo: 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: bcom ldan dam chos dug mi mnga': dam chos bden pas dug bcom mo: 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: bcom ldan dge 'dun dug mi

༄sha /mnga': dge 'dun bden pa'i dug bcom mo: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis: khyod lus dug gis mi tshug shog: gshin gang dug dang bcas pa rnams: de kun 'dod chags dug las byung : 'dod chags 'di ni dug bi mchog: drag po'i dug ni dug bcom mo: gshin gang dug dang bcas pa rnams: de kun zhe sdang dug las byung : zhe sdang 'di ni dug gi mchog: drag po'i dug ni dug bcom mo: gshin gang dug dang bcas pa rnams: de kun gti mug dug las byung : gti mug 'di ni dug gi mchog: drag po'i dug ni dug bcom mo: sa ni dug gi pha yin te: sa ni dug gi ma yang yin: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas: dug rnams sa yi nang du song :

gang ba'i snod du dug song la: khyod kyi dug ni dug med shog: chu ni dug gi pha yin te: chu ni dug gi ma yang yin: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas: dug rnams chu yi nang du song : gang ba'i snod du dug song la: khyod kyi dug ni dug med shog: me ni dug gi pha yin te:me ni dug gi ma yang yin: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas: dug rnams me yi nang du song : gang ba'i snod du dug song la: khyod kyi dug ni dug med shog: rlung ni dug gi pha yin te: rlung ni dus gi ma yang yin: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas: dug rnams rlung gi nang du song : gang ba'i snod du dug song la: khyod kyi dug ni dug med shog: sangs rgyas rnams kyis dug bcom pas: rdzogs sangs

༄sha /rgyas la skyabs su song : dam chos rnams kyis dug bcom pas: dam chos rnams la skyabs su song : dge 'dun rnams kyis du ga bcom pas: dge 'dun rnams la/ skyabs su song : dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang : ting 'dzin sngags kyi byin rlabs kyis/: tshe 'das lus brjes bu khyod kyi: dug rnams gtan nas dag gyur cig: zhes brjod yi ge brgya pa dang : ka ka ni brjod khrus bya'o: lnga pa rgyud lnga'i lha la skyabs 'gro zhing : tshe 'das rigs drug gnas nas drang ba ni: tshe 'das nye 'brel gcig sgas mtshan byang bzung : tshe 'das nyid kyi sasol ba bdab par bsam: kye ma mgon po thugs rje can: rigs drug gnas su ltung ba yi: skyabs bral mgon med sems can la: thugs rje'i lugs kyus bzung du gsol: de skad gsol ba gdab rjes slob dpon gyis: 'gyod

tshangs byung khungs bram ze dung phreng canaḥ slob bu rgyal bu dbe mthong na raka nasaḥ rim gyis rigs drug gnas nas drangs tshul dang ཿ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus chos bshad btang ba'i rjesaḥ spu) ma byemo 'phos lus brjes bar do'i yid lus khyod: sngon chad ma rig rmongs pa'i las dbang gis: dug gsum gyis bcing ngan song gsum du mnar:deng nas brtsams te rgyal ba'i thugs rje yis: pho nyas bzung ste rigs drug gnas nas drangs: don 'bras 'dod phyir dad pa'i shugs bskyed la: 'dren pa thub chen drug la gsol ba thob: ces brjod rjes su gsol ba gdab pa ni: kye ma bdag 'dra'i sems can las ngan pas: zhe snang drag po'i las dbang gis: na raka dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes: btso bsreg sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag sgrol

༄sha /mdzod: brtse ba chen pos bzung du gsol: de skad gsol ba gdab rjes slob dpon gyis: kye ma tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu: zhe sdang drag pos kun nas bslangs nas su: mi dge bcu dang khyad par srog gcod kyis: na raka dmyal ba'i gnas su skye srid kyi: de na mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa ni: dmyal ba'i thub pa chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs: de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig 'di smros: zhe sdang gzung 'dzin kun spangs bde bar gshegs: bzod pa'i chos thob zhe sdang rnam par dag: dmyal ba'i thub pa me chu bsil drod can: dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal sbyong du gsol: chos kyi rgya'/ po khyed la skyabs su mchi: de rjes me chu'i dbang bskur bya ba ni: mar me khrus bum dbang bskur lag tu gtad: lha: tsha grang skyobs

byed me chu bsil drod ldan: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal las grol nas: na ra ka yi sdus bsngal bral bar shog: du da ha da ha sarba na ra ka te he dun hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas sman lnga'i bum nga sa dbang bskur ba niḥ rgyu: kun bzang yab yum bum pa na:rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: dmyal ba'i skye sgo bcad nas ni: na raka sdug bsngal bral bar shog: lhu badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: rdor sems yi che brgya pa bzlas pa'i mthar: lhu badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: de nas lan chasas gtor ma bsngo ba ni: lha: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di: tshe 'das srog si lan chags bsnyegs pa yis: gson bdud gshin lcags lan chags khyod la sbyin: gtor ma 'di yis

༄can /mgu zhing tshim gyis la: tshe 'das 'di yi thar pa'i gegs ma byed: ces brjod lan chags 'jal ba'i gtor ma btang : de nas brab rdzas bye ma lag tu thogs:'dod chags zhe sdang gti nu/ga gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: rdo rje sems dpa' dug mi mnga': thugs mchog rdo rjes dug bcom mo: stun sdang sgrib pa dag sdomar cig: ces brjod bye mas brab pa yis: dmyal ba'i sa bon duḥnag po: rang bzhin med par bsregs pa ra bsam: de yi rjes la dri ma 'khru ba ni: me 'o nga mtshan byang ngos bsta na 'di skad do: 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu: khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: byams/ pa'i chu yis legs bkrus pas: khong khro'i dri ma dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: zhes brjod khrus gsol sdig sgrib dag par bsam: de nas mtshan byang yi dwags gnas su drangs: lha: sa

'di bcad pa man chad ni: na raka dmyal ba'i sa yin pas: bor ro spong ngo rigs kyi bu: sa 'dis bcad pa ya na chad ni: mtho ris bde ba'i sa yin pas: 'dong ngo gshegs so rigs kyi bu: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: ces brjod rdo rjes phyi lam bcad nga ra bya: gnyis pa yi dwasas gnas nas drang ba ni: tshe las 'das pa/sa gsol ba gdab nga ra bsam: kye ma bdag 'dra'i sems can las ngan pa: ser sna drag po'i las dbang gisaḥ pre ta yi dwags gnas su skyes: bkres skom sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag sgrol mdzod: brtse ba chen pos bzung du gsol: de skad gsol ba gdab rjes slob dpon gyis: kye ma tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu: ser sna drag pos kun nas bslangs nas su: mi dge bcu dang ser sna 'jur

༄sha /gegs kyis: bkres skom yi dwags gnas su skye srid kyi: de na mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa ni: yi dwags thub pa kha 'bar zhes bya bzhugs: de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig 'di smros: 'dod chags gzung 'dzin kun spangs bde bar gshegs: sbyin pa'i chos thob ser sna rnam par dag: yi dwags thub pa kha 'bar rin chen sgrom: yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal sbyong du gsol: bcom ldan kha 'bar zhabs la skyabs su mchi: de nas rin chen sgrom bu'i dbang bskur ba ni: āḥ rin chen sgrom gyi bum pa na: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bsaḥ pre ta ka yi sdug bsnga la bar shog: sre pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka te he dun hūm̐ phaṭa: nub nas dri lnga'i bum pa 'i dbang bsku ro ba ni: lha:

bdud rtsi dri lnga'i bum pa 'dir: bde gshegs gsung gi lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: yi dwags skye sgo bcad nas ni: bde ba can du skye bar shog: o pad+ma satwa sa ma ya: snang mtha'i yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa'i mthar: o pad+ma ā bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas la na chags gtor ma bsngo ba niḥ lha: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di: tshe 'das rku 'phrog lan chags bsnyegs pa yi: gson bdud gshin lcags lan chags khyod la sbyin: gtor ma 'di yis mgu zhing tshim gyis la: tshe 'das 'di yi thar pa'i gegs ma byed: ces brjod lan chags 'jal ba'i gtor ma btang ༷ de nas brab rdzas bye ma lag tu thogs: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: snang ba mtha' yas dug mi mnga':

)sto /gsung mchog rdo rjes dug bcom mo: 'dod chags sgrib pa dag gyur cig: ces brjod bye ma sa brab ba yis: yi dwags sa bon pre dam ra po: rang ba'in med par bsregs par bsam: de'i rjes la dri ma 'khru ba ni: me 'o nga mtshan byang la bstan nas 'di skad do: 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu: ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: sbyin pa'i chu yis legs bkrus pas: 'dod chags dri ma dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: zhes brjod khrus gsol sdis sgrib dag par bsam:de nas mtshan byang dud 'gro'i gnas su drangs pa ni: rdzu: sa 'di bcad pa man chad ni: bkres skom yi dwags gnas yin pas: bor ro spong ngo rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad ni: mtho ris bde ba'i sa yin pas: 'dong ngo gshegs so rigs kyi bu: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog:

ces brjod do rjes phyir lam bcad par bya: gsum pa dud 'gro'i gnas nas drangs pa ni: tshe las 'das pas gsol ba gdab par bsamaḥ kyi ma bdag 'dra'i sems can las ngan pas:gti mug drag po'i las dbang gis: tir+ya dud 'gro'i gnas su skyes: bkol spyod sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag sgrol mdzod: brtse ba chen pos bzung du gsol: de skad gsol ba gdab rjes slob dpon gyis: kye ma tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu: gti mug drag pos kun nas bslangs nas su: mi dge bcu dang chos la mi mos shing : blun rmongs dbang gis dud 'gror skye srid pas: de na mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa ni: byol song thub pa seng ge rab brtan bzhugs: de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig 'di smos: gti mug gzung 'dzin

༄ga /kun spangs bde bar gshegs: shes rab chos thobs gti mug rnam par dag: byol song thub pa seng ge po ti 'dzin: dud 'gro glen lkugs sdug bsngal sbyong du gsol: seng ge rab brtan zhabs la skyabs su mchi: de rjes shes rab po ti'i dbang bskur ba ni: o shes rab rig pa'i po ti 'di: dus gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i gsung : tshe 'das khyod dbang bskur bas: tir+ya ka yi sdug bsngal bral bar shog: tri ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka te he dun hūṃ phaṭa: shar nas 'bru lnga'i bum pas dbang bskur ba ni ༷ sa: rin chen 'bru lnga'i bum pa 'dir: bde gshegs sku yi lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: dud 'gro'i skye sgo bcad nas ni: mngon dga'i zhing du skye bar shog: o bud+dha satwa sa ma ya: rnam par snang

mdzad yig brgya bzlas pa'i mthar: o bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: nge nas la na chags gtor ma bsngo ba ni:lha: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di: tshe 'das bkol spyod lan chags bsnyegs pa yi: gson bdud gshin lca gas lan chags khyod la sbyin: gtor ma 'di yis mgu zhing tshim gyis la: tshe 'das 'di yi thar pa'i gegs ma byed: ces brjod lan chags 'jal ba'i gtor ma btang : de nas brab rdzas bye ma lag tu thogs: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: rnam par snang mdzad dug mi mnga': sku mchog rdo rje'i dug bcom mo: gti mug dri ma dag gyur cig: ces brjod bye mas brab pa yis: dud 'gro'i sa bon tri sngon po: rang bzhin med par bsregs nga ra bsam: de yi rjes la dri ma bkru ba ni: mtshan byang me long ngos bsta na 'di skad do: 'di ni shes rab rang

༄ga /bzhin chu: mi shes dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: ye shes chu yis legs bkrus pas: gti mug dri ma dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: zhes brjod khrus gso la sdig sgrib dag par bsam/: de nas ma/tshan byang lha min gnas su drangs: lha: sa 'di bcad pa man chad niḥ glen lkugs dud 'gro'i gnas yin pas: bor ro spong ngo rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad ni: mtho ris bde ba'i sa yin pas: 'dong ngo gshegs so rigs kyi dra/: ji)ra mi 'o/ga pa'i sa thob shegag: ces brjod rdo rjes phyi lam bcad nga ra bya: bzhi pa lha min gnas nas drangs pa ni: tshe las 'das pa sa gso la ba gdab par bsam: spu) ma bdag 'dra'i sems can las ngan pa: phrag dog drag po'i la sa dbang gis: gdug rtsub lha min gnas su skyes: 'thab rtsod sdus/ bsngal

brjod kha sa 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag sgrol mdzod: brtse ba chen pos bzung du gsol: de ska da gsol ba gdab rjes slo ba dpon gyis: kye ma tshe 'das 'u sa brjes rigs kyi bu: phrag dog drag pos kun nas bslangs nas su: mi dge bcu dang 'thab rtsod las dbang gis: gdug rtsub lha min gnas su skye srid pas: de na mthon dang skyabs su gyur pa ni: lha min thub pa thag bzang zhes bya bzhugs: de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig 'di smros: phrag dog gzung 'dzin kun spangs bde bar gshegs: tshul khrims chos thob phrag dog rnam par dag: lha min thub pa skyob byed bo mtshon 'dzin: lha min 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol: bcom ldan thag bzang ris la skyabs su mchi: de rjes skyobs byed bo mtshon

༄sha /dbang bskur niḥ ha shes rab don mtshon ral gri dang : bdud kyi mtshon bsrung go cha 'di: dus gsum rgyal ba'i sbyor sgro la te: zhi khro rgyal ba'i phyag mtshan 'dis: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: he sa ka yi sdug bsngal bral bar shog: su sa/rba du la sarba kurma pra be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: snying po lnga yi bum pa sa dbang bsku ra ni: lha: snying po lnga yi bum pa 'dir: bde gshegs phrin las lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bsku ra bas: lha min skye sgo bcad nas ni: las rab zhing du skye bar shog: ha kurma satwa sa ma ya: don yo da grub pa'i yig brgya brjod pa'i mtharaḥ ha kurma a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: de nas la na chags gtor ra/ bsngo ba niḥ lha: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di: tshe 'das 'thab rtsod lan chags bsnyegs pa yi:

gson bdud gshin lcags lan chags khyod la sbyin: gtor ma 'di yis mgu zhing tshim gyis la: tshe 'das 'di yi thar pa'i gegs ma byed:ces brjod la na chags 'jal ba'i gtor ma btang : de nas brab rdzas bye ma lag tu thogs: nga rgyal log lta the tshom gsum: 'di dag rtsa ba'i dug gsum ste: don yod grub pa dug mi mnga': phrin las rdo rjes dug bcom mo: phrag dog sgrib pa dag gyur cig: ces brjod bye mas brab pa yis: lha min sa bon su ser po: rang bzhin med par bsregs par bsam: de'i rjes la dri ma bkru ba ni: me 'o nga mtshan byang ngos bstan 'di skad do: 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu: phrag dog dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: tshul khrims chu yis legs bkrus pas: phrag dog dri ma dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: 'es brjod khrus gsol sdig sgrib dag par bsam: de

sngag /nas mchan byang lha yi gnas su drangasaḥ lha: sa 'di bcad pa man chad ni: 'thab rtsod lha min gnas yin pas: bor ro spong ngo rigs kyi bu:sa 'di bcad pa yan chad ni: mtho ris bde ba'i sa yin pas: 'dong ngo gshegs so rigs kyi bu: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: ces brjod rdo rjes phyi la ma bcad par bya: lnga pa lha'i sanas nas drangs pa niḥ tshe la sa 'das pa sa gsol ba sadab par bsamaḥ kye ma: bdag 'dra'i sems can las ngan pa: nga rgyal drag po'i las dbang gis: 'dod khams lha yi gnas su skyes/: lhung ba'i sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag sgrol mdzod: brtse ba chen pos bzung du gsol: de skad gsol ba gdab rjes slob dngo na gyis: kye ma tshe 'das 'u sa brjes rigs kyi bu: nga rgyal drag pos kun
