nas bslangs nas su: mi dge bcu dang pha rol khyad gsod kyis: 'dod khams lha yi gnas su skye srid pas: de yang 'jig rten 'khor ba'i gnas yin pas: de la ma chags byang chub sems bskyed la: de na mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa ni: lha yi thub pa dbang po brgya byin bzhugs: de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig 'di smros: nga rgyal gzung 'dzin kun spangs bde bar gshegs: bsam gtan chos thob lta ba rnam par dag: lha dbang thub pa brgya byin pi wang bsnams: 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal sbyong du gsol: lha dbang brgya byin khyod la skyabs su mchi: de rjes sgra snyan pi wang dbang bskur ni: su: longs spyod bdud kyi g.yeng 'joms pa'i: pi wang snyan pa'i don byed 'dis: tshe 'das khyod la

༄sha /dbang bskur bas: skye ba gcig gi las rdzogs shog: a sarba ta thā ga ta bhi dan khad kha tshin+dha tshirnya hūm̐ phaṭa: rin chen lnga yi bum pas dbang bskur niḥ lha: rin chen sna lnga'i bum pa 'dir: bde gshegs yon tan lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha yi skye sgo bcad nas ni: dpal ldan zhing du skye bar shog: swā rat+na satwa sa ma ya: rin chen 'byung ldan yig brgya bzlas pa'i mtharaḥ swā rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas lan chags gtor ma bsngo ba niḥ rdzu: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di: tshe 'das 'dod pa'i lan chags bsnyegs pa yi: gson bdud gshin lcags lan chags khyod la sbyin: gtor ma 'di yis mgu zhing tshim gyis la: tshe 'das 'di yi thar pa'i gegs ma byed: ces brjod lan chags 'jal

ba'i gtong ma btang : de nas brab rdzas bye ma 'a ga tu thosas : nga rgyal log lta the tshom gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: rin chen 'byung ldan dug mi mnga': yon tan rdo rjes dug bcom mo: nga rgyal sgrib pa dag gyur cig: ces brjod bye ma sa brab pa yis: lha yi sa bon a dkar po: rang bzhin med pa ra bsregs pa ra bsam: de rjes nga rgyal dri ma 'khru ba ni: 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu: lhung ba'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa: ting 'dzin chu yis legs bkrus pas: nga rgyal dri ma dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: ces brjod khrus sasol sdig sgrib dag par bas ma: de nas mtshan byang mi yi gnas su drangs : lha: sa 'di bcad pa man chad ni: rigs drug 'khor ba'i gnas yin pas: bor ro spong ngo rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad ni: thar pa bde

mug /ba'i sa yin pas: 'dong ngo gshegs so rigs kyi bu: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: ces brjod rdo rjes phyi lam bcad par bya: drug nga mi yi gnas nas drangs pa ni: tshe las 'das pas gsol ba gdab par bsam: kye ma bdag 'dra'i sems can las ngan pa: nyon mongs 'dod pa'i las dbang gis: 'dod khams gling bzhi'i mi ru skyesaḥ brel 'phongs sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: sdug bsngal 'di las bdag sgrol mdzod: brtse ba chen pos bzung du gsol: de skad gsol ba gdab rjes slob dngo na gyis: kye ma tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu: nyon mongs 'dod pas kun nas bslangs nas su: zag bcas 'dod pa'i dge ba bcu spyad kyang: 'dod khams gling bzhi'i mi ru skye srid kyis: de yang 'jig rten 'khor ba'i gnas yin

pas: 'khor ba 'di la khab kyi rtse tsam yar: bde ba nam yang yod ma yin zhes gsung : cung zad bde yang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yod:khyod kyi nye drung 'o dod 'bod byed cing : pha ma bu tsha nye drung nga yin zhes: khang khyim yo byad gnas mal nor rdzas dang : khyod kyi ming nas 'bod pa'i sgra skad kyang : byang chub lam la bar du gcod byed bdud: de la ma nyan ma blta ma sems par: de la ma chags byang chub sems bskyed la: de na mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa ni: mi yi thub pa shākya thub pa bzhugs: de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig 'di smros: the tshom gzung 'dzin kun spangs bde bar gshegs: brtson 'grus chos thob the tshom rnam par dag: shākya thub pa gseg gshang par bu 'dzin: skye

mug /rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal sbyong du gsol: rgyal ba thub dbang khyod la skyabs su mchi: de rjes gsesas gzhang par bu lag tu gtadaḥ lha: rin chen par bu lhung bzed na: rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: gseg gshang drang srong sgra sgrogs 'di: thugs rtags zhi khro'i lha yi rtags: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: a wa dhu ti'i dbang thob shog: o tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas gtso bo'i bum pa spyi bor bzhagaḥ lha:rin chen bum pa gzhal yas khang : rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dbang lus la thob par shog: lha badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ o bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ swā rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ e pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ ha kurma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas lan chags gtor

ma bsngo ba niḥ lha: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'diḥ tshe 'das bu lon lan chags bsnyegs pa yi: gson bdud gshin lcags lan chags khyod la sbyin: gtor ma 'di yis mgu zhing tshim gyis la: tshe 'das 'di yi thar pa'i gegs ma byed: ces brjod lan chags 'jal ba'i gtor ma btang ཿ de nas brab rdzas bye ma lag tu thogs: nga rgyal log lta the tshom gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: kun bzang 'i/ khro dug mi mnga':sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo: tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i: the tshom dri ma dag gyur cig: ces brjod bye ma sa brab pa yis: mi yi sa bon dri ljang seraḥrang bzhin med par bsregs par bsam: de nas nyon mongs dri ma bkru ba ni: 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu: yid gnyis dre ma sbyong mdzad pa: spro dga' chu

nonan /yis legs bkrus pas: the tshom dri ma dag gyur cig: khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: zhes brjod khrus gsol sdig sgrib das par bsam: de nas mtshan byang dkyil 'khor drung du drangasaḥ lha: sa 'di bcad pa man chad ni: rigs drug 'khor ba'i gnas yin pas: bor ro spong ngo rigs kyi bu: yul dang khang khyim nor rdzas kun: sgyu ma'i rta glang ji bzhin du: mi rtag 'gyur ba'i chos can yin: rtag par gnas pa gcig kyang med: ma chags ma zhen rigs kyi bu: pha ma bu tsha nye drung kun: mi lam skyes bu ji bzhin du: mi rtag bral ba'i chos can yin: khyod kyi ming nas 'bod byed cing : pha ma nye drung nga yin zhes: smri sngags 'o dod 'bod pa kun: thar lam bar chad gegs yin pas: de la ma nyan rigs kyi

bu: chags par ma byed rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad ni: thar ba bde ba'i sa yin pas: 'dong ngo gshegs so rigs kyi bu:dga' zhing spro ba'i sems bskyed la: zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas mchog tu: bdag gis khyod nyid 'jug bya'i phyir: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon shog: de nas drus pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni: tshe las 'das pas gsol ba gdab par bsamaḥ e ma mgon po thugs rje can: bdag 'dra'i sems can 'khor bar 'khyams: log pa'i lam du zhugs lags pas: bde chen thar pa'i lam ston 'tshal: dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug tu gsol: de ska da gsol ba gdab rjes slob dpon gyis : kye ma tshe 'das bu khyod legs par nyon: 'khor ba'i gnas nas thar pa'i grong 'jug na: tshe 'di'i 'bras bu don

tshog /du gnyer mi bya: 'jig rten tshe 'di don du gnyer ba na: pha rol thar pa'i 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur: 'jig rten pha rol gzhan don gnyer bas na: 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras rang don 'grub: de phyir pha rol gzhan don gnyer bar gyis: ces sasung slar yang gsol ba gdab pa ni:kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang : rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gang : byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol: thun mong dang ni khyad par gyi: skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol: rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: mgon pos bdag ni 'jug tu gsol: de skad zhus pa'i lan du slob dpon gyisaḥ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni: shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon: brjed

ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogs pa'i: dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin mi rlobs: zhes pas nyan par bskul nas spro ba bskyed: bu khyod shin tu skal ba bzang : gang gis sgyu 'phrul zhi khro yi: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal na: nyams chags kun kyang byang bar 'gyur: mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang byang : na raka gnas kyang dong sprugs te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags: rang bzhin sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor la: gang zhig gus pas phyag 'tshal na: nyams chags kun kyang byang bar 'gyur: dam tshig skongs nas dngos grub thob: de phyir spro ba'i sems kyis legs par nyon: thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa niḥ tshe 'das bu khyod dkyil 'khor bzang ngo 'di'iḥ mdun du thal sbyar skyabs 'gro'i bslab pa zungs: de yang thun mong dang ni khyad par gnyisaḥ thog mar

nonan /thun mong skyabs su 'gro ba ni: dkon mchog gsum la 'di bzung byang chub bar: skyabs su bzung ba bdag gi rjes zlos mdzod: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams:tshe 'das bdag la dgongs su gsol: rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang : zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos: tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la: 'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa khyad par skyabs su 'gro ba ni: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la:skyabs su bzung la bdag gi rjes zlos mdzod: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: 'di bzung bla med byang chub bar: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi:dpa' bo dpa' mo chos skyong bcas: byang sems rdo rje slob dpon la: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: ces brjod lan gsu ma rjes la sdom pa bzung :

thog mar so thar sdom pa bzung ba niḥ sems bskyed ldan pas bdag gis rjes zlos mdzodaḥ bla ma kun bzang :gran snga ru: lus ngag yid kyis gnan rnams la: gnod pa las bzlog dge ba bsgrub: dge tshul dge slong byang chub sems: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la: rgyun du gnas shing dge ba bsgom: sdom pa yongs su bzung bar bgyi: ces pas lan gsum so thar sdom bzung nasaḥde nas smon pa sems bskyed blang bya ste: ho: bla ma kun bzang dgongs su gsol : 'di bzung byang chub ma thob par: 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: ma dang bu yi 'du shes kyis: ma bsgral pa rnams sgrol ba dang : ma grol pa rnams dgrol ba dang : dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung phyir: smon pa byang chub sems bskyed do: de rjes 'jug pa'i sems bskyed blang ba niḥ sngon

༄ga /gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang : sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar: 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs par: bla med 'jug pa'i byang chub sems: tshe 'das bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: phar phyin drug la bslabs cing bsgrub: brtson 'grus dag gis thams cad bsgral: kun don tshul khrims gsum yang gzung : bdag gis sems bskyed sdom bzung nas: ma grol dgrol dang ma bsgral bsgral: dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god: ces brjod de rjes dam tshig blang ba ni: dkon mchog gsum ni mi spang ngo : rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang : byang chub sems ni spang mi bya: rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu: sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin: pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu: theg

pa gsum gyi chos rnams bshad: las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu: 'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya: de bzhin rigs kyi dam tshig tu: dkyil 'khor gsum dang 'bral mi bya: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun: ma lus bdag gis yongs su bzung : ces pas dam tshig sdom pa 'bog nas suḥ de nas tshe 'das lha ru bskyed pa niḥ ro'am rus nga 'am ni mtshan byang laḥ i badz+ra shrī he ru ka u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod bgegs baspa da de nas skad cig gisaḥ slob ma'i chas 'dzin mtshan byang rdor sems kyi: thugs kur zla steng hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor: yig brgya bzlas pas sdig sgrib dag par bsam: de nas dkyil 'khor dal du 'jug pa niḥ mtshan byang dkyil 'khor shar kyi sgor khyer la ཿ lha: dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar gyi sgo: zhe sdang sgrib pas bcad lags na: snying rje'i sgo ma rta

༄sha /gdong ma: sgo ba khro bo rnam par rgyal: sgo ma lha mo lcags kyu ma: thabs shes lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis: me long ye shes shar sgo phyes:bdag cag dad pas 'jug par bgyi: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: yi dam lha dang mjal bar shog: ྈ: dkyil 'khor chen po'i lho yi sgo: nga rgyal sgrib pas bcad lags na: byams pa'i sgo ma phag gdong ma: sgo ba khro bo gshin rje'i gshed: sgo ma lha mo zhags pa ma: thabs shes zhags pa'i phyag rgya yis: mnyam nyid ye shes lho sgo phyes: bdag cag dad pas 'jug par bgyi: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: yi dam lha dang mjal bar shog: rdu: dkyil 'khor chen po'i

nub kyi sgo: 'dod chags sgrib pas bcad lags na: dga' ba'i sgo ma seng gdong ma: sgo ba khro bo rta mgrin rgyal: sgo ma lha mo lcags sgrog ma: thabs shes lcags sgrog phyag rgya yis: sor rtogs ye shes nub sgo phyes: bdag cag dad pas 'jug par bgyi: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs: bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: yi dam lha dang mjal bar shog: sbyi: dkyil 'khor chen po'i byang gi sgo: phrag dog sgrib pas bcad lags na: gtang snyoms sgo ma sbrul gdong ma: sgo ba khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil: sgo ma khro mo dril bu ma: thabs shes dril bu'i phyag rgya yis: bya grub ye shes byang sgo phyes: bdag cag dad pas 'jug par bgyi: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: bdag cag gus pas phyag

no༅na /'amyodrol lo: yi dam lha dang mjal bar shog: pra be sha ya phaṭa: ces pas dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi'i sgo phyes la: de nas mchan byang dar gyis gdong g.yogs bcings:lag tu cod pa na thogs la 'di skad brjod: lha: bdag cag rig pa'i me tog 'di: yi dam zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i: yi dam lha 'a/ babs pazar shegag: pra ti bos ho: ces brjod cod pan dor la dkyil 'khor gyi: kha dog ji ltar mthong ba'i dri lan gdab: me tog gang la phog pa 'i gsang mtshan btags: de nasadakyil 'khor rnam dag bshad pa dang : dkyil 'khor lha ngo sprad pa la sogs rnams: dkyil 'khor rnam dag mthong ba rang grol ltar: lha dang dkyil 'khor ngo sprod rgyas par bya: de nas mig dar dbye ba 'di skadado: kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje sems: khyod kyi ma rig ldongs pa'i mig: ye shes spyan du dbye bar bya: de bzhin khyod kyis 'gro ba rnams: ye shes spyan du dbye bar shog: o dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa: de yi rjes la 'di skad brjod par bya: kye ma tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: khyod ni sdig pa kun las

grol: dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos: lus ngag yid kyis dad pa bskyed: rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs su skye: sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs: dngos grub thams cad khyod kyis thob: dam tshig sngags la brtson par gyis: ces brjod de'i rjes la lha ngo bstan: bdun pa dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs bskur ba ni: thog mar sku gsu nga thugs kyi dbang gsum bskur: de rjes chu dang dbu rgyan rdor dril ming : thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bar bya: de nas sasang dbang shes rab tshig dbang bskur: de rjes zhi khro'i mnga' gsol rtags kyi dbang : rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags brgyad dbang : de rnams na raka dbang chog chen rngo ra ltos: de ltar dbang bzhi rdzogs par bsku ra byas nas: brgyad pa zhing du smon la ma gdab pa ni: mchan byang lag tu bzung la 'di skad do: 'di nas shar gyi phyogs rol na: mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams yod: thams cad sa yi rang bzhin te: sa la shi zhes bya ba med: sems can srog mi sa yin te: sa yi snying po sum̐ zhes bya: de la brten nas bu khyod kyang : byang chub

༄sha /mchog tu sems bskyed nas: zhing mchog der ni skyes gyur te: sangs rgyas spyan dang gnyis med shog: 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na: dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams yod: thams cad chu yi rang bzhin te: chu la shi zhes bya ba med: sems can srog ni chu yin te: chu yi snying po baṃ zhes bya: de la brten nas bu khyod kyang : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: zhing mchog der ni skyes gyur te: mā ma gī dang gnyis med shog: 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na: bde ba can gyi zhing khams yod: thams cad me yi rang bzhin te: me la shi zhes bya ba med: sems can srog ni me yin te: me yi snying po raṃ zhes bya: de la brten nas bu khyod kyang : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas:

zhing mchog der ni skyes gyur te: gos dkar mo dang gnyis med shog: 'di nas byang gi phyogs rol na: las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams yod: thams cad rlung gi rang bzhin te: rlung la shi zhes bya ba med: sems can srog ni rlung yin te: rlung bi snying po yo zhes bya: de la brten nas bu khyod kyang : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas: zhing mchog der ni skyes gyur te: dam tshig sgrol dang gnyis med shog:'di nas dbus kyi phyogs rol na: stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams yod: thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin te: nam mkha' shi zhes bya ba med: sems can srog ni nam mkha' ste: nam mkha'i snying po e zhes bya: de la brten nas bu khyod kyang : byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed

༄sha /nas: zhing mchog der ni skyes gyur te: dbyings phyug ma dang gnyis med shog: dgu pa nad dang sgrib pa sbyang ba ni: sems dang/'a lnga yi sku gzugs lag tu thogasaḥ mtshan byang me long ngos la bstan nas su: kye ma mun pa lta bu'i 'jig rten khams su 'khyams: sdug bsngal nyam thag 'o dod 'bod pa khyod: rgyal sras thugs rje can gyis skyobs par shog: me long ye shes ngang las skur sprul pa: rgyal sras sa yi snying po'i thugs rje yis: tshe 'das mig gi dbang po'i nad bsal nas: rab rib nad sel gzugs la blta bar shog: sngon tshe gong nas bsnyen pa'i lha: yi dam lha mchog 'khor ba'i skyabs: rgyal sras byang sems sa yi snying : lha mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi: thugs rjes tshe 'das byin gyis rlobs: kye ma mun pa lta bu'i

'jig rten khams su 'khyams: sdug bsngal nyam thag 'o dod 'bod pa khyod: rgyal sras thugs rje can gyis skyobs par shog: mnyam nyid ye shes ngang las skur sprul pa: rgyal sras nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs rje yis: tshe 'das rna ba'i dbang po'i nad bsal nas: 'on pa'i nad sel gsung la nyan par shog: sngon tshe gong nas bsnyen pa'i lha: yi dam lha mchog 'khor ba'i skyabs: rgyal sras byang sems nam mkha'i snying : lha mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi: thugs rjes tshe 'das byin gyis rlobs: kye ma mun pa lta bu'i 'jig rten khams su 'khyams: sdug bsngal nyam thag 'o dod 'bod pa khyod: rgyal sras thugs rje can gyis skyobs par shog: sor rtogs ye shes ngang las skur sprul pa: rgyal sras spyan

༄shi /ras gzigs dbang thugs rje yis: tshe 'das sna yi dbang po'i nad bsal nas: mtshub ma'i nad sel dri la snom par shog: sngon tshe gong nas bsnyen pa'i lha: yi dam lha mchog 'khor ba'i skyabs: rgyal sras byang sems spyan ras gzigs: lha mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi:thugs rjes tshe 'das byin gyis rlobs: kye ma mun pa lta bu'i 'jig rten khams su 'khyams: sdug bsngal nyam thag 'od dod 'bod pa khyod:rgyal sras thugs rje can gyis skyobs par shog: bya grub ye shes ngang las skur sprul pa: rgyal sras phyag na rdo rje'i thugs rje yis: tshe 'das lce yi dbang po'i nad bsal nas: jig pa'i nad sel ro mchog myong bar shog: sngon tshe gong nas bsnyen pa'i lha: yi dam lha mchog 'khor ba'i

skyabs: rgyal sras byang sems phyag na rdor: lha mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi: thugs rjes tshe 'das byin gyis rlobs: kye ma mun pa lta bu'i 'jig rten khams su 'khyams: sdug bsngal nyam thag 'o dod 'bod pa khyod: rgyal sras thugs rje can gyis skyobs par shog: chos dbyings ye shes ngang las skur sprul pa: rgyal sras sgrib pa rnam sel thugs rje yis: tshe 'das lus kyi dbang po'i nad bsal nas: tsha grang nad sel reg bya myong bar shog: sngon tshe gong nas bsnyen pa'i lha: yi dam lha mchog 'khor ba'i skyabs: rgyas sras sgrib pa rnam par sel: lha mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi: thugs rjes tshe 'das byin gyis rlobs: bcu pa lam bstan gnas spar bya ba ni: mar me ye shes chen por byin gyis rlobs: mtshan byang ngos la bsta na nas

rog /'di skad do: sbyi: rang bzhin shugs kyis drangs pa'i dran pas nyon: 'khor ba'i rba rlabs rlung ltar 'khyams pa la: thugs rje'i shugs kyi sgron me 'di bstan pas: ye shes/ 'od la rtag tu bde bar shog: thar pa'i zhing du 'gro ba la: gal te mun pa 'thib na yang : sgron me 'di yis gsal gyur cig: gal te ma rig rmongs na yang : sgron me 'di yis gsal gyur cig: gal te ma shes 'khrul na yang : sgron me 'di las gsal gyur cig: sal te dag pa'i lam stor na: ye shes 'di yis rnyed gyur cig: ye shes snang ba chen po ste: sngags 'chang rgyal pos sgron me sbyin: 'di la brten nas bu khyod kyang : 'og min chos dbyings zhing khams su: ye shes lha dang 'phrad par shog: 'di nas shar gyi

phyogs rol na: mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad: gang zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa: zhing mchog der ni skye bar 'gyur: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad la: tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i: gzugs kyi phung po yon du 'bul: yon 'di bzhes la lam 'di ston: sems 'di byang chub gnas su drongs: 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na: dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams su: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung : gang zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa: zhing mchog der ni skye bar 'gyur: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan la: tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i: tshor ba'i phung po yon du

༄ga /'bul: yon 'di bzhes la lam 'di ston: sems 'di byang chub gnas su drongs: 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na: bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med: gang zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa: zhing mchog der ni skye bar 'gyur: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas la: tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i: 'du shes phung po yon du 'bul: yon 'di bzhes la lam 'di ston: sems 'di byang chub gnas su drongs: 'di nas byang gi phyogs rol na: las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams su: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas don yod grub: gang zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa: zhing mchog der ni skye bar 'gyur: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: bcom ldan

don yod grub pa la: tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i: 'du byed phung po yon du 'bul: yon 'di bzhes la lam 'di ston: sems 'di byang chub gnas su drongs: 'di nas dbus kyis phyogs rol na: stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems: gang zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa: zhing mchog der ni skye bar 'gyur: zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la: tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i: rnam shes phung po yon du 'bul: yon 'di bzhes la lam 'di ston: sems 'di byang chub gnas su drongs: lam lnga sa bcu mthar phyin nas: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lhun gyis grub: thams cad mkhyen pa'i don rtogs nas: 'bras bu sku gsum 'grub

༄yin /par shog: de nas rnam shes gnas su spar ba niḥ mda' dang sazhu rgyud sbyar nas mda' yi rtseraḥ mtshan byang btags sam ro la reg nas suḥ lha: thabs kyi gzhu la shes rab mda' bkang ste: ye shes thugs rje'i shugs kyi rgyud dang ldan: bla na med pa'i gnas mchog dam pa ru: tshe 'das mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog: zhing khams 'di nas shar gyi phyogs rol na: mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams zhes bya yod: de na sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs: yum mchog lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma bzhugs: g.yas su sems dpa' sa yi snying po bzhugs: g.yon du sems dpa' byams pa mi tri bzhugs: mdun du sems ma lā su dkar mo bzhugs: rgyab tu sems ma pukhye dkar mo bzhugs: bder gshegs rigs kyi

gtso 'khor rnam pa drug: sprul pa'i sangs rgyas grangs las 'das pa yod: dga' bde'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab yod: de phyir ming ni mngon par dga' ba'i zhing : zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas par dam pa der: tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭa: tshe las 'das pa'i gzugs kyi phung po o dkar po gyur te: mda' 'phang ba bzhin du rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su thim pas: rgyal ba'i sras su gyur te sangs rgyas par gyur cig: zhing khams 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na: dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams zhes bya yod: de na sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan

༄dzo /bzhugs: yum mchog mā ma ki zhes bya ba bzhugs: g.yas su sems dpa' kun tu bzang po bzhugs: g.yon du sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po bzhugs: mdun du sems ma mā le ser mo bzhugs: rgyab tu sems ma juspru ser mo bzhugs: rin chen rigs kyi gtso 'khor rnam pa drug: sprul pa'i sangs rgyas grangs las 'das pa yod: dpal dang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab yod: de phyir ming ni dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing : zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas rab dam pa der: tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭa: tshe las 'das pa'i tshor ba'i phung po swā ser por gyur te: mda'

'phang ba bzhin du rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su thim pas: rgyal ba'i sras su gyur te sangs rgyas par gyur cig: zhing khams 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na: bde ba can gyi zhing khams zhes bya yod: de na sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs: yum chen lha mo na bza' dkar mo bzhugs: g.yas su sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs: g.yon du sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nu bzhugs: mdun du sems ma gīrti dmar mo bzhugs: rgyab tu sems ma ā lo dmar mo bzhugs: pad+ma rigs kyi gtso 'khor rnam pa drug: sprul pa'i sangs rgyas grangs las 'das pa yod: bde skyid ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab yod: de phyir ming ni bde ba can gyi zhing :

jug /zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas rab dam pa der: tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭa: tshe las 'das pa'i 'du shes kyi phung po āḥdamar por gyur te: mda' 'phang ba bzhin du snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su thim pas: rgyal ba'i sras su gyur te sangs rgyas par gyur cig: zhing khams 'di nas byang gi phyogs rol na: las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams zhes bya yod: de na sangs rgyas don yod grub pa bzhugs: yum mchog lha mo dam tshig sgrol ma bzhugs: g.yas su sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel bzhugs: g.yon du sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje bzhugs:

mdun du sems ma gan+dhe ljang mo bzhugs: rgyab tu sems ma nirti ljang mo bzhugs: las kyi rigs kyi gtso 'khor rnam pa drug: sprul pa'i sangs rgyas grangs las 'das pa yod: phrin las mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab yod: de phyir ming ni las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing : zhing mchos gtsang ma'i gnas rab dam pa der: tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭa: tshe las 'das pa'i 'du byed kyi phung po hā ljang gur gyur te: mda' 'phang ba bzhin du don yod grub pa yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su thim pas: rgyal ba'i sras su gyur te sangs rgyas par gyur cig: zhing khams 'di nas dbus kyi

༄ga /phyogs rol na: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang zhes bya yod: de na sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi mes ni: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po bzhugs: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum: chos nyid kun tu bzang mo zhes bya yod: rgyal ba'i sras mchog rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs: yum chen nam mkha'i dbyings phyug zhes bya bzhugs: rigs bzhi yab yum gtso 'khor grangs med yod: sprul pazhi sangs rgyas grang las 'das pa yod: ya mtshan bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab yod: de phyir ming ni stug po bkod pa'i zhing : zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas rab dam pa der: tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod kyang : rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yi sras mchog tu: rtsal chen

mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭa: tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa hūm̐ mthing ka gcig tu gyur te: rtsal po ches mda' 'phang ba bzhin du rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su thim pas: rgyal ba'i sras su gyur te sangs rgyas nas slar yang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don thogs pa med pa byed nus par gyur cig: ces brjod gyen du mda' 'phang tshul bstan la: dal gyi dbus su satad la 'phangabar bya: rgyas par byed na rigs lnga thams cad la: bsdus par byed na dbus kyi gtso bos chog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de ltar rnam shes gnas su spar ba'i rjes: phung po sbya ngas la sbyin bsregs bya ba ni: mar me'i dbus su dam tshig me lha bskyed: ye shes me lha spyan drangs gnyis med bstem: de nas mtshan byang mar me'i 'od la reg: nyon mongs sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs par bsam: lha: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu khyod kyi: kun gzhi rnam shes thab khung du: gzugs kyi phung po'i yam shing la: chos dbyings ye shes me sbar bas: gti mug rgya mtsho

༄sha /skems par shog: nyon mongs rnam shes thab khung du: tshor ba'i ngu nga po'i yam shing la: mnyam nyid ye shes me sbar bas: nga rgyal rgya mtsho skems par shog: nyon yid rnam shes thab khung du: 'du shes phung po'i yam shing la: sor rtog ye shes me sbar bas: 'dod chags rgya mtsho skems par shog: sgo lnga'i rnam shes thab khung du: 'du byed phung po'i yam shing la: bya gub ye shes me sbar bas: phrag dog rgya mtsho skems par shog: bdag 'dzin rtogs pa'i thab khung du: rnam shes phung po'i yam shing la: me long ye shes me sbar bas: zhe sdang rgya mtsho skems par shog: bdag tu 'dzin pa'i phung po la: stong pa nyid kyi me sbar bas: gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs par shog: dug gsum

'dus pa'i phung po la: sku gsung thugs kyi me sbar bas: sku gsum lhun gyis grub par shog: dug lnga 'dus pa'i phung po la: rgyal ba regs lnga'i me sbar bas: ye shes lnga dang ldan par shog: 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po la: yum chen bzhi ye me sbar bas: tshad med bzhi dang ldan nas kyang : phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub nas: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems par shog: zhes brjod yig brgya dang kai ka ni bzlas: ming byang dal bus bsreg la sāts+tsha gdab: de rjes dmigs med khyab brdal ngang du bzhag: de nas mjug gi bya ba'i rim pa la: dang po gtang rag mchod bstod tshar gcig bya'o: de nas gtor bskul chad mdo brtan skyong dang : gtor bro bshags pa bzod gsol smon lam gdab: dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing dge ba bsngo ba rnams: las byang tshor ba rang grol ltar du bya'o: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi: cha rkyen bskong bshags nyams chag rang grol las: tshe 'das bar do'i rnam shes drangs pa'i phyir: gnas 'dren 'gro drug rang grol 'di sbyar ro: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi cha lag: rigs drug gnas nas 'dren pa'i lung : 'gro drug rang grol zhes bya ba: u rgyan gyi mkhan po nga d+ma 'byung gnas kyis sbyar ba: 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du ma rdzogs so: skal ldan las can shes rab blo ldan snying rje can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya
nonan /rgyaḥkarma gling pas dwasas lha sgam po nas spyan drangs pa'i zab chos lags so:

༄dzo/::chos dbyings ka dag pho brang nas:kun bzang yab yum byin gyis rlobs:'og min spros bral pho brang nas:rdo rje sems dpas byin gyis rlobs: snang shar mdzes pa'i pho brang nas: dga' rab rdo rjes byin gyis rlobs: rang byung spros bral pho brang nas: shrī sing has byin gyis rlobs: pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: o rgyan pad+mas byin gyis rlobs: mchims phu bre gu'i brag phug nas: mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal byin gyis rlobs:gar bzhugs chos kyi pho brang nas:rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rlobs: rang snang rtsa yi pho brang nas: rgyal ba zhi khro'i byin gyis rlobs:mkha' spyod rnam dag pho brang nas:dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs: gdug pa 'dul ba'i pho brang nas: chos skyong dam can byin gyis rlobs: sgam

po gda' ri'i gter gnas nas: gter bdag gter srung byin gyis rlobs: yi dam lha tshogs ya la la: mkha' 'gro ma tshogs thibs se thibs: byin rlabs na bun ya la la: dngos grub char bzhin si li li: nyams dang rtogs pa 'u ru ru: snang ba shes pa ban ma bun: rig pa ye shes sha ra ra: gnas lugs rtogs pa shigs se shig: ka dag chen por byin gyis rlobs: rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams: byin gyis rlabs phyir gshegs su gsol: dzaḥtsū baṃ ho:gnyis su med pa ra bsgo ma:o āḥbhū gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī sirnyi pha la rgyu:ces dang ཿo āḥlha bo dhi sogs 'dzab bzla'o: de ltar byin phab pa'i ye shes pa rnams: khyed rang rnams la dbyer med ro cig tu gyur pa'i mos par mdzod:i su
sngag /pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā:
༄gi /zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi dbang bsdus bzhugs so:

༄sha/maṇ+ḍal phul yan lag bdun pa'i rjes su thal mo sbyar te/mgrin gcig tu gsol ba gdab pa ni/e ma mgon po thugs rje can: rigasadrug gnas su ltung ba yi: skyabs bral mgon med sems can la: thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol: zhes lan gsum gyi rjes la :slob dpon gyis: kye ma skal ldan bu khyod legs par nyon: 'khor ba'i gnas nas thar pa'i grong 'jug na: tshe 'di'i 'bras bu don du gnyer mi bya: 'jig rten tshe 'di don du gnyer ba

sngag /na: pha rol thar pa'i 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur: 'jig rten pha rol gzham don gnyer bas na: 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras rang don 'grub: de phyir pha rol gzhan don gnyer bar gyis: ces gsungs: de nas skal ldan rnams kyi lag tu me tog thogs la 'di skad zhu'o: kye: bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin: bdag cag skal ldan bu slob la: dbang bzhi'i chu bo bskur du gsol: brgyud pa'i che ba gang ltar lags: zhes nga dang ཿ bla mas: bu rnams ma yengs nga la nyon: bla med gnad kyi gdams ngag 'di: snod min rnams la bskur mi rung :༷sdorngadi khu/na cesas ṭa/sa rnganirngani pa bskre)rngani: zhes brjod la: bla ma 'i mdun du mos gas bskyed la 'dug go: de nas bla mas chos spyi dang bye bras brgyud pa'i lo rgyus sogs bshad: slob mar mig ras kyis

bkab laḥ o ā khaṃ wi ra sa: zhes brjod: i āḥtsū gis me tog gtadaḥ dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsol ba gdab pa ni: e ma mgon po thugs rje can: bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus pa: log pa'i lam du zhugs pa rnams: bde chen thar pa'i lam ston 'tshal: zhes lan gsum gyi rjes la: slo ba dngo na gyis 'di skad do: e ma 'dir 'dus skal ldan las can rnams: sngon chad ma rig rmongs pa'i las dbang gis: dug gsum gyis bcings ngan song gsum du mnar: deng nas brtsams te rgyal ba'i thugs rje yi: pho nyas bzung nas dkyil 'khor gral du 'khod: don 'bras 'dod phyir dad pa'i shugs bskyed la: sku gsum zhing khams pho brang 'dir shog cig: bla med don gyi snying po sbyin par bgyi: 'es brjod laḥ thog ma ra slob bu rnams la skyabs

nonan /'gro 'bogs pa ni: ma dun gyi nam ma khar dkon mchog gsum dang zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams mngon sum du bzhugs par dmigs la: thal mo sbya ra te rjes zlos byed du bzhugs la: skyon myo/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs: rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang : zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos: tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'a na gsum dang : yang: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang : dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs la: deng bzung bla med byang chub bar: gus pas skyabs su nye bar mchi: zhes lan gsum bya'o: so thar sdom bzung ni: bla ma kun bzang spyan snga ru: lus ngag yid kyis gzhan rnams la: gnod pa'i las bzlog dge ba bsgrub: dge bsnyen dge tshul dge

slong sogs: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la: rgyun du gnas shing dge ba bsgom: sdom pa yongs su bzung bar bgyi: lan gsu ma: smon 'jug sems bskyed ni: kye ho bla ma dgongs su gsol: 'di bzung byang chub ma thob par: 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: ma dang bu yi 'du shes kyis: ma bsgral pa rnams bsgral ba dang : ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang : dbugs ma dbyung rnams dbugs dbyung phyir: smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: lan gsum: ho sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang : sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar: 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs bar: bla med 'jug pa'i byang chub sems: de bzhin bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: phar phyin drug la bslab cing bsgrub: brtson 'grus dag gis thams

murdza /cad bsgral: kun don tshul khrims gsum yang bzung : bdag gis sems bskyed sdom pa bzung : ma grol dgrol dang ma bsgral bsgral: dbugs dbyung mya ngan la 'god: zhes lan gsum byaḥsngags sdom ni: dkon mchog gsum ni mi spang ngo : rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang : byang chub sems ni spang mi bya: rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu: sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin: pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu: theg pa gsum gyi chos rnams bshad: las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu: 'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun: ma lus bdag gis yongs su bzung : ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung :de nas slo ba ma dam la bzhas pa:ngag tu bdud rtsi blud laḥ 'di ni dam tshig bdud rtsi'i

chu: dam srung dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: nyams na dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur: de bas dam la ma 'da' zhig: i sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta sa ma ya swā hā: spyi bor rdo rje bzhag laḥ deng nas skal ldan bu khyod kyi: rdo rje slob dpon nga yin gyi: nga la brnyas pa ma byed cig: gal te brnyas par gyur pa na: ngan song gnas su ltung nas ni: rdo rje 'bar bas 'joms 'gyur zhing : sdug bsngal bzod glags med par 'gyur: o badz+ra sa ma ya rdu: de nas dkyil 'khor shar phyogs nas g.yas su bskor zhing sgo bzhi dbye zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni: sbyi: lhun grub gzhal yas chen po yi: shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi nas: ye shes chen pos sgo phyes shig: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: yi dam lha dang mjal bar

༄sto /shog: rgyu pra we sha ya phaṭa: de nas me tog dor ba ni: hoḥ bdag cag rig pa'i me tog 'di: yi dam zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i: yi dam lha la bab par shog: pra tī jardoḥho: ces cod pan me tog dkyil 'khor steng du bskyur: me tos gang phog sasang mtshan btag pa ni: dbus kyi thig le'i nang du bab na du ma rang grol : chos dbyings rang grol: dri med kun khyab: rgyal ba spyi blug: ye mnyam 'gyur med: de la sogs pho mo gang 'os 'pho 'gyur med par btag so: shar gyi thig le'i nang du bab na: gdod ma rang dngangs: rdo rje rang gsal: rdo rje sems dpa': rdo rje 'gyur med: rdo rje sras 'bar: rdo rje snying po: 'od gsal rang shar: de la sogs po mo/ mi bskyed pa'i gas la btas go: lho yi thig le'i nang du bab na: rin chen rgyal po: rin chen 'byung lda na: gnyis med lhun grub: 'dod yon rang grol: dbang chen dang la 'byor: de la sogs pas pho mo gang 'os rin 'byung gras la btas go: nub kyi this le'i nang du bab na: pa d+ma ka chung : pa d+ma 'dod rgyal: pad+ma glang chen: pad+ma gsal yang : bde chen dri med: de la sogs pas pho mo sang la pad+mar gras la btag go: byang gi thig le'i nang du bab na: tshogs dru ga rang grol: karma don yod: phrin las thog med: gang bsam lhun grub: rang byung rang grol rtsal: bya bral 'bad med: de la sogs pa pho mo gang la kurmar gras la btag go: mtshams su byung na spel mar

btag go: dkyil 'khor gyi nam mkha'i kha dog dris la: dkar po mthong na zhi ba'i la sa 'grub: de bzhin du ser po rgyas pa: dmar po dbang : nag dang ljang gu drag po: khra bo la las sna tshogs 'grub bo: pra ti groṇ+ḍi i rma satwa ma hā ba la: zhes me tog slob ma'i mgo bor bcings: de nas mig 'byed pa ni: hoḥ ji ltar mig mkhan mig 'byed ltar: bu khyod ma rig ling tog ni: rig pa'i ngang du da dbye bas: ye shes spyan dang ldan par shog: i badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa: zhes mig dar gsal la dkyil 'khor bstan te: 'o rigs kyi bu ma yengs par nyon cig: 'di na slob dpon gyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa dang : mtshan ma'i rten rang snang dbyer med kyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par gsal ba gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor 'dis mtshon pa yin pas: de yang rten dang

༄sha /brten pa'i lha tshogs rnams brda dang rtags kyi rang bzhin du mjal bas thams cad kyang sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes 'gags med sgyu 'phrul gyi rol par 'char ba'i ye shes kyi snang brnyan nyid: da res mtshan ma'i rten 'dis mtshon te: bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig: rigs drug gnas spa ra gyi dbyang bskur ba spro na 'dir bskur: de nas bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo : khri mthon po la rgyan gyis brgyan la bzhugs: slob ma mu ge'i bskal pa las thar pa'i phyir: 'bru lnga'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul la zhu ba ni: spu) ༷ste: bla ma 9/11 ba:( myo/bo/na: bdag cag skal lnga/na bu slob la: dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar phyogs su: bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol: zhes lan gsum zhu: der bla mas:tshur shog tshur shog

rigs kyi bu: da ni bdag gis khyod smin bya: ces brjod: de nas skabs 'dir rigs mthun gyi 'gros ltar dbang gi snod rung du bya ba ye shes pa dbab pa niḥ las bum chu mthor zhing :oṃ badz+ra satwa sa: o swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shurnyo3rtaḥ slob dpon kun bzang rdor sems zhi khro rab 'byams kun 'dus kyi thugs ma'i 'od kyis slob ma'i lus sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las rin chen khri rkang pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du: khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpa' dkar gsal zhal gcig 'dzum bcas bzhad pa: phyag gnyis g.yas rig stong rdo rje thugs kur 'dzin zhing g.yon snang stong dril bu sku la brten pa: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan sogs longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin po che'i

)sna /rgyan gyis brgyan pa: zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i: thugs chos dbyings khyab brdal gyi klong du: rang sems ka dag rig mdangs zhal phyag gi rnam pa kun bzang yab yum la 'khor ye shes lnga'i rang 'od rigs lnga yab yu/ma bcu: sems dpa' brgyad: sems ma brgyad: thub pa drug sgo ba yab yum brgyad dang bcas pa'i rtsal mdangs lasaḥ klad pa dung khang 'bar ba'i gzhal yas 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i klong du che mchog yab yum la khrag 'thung khro bo yab yum bcu: ka'u ri ma brgyad: seng ha ma brgyad: sgo ma bzhi: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya dang : mgrin par rig 'dzin dpa' bo yab yum

bcu rnams gsal ba'i sku'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥlha gsum dang rang rang gi thugs srog sa bon las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas :dus gsum gyi rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad char sprin gtib pa ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib du thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la: spos dang gu gul tshil chen bsreg: rol mo'i sgra sgrogs shing : e ma ho: bla ma kun bzang rigs lnga'i tshogs: dpal chen he ru yab yum dang : sras mchog dpal bo ḍā ki'i tshogs: 'khor bcas dbyings nas spyan 'dren no: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thibs se thib: rol mo mang po khro lo lo: rgyan cha mang po pu ru ru: 'dir gshegs dgongs la byin gyis rlobs: sku yi byin rlabs lus la stsol: gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la

༄dzo /stsol: thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la stsol: nyid dang dbyer med mdzad du gsol: i āḥlha bod+dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhartu āḥ i ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥlha: badz+ra a be sha ya a be sha ya dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ zhes gnyis su med par thim pa ra bsams la/ de la ye shes brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje me tog bzhag la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: ces pa brjod/ de nas bum dbang dngos bskur ba ni/ yang slob bu'i thal mo sbyar la sasol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai hoḥ bla ma rdo rje 'acirdon pa che: bdag cag skal ldan slob bu la: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol: zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes la: 'phrad tshad rang grol ltar bum dbang rigs dbang rnams rgyas par bskur ba'am: yang na rigs mthun gyi dgongs pa la spyad na 'gro drug rang grol gyi nang bzhin rigs dbang lnga kho nar bskur bas kyang : bum dbang gi rim pa ma 'thus pa med 'dra bas: de lugs su bya ba'am : yang na gter gzhung khrus chog nas gsungs pa'i go rim ltar bkod pa 'di bzhin bya ste: de la bum pa thams cad kyi bum chu gtso bo'i bum pa'i nang du bsdus

la : spyi bor bzhag la dbang bskur ba ni: lha: bum pa 'di ni gzhal yas khang : nang na zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog rnams: slob bu khyod la phab pa yis: phung khams lha dang lha mor gyur: bskyed rim lha dbang thob par shog: i āḥlha: sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa lha: o āḥsbyi hrīḥswā hā: 'o rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la bum pa 'di'i dbang bskur bas: phyi snod thams cad gzhal yas khang du shes pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: bum chu'i dbang bskyar bas: nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad lha dang lha mor shes pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: phyag mtshan lnga'i dbang bskur bas: bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon

sngag /pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: kha rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas: 'bras bu myur du smin pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: mgul chings kyi dbang bskur bas: gzhan don 'bad med 'grub pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: gzungs thag rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas: sdom pa gsum dang dam tshig mthar phyin pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: bum chu'i dbang bskur bas: rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi khams dag nas: bskyed rdzogs zung du 'brel ba'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: 'o ma bum rdzas dang bcas pas dbang bskur bas: rang don mthar phyin nas gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyis bskal pa ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro ba sems can thams cad 'dren pa'i

dpal mgon dam par gyur cig: gzungs thag rnam lnga'i dbang bskur bas: sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i sdug bsngal las skyob par gyur cig: bum chu gtsang ma'i dbang bskur bas: thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i chu rgyun mi chad cing : stong nyid snying rje dang 'brel ba'i dbang dam pa thob nga/ra gyur cig: bum pa rgyan bkod pa gzi byin can: bla ma yab yum rol mo rgyan dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba la brten nas: zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin pa'i dbang dang dngos grub dam pa thob par gyur cig: dbang bar gyur cig: gsalo bar gyur cig: mched par gyur cig: 'bar bar gyur cig/: rgyas par gyur cig: dbang du gyur cig: smin grol reg

mug /cing rtogs par gyur cig: brtan par gyur cig: grol bar gyur cig: me tog gang la phog pa'i lha gang yin pa de dang dbyer med du sangs rgyas pabasi sdi/shāt+na cig: ces smon lam dang bkra shis brjod: me tog gtor: de nas thun mongs rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba ni: rgyud las: zhe snang me gsod chu yi dbang : nga rgyal ri bsnyil dbu rgyan dbang : 'dod chags dug 'joms rdo rje'i dbang : phrag dog lcags 'grol dril bu'i dbang : gti mug mun sel ming gi dbang : chu dang dbu rgyan rdor dril ming : mched lcam rnams la bsku ra bar bya: zhes pas: dang ngo mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur ba ni: bum pa spyi bor bzhag la: spyi gtsug tu chu tig blug cing 'di skad do: lha: sku gsum dam cigag las byang zhing : nyon mongs zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa'i: lha yi bdud rtsi dag pa yis: mi bskyod pa ru dbang bskur ro: : badz+ra a dharmā shu dz+nyā ta dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa rmaḥ gnyis pa rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: dbu rgyan mtho la basmon: rna ltag g.ya sa su bum pa bzhag la: lha: sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid de: nga rgyal rtog

pa rnam par 'joms: chags med sbyin pa'i dbu rgyan 'dis: rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro : swā rat+na sa man+ta dz+nyā na rat+na swā bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa mo: gsum pa snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje'i dbang ni: rdo rje mgo thog tu bzhag: mthar lag tu gtad: bum pa ltag par bzhag la: lhu: sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang : mi phyed rdo rje'i gsang ba la: 'dod chags rtog pa rnam par 'joms: rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ro: e pad+ma pradz+nyā a bhi ṣiñtsa me: bzhi nga don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang ni: bum pa rna ltag g.yon du bzhag: dril bu gsil zhing la sa tu gtad la: don yod grub pa'i ngo bo dril bu lag g.yon du gtad pa dgrol zhing / bum pa rna ltag g.yon du bzhag pas phrag dog dag /'du byed kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa'i mod pa mdzod/

༄ga /rgyu: thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yi: 'gro don mnyam med dril bu 'dis: phrag dog rtog pa rnam par 'joms: gnyis su med par dbang bskur ro: hā ri sha a nu te dz+nyā na pa de badz+ra kurma a bhi ṣiñtsa mo: lnga pa rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang bskur ba ni: bum chu dpral bar bzhagaḥ rnam snang gi sku bstan: gsang mtshan btags la: ྈ: rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas: gti mug rtog pa rnam par 'joms: cis kyang mi chod mi shes pa: rdo rje'i ming ni rab tu grags: o tro tsakra ma du a mi dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa rmaḥ zhes dbang bskur ro: 'o de ltar thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bas:dug lnga dang phung po lnga gtan nas dag nas: ye shes lnga dang sku lnga lhun gyis grub cing zhing khams lnga la dbang bsgyur nas sems can gyi don

thogs pa med par byed nus pa'i dbang thob par gyur cis: ces brjod: de nas zhi khro'i lha dbang chen mo bskur ba ni: yang slob bus thal mo sbyar la: gsol ba gdab pa ni: kye ho bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: lha dbang yongs rdzogs bskur du gsol: zhes pa lan gsum gyi rjes la:slob dpon gyis spros pa la dga' na: dam pa rigs brgya'i sku tsaka li rgyab yig dang bcas pa re re nas bskur bar bya'o: mdor bsdus te mgyogs dbang du bskur na: lha'i gtso bo rnams bsdus te mgo thog tu 'grim zhing : :: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: kun bzang yab yum dbang bskur bas: yid chos rnam par dag pa yi:chos sku rab 'byams dbang thob shog: dharma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa o āḥsbyi hrīḥ de nas smon lam ni: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la kun bzang yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas: yid chos kyi khams rnam par dag ste chos sku rab 'byamari sri kyi dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: de nas ngo sprod ni: 'o skal

jug /ldan rigs kyi bu rnams kun bzang yab yum zher bya ba de'ang gzhan zhig yin snyam du ma sems shig: rang gi kun gzhi byang chub kyi sem/sa: yid byed pa po da lta'i shes rig ma 'gags par sa le: trig ge ba 'di ka chos sku kun tu bzang po ye thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba zhes bya ba de 'di nyid yin no: rang gi shes rig dngos po rdos can du grub pa med pa: ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa'i stong sang nge ba 'di ka yum kun tu bzang mo yin no: 'di'i rang rtsal 'gag med du chos byed pa po sna tshogs su shar ba 'di nyid kyang yab kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin yin par ngo shes par gyis shig: ces brjod: de nas rigs lnga yab lnga'i dbang bsku ra te: lha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: rigs lnga

yab lnga'i dbang bskur bas: phung po lnga po gnas dag nas: longs sku rab 'byams dbang thob shog: o hūm̐ swā āḥhāḥ so bho ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ smon lam ni: skal ldan rnams la rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbang bskur bas: phung po lnga gnas su dag nas longs sku rab 'byams kyi dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: ngo sprod ni: 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams: rgyal ba rigs lnga zhes bya ba de gzhan zhig yin snyam du ma sems shig: rang gi phung po lnga ma spangs gnas su dag pa nyid rgyal ba rigs lngar snang ba ste: de yang gzugs ma 'gags par gsal ba 'di ka rnam par sna nga mdzad do: tshor ba 'gag med du gsal ba 'di ka rin chen 'byung ldan no: 'du shes dung nge ba 'di ka snang ba mtha' yas

༄ga /so: 'du byed khyug ge ba 'di ka don yod grub pa'o: rnam par shes pa 'gag med du gsal ba 'di ka rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: ces brjod do: de mas rigs lnga yum lnga'i dbang bskur ba niḥ rdu: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: bde gshegs yum lnga'i dbang bskur bas: 'byung lnga ma spangs gnas dag nas: rigs lnga yum lnga'i dbang thob shog: rlu lko rmā r+pā t+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: smon la maḥskal ldan rnams la yum lnga'i dbang bskur bas: 'byung ba lnga po gnas su dag nas: rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig: ngo sprod ni: 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams: yum lnga zhes bya ba ni gzhan na med de: phyi nang gi 'byung ba lnga ma 'gags par snang ba 'di

ka yum lnga'i rang bzhin yin no: nge yang sar snang ba ni sangs rgyas spyan ma'o: chur snang ba ni mā ma ki'o: mer snang ba ni gos dkar mo'o:rlung du snang ba ni dam tshig sgrol ma'o: nam mkhar snang ba ni dbyings phyug ma'i rang bzhin yin no: ces brjod: de nas byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba ni: lha'i skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: sems dpa' brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: tshogs brgyad ma spangs gnas dag nas: sems dpa' rab 'byams dbang thob shog: sgo rnyi satwa a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ smon lam: skal ldan rnams la sems dpa' brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas:rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad ma spangs gnas su dag nas: byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po byed pa'i dbang dam

sngag /pa thob par gyur cig: ngo spyod: 'o skal ldan rigar/ kyi bu rnams: sems dpa' brgyad kyang gzhan na med de: rang gi rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad 'gags med du gsal ba 'di ka yin no: mig gi rnam par shes pa gzugs 'gags med du mthong mkhan gyi shes pa 'di ni sa'i snying po'o: rna ba'i rnam par shes pa sgra 'gags med du tshor mkhan gyi shes pa 'di ni nam mkha'i snying po'o: sna'i rnam par shes pa dri 'gags med du tshor mkhan gyi shes pa 'di ni spyan ras gzigs so: lce'i rnam par shes pa ro 'gags med du myong mkhan gyi shes pa 'di ni phyag na rdo rje'o: lus kyi rnam par shes pa reg bya 'gags med du tshor mkhan gyi shes pa 'di ka byams pa'o: yid kyi rnam par shes pa kun tu

thogs med du gsal ba'i yid shes 'di ka sgrib pa rnam sel lo: nyon mongs pa'i yid can ngar 'dzin gyi shes pa hu re ba 'di ka sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'o: kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa khyab brdal du gsal bu 'di ka 'jam dpal gyi rang bzhin yin no: ces brjod do: de nas sems ma brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba ni: lha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: sems ma brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: yul brgyad ma spangs gnas dag nas: sems ma rab 'byams dbang thob shog: a a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ smon lam: skal ldan rnams la sems ma brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: yu/la brgyad ma spangs gnas su dag nas: byang chub sems ma'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don byed par gyur cig: ngo spyod: 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu

༄si /rnams: byang chub sems ma brgyad kyang gzhan na med de: phyi yul brgyad kyi rtog pa rang sar dag pa nyid byang chub sems ma brgyad do: de yang mig gi yul gzugs su snang ba rnam par dag pa nyid sems ma lā su dkar mo'o: de bzhin du rna ba'i yul sgra rnam par dag pa ma le ser mo'o: sna'i yul dri rnam par dag pa gīrti dmar mo'o: lce'i yul ro bro ba gnas su dag pa dīrti ljang gu'o: 'das pa'i rtog pa gnas su dag pa puspe dkar mo'o: da ltar gyi rtog pa gnas su dag pa sbruspru ser mo'o: ma 'ongs pa'i rtog pa gnas su dag pa ā lo ke dmar mo'o: 'byung bar ma nges pa dang chos can gyi rtog pa gnas su dag pa lha mo garnye ljang mo'i rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: ces ngo

sprod do: de nas sprul sku thub pa drug gi dbang ni: lha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: thub chen drug gi dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs drug po gnas dag nas: sprul sku rab 'byams dbang thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ smon lam: skal ldan rnams la sprul sku thub pa drug gyi dbang bskur bas: dug lnga ser sna dang drug gnas su dag nas: sprul sku rab 'byams kyis rigs drug 'dul ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig: ngo sprod: 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams: thub pa drug kyang gud na med de: nga rgyal rnam par dag pa lha'i thub pa dbang po brgya byin: phrag dog rnam par dag pa lha ma yin gyi thub pa thag bzang ris: 'dod chags rnam par dag pa mi'i thub pa shākya thub pa: gti mug rnam par das pa byol

༄sha /song gi thub pa seng ge rab brtan: ser snar nam par dag pa yi dwags kyi thub pa kha 'bar ma: zhe snang rnam par dag par dmyal ba'i thub pa chos kyi rgyal po'i rang bzhin yin no: ces ngo sprad do: de nas sgo ba bzhi'i dbang ni: :: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: sgo ba bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: rtag chad mu bzhi gnas dag nas: phrin las rab 'byams dbang thob shog: shan+tiḥ puṣ+ṭiḥ wā shang mā ra ya a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ smon lamaḥ skal ldan rnams la sgo ba bzhi'i dbang bskur bas: rtag chad mu bzhe gnas su dag nas phrin las rnam pa bzhis 'gro ba'i don thogs pa med pa byed nus par gyur cig: ngo sprod: 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams: sgo ba bzhi yang gud na med de: rtag par lta ba gnas su

dag pa rnam par rgyal ba'o: chad par lta ba gnas su dag pa bshin rje gshed po'o: bdag tu lta ba gnas su dag pa rta mgrin no: mtshan mar lta ba gnas su dag pa sgo ba bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rang bzhin no: ces ngo sprod: de nas sgo ma bzhi'i dbang ni: :: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la:sgo ma bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: skye gnas bzhi po gnas dag nas: phrin las bzhi yi dbang thob shog: badz+ra e ku sha dza: badz+ra pā sha ::badz+ra sbo ṭa bo: badz+ra garnye ho: ā bhi ṣiñtsa ā: smon la ma: skal ldan rnams la sgo ma bzhi'i dbang bskur bas: skye ba rnam bzhi'i sgo bcad de:tshad med rnam bzhi rgyud la skyes nas phrin las rnam bzhis sems can gyi don thogs pa med pa byed nus par gyur cig: ngo sprod ni: 'o skal ldan

khug /rigs kyi bu rnams: sgo ma bzhi yang gud na med de: skye gnas kyi rtog pa bzhi gnas su dag pa ni sgo ma bzhi'i rang bzhin te: rdzus skyes kyi rtog pa gnas su dag pa lcags kyu ma: mngal skyes kyi rtog pa gnas su dag pa zhags pa ma: sgong skyes kyi rtog pa gnas su dag pa lcags sgrog ma: drod gsher las skyes pa'i rtog pa gnas su dag pa ni sgo ma dril bu ma'i rang bzhin ye nas kyang yin te: skal ldan rnams kyis kyang yin pa la yin par shes pa'i nges shes dang ldan par mdzodacig: ces brjod:de nas khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha dbang skur ba ni:che mchog yab yum gyi dbang bsku ra la : :: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: che mchog yab yum dbang bskur bas : nyon mongs ma spangs gnas das/ nas: khrag 'thung rab

'byams dbang thob shog: ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā gro ti shwa ri a bhi ṣiñtsa :: smon la ma ni: skal ldan rnams la che mchog yab yum gyi dbang bskur nas: nyon mongs ma spangs rang sar dag nas khrag 'thung che mchog he ru ka yab yum gyi go 'phang thob nas: log par lta ba rnams 'dul ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig: ngo sprod ni gong ltar 'gre'o: de nas khrag 'thung yab lnga'i dbang bskur ba ni: stu: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: khrag 'thung yab lnga 'i dbang bskur bas: dug lnga ma spangs gnas dag nas: khrag 'thung yab lnga'i dbang thob shog: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa sbyi: smon lam ni: skal ldan rnams la khrag 'thung yab lnga'i dbang bskur bas: dug lnga nga / srangs gnas su dag nas he ru ka sku lnga'i dbang dang dngos/

༄sto /grub thob par gyur cig: ngo sprod 'gre'oḥ de nas dbyings phyug yum lnga'i dbang bskur la ཿ lha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: dbyings phyug yum lnga'i dbang bskur bas: yul lnga'i rtog pa rang grol nas: gro ti yum lnga'i dbang thob shog: gro ti shwa rī pañtsa a bhi ṣiñtsa lha: smon lamaḥ skal ldan rnams la dbyings phyug yum lnga'i dbang bskur bas: yul lnga'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag nas gro ti yum lnga'i dbang dang dngos grub thob par gyur cig: ngo sprod 'gre'o: de nas ma mo kau rī brgyad kyi dbang bskur laḥ bh+yo: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: ko'u rī brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas:tshogs brgyad ma spangs gnas dag nas: ma mo rab 'byams dbang thob shog: ha a bhi ṣiñtsa sbyi: smon lam: skal ldan rnams la ma mo kau'u rī

brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: tshogs brgyad kyi rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag nas mkha' 'gro ma rma rab 'byams dbang du 'dus par gyur cig: ngo sprod 'gre'o: de nas phra med seng ha brgyad kyi dbang bskur la: lha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: seng ha brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: yul brgyad ma spangs gnas dag nas: phra men rab 'byams dbang thob shog: ho a bhi ṣiñtsa :: smon la ma: skal ldan rnams la phra men seng ha brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: yul brgyad kyi rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag nas: phra men rab 'byams dbang du 'dus par gyur cig: ngo sprod 'gre'o: nge nas sgo ma bzhi'i dbang bsku ra la ཿ lha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: sgo ma bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: skye gnas bzhi po gnas dag nas: phrin

༄gi /las bzhi la dbang thob shog: dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho: a bhi ṣiñtsa rgyu: smon lam: skal ldan rnams la rta gdong sgo ma bzhi'i dbang bskur bas: skye gnas bzhi po gnas su dag nas phrin las rnam bzhis sems can gyi don byed par gyur cig: ngo sprod 'gre'oḥ de nas dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad kyi dbang bskur laḥlha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: dbang phyug nyer brgyad dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs rtog tshogs gnas dag nas: ma mo rab 'byams dbang thob shog: bh+yo a bhi ṣiñtsa lha: smon lamaḥ skal ldan rnams la dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs pa'i rtog tshogs thams cad ma spangs gnas su dag nas: ma mo dang dam can thams cad kyi srog la dbang thob par gyur cig: ngo sprodaḥ 'o

skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams: khrag 'thung drug cu'i lha tshogs de rnams kyang gud na mi dmigs te: rang gi nyon mongs pa'i rtog tshogs ma spangs gnas su dag nas: rang bzhin med par shes pa nyid khrag 'thung drug cu'i skur snang ba yin te: de mtshon pa'i brdar: rang gi klad pa dung khang gi gzhal yas khang na khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs/ thams cad sku tshom bu shegs se dngos su bzhugs nas yod do: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi lha tshogs thams cad snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo na 'od kyi sku ru bum sku'i tshul du dngos su bzhugs nas/ yod do: gzhan yang rtsa thams cad ni dpa' bo'i rang bzhin du gnas so: rlung thams cad ni dpal mo 'i rang bzhin du gnas so: thig le dkar cha thams cad

༄sha /longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams yab kyi tshul du gnas so: rak+ta dmar cha thams cad longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams yum gyi tshul du gnas so: ba spu bye ba sa ya ni mkha' 'gro ma bye ba sa ya'i rang bzhin du gnas so: des na rang gi lus 'di nyid rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin yin pas: 'di la brnyas pa dang : bsad pa dang : brdungs pa dang : dka' thub la sogs pas rgyad du ma bcug par: bza' btung thams cad tshogs 'khor gyi tshul du mchod cig: rgyan dang : gos kyi rnam pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba rnams kyang zhen pa med pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa rgyun mi chad par gyis shig: de nas rang nyid 'chi ba'i tshe na zhi khro'i lha tshogs thams cad rang gi

lus nas thon te: nam mkha' gang bar bar dor 'char bar 'gyur ro: de'i dus su sgra 'od zer gsu lpi la ma 'jigs: ma sngangs: ma skras par da lta dbang bskur ba'i yi dam gyi lha 'di rnams yin par ngo shes par gyis shig: de dus ngo shes pa dang : grol ba dus mnyam du 'ong ngo : ces ngo spro da rgyas par bya'o: e ma dag pa rab 'byams kun bzang dgongs pa'i bcud/ dgong pa rang grol sangs rgyas mngon byed lam/ /ma dag 'gro ba 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /ye das gdod ma'i dbyings su sgrol ba'i chos / /nges gsang rgyud sde'i yang snying yid bzhen nor/ /dbang gi rgyal por mchog tu yongs snyoms pa/ /theg kun rtse rgyal man ngas snying gi this /zab yangs gdams pa 'di t+na 'gran zla bral/ /gang 'di'i dbang mchog lag len rgyas bsdus skor/ /zhib par byas 'di rigs mthun rgyud sde dang / /zhi khro'i gdams zab mang po'i smin grol smo ra/ /yongs 'dzin du ma 'i drung nas thob nga yis/ /chos tshul rnams kyi mthong brgyud phyag bzhes dang / /rang bzhung nyid la sa gsungs nga 'i bo rim rnams/ /yongs sdom bklag chos sasal bar bkod pa 'di/ /mdo khams stod kyi sprang ban gyis bgyis so/ /maṅga lo/

sngag /oṃ badz+ra satwa sbyi: oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shurnyo3rta/ stong pa'i ngang las/ r+ghaṃ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du 'dod yon gyi dngos po gzugs bzang ba/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dad ldan pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga sogs kyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ mkha' mnyam zhing na gzugs mchog ci mchis nga// /blo yis blangs nas dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /tshe 'das gzugs kyi log rtog rnam dag nas/ /bcom ldan rnam snang go 'phang myur thob shog /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta rū nga pustso hoḥ mkha' mnyam zhing na sgra snyan ci mchis pa/ /blo yis blangs nas dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /tshe 'das/ sgra yi log rtog rnam dag nas/ /

bcom ldan mi bskyod bo 'phang myur thob shog /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shabha pustso hoḥ mkha' mnyam zhing na dri zhem ci mchis pa/ /blo yis blangs nas dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /tshe 'das dri yi log rtog rnam dag nas/ /bcom ldan rin 'byung go 'phang myur thob shog /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhe lurtso hoḥ mkha' mnyam zhing na ro mchog ci mchis pa/ /blo yis blangs nas dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /tshe 'das ro yi log rtog rnam/ dag nas/ /bcom ldan snang mtha'i bo 'phang myur thob shog /o na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ra sa pustso ho: mkha' mnyam zhing na reg bya ci mchis pa/ /blo yis blangs nas dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /tshe 'das reg bya'i log rtog rnam dag nas/ /bcom ldan don grub go 'phang myur thob shog /o

༄sha /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sparnye lurtso ho: kye ho tshe 'das thar ba'i sogs/ 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod ba'in du/ /longs spyod zad pa med par shos /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med pa/ /rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /
sngag /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: dbang bzhi 'phrad tshad rang grol gyi rjes kyi rim pa gsal ba'i me tog ces bya ba bzhugs so:

༄sha /dbang lda na zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'chal lo: bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: dbang mchog kun gyi rjes bstan pa : 'di bzhin spyod cig phyi rabs rnams:nor 'khrul rang bzo spangs pa gces: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de ltar dbang bzhi bsku ra ba'i mjus tu'am: spros bcas bum dbang chen mo bskur ba'i rjes:gzhan don dpas med nus par byed pa: rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang bskur ba ni: stu: 'khor lo rin chen rnam bcu ldan: 'khor ba'i 'khor tshogs/ rgyun bcad nas: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor byed pa: skal ldan khyod kyis thob par shog:

sngag /oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ lha: btsun mo rin chen bsod nams gter: pha rol phyin bcu'i gzugs dang ldan: tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa dang : yid bzhin dpal 'byor dbang thob shog: o pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ lha: nor bu rin chen mchog gsum ldan:bsod nams tshogs gnyis rmyu/ra rdzogs shing : dgos 'dod yid bzhin char ltar 'bebs: lhan cig nor bdun phyug par shog: 'o ma hā rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ lha: khyim bdag rin chen sna bdun ldan: gang la ci 'dod dpag bsam ltar: gzhan don tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs byed: shes bya thogs med dbang thob shog: o ma hā ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ lha: blon po rin chen dmag dpon mchog: brtson 'grus go

gyon 'khor ba 'dzoms: thabs/ ldan skyabs mchog dbang thob nas: 'jigs tshogs lta ba 'joms par shog: o ma ti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥsbyi: rta mchog rin chen sa lam bgrod: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sprin shugs 'chang : bde chen thar lam zhing du phyin: rdzu 'phrul rkang nga/'i dbang thob shog: i kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ lha: glang po rin chen theg pa che: bdud sde 'joms pa gcig tu ldan: stobs bcu'i bdag gzham/ don byed cing : yang dag snying po'i don rtogs shog: i hasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ 'o rigs kyi bu rnams la rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang bskur bas: bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang : 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang ldan nas: gzhan don dpag med 'grub pa 'i dbang dam

rañdzan /pa thob par gyur cig: de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis dbang bskur ba ni:me tog gi char phabaḥrol mo rnams 'joms nga ra 'khrolaḥ lha: ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba yi:dbu la gdugs kyis spras pa ltar: de ltar rigs kyi bu rnams kyi: dbu la gdugs kyi dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs rgyu drug tshad pa skyobasaḥ skyobs pa mthar phyin a ti'i dbang : gsang ba byang chub dbang thob shog: thā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa lha: lha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyi: spyan la gser nya'i dbang bskur bas: ye shes rnam pa lnga yi spyan: ye shes mig gcig dri ma med: ma sgrib rang gsal lu gu brgyud:sgron ma bzhi ldan dbang thob shog: bha ka a bhi ṣiñtsa lha: :: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyiḥ ljags la pad+ma'i dbang bskur bas: smra byed

don mtshon chos sgra sgrogs: dri med mdangs ldan dbang thob shog: bha ka a bhi ṣiñtsa :: :: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyi: so la dung gi dbang bskur bas: chos kyi sgra dbyangs rab tu sgrogs: theg dman rnams kyi bye brag phyed: sgra don rtogs pa'i dbang thob shog: bha ka a bhi ṣiñtsa lhaḥ bhūḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyi: mgul la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas: dbang bzhi chu bo bdud rtsi lnga: gzhon nu bum pa sku yi rgya: ye shes rang lugs rang byung ba'i: mgul la bum pa'i dbang thob shog: bha ka a bhi ṣiñtsa lha: lha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyi:thugs la dpal be'i dbang bskur bas: mi 'gyur rin chen theg pa'i mdzod: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i gter: thugs la dpal be'i

༄sha /dbang thob shog: thā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa lha: lha: sal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyi: sku la rgyal mtshan dbang bskur bas: bstan pa mi nub don mtshon phyir: rgyal bas don mtshon rtags ldan 'dis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: bha ka a bhi ṣiñtsa :: :: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyi: zhabs la 'khor lo'i dbang bskur bas: rtag par rgyun gyi 'khor lo ru: chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor nas: skye med don gyi dbang thob shog: bha ka a bhi ṣiñtsa :: 'oḥ rigs kyi bu khyod la bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: rgyal po rgyal sar bton pas rgyal phran 'bangs 'khor rnams mnga' 'og tu tshud pa ltar dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob nas gzhan don dpa ga tu med pa 'byung bar gyur
cig: ces thob pa'i gnas rnams su gtug cing : me tog gtor/ rol sdir ro: dge'o:
rog /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: gtor dbang reg pa don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

༄sto /zhi kro rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal 'o : zab chos zhi khro dbongs nga rang grol gyi: gtor dbang reg nga don ldan bskur ba ni: rgyud las : mtha' brten gtor ma'i dbang bsku ra ni: smon lam dang bcas bu la bskur: zhes pas: gtor ma'i rgyu rmi spos sna tshogs dang ma ngar sasum gar chang gis sbrus la: gtor mazlum por pad 'dab brgyad kyis bskor ba'i rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa mtshan pa: sayas g.yon gnyis su nyi zlas brgyan pa: dkar dmar thig gur dang rtsa ba sasum gyitsaka lis brgyan: dar sna lnga'i gur phub: zas sna tshosas dang sman raka bran la dkyil 'bor dbus su bkod: gtor tshogs dang phyi nang gsang mchod gyis basmor: rol mo sna tshogs sbir zhing las byang rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum gang rung bsang : tshogs 'khor rgyas par thog nas: dus la bab dus: rgyal thebs kyis

༄sto /gtor chen bzung : bla ma rgyan dang ldan nga/sa rdo rje dril bu thogs: gzung mas bdud rtsi ka pā la khyer: las chog nga sa spos bsreg rol mo sna chogs sbi ra zhing : gtor chen slob bu'i spyi bor bzhag la 'di skad doḥ 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu: dad pa dang dam tshig ldan pa rnams nyon cig: gtor ma'i snod gzhal yas khang sum thog gi nang du: phye mo na bla ma rnams bzhugs pa: bar na yi dam/ lha tshogs rnams/ bzhugs pa: 'og na ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams bzhugs pa: 'dab 'khor na chos skyong rnams khrom tshogs pa bzhin du bzhugs par bsam: lha tshogs de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs nas bdud rtsi 'od zer dang bcas pa byung nas: khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas mar lan gsu ma babs pas: dang pos sdig sgrib rnams dag: gnyis pas lus sems khengs:gsu/ma pas gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gyis brgyan par bsgo mas la: mos gus drag po bskyed cig: o āḥlha: skye med dbyings kyi gtor

snod du: 'gags med snang ba'i gtor chen bshams: rol rtsal sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs kyis: dbang 'di khyod la bskur bar bya: dbang mchog 'di yi byin rlabs kyis: skye gnas bar dor grol bar shog: mi lam bar dor ngo shes shog: bsam gtan bar dor gdeng thob shog: 'chi kha bar dor rang grol shog: chos nyid bar dor ngo shes shog: srid pa bar dor dbugs phyung shos: gzhan don dpag med 'grub pa dang : sku gsum lhun gyis grub par shog: chu gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa: myo āḥbhū hrīḥ ces brjod la rang rtsal gyi ye shes pa rnams rtsa ba sasum gyi nges shes gding dang lda na par bya'o: de nas g.yas su dngos grub g.yo na du bharnya bdud rtsi bsnams: ngag tuḥ kā ya sirnyi o: 'a/ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta

rañdzan /(ped+dhi (1: sarba cisad+dhi ༷khro: ces tshar sasum brjod cing : rang yi dmaḥ mgrin spro ra bla ma: lte bar mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnam/sa gsal bar: dus gcis tu rol bar bya'o: tshesas chung don che dngos grub myu ra: sator dbang res nga don ldan 'di: rgyud la brten te pad+mas bkod: mtsho rgyal bdas nas zin ris byas: phyi rabs rnam sa la phan thob thos: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgyaḥ sater rgya: sba sa rgya: zab rgya: grub thob 〉karma gling pas sgam ngo sadar gyi ri bo nas bton pa 'o: dge'o: madru lo: bha wan+tu: dge'o:
sngag /gar gling zhi khro'i gnas 'dren gyi mtshams sbyor snying por dril ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

༄pha /'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam mkhyen bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zung 'jug sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang rin po che/ tshe 'di nyid la ci nas kyang mngon du bsgrub par bya/ de'i ched du 'dir zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor chen po tshe 'das 'di bar dor zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i

༄ga /tshul rnams rim pa bzhin du nod par bgyi'o/ /snyam du sems bskyed pa dang / chos nyan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams kyang blang dor ma 'dzol bar bgyis te legs par gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir gang zhig gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa la/ spyir bdag cag gi ston pa thabs la mkhas shing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis gdul bya'i sems can rnams kyi khams dang dbang po dang bsam pa'i rjes su 'gro ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bskor bar mdzad pa mtha' dag kyang legs par bsdu na rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du ba yang / kun byed rgyal po'i rgyud las/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang / /'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /

zhes gsungs pa ltar las 'dir ska bas su babs pa ni/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na'ang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas shis/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsu/ngas pa ltar rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg nga/ las khyad chos bzhi'am bco lnga'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags nga 'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa nyid yin te/ de la yang phyi nang gi rgyud sde gnyis su yod pa las 'dir nang rgyud yo ga'am/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ der yang bsgrub bya lha yi sde dang / sgrub byed thabs kyi rgyud gnyis las / bsgrub bya lha yi sde'i dbang du byas te/ zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub nga/'i lam gyi rim/ pa dang rjes su 'brel ba

༄ga /nyid yin zhing / de la yang rgyud dang man ngag so so'i dgongs pa la slob dpon rnams kyis bzhed pa'i dbang gis bzhi ste/ 'di ltar glang po che rab 'bog gi rgyud kyi rtogs pa gcig khol du phyungs ba kulpa dum bu'i rgyud dam bshags pa'i rgyud kyi le'u gsum pa gu rus mdzad pa'i gdams ngag gi le'u tho sogs kyis bkral ba zhi khro khrom dkrugs su grags pa dang / gu ru rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgya zhang khrom gyi gter ma'i rjes su 'brangs te bshags rgyud du zhi khro'i le'u gsungs tshul gyi go rim bzhin du sgrub pa zhi khro gnas bsgyur dang / yi ge brgya pa dbang mchog rgyal po'i rgyud la brten pa zhi khro rigs bsdus sam pad+ma brgya ldan dang / sgyu 'phrul zhi khro sogs rang gzhung la bkol rgyud kyis

kha bskang ba zhi khro bar 'byams su grags pa rnams las 'di phyi ma yin zhing / de yang bkol rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang nas/ 'gyod tshangs kyi rgyal po 'di nyid ji ltar byung ba'i khungs dang gleng gzhi'i dbang du bgyis na sngon 'dod khams kyi gnas 'dir bram ze dung gi phreng ba can zhes bya ba rig nga/'i gnas lnga la byang ba zhig la slob ma rgyal bu dge mthong zer ba zhig yod pa des slob sbyong rnams mthar phyin pa na/ da ni nga'i gong na rig par smra ba slob dpon 'di tsam du zad pas/ 'di nyid gong du mi gtong ngo snyam du bsams nas slob dpon la mi mtshams pa'i las rngams po ches tho brtsams shing / slob dpon gyis kyang rang gi slob ma rgyal po'i phrug gu des phrag dog gi bsam pas gnod pa'i sbyor ba byas

jug /par shes te zhe sdang gi dmod pa bor bas las des dpon slob gnyis ka ngan song du ltung nas sdug bsngal drag pos nyam thag par gyur to/ /de'i tshe rgyal ba rnams kyis las ngan pa'i sems can de dag 'dul ba'i dus la bab par dgongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po'i byin rlabs las dpal rdo rje sems dpar sprul nas de la 'gyod tshangs kyi bshags pa dang yi ge brgya pa'i sngags bstan pas sngon gyi bag chags dang rnam smin dran te 'gyod pa drag po skyes pa la/ slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag por mngon par sprul nas phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams bskur bas/ bram ze dang rgyal bu de'i byang chub kyi myu gu sngo

skams su gyur pa slar yang gsos nas kun gzhi byang chub kyi sems dang phrad de 'bad pas rig 'dzin gyi sa la rim gyis gnas par gyur to/ /de lta bu'i sngon gyi gleng sa/zhi phun sum tshogs pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid kyis mtshon rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud sde rnams ma'i yul du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul yang / thub pa'i dbang po nyid mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad na gsang bdag gis ri ma la ya'i rtser dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i byin rlabs kyis sa ho ra'i rgyal po dzaḥl rmi ltas ngo mtshar ba bdun sngon du snang ba dang / dngos su pu sti glegs bam gyi char babs so/ /de nyid la nang gses tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad

jug /du phye ba las khyad par du gyur pa 'di ni spyi rgyud sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs te/ de ltar na/ sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las/rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor nga// /dgongs pa rig pa rna bar brgyud/ /gang la thug gi bar du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba dgongs brda'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ gang zag rna bar brgyud pa ste/ brgyud tshul gsum gyi rim pas o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la chos bka' 'di babs shing gu ru rin po che de nyid kyis snyigs ma'i gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi ched du/rgyud sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba sgrub thabs mne ngag dang 'brel ba/ man ngag chog khrig dang 'brel ba/ chog khrid phyag bzhes dang 'brel ba ste/

'brel ba bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas legs par gtan la phabs te smon lam gtad rgya dang bcas nas dpal dwags lha sgam po'i brag ri lha bran gar stabs byed pa 'dra bar gter du sbas pa nyid/ phyis su dus rtags rten 'brel mngon du gyur pa na/ sprul pa'i gter ston chen po rig 'dzin kurma gling pas gter gnas de nyid nas spyan drangs te rang gi sras nyi zla chos rje la gnang / des gu ru nyi zla 'od zer la bstsal ba ste/ brgyud pa gsum gyi bar du chig brgyud du mdzad nas/ slar yang rgya ra ba nam mkha' chos kyi rgya mtsho la sogs pa nas bdag cas gi bla ma dam pa'i bar du byin rlabs kyi sprin phung ma yal/ dngos grub kyi char rgyun ma chad/ dam nyams dang 'dres khyer gyi slad ma zhugs par zhal nas snyan du

༄ga /rim bzhin brgyud pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'di la smin grol gyi rim pa gnyis las/ 'dir smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba de skabs su babs pa yin/ de la yang sbyor ba sngon gyi gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa dang rjes su mthun par rigs drug gnas 'dren gyi dbang dang dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor chen por bcug nas dbang gzhi rdzogs par bskur ba dag rim bzhin sgrub par byed pa las/ rigs drug so so'i gnas nas 'dren mdzad thub pa drug gi rnam par snang ba rnams dang / rigs kun 'dus pa'i khyab bdag bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nyid la gsol ba bdebs pa dang skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i tshig gi rim pa rnams nged kyi rjes su zlos

nga/:re 31tra/ nga/ 3)tra/ lhanab/ /ces mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ /'dir rang gzhung las/ lnga pa rgyud lnga'i lha la skyabs 'gro zhing / /tshe 'das rigs drug gnas nas drangs pa ni/ /tshe 'das nye 'brel gcig gis mtshan byang bzung / /tshe 'das nyid kyis gso la ba gdab par bsam/ /zhes gsungs pas dngos su rjes zlos byed pa ni mi dgos par mngon la/ yang la cig kye ma mgon pos gsol sadab kyi sngon mtshams sbyo ra gyi lo rgyus bshad pa yang gzhung dang cung zad 'gal te/ gsol gdab kyi rjes su/ de skad gsol ba btab rjes slob dpon gyis/ /'gyod tshangs byung khungs bram ze dung phreng can/ /slob bu rgyal bu dge mthong na raka nas/ /rim gyis rigs drug gnas nas drang tshul dang / /brgyud pa'i lo rgyus chos bshad btang ba'i rjes/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / mtshams sbyor gzhan yang 'chad dgos par gzhung nyid las ma bshad pas na 'dis rdoX /sdu wa kāṭā// gyi/ r+shadī byin dīkā sdo ༵/ /shā //kā / snro ༵༵༵ ༵ sbya bye ༵ sdo /khyod tshangs byung khungs dang brgyud pa'i lo rgyus tsam zhig bshad pas kyang 'thus so/ /zhes pa'ang 7bcun pa gzhan phan 'tha' yas pas
sngag /bram ze dung phreng can gyi lo rgyus bzhugs so/ /

༄sha /tshe las 'das pa khyod da lam 'jig rten tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ste/ phyi ma'i snang ba ma shar ba da lta chos nyid kyi bar do'am srid pa bar do na yod pa'i skabs/ yin pas/ rang snang zhi khro'i lha tshogs shar ba rnams la ma 'jigs ma skrag par rang snang du ngo shes par gyis shig /rang snang dbyer med du sangs rgyas/ par 'gyur ro/ /sngar gson po'i dus las da lta bar do'i rig pa dgu 'gyur gyis gsal bas rta kha srab

mug /kyis bsgyur ba dang 'dra ste/ tshe las 'das pa khyod da lam 'jig rten tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ste/ phyi ma'i snang ba ma shar ba da lta chos nyid kyi bar do'am srid pa bar do na yod pa'i skabs yin pas/ rang snang zhi khro'i lha tshogs shar ba rnams la ma 'jigs ma skrag par rang snang du ngo shes par gyis shig /rang snang dbyer med du sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /sngar gson po'i 'dus las da lta bar do'i rig pa dgu 'gyur gyis gsal bas rta kha srab kyis bsgyur ba dang 'dra ste/ yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams yin pas tshe 'di'i snang zhen gang la'ang chags pa dang zhen pa ma byed cig /da lan nged rnams kyis sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes shing lha bsgom sngags bzlas nas/

khyod rang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs phyir khrus dang smin par byed pa'i dbang rnams bskur nas thar ba byang chub lam la 'god par byed pa yin pas/de la yang 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus cung zad cig brjod na/ sngon 'dod khams 'di na bram/ ze dung gi phreng ba can zhes bya ba rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhig la slob bu rgyal po'i bu zhig yod pa la/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par bslab par 'gyur ba dang / slob dpon bram ze 'di ma gtogs nga'i gong na shes rab can gzhan med bsams nas phrag dog skyes pas slob dpon bram ze bsad pa'i rnam smin gyis/ rgyal bu de ngan song gsum du ltung nas brgyud cing mthar sems can lus srul po can gcer bu pa zhes bya ba skyes nas/ lus la nad rnam pa drug gis theb ste/

jug /'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dus gcig la myong ba zhig tu skye ba la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po dang longs sku rnam par snang mdzad kyis thugs rjes gzigs nas zhi khro na rag dong sprugs kyi rgyud gsungs shing / sems can de rnams kyi rna bar zhi khro'i mtshan dang sngags bsgrangs shing dbang bskur na thar gsungs pas/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje la sogs kyis sems can de dag dmyal ba'i gnas nas drongs te/ lha'i gnas su rig 'dzin mi'i thod pa can zhes bya bar skyes so/ /gzhan yang dpal kun tu bzang po nyid kyis kyang / gal te rnal 'byor pho mo gang zhig gis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'di rnams kyi mtshan rna bar lan

cig thos pa tsam gyis kyang na raka chen por mi lhung ngo / /khyad par du o rgyan rin po che nyid kyi rdo rje'i gsungs las/ thos grol 'di ni ma sgom bar sangs rgyas pa'i chos: thos pa tsam gyis grol ba thob pa'i chos: sdig po che gsang lam du khrid pa'i chos: skad cig gcig gis bye brag byed pa'i chos: skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i chos zab mo yin pas 'di yi slebs pa'i sems can ngan song du 'gro mi srid do: mtshams med pa lnga bsags pa'i mi'i rna lam du thos na'ang nges par grol bar 'gyur ro: 'chi khar sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag zab mo dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis btsal kyang 'di las lhag pa'i chos rnyed mi srid do: zhes gsungs so: de lta bu'i gdams pa khyad par

jug /can la yid ches nges shes dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran par bya zhing lha dang bla ma la yid ches nges shes kyis 'dun pa drag po gtod la/ gsol ba rtse gcig tu thob dang bar do'i sdug bsngal las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gar sgang bi ri khyod du sbyar bas 'gro rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god par gyur cig /
