༄ga /gang 'dir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / de'i zhal nas gsung rab dam pa'i chos dang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams dang / yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnam la bdag cag gi yo byad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sku khrus dam pa gsol bar bgyi'o/ /khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tshe/ ba ltar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla re bris pa der/ /de

bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs nga/ra bkang ba'i glu dang ni/ /rol mo bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchod dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi r+ṣa ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la/ /nyon mongs dri ma mi mnga' yang / /tshe 'das sgo gsum sgrib sbyang phyir/ /gtsang ma chab kyi

༄dzo /sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ hrī āḥ kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i//gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyangs phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra wan+t+ra ye swā hā/

༄ga /de yang khyed rang rnams ma yengs par legs pa nyon cig /spyir 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid thams cad 'khrul snang nyi tshe ba bar ma do'i gnas skabs kho nar nges pa yin te/ tshe 'di'i gnas skabs kyi mtshan nyid ma dag 'khrul pa'i bar do'am bsam gtan bar do'i gnas skabs su 'dod pa dang / tshe'i 'du byed dor nas phyi ma'i skye srid ma blangs pa'i bar der chos nyid bar do'i gnas skabs yin pa'i phyir/ des na sgyu lus kyi phung khams tsam la brten ma rten kho na'i bye brag tsam ma gtogs 'khrul snang gi rang bzhin nyid la spyod pas na/ des na tshe las 'das ldan thams cad 'khrul snang ma dag pa'i ngor shar ba'i bar do drug gi 'jigs skrag las thar bar 'dod pa dag gi don por bya ba ni

dam pa'i chos kho nar yin te/ de yang rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis te/ de dag kyang rgyu las khyad par du 'phags pa 'bras bu gsang chen rdo rje theg pa yin la/ de dag la'ang gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams pa'i dbang gi theg pa'i bye brag dang lam gyi 'jug sgo 'tha' yas par mchis na'ang / da lam chos bka' 'di nyid kyi dbang du bgyi na/ sngon 'dod khams 'di na bram ze dung gi phreng ba can zhes bya ba rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa zhig yod pa las/ slob ma rgyal bu'i bu zhig la blo sbyongs rdzogs pa'i mthar/ slob bus phrag dog byas te bsad pas/slob dpon bram ze kyang sems 'khrugs nas dmod ngan bor bas nyer len gyis mtshams sbyar te/ ngan 'gro'i gnas su sdug bsngal dpag med

༄sha /myong ba las/ kun tu bzang po rnam pa ra snang mdzad kyi thugs rjes gzigs te phyag na rdo rje dang / rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis su sprul nas gdul bya de gnyis kyi gam/ du byon nas 'gyod tshangs kyi bshags pa dang zhi khro'i mtshan sngags sogs bstan pas ngan 'gro'i gnas nas rim gyis drangs nas rig 'dzin gyi gral du 'khod par mdzad pa'i zab chos 'di nyid dgongs brda snyan khung rim par brgyud nas pad+ma 'byung gnas la bka' bab pa ste/ de nyid kyis cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan sogs la gnang ste phyi rabs kyi 'gro ba rnams kyi don du gter du sbas pa nyid/slad dus 'dir 'gro 'dul gter ston thams cad kyi rgyal po kurma gling pas zab gter gyi gsang mdzod phyes te snyigs dus kyi gdul bya

rnams la chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston dpag med stsal ba'i zab chos 'di nyid kyi sgo nas rig drug gi gnas nas drangs te gsang chen lam gyi rim pa'i 'jug sgo smin byed kyi dbang rnams bskur ba'i skabs su bab pa yin pas gzhan du ma yengs par 'jug pa'i chos dang dbang gi tshig don la blo gzhol ba'i ngang nas rtse gcig par nyon cig /

༄ga /de lta bu'i phan yon khyad par can rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas mdun gyi nam mkha' dkon mchog gsum dang zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams zhal mngon sum du bzhugs yod snyam pa'i spyan sngar phyag 'tshal ba dang / skyabs sems sdom bzung dam tshig blangs pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di bzhin du ram bu 'debs par zhu/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pas ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las sgrol te/ /gcig tu don dmu mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa

dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni/ /dran pa tsam gyis 'joms mdzad cing / /bla med byang chub mchog thob pa'i/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'chal lo/ /brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che rol ba'i lha/ /zhi khro sku sasum lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yum mchog mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan srung dregs pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /
sngag /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: sku gsum bla ma'i gsol 'debs dug gsum ma spangs rang grol bzhugs so:

༄ga /rnam dag chos dbyings khyab gdal pho brang nas: skye med spros bral chos sku'i bla ma la: bdag nyid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs: ma rig gti mug ma spangs rang grol nas: rang byung ye shes ma bcos lhun grub tu: chos sku'i byin rlabs ka dag rang dbang zhu: gsal dag ye shes bde chen pho brang du: ma 'gags bde chen longs sku'i bla ma la: bdag nyid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs:

sngag /'dod chags zhen pa ma spangs rang grol nas: rang rig ye shes bde chen rang grol du: longs sku'i byin rlabs lhun grub rang dbang zhuni skyon med rnam dag pad+ma'i pho brang du: nges med rang shar sprul sku'i bla ma la: bdag nyid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs: log rtog zhe sdang ma spangs rang grol nas: rang snang ye shes rang rig rang gsal du: sprul sku'i byin rlabs rang grol dbang bskur zhu: yang dag 'od gsal rang rig pho brang du: phyogs med bde chen sku gsum bla ma la: bdag nyid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs: tha dad gzung 'dzin ma spangs rang grol nas: rang byung ye shes sku gsum lhun grub tu: bde chen sku gsum byin rlabs dbang bskur zhu: rang

sems mtha' bral chos skur ma rtogs pas: gti mug rmongs pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yi: sdug bsngal sems can 'di rnams snying re rje: de rnams thams cad chos sku thob par shog: rang rig bde chen longs sku ma rtogs pas: 'dod chags srid pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yi: 'dod log sems can 'di rnams snying re rje: de rnams thams cad longs sku thob par shog: rang sems shar grol sprul sku ma rtogs pas: snang sems gnyis snang 'khor bar 'khyams pa yi: log rtogs sems can 'di rnams snying re rje: de rnams thams cad sprul sku thob par shog: rang sems sku gsum dbyer med ma rtogs pas: der 'dzin nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa rnams: sangs rgyas ma thob 'gro kun

no༅na /snying re rje: de rnams thams cad sku gsum thob par shog:zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi sku gsum bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi gsol 'debs dug sasum ma spangs rang grol zhes bya ba: o rgyan gyi mkhan ngo pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis sbyar ba: ji srid 'khor ba'i 'jig rten ma stongs bar: de srid dam chos 'di yang ma rdzogs shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
rog /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: zhi khro'i klong bshags brjod pa rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

)sto /kun bzang che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: gus pas phyag 'tshal nyams chags dag gyur cis: zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol la sa: nyams chags maspangs gnas su dag bya'i phyir: zhi khro'i klong bshags brjod pa rang grol bstan: 'di la brtson par gyis shig phyi rabs bu: sa ma ya: 'di la drug ste: brjod med dom bshags dang : zhi ba'i klong bshags khro bo'i klong bshags dang : lta ba'i klong bshags rū tra'i smre bshags/ dang : bde gshegs spyi bshags rnam pa drugatshes bstan: dang po brjod med don gyi bshags pa ni: o ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni: zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang : thugs rje nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad de: 'dir gshegs bdag la

༄sha /dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol: brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso: thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che sprul pa'i sku: zhi khro sku gsum lha la phyag 'tshal lo: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis: mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod: kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga ru: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus kun: 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du ro gcig pas: gnyis med byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig: sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che: chos kun rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal bas: rnal 'byor

nyid dbyings smra bsam las 'das pa: mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'du: kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas gdal ba la: phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings: 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams: gsang chen rab dgyes gzung chen bdag nyid ma'i: mkha' dbyings klong yangs pad+mo 'khyil pa 'dir: gnyis med thig le chen por 'od gsal zhing : ma bcos spros med byang chub snying po'i sku: cir yang snang ba bde chen g.yung drung lha: 'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: bdag nyid chen po rigs lnga yab yum dang : byang sems lcam dral 'gro 'dul thub pa drug: sprul pa'i sgo ba yab

༄ga /yum brgyad la sogs: dbyings med dbyings nyid sprul pa mang po'i tshogs: rdo rje lha mo tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag: rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu: gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi: ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs mang po dag: ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i: phyi nang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor nyer brgyad tshogs: dbang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol: lhu: thugs rje'i gdung 'tshob rdo rje rnal 'byor bdag: 'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed de: bla med go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir: bstan pa rgya mtsho so so'i 'dul khrims dang : sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog: 'da'

dka' rdo rje dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams: snga phyi mnos shing gnyer du smras so 'tshal: yun du mi gtong 'da' bar mi bgyid cing : don la gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang : gdod bya long yod snyoms pa'i le lo yis: klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang : shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur te: bsgoms la mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel la sogs: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la: tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis ni: ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'gal gyur te: rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa dang : skad cig tsam yang 'phrad smra mi bya zhes: bka' las byung ba de ltar ma lcogs te: gsang sgo 'chol bas dbye gsal

༄sha /dka' ba dang : mngon shes med pas skyon can ma rtogs te: nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pa bskang ba dang : nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang : nyams la mi 'dzem nyams pa de dag gi: nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal: tshe 'di'i rkyen dang phyi ma'i sgrib gyur rnams: rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol bshags na: 'phags pa'i bka' chad bdag la mi gtong zhing :byams pa'i thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang : gnyis med dbyings su mi 'gyur bdag bkod de: mi dmigs btang snyoms ngang du bzhugs nas kyang : gnyis med don gyi tshangs pa stsal du gsol: don dam spros med brjod las 'das pa las: rnam rtog gang yang

dmigs par mi 'gyur te: kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis na: thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa mthol/ lo bshags: nongs pa mchis na rang gnong bzod par gsol: 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas: las kyi dbang gis bdag cag 'khor bar 'khyam/sa: nyon mongs log par lta ba'i dug 'byung ste: sdug bsngal nad kyis shin tu gdung ba la: bde gshegs thugs rje sman pa'i rgyal ngo/ yis: dam chos bdud rtsi thar pa'i sman bstsal nas: nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i nad rnams zhi mdzad cing : bla med byang chub snying por 'tsho mdzad pa: byams mgon thugs rje can la skyabs su mchi: thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa mthol lo bshags: lta ba 'phang dma' chos nyid don ma rtogs:

༄ga /sgom pa yun thung yi dam lha ma gsal: bzlas brjod grangs nyung grwa chags zur nyams pas: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: rgyal ba zhi khro'i spyan sngar4 mthol lo bshags: thugs rje mnga' ba khyed la bzod par gsol: ye shes lha tshogs spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: 'bad rtsol chung bas slob dpon thugs ma mnyes: gdung sems chung bas mched lcam thugs ma zin: 'phyor la g.yem pas gdams ngag gzhan la shor: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la: tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis ni: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul gyur pa ci mchis pa: rgyal ba zhi khro'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags: thugs rje mnga' ba khyed la bzod par gsol: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la

mthol lo bshags: mthol zhing bshags so byang shing dag gyur cig: gnyis med don gyi tshangs pa stsal du gsol: sa ma ya: sanyis pa/ chos nyid zhi ba'i klong bathags ni: i: kun bzang yab yum gsan cing dbongs su gsol: yid dang chos ni ye nas mngon sangs rgyas: kun bzang yab yum dgongs spyod de 'dra yang : de ltar bdag gis ma rig ma rtogs te: kun bzang yab yum thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: rgyal ba rigs lnga gsan cing dgongs su gsol: phung ngo/ lnga ni ye nas mngon sangs rgyas: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dgongs spyod de 'dra yang : de ltar bdag gis ma rig ma rtogs te: rigs kyi yab rnams thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: thugs rje che mnga'

༄ga /khyed la bzod par gsol: rigs kyi yum rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: 'byung ba lnga ni ye nas mngon sangs rgyas: rigs kyi yum lnga'i dgongs spyod de 'dra yang : de ltar bdag gis ma rig ma rtogs te: rigs kyi yum lnga'i thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: sems dpa' brgyad rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: rnam shes tshogs brgyad ye nas mngon sangs rgyas: sems dpa' brgyad kyi dgongs spyod de 'dra yang : de ltar bdag gis ma rig ma rtogs te: sems dpa' brgyad kyi thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: sems ma brgyad rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: rnam shes yul brgyad ye

nas mngon sangs rgyas: sems ma brgyad kyi dgongs spyod de 'dra yang : de ltar bdag gis ma rig ma rtogs te: sems ma brgyad kyi thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: thub pa drug rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol : nyon mongs drug ni ye nas mngon sangs rgyas: thub pa drug gi dgongs spyod de 'dra yang : de ltar bdag gis ma rig ma rtogs te: thub pa drug gi thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: sgo ba bzhi rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: rtag chad mu bzhi ye nas mngon sangs rgyas: sgo ba bzhi yi dgongs spyod de 'dra yang : de ltar bdag gis ma rig ma rtogs te: sgo ba bzhi yi thugs dang ci 'ga' ba:

༄sha /thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: sgo ma bzhi rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol: tshad med bzhi ni ye nas mngon sangs rgyas: sgo ma bzhi yi dgongs spyod de 'dra yang : de ltar bdag gis ma rig ma rtogs te: sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dang ci 'ga' ba:thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: de nas zhi ba'i lha la gnong bshags bya ba ni: i: rang rig ye shes blo dang ma ldan pas: bdag gi phung po khams dang skye mched rnams: zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor lha ru sbyor ma 'tshal: sangs rgyas bzhi bcu gnyis la bzod par gsol: rang rig ye shes blo dang ma ldan pas: phung po lnga po rigs lngar sbyor ma 'tshal: ma rig rang sems bdag tu bzung bas nongs: kun tu bzang po'i

tshogs la bzod par gsol: rang rig ye shes blo dang ma ldan te: 'byung ba lnga rnams yum lngar sbyor ma 'tshal: ma rig rang sems bdag tu bzung bas nongs: kun tu bzang mo'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: rang rig ye shes blo dang ma ldan pas: rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems dpar sbyor ma 'tshal: ma rig rang sems bdag tu bzung bas nongs: byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: rang rig ye shes blo dang ma ldan pas: yul bzhi dus bzhi sems mar sbyor ma 'tshal: ma rig rang sems bdag tu bzung bas nongs: byang chub sems ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: rang rig ye shes blo dang ma ldan pas: nyon mongs drug po thub par sbyor ma 'tshal: ma rig rang

jug /sems bdag tu bzung bas nongs: thub drug sprul pa'i sku la bzod par gsol: rang rig ye shes blo dang ma ldan pas: rig pa rtag chad sgo bar sbyor ma 'tshal: ma rig rang sems bdag tu bzung bas nongs: khro bo khro mo rnams la bzod par gsol: rang rig ye shes blo dang ma ldan pas: yid chos kun bzang yab yum sbyor ma 'tshal: ma rig rang sems bdag tu bzung bas nongs: kun bzang yab yum sku la bzod par gsol: rang rig ye shes blo dang ma ldan pas: ma rig 'khrul pas nongs pa bgyis lags na: nyon mongs las kyis yi dam lha spangs te: bslu byed dbang gis slob dpon snying nas smad: nga rgyal dregs pas mched dang lcam dral 'khrugs: srab la 'phyor

bas gsang sngags gzhan la spel: ser sna'i dbang gis mchod pa dus las 'das: grogs ngan rkyen gyis cho ga'i gsang ba chags: brtur zhugs chung bas bgegs rnams tshar ma chod: brngams zhing thug thub lhag phud nyams la sogs: tshe rabs thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas: tshe 'di'i lus bzung da lta yan chad du: sdig pa mi dge'i las rnams ci bgyis pa: dus rig rgyun mkhyen rnams la bzod par gsol: 'phags pa lags pas khyed kyis dang du bzhes: sems can lags pas nongs shing 'khrul ba byung : sgyu ma lags pas bshags pa gnang bar mdzod: thabs la mkhas pas tshangs par stsal du gsol: de nas zhi ba'i lha la 'gyod bshags bya ba ni: i: kun tu bzang po thugs mchog

༄sha /rin po che: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa yab lags kyang : don dam dbyings su sdud pa yum lags kyi: bdag lus rtog pas sgyu ma'i sku bslus shing : bdag dam nyams pas sems la 'gyod pa skyes: kun bzang yab yum sku la bzod par gsol: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas thugs mchog rin po che: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa yab lags kyang : don dam dbyings su sdud pa yum lags kyi: bdag lus rtog pas sgyu ma'i sku bslus shing : bdag dam nyams pas sems la 'gyod pa skyes: rigs lnga yab yum sku la bzod par gsol: sems dpa' sems ma thugs mchog rin po che: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa yab lags kyang : don dam dbyings su sdud pa yum lags kyi:

bdag lus rtog pas sgyu ma'i sku bslus shing : bdag dam nyams pas sems la 'gyod pa skyes: sems dpa' sems ma'i sku la bzod par gsol: sprul sku thub drug thugs mchog rin po che: bcud kyi sems can khams gsum dbang du sdud: snod kyi 'jig rten don dam dbyings su sgrol: bdag lus rtog pas sgyu ma'i sku bslus shing : bdag dam nyams pas sems la 'gyod pa skyes: sprul sku thub pa drug la bzod par gsol: sgo ba sgo ma thugs mchog rin po che: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa yab lags kyang : don dam dbyings su sdud pa yum lags kyi: bdag lus rtog pas sgyu ma'i sku bslus shing : bdag dam nyams pas sems la 'gyod pa skyes: sgo ba yab yum sku la bzod

༄gi /par gsol: gsu ma pa khro bo'i klong bshags bya ba ri: i: dang po rang bzhin mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor du: gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi bdag dang ma bral bas: gnyis su med pa'i gnas lugs don ma rtogs: gnyis med chos kyi sku la bzod par gsol: don dam mi 'gag gsal ba'i go 'byed cing : zla gsal dwangs pa'i dbyings su de bzhengs la: byang chub thig le'i 'od kyis khyab mdzad pa: kun snang dwangs pa'i sku la bzod par gsol: don dam skye ba med pa'i mkha' dbyings las: 'bras bu yon tan 'byung ba'i skur snang ba: dbang chen rim gyis bskyed pa'i bzhugs gnas rten: dbang chen gzhal yas gsal bar ma gyur pa: pho brang 'bar ba'i klong du bzod par gsol: bde chen

nyid la phyag rgya'i skur bstan zhing : ye shes drug gi phyag mtshan rang rang rnams: ji ltar gsal ba'i ngang du ma gyur pa: khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i sku la bzod par gsol: gnyis med sku la 'khril pa'i gzung mchog ma: pad+ma'i don la chags pa'i mkha' dbyings su: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi 'od 'phros pas: gro ti yum lnga'i sku la bzod par gsol: thugs las skyes pa'i ye shes khro mo ni: rnam shes brgyad kyi ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: ko'u rī la sogs thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: gnas kyi ma mo brgyad la bzod par gsol: thugs rje zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : log rtog mtshan mar 'dzin pa zhi ba'i phyir: mche gshog rngam pa 'bar ba'i skur sprul pa: seng ha la sogs thugs dang ci

༄ga /'ga' ba: yul gyi phra men brgyad la bzod par gsol: pho brang rgyan dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor du: 'gugs dang 'ching dang sdom dgyes sgo ma bzhi: rta gdong la sogs thugs dang ci 'ga' bar: sgo ma phyag rgya bzhi la bzod par gsol: mngon spyod las la grub pa'i dbang phyug ma: dge dang mi dge gnyis kyi stangs 'dzin ma: ma tshogs dbang phyug thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: thugs rje mnyam pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : phra mo'i ting 'dzin gsal bar ma gyur pa: yon tan 'dzin pa rnams la bzod par gsol: bdag gi skye ba thog ma ma mchis nas: da lta'i lus 'di bzung ba

yan chad du: ma rig dbang gis srid pa'i kha 'khor zhing : ci srid mi lus blangs nas gar skyes kyang : mtshams med lnga dang de dang nye ba lnga: sdig pa'i las su gyur pa ci mchis pa: dngos su bgyis dang bgyid du bstsal ba dang : de la rjes su yi rang bgyis pa rnams: byang chub thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang : tshangs pa stsal nas dngos grub stsal du gsol: de nas khro bo'i dkyil 'khor la bshags pa bzod gsol bya ba ni: lha:bskal pa dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus: dug lnga gnas gyur ye shes he ru ma: dbyings kyi yum chen khro mo lnga dang sbyor: ska'u rī la sogs nang gi mkha' 'gro bzhiḥ puska la sogs phyi yi rnal 'byor ma: seng ha la sogs za byed gdong can tshogs: bri ta la sogs mtshams

sngag /kyi gshog pa can: 'bar ba'i bar khyams dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: sgo bzhir 'gugs 'chings sdom dgyes sgo ma bzhi: khrag 'thung lha tshogs sku yang ma gsal zhing : snying po grangs nyung phyag rgya gnas ma son: tshogs dang gtor mas gnas su ma bkang ba: khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams la bzod par gsol: de nas khro bo'i dkyil 'khor la bshags pa bye brag tu gsol ba ni: lha: dang po gsang mchog sdom pa 'di mnos nas: 'da' dka' khas blangs dam las g.yel gyur te: khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: gha na'i sbyor mchog rtog 'dzin bar chad kyis: gro ti yum lnga'i thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: khro mo dbyings phyug ma la bzod par

gsol: rdzas dang phyag rgya mngon du ma gyur te: sha za kau'u rī'i thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: gnas kyi ma mo brgyad la bzod par gsol: sha khrag mchod pa gzhung bzhin ma bshams te: sing ha phra men thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: yul gyi mkha' 'gro'i sku la bzod par gsol: shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi ma phyed de: rta gdong sgo ma'i thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: ye shes sgo ma bzhi la bzod par gsol: 'da' dka' khas blangs 'khor drug ma thul te: ma bdun sring bzhi'i thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: mkha' 'gro bcu gcig sku la bzod par gsol: longs spyod chung nas tshogs kyi phud nyams pa: phud nyams dbang phyug thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: dbang mo nyi shu brgyad la bzod par gsol: gnas la ma

sngag /brten bya byed 'byung 'jug bgyis: ti ra'i gnas nyul thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: gnas nyul chen mo'i sku la bzod par gsol: sku mnyes pha ma'i tshul du ma gyur te: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: rdo rje rgyal po'i sku la bzod par gsol: ting 'jin ma brnyes zhi khro ma phyed de: rdo rje rgyal theb thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: ston pa sgron me'i sku la bzod par gsol: le lo byas pas phyag rgya rgyun chad de:kurma las mkhan thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: las kyi slob dpon sku la bzod par gsol: sbyor ba'i tshe na tshad la ma phebs te: shes rab snyems ma'i thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: gsang yurme rig ma'i sku la bzod par gsol: sgrol ba'i tshe na ting 'dzin gnas ma stobs: skyes bu

ging chen thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: sgrol ging bdag po'i sku la bzod par gsol: sprul sku khro mo'i thugs su ma gyur te: 'gugs 'dren pho nya'i thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: 'gyogs byed las mdzad sku la bzod par gsol: le lo'i dbang gis brtse gdung rgyun chad de: byang chub mched lcam thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: rdo rje ming sring sku la bzod par gsol: bye mo'i phyir na dam tshig nyams la sogs: phyi nang rjes gcod thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: dam tshig bya ra byed la bzod par gsol: longs spyod gsol nas lhag ma'i phud nyams te: phyi 'khor brten ma'i thugs dang ci 'ga' ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol:

༄ga /ba'i pa rū tra'i smre bshags ni: i: thugs rje chen po bcom ldan rdo rje sems: dri med dung mdog mchog tu gzugs bzang ba: rnam dag 'od gsal nyi zla 'bum gdal bzhin: dpa' bo 'od zer stong khams lam me ba: srid pa gsum gyi sa mkhan ston par grags: khams gsum 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu: byams mgon thugs rje'i lha khyod dgongs su gsol: bdag ni thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas: lam log lam stor srid pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams: sngon tshe las log sdig pa spyad pas nongs: sdig pa'i las rnams ci spyad rab gnong 'gyod:dar cing drag po'i las dbang de btsan nas: 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings gyur te: zhe sdang 'bar ba'i mes ni rang rgyud

bsregs: gti mug mun pa 'thibs pas shes rab rmongs: 'dod chags rgya mtsho'i 'gram du rnam shes bying : nga rgyal drag po'i ri bos ngan 'gror mnan: phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshub mas 'khor bar g.yengs: bdag tu lta ba'i mdud pa dam pos bcings: 'dod pa me 'dag dong 'dra'i 'obs su lhung : sdug bsngal drag po mi bzod char ltar 'bebs: 'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal shin tu bzod dka' zhing : sdig pa'i las dbang drag po'i me 'bar bas: rnam shes dbang po'i myu gu gdung gyur te: phung po sgyu ma'i lus kyis mi bzod na: byams mgon thugs rje can gyis bzod lags sam: bdag ni blun rmongs las ngan sdig po che: las kyi dbang gis 'dod khams rū trar skyes: skyes pas 'gyod

༄ga /do las la yi re chad: yi chad 'gyod kyang las la bcos su med: las kyi shugs ni chu bo'i gzhung dang 'dra: las dbang chu klung 'phral du ga la bzlog: rnam smin thams cad rang gi las las byung : las kyi rlung dmar drag po des bdas pas: bdag ni de sngon bskal pa grangs med du: 'khor ba'i btson rar mun par 'khyams pa las: byams mgon khyed kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis: las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa gnas sbyangs nas: ma ltar byams pa'i zhabs drung da ltar 'khod: nyi ltar 'od 'bar zla ltar mdangs gsal ba'i: thugs rje'i zhal nyid lta bas mi ngoms kyang : thog ma med nas ma rig ling tog gis: ldongs pa'i chu bur mig gis ma mthong na: 'gro ba'i mgon

khyod de snga gang na bzhugs: las dbang drag po shin tu mi bzad pas: shin tu skrag cing skyi g.ya' rab 'jigs nas: dung dung gdung ba'i smre sngags 'di 'don cing : nyam thag 'phongs pa'i nga ros 'bod lags na: byams mgon thugs rjes dus 'dir shā dgongs na: nam zhig 'chi 'pho lus sems 'bral ba'i tshe: gnyen bshes grogs dang bral nas gshin rjes 'khrid: de tshe 'jig rten nye dus mi stongs te:las kyi dbang gis bdag nyid gcig pur 'khrid: dus der bdag la mgon skyabs ma mchis kyis: gang gi phyi bshol dus las ma g.yel bar: da lta nyid du btud de mngon spyod mdzod: las kyis mnar ba'i skye bo bdag 'dra ba: thog ma med pa'i dus nas log rtog pas:

mug /khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas nas ma thar te: bskal pa grangs med skye ba ji snyed du: rdos po can lus grangs med blangs gyur pa'i: sha rus bsags na 'jig rten gtos dang mnyam: rnam khrag bsags na rgya mtsho chen po tsam: las 'phro bsags na bsam 'das brjod mi lang : khams gsum bgrangs shing skye shi'i kha brgyud kyang : byas pa'i las rnams don med chud re zos: skye ba grangs med ji snyed de tsam la: skye ba tshe gcig kho na tsam gyi las: bla med byang chub don du rab spyad na: de tsam byas pa'i las la don yod pas: don gyi yong ye mya ngan 'das zin snyen: las kyi dbang btsan nyon mongs stobs che bas: sha khrag dra ba'i lus blangs 'khor bar 'khyams: sdug bsngal

bzod dka' srid pa'i btson rar tshud: mi bzad drag po'i sdug bsngal 'di lta bu: nyes byas thams cad rang gi las las byung : thugs rje chen pos las ngan rgyun bcad de: nyon mo ngas las kyi rlung 'di bzlog tu gsol: ma rig log pa'i las kyi dbang btsan nas: mi shes mun pa'i nang du gtan 'khyams na: ye shes sgron me'i zer gyis mi stongs sam: nyes byas las kyi rnam smin mi bzod na: thugs rje chen po'i phrin las mi mdzad dam: phyin ci log gi g.yang sar ltung lags na: thugs rje'i myur mgyogs phyag gis mi 'dzin nam: dug gsum bzod dka'i nad kyis gdung lags na: thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sman gyis mi gso'am: las kyi rnam smin sdug bsngal me 'bar na: thugs rje

༄ga /bsil ba'i chu rgyun mi 'bebs sam: sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i 'dam du byings gyur na: thabs mkhas thugs rje'i lcags kyus mi 'dren nam: khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas nas sbyang sbyangs nas: nam zhig rang gi 'bras bu thob pa'i tshe: 'phags pa'i thugs rjes ci 'tshal don ma mchis: bdag nyid las 'phro dbang btsan bzhag na lta: thugs rje che zhes su la ci zhig bgyi: dpa' bo khyed la thugs rje'i stobs mnga' zhing : sngon 'byung 'brel ba'i las kyi 'phro btsan na: yal yol btang snyoms le lo ma mdzad par: snying nas da gzigs thugs rje rgyal ba'i lha: 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drangs te sku gsum gyi: go 'phang mchog la myur du drang du gsol: lnga pa lta ba'i klong du bshags pa ni: i: chos

kyi dbyings nyid spros pa med pa la: gzung 'dzin gnyis su lta ba yongs re gol: dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa nyon mongs: spros med bde chen klong du bshags pa ra bgyi: kun tu bzang po bzang ngan med pa la: bzang ngan gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: gtsang dang rme bar 'dzin pa snying re rje: bzang ngan med pa'i klong du bshags par bgyi: mnyam pa nyid la che chung med pa la: sangs rgyas sems can lta ba yongs re gol: che chung gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: mnyam nyid bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi: byang chub sems la skye 'chi med pa la: 'di dang phyi mar lta ba thang re chad: skye 'chi gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: 'chi med g.yung drung klong du bshags par bgyi:

sngag /thig le chen po grwa zur med pa la: gzugs dang rdzas su lta ba yong re gol: ga zur gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: kun zlum thig le'i klong du bshags par bgyi: dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: thog ma tha mar lta ba yongs re gol: 'pho 'gyur gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: dus gsum 'gyur med klong du bshags par bgyi: rang byung ye shes btsal du med pa la: rgyu 'bras gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: rtsol sgrub gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: rang byung rtsol med klong du bshags par bgyi: rig pa ye shes rtag chad med pa la: rtag chad gnyis su lta ba snying re rje: gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: rig pa ye shes klong du bshags par

bgyi: chos dbyings rnam dag mtha' dbus med nga/ la: phyogs ris gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: mtha' dbus gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: chos dbyings rnam dag mtha' dbus med par bshags: gzhal yas khang la phyi nang med pa la: phyi dang nang du lta ba thang re chad:yangs dog gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: yangs dog phyi nang med pa'i klong du bshags: yum gyi mkha' dbyings mtho dman med pa la: stong 'og gnyis su lta ba snying re rje: mtho dman gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: bha ga yangs dog med pa'i klong du bshags: chos kyi sku la dbye ba med pa la: yul dang sems su lta ba thang re chad: snod bcud gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: chos sku 'gyur med klong

༄ga /du bshags par bgyi: ci mdzad ci spyod yab kyi rol pa las: rnam rtog so sor lta ba thang re chad: ming gi log par 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: rol pa 'dzin rtog med pa'i klong du bshags: rig pa'i ye shes nang nas ma shar bas: ma rig rmongs pa'i blo 'di snying re rje:gzugs med chos la dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin: ye shes rang bzhin klong du mthol lo bshags: skye ba med pa'i don de ma chirtogs na: gang zag 'khrul ba'i blo 'di yongs re sdug: skye med chos la nga dang bdag tu bzung : bde chen skye med klong du mthol lo bshags: chos nyid don de blo la ma gsal bas: snang srid sgyu ma yin par ma shes te: zang zing nor la sems kyi chags pa skyes: chos nyid skye med chags pa

med par bshags: 'khor ba rang bzhin med par ma shes pas: dngos po mtshan ma'i chos la bdag tu 'dzin: mi dge'i las kyis bde ba 'tshol byed pa: byang chub skyon bral klong du mthol lo bshags: mnyam pa'i don nyid mnyam par ma rtogs pas: gnyen bshes 'khrul pa'i grogs la rtag par bzung : mi shes skye bo'i sems 'di yongs re gol: mnyam nyid bde chen klong du mthol lo bshags: chos nyid bden pa'i don dang ma 'phrad nas: bden pa'i don bor mi dge'i las la brtson: ston pa'i bka' bor mi chos g.yeng bas bslus: chos nyid bde che'o/ klong du mthol lo bshags: rig pa'i ye shes rang sar ma grol bas: rang rig don bor g.yeng ba'i las la brtson: 'di 'dra'i

mug /don med sems can snying re rje: dbye bsri med pa'i klong du bshags par bgyi: ye shes lha tshogs srung ma dam tshig can: dam tshig gzhung bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: ma rtogs lta ba'i gol sgrib byung ba na: rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: drug pa bde gshegs spyi bshags 'di skad do: o: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas: rdo rje dam can ma lus dgongs su gsol: dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin byang chub go 'phang du: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje sgrub pa'i phyir: yi dam lha dang rdo rje slob dpon dang : gsang ba'i dam tshig grangs su mnos pa las: dam bcas bka' las 'da' bar mi bgyid de: las dang skal bas

dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang : phrag dog la sogs shor nas nongs bgyis pa: rdo rje slob dpon bstan pa'i sgron me la: snying nas smad cing dar/ tshig nyams pa dang : dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje spun rnams la: ngan sems log par lta ba la sogs pa: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: yi dam lha yi phyag rgya ma gsal zhing : sngags kyi bsnyen pa grangs las chad pa dang / dus drug las kyi mchod pa'i khyad par du: bsnyen sgrub bskang ba'i cho ga ma bgyis te: bka' ltar ma lcogs gzhung bzhin rngo ma thogs: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: rdo rje slob dpon byams pa'i sku drin gyis: snyan khung brgyud nas sems kyi dkyil

༄ga /du bzhag: thugs kyi man ngag ster nas dam tshig smod: gsang tshig 'das nas 'chol bar smra la sogs: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: chos rnams mnyam pa nyid du ma rtogs te: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa ma/thol lo bshags: le lo snyoms las gnyid kyi dbang gyur te: bsnyen bsgrub dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: lus ngag yid kyi bsgrub bya 'das pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags: rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: yo byad 'byor tshogs chung ba mthol lo bshags: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du: ma/ngon rtogs spong len bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rnams kyi spyan lam du: khas blangs dam bca'

nyams pa mthol lo bshags: chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: gtor ma lo zlar 'gyangs pa mthol lo bshags: dus gsum pha ma/ rnams kyi spyan lam du: drin lan lan gyis ma lon mthol lo bshags: mched dang lcam dral rnams kyi spyan lam du: dam tshig brtse gdung chung ba mthol lo bshags: 'gro drug sems can rnams kyi spyan lam du: snying rje phan sems chung ba mthol lo bshags: so so thar pa rnams kyi sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa dang : rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig la/ sogs pa: 'gal zhing nyam/sa/ nga/ thams cad mthol lo bshags: mi 'chab mi sbed slan chad sdom nga/ra bgyi: dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib mthol bshags na: tshangs/

nonan /par mdzad nas sku gsung thugs la sogs: mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes solas yi nye brgya pa bzla'o: bskang bshags nyams chags rang grol cha rkyen du: zhi khro'i klong bshasas brjod pa rang grol bstan: 'di la brtson par gyis shig phyi rabs bu: ma 'ongs las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: zhi bro'i don gyi bshags pa klong bshagasa~Xdargya pargya /dī gros teXsargya ༵ ba/sa sbyi pyinag k+to /ji/ ༵ shā d+dhi dri rdotā pa/dri rdoX: dri med bshags pa'i rgyud nas bkol ba: ji srid 'khor ba'i 'jig rten ma stongs pa ra: de sri da dam pa 'i chos 'di ma rdzogs so: sa ma
sngag /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi las byung tshor ba rang grol snying po bzhugs so:

gag /zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ska la ldan blo dman don du ni: zhi khro 'dus pa 'i la sa byang bstan: 'di la le'u gsum yin te: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo: dang po sngon 'gro la yang gsum: bka' bsgo mtshams gcod byin brlab bo: dang po bshegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: lha: nga nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: phyogs bcu kun kyang zhi khro'i lha: rab tu gang nas 'od 'phros pas: lus ngag sems la gnod byed cing : mchod pa'i

sngag /mdangs 'phrog ma rig bgegs: nyon mongs ma rig rgyu las byung : 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: sbyi hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: gnyis pa mtshams gcod 'di skad doḥ sbyi: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : rgya gram 'khor lo me ri'i gur: rim pa drug gi tshul du bskor: khro tshogs sprul pa dpag med kyis: rab tu gtams shing mtshams bcad do: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma kurma tsakra dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: sngon 'gro rgyud sbyang niḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs:

nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcur 'khor gsu/ma dag pa'i chos: ma/ chags spyod 'a/ rjes yi rang : dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde bshegs byang chub sems dpa' la: dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: zhes pa lan gsum sogs brjod: gsum pa/ mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: lha: bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang nyid las: thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid: sman rag gtor mchod dngos po rnams: stong nyid bdag 'dzin bral ba las: ro yaṃ khaṃ gsum me rlung chus: bdag gzhan rtog pa'i dri ma sbyangs: me rlung chu yang 'od du zhu: sman rag gtor mchod dngos por

sngag /gyur: rtog gnyis dab/ nas snod bcud rnams: 'dod pa'i yon tan du mar gyur: o āḥ: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: i āḥlha ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrī:ṭha: o āḥtsū ma hā bha lidha hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: o āḥsbyi: badz+ra phusne 6spru ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wir+ya shabha āḥsbyi: sngon du 'gro ba'i le'u'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i le'u bstan: lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol cing : phyag mchod bstod bshags bdun gyis bstan: dang ngo bskyed pa'i rim pa ni: ༷snye: cesab/ brashāt+pa sgom med de bzhin nyid: kun khyab rang gsal kun tu snang : 'gag med rgyu yi āḥmathing gsal: stong gsal rang babs gdos bcas bra': a las e yo bam̐ lam̐ 'phros: nam mkha' rlung chu sa gzhi brdal: a las r+ghaṃ 'phros gzhal yas khang : zur bzhi logs bzhi sgo bzhir

ldan: stong pa'i dbyings su 'ja' ltar shar: phyi dang nang med zang thal gsal: yid 'ong mdzes ldan gzhal yas khang : rgyal ba zhi khro'i bzhugs gnas so: rdzu bi sha bi shudhe dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la rgyu: lha: bdag nyid tha mal rang sems 'di: rtog med skad cig dran rdzogs su:kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing : chos nyid bzang mo sku mdog dkar: mnyam bzhag skyil krung gnyis med 'khril: dal dbus pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs: :: dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar: seng ge glang chen rta mchog dang : rma bya shang shang khri steng du: longs sku rigs lnga yab yum gsal: lha: rnam/ snang dbyings phyug sku mdog dkar: 'khor lo dril 'dzin gnyis med 'khril: rang sna nga dkyil

sngag /'khor dbus phyogs su: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: rdu: rdor sems spyan ma sku ma/dos mthing : rdo rje dril 'dzin gnyis med 'khril: g.yas su sa snying myu gu dkar: g.yon du byams pa klu shing dkar: mdun du lā su me long dkar: rgyab tu phusne me tog dkar: rdo rje rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: snrudhi rin 'byung mā ki sku mdog ser: rin chen dril 'dzin gnyis med 'khril: g.yas su kun bzang snye ma ser: g.yon du nam snying ral gri ser: mdun du mā l+ya phreng 'dzin ser: rgyab tu juspru spo sa phor ser: rin chen rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bskom: lha: mtha' yas bos dkar sku mdos

dmar: pad+ma dril 'dzin gnyis med 'khril: g.yas su spyan gzigs pad 'dzin dmar: g.yon du 'jam dpal ral gri dmar: mdun du bīrti pi wang dmar: rgyab tu ā lo mar me dmar: pad+ma rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: lha: don grub sgrol ma sku mdog ljang : rgya gram dril 'dzin gnyis med 'khril: g.yas su sgrib sel po ti ljang : g.yon du phyag rdor rdor 'dzin ljang :mdun du gan+dhe dung phor ljang : rgyab tu nirti zhal zas ljang : las kyi rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: zhi ba'i lha tshogs de rnams kyang : longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chas rnams rdzogs: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: 'dzin med ma bcos rang

༄sha /gsal bsgom: lha: steng du brgya byin pi wang dkar: 'og tu chos rgyal me chu nag: shar wor thag bzang go mtshon ljang : lho nub shaka thub gseg shang ser: nub byang seng ge po ti mthing : byang shar kha 'bar sgrom bu dmar: 'gro don mdzad pa'i thub pa drug: bad rkyang steng na bzhengs stabs gas la: lha: shar sgor rnam rgyal lcags kyu dkar: lho sgor gshin rje zhags pa ser: nub sgor rta mgrin lcags sgrog dmar: byang sgor bdud rtsi dril bu ljang : tshad med bzhi ldan yab yum brgyad: khro bo'i tshul rdzogs 'dor stabs bzhugs: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ni: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgo ma: sbyi: dbus su bud+dha he ru ku: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas

dkar g.yon dmar dbus smug nag: 'khor lo dgra sta ral gri ga5/sa: dril bu thong gshol bhan+dha g.yon: burnya gro ti gnyis med 'khril:lha: shar du badz+ra he ru sa: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag: rdo rje bharnya dgra sta g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol g.yon: badz+ra kro ti gnyis med 'khril: lha: lho ru rat+na he ru ku: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dam/ra dbus ser nag: rin chen kha ṭ+wāṃ be con g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rtse gsum g.yon: rat+na gro ti gnyis med 'khril: bh+yo: nub tu pa d+ma te ru ga: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar nag: pad+ma

sngag /kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rnge'u chung g.yon: pad+ma kro ti gnyis med 'khril ཿ bhūḥ byang du kurma he ru la: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang nag: rgya gram ral gri kha ṭī g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol g.yon: karma gro ti gnyis med 'khril: khrag 'thung gtso bo yab yum bcu: khro bo'i cha lugs rdzogs par ldan: byol song gtso bo rin chen brag: pa d+ma nyi steng gsal bar bsgom: rdu: shar phyogs ko'u rī zhing dbyug dkar: lho phyogs tso'u rī mda' 'gengs ser: nub phyogs pra mo chu srin dmar: byang phyogs be tā bhan dmar ljang : shar lho puska rgyu 'dren ser: lho nub kusma bhan dmar ljang : nub byang tsan+dha rgyu za

ser: byang shar sme sha ro za mthing : zhing chen sadan la gar stabs 'gyings: ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgo ma: lha: de yi phyi rim phyogs mtshams brgyad: seng ha seng gdong ro za smug: sto kri stag gdong lag bsnol dmar: sri la wa gdong byis ldag nag: shā na spyang gdong ro thogs mthing : khri ta bya rgod rgyu 'dren ser: kang ka dur bya zhing phrag dmar: kha khā bya rog bhan gri nag: hu lu 'ug gdong lcags kyu mthing : zhing chen gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: ma yengs yid yu'/ gsal bar bsgom: lha: shar du rta gdong lcags kyu dkar: lho ru phag gdong zhags pa ser: nub tu seng gdong lcags sgrog dmar: byang du sbrul gdong dril bu ljang : tshad med bzhi ldan sgo ma bzhi: zhing

sngag /chen gdan la gsal bar bskyed: rdu: shar du zhi ba'i las mdzad bdun: srin mo g.yag gdong rdo rje smug: tshangs pa sprul gdong pad+ma ser: lha chen gzig gdong tri shul ljang : gtog 'dod sre gdong 'khor lo sngo: gzhon nu dred gdong mdung thung dam/ra: brgya byin dom mgo rgyu zhags dkar: zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: sbyi: lho ru rgyas pa'i las mdzad bdun: rdo rje pha wang sru gri ser: zhi ba chu srin bum pa dmar: bdud rtsi sdig gdong pad+ma dmar: zla ba khra mgo rdo rje dkar: be con wa gdong dbyug to ljang : srin mo stag gdong thong khrag nag: zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: ྈ: nub tu dbang gi las mdzad bdun: za ba bya rgod be con ljang :

dga' ba rta gdong khog chen dmar: stobs chen khyung gdong dbyug to dkar: srin mo khyi gdong rdo rje dmar: 'dod pa pu shud mda' 'gengs dmar: nor srung sha mgo bum pa ljang : zhing rkyang gdan la gar thabs bzhugs: lha: byang du drag po'i las mdzad bdun: rlung lha spyang gdong ba dan ljang : me mo skyin gdong gsal shing dmar: phag mo phag gdong mche zhags nag: rdo rje khwa gdong zhing chung dmar:sna chen glang chen bam chen ljang : chu lha sbrul gdong sbrul zhags ljang : zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: snruPROB PROBPROBPROB 'bor phyi rim sgo bzhi ru: shar du khu phyug lcags kyu dkar: lho ru ra gdong zhags pa ser: nub tu seng gdong lcags sgrog dmar: byang du sbrul gdong

sngag /dril bu ljang : zhing rkyang gdan la gar stabs bzhugs: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang : ma yengs yid yul gsal bar bsgom: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya yiḥ bsgo ma khog 'dus pa'i sgron me'oḥ sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gnyis pa lha tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni: :: dpe med bas/ma brjod bral ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: bla ma rin chen kun bzang chos kyi sku: longs spyod rdzogs sku bcom ldan rigs lnga yab: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum mchog lnga dang sbyor: sku gsum yon tan gsal la 'gag pa med: 'gro don yid snang dag pa'i gnas mchog 'dir: kun bzang rigs lnga yab yum gtso 'khor rnams: rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol:

rgyu: tshogs brgyad gnas dag byang chub sems dpa' brgyad: yul brgyad gnas dag byang chub sems ma brgyad: 'gro don rdzogs mdzad sprul sku thub pa drug: phrin las 'gro don sgo ba yab yum brgyad: zhi ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gshegs su gsol: lha: sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal: bcom ldan dpal chen rigs lnga he ru ga: gnyis med yum chen kro ti lnga dang 'khril: dug lnga 'joms phyir khrag 'thung sprul 'khor bcas: 'gro don yid snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir byon: :: ko'u rī la sogs gnas bdag ma mo brgyad: seng ha la sogs yul bdag phra men brgyad: rta

jug /gdong la sogs ye shes sgo ma bzhi: dkyil 'khor mu ran dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: bka' srung gter bdag dam can chos skyong tshogs: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs rnams: 'gro don yid snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir byon: rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gsum pa lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol ba ni: lha: sgyu ma gzugs brnyan chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : stobs ldan rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: chos sku kun bzang sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las lnga yi rig rtsal cho 'phrul las:bcom ldan dpal chen rigs lnga yab yum bcu: sems dpa' sems ma yab yum bcu drug bcas: rang snang dag pa'i gnas 'dir

bzhugs su sa/sol: sbyi: rnam thar brgyad ldan sgo ba yab yum brgyad: rigs drug dong sprugs bcom ldan thub pa drug: zhi ba'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas bzhi bcu gnyis: rang snang gnas yul dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du: phyogs mtshams rang rang bzhugs pa'i gdan khri la: gnyis med rang bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol: rdu: zhi ba longs sku'i rig rtsal cho 'phrul la sa: dug lnga 'joms pa'i lha tshogs dpag med 'phros: bcom ldan khrag 'thung rigs lnga he ru na: shes rab dbyings phyug gro ti lnga dang sbyor: yab yum sras dang bka' sdod sprul 'khor bcas: rang snang dag pa'i sa/nas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: lha: ko'u rī la sogs gnas bdag ma mo brgyad: seng ha la sogs yul

༄sha /bdag phra men brgyad: tshad med bzhi ldan ye shes sgo ma bzhi: sprul pa'i las mdzad dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: khrag 'thung lha tshos/sa 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad: du ma ro gcig brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bzhi pa gus pas phyag 'tshal ba ni: lha: yid chos gnas dag kun bzang yab yum la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: ྈ: phung lnga gnas dag ye shes lnga dang ldan: longs sku rigs lnga'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: r+sha: 'byung lnga gnas dag bde chen ye shes ngang : dbyings kyi yum chen lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: :: tshogs brgyad gnas dag sems dpa' chen po brgyad: yul brgyad gnas dag sems ma chen mo brgyad: nye ba'i sras mchog byang sems bcu drug la:

rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal loḥ bhūḥ rigs drug dong spugs spul sku thub pa drug: tshad med bzhi ldan sgo ba yab yum brgyad:zhi ba'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyas/ 'tshal lo: lhu: dug lnga 'dzoms mdzad khrag 'thung khro bo lnga:dbyings kyi yum chen gro ti lnga dang sbyor: khrag 'thung khro bo yab yum bcu rnams la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: lhu:ko'u rī la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad: seng ha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad: rta gdong la sogs ye shes sgo ma bzhi: bka' yi las byed dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: khras/ 'thung lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la: rang snang gnas yul dag pas phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: lnga pa phyi nang

༄sna /gsang mchod ni: dang po phyi'i mchod nga 'di ska da doḥ lha: bla ma kun bzang rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: dpag med nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs la:dag pa rnam gsum yid kyis mchod pa'i sprin: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: snang stong rig stong gas la stong bde stong dang :dran stong grags sto nga tshor stong mchod pa'i tshogs: me tog bdug spos dri zhal rol mor bcas: bla ma zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul:thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: gnyis pa nang rmi chod 'bul ba niḥ bhūḥ bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs: rgya/la ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: lha rdzas nang mchod 'bul ba ni: snod bcud snang srid thams cad kun: rdo rje gzugs sgra dri ro reg: rdo rje chos ma'i tshogs sprul

nas: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: gus pa'i sems kyis 'bul lags na: 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: gsum pa gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: lha: snang ba yab la stong ba yum: gsal ba yab la 'od zer yum: bde ba yab la stong pa yum: sgra grags yab la grags stong yum: dran pa yab la rig stong yum: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bde: rig ma dkar ser dmar ljang mthing : bde ba ye shes kun ldan du: bde ba'i ro snyoms mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon dgyes phyir bzhes: sman rag gtor gsum/ 'bul ba la: dang ngo sman mchod 'bul ba niḥ lha: rigs lnga yab yum gnyis kyi rgyu byas te: sku lnga ye shes lnga yi rkyen byas nas: thabs shes rgyu la ma/

sngag /'gags rkyen sbyar ba'i: dam pa rigs brgya'i 'bru bcud bdud rtsi 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: thugs rje'i brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: khā hi ni: rgyal kun spyi myes kun bzang rdo rje 'chang : rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab shrī seng : o rgyan yab yum rje 'bangs lo paṇa dang : karma gling pa'i zhal du o āḥlha: nyi zla chos rje nyi zla 'od zer mtshan: nam ma/kha'i mtshan so/gas bka' babs brgyud ldan gyi: rtsa brgyud bla ma skyabs/ mchog kun 'dus dngos: drin chen bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha: 'khor 'das dmigs med sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sprin: zhi ba rdor dbyings 'bar ba khrag 'thung dang : dag pa rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro

chos skyong bcas: mchod par 'os rnams zhal du oṃ āḥlha: gnyis pa rak+ta 'bul ba ni: lha: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru bsgral ba'i khrag: ma chags chags bral chags pa chen po'i khrag: gnyis med 'dzin bral gsang ba'i khrag chen 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hiḥ gsum pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni: sbyi: phyi snod 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: nang bcud sems can gtor mar bshams: rtsi bcud 'bras bu sma na gyis brgyan: zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: ma hā ba lo ta la kha raṃ khā hi: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgyaḥ drug pa bstod pa bya ba ni: :: sku ni mi 'gyur ka dag zang thal sku: gsung ni mi 'gags rang byung ye shes gsung : thugs ni mi g.yo bsam brjod bral ba'i thugs: kun bzang skye

༄sha /'gags med la phyag 'tshal bstod: sbyi: chos sku nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa la: longs sku nyi 'od lnga bur so sor 'phro: sprul sku 'ja' tshon lta bur 'gro don mdzad: rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha: gsal mtsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od zer 'phro:mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul zhi ba'i tshogs: mtshan dang dpe byed rgyan rnams mdzes tshul ldan: zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha: sgog pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang ci rgod dang gshe dang rngam par ston pa dang : snying rje ngo mtshar che tshul gar dgur ldan: khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: lhu: thal chen rak+ta zhag gi zo ris dang : ko rlon g.yang gzhi stag gi sham thabs

dang : thod phreng sbrul chun me dpung chas dgus brgyan: dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha: rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung ba'i las la brtson: rnal 'byor kun gyi dam tshig rjes gcod cing : bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad pa'i: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdun pa bshags pa bya ba ni: rtsa: bla ma kun bzang mtha' bral chos kyi sku: nyag gcig zang thal skye med longs spyod rdzogs: shar grol 'gag med sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku: rgyal ba zhi khro sprul 'khor dgongs su gsol: bdag dang 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyis: gti mug 'khrul sems dpag med blangs pa nas: da lta tshe 'di'i lus blangs yan chad du: rig dang ma rig

༄sha /'khrul pa'i las dbang gis: sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig chags nyams nor 'khrul gyur pa kun: mi gsang mi sbed gnong 'gyod mthol lo bshags: klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par gsol: o badz+ra satwa sogs: phrin las dngos gzhi'i le'u gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum nga rjes kyi le'u bdun gyis bstan: tshogs las bskul dang chad mdo gtor skyong dang : gtor bro bkra shis smon la ma bdun yin no: dang po tshogs 'khor bshams la 'di ska da doḥ bhūḥnyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: tshogs la bar chad byed nga 'i bgegs: lan chags gnas 'dir ma 'dug par: so sor rang rang gnas su dengs: sbyi hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: gnyis pa bsang sbyangs byin rlabs ni: sbyi: bdag nyid rdor sems thugs ka nas: o dkar āḥdamar hūm̐

mthing 'phros: zhal zas dngos po thams cad kun: i āḥtsū gsum ngo bor gyur: 'bru gsum me chu rlung gsum 'phros: tshogs kyi rnam rtog bsregs gtor bkrus: me chu rlung gsum 'od du zhu: sku gsung thugs kyi bdud phyir gyur: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams: dgyes mchod bdud rtsi chen por gsal: i āḥbhū hrīḥha ho: gsum pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: sbyi: ma bcos chos dbyings zhing khams nas: bla ma kun bzang yab yum dang : rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs kyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: de nas tshogs phud sasu ma bcad laḥ dang ngo mchod pa 'di skad doḥ lha: bla ma kun bzang thig le'i sku : nyag gcig zang thal longs spyod rdzogs: cir mi dgongs pa sprul pa'i sku: rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhi

༄dzo /khro'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprul 'khor bcas: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: drug pa zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: lha: bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dang : mkha' 'gro dam can ma ning nag po dang : e ka tsa ti dpal 'bar srog bdag dang : khyab mjug gnod sbyin dam can thig le rtsal: brtan ma bcu gnyis dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang : yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di 'bul bas: dgyes par dgongs la dngos grub stsal du gsol: ma hā gha na tsakra pū tsa la khā hi: bar pa bshags shing 'bul ba ni: lha: bdag cag 'khor ba'i sems gzhi blangs pa nas: da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa yan chad du: rig dang ma rig bag chags dbang

gyur pas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnams: zhal zas tshogs 'bul bskang zhing bshags par bgyi: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs par stsal du gso la: o badz+ra satwa ā: bdun pa bshags pa bya ba ni: lha: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dgongs : bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin gyis: nyon mongs dbang gyur sku gsung thugs la sogs: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun: gnong 'gyod drag ngo sa mthol bshags bzod par bzhes: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes pa dang yi ge brgya pa bzla bar bya'oḥ skabs 'dir zhi kro'i mdangs bska nga la sogs dang : lta ba'i klong btsogs la sogs ci rigs byaḥ tha ma tshogs phud bsgra la zhing bstab pa niḥ lha: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : thabs kyi cho 'phrul rgyal

༄ga /ba zhi khro'i tshogs: khrag 'thung rngam brjid 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs la: nyon mongs ma rig dug lnga phung po lnga: bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus pa: myur du khug la bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: gnyis pa phung ngo zhal du bstab pa ni: rgyu: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro sprul 'khor bcas: mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma zhal phyes shig: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: ye shes lnga ldan mi 'gyur zhal du bstabs: rnam rtog bag chags chos nyid klong du rol: bstab po bzhes shig rol zhig kha raṃ khā hi: o āḥsbyi: sbyi hūm̐ sbyi: phaṭaḥphaṭa:phaṭaḥlhag ma bsngo ba niḥ i āḥbh+yo: lhag la dbang ba dregs pa'i tshogs: sprin ltar gtibs cing hab sha rgyug: sha khrag brgyan pa'i tshogs lhag bzhes:

sngon gyi dam bca' ji bzhin du: bstan dgra dam nyams zas su zo: rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston: sgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog pa dang : phrin las thogs med 'grub par mdzod: u tsis bha ling ta khā hi: gnyis pa srung ma las la bskul ba ni: lha bh+yo: bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas su: mkha' 'gro chos skyong bka' srung rnams: la las bstan pa'i gzhi 'dzin mdzad: la las bka' yi bya ra mdzad: la las chos mdzad srung ma mdzad: 'a/ las gtsug lag dkor khang bsrung : la las yul dgon dben gnas bsrung : la las dam tshig las rjes gcod: la las sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzad: la la stong gsum khyab par rgyug: la la bsam bstan ngang la gnas: la las skye 'gro'i bla tshe chu: la la

tshog /srog gcod srin po'i rigs: la la gtsang sgra bram ze'i rigs: la la rims dang nad kyi bdag: la la ltas ngan cho 'phrul bdag:sprul pa yang sprul bsam mi khyab: 'khor dang las byed bye ba 'bum: kun kyang zhi khro'i cho 'phrul te: rig rtsal rol pa thogs med 'phro:bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces pas bskul zhing phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsum pa bka' yi chad mdo ni: lha sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: bcom ldan khrag 'thung che mchog he ru gas: dregs pa rū tra'i sde dpung btul ba'i tshe: ka'u rī phra men dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang : srung ma dam can rgya mtsho thams cad kyis: ci ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du: gtor ma 'di bzhes bdag gi sdong grogs

mdzod: rdu: sngon tshe khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar: chad tho'i dam can srung ma thams cad kun: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: da lta rnal 'byor bdag gi sdong grogs mdzod: bzhi pa gtor skyong bya ba ni: lha bh+yo: shar gyi dbang phyug ma bdun gtor ma longs: nyon mongs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: lha bh+yo: lho yi dbang phyug ma bdun gtor rme/ longs: bsod nams ye shes rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: lha bh+yo: nub kyi dbang phyus ma bdun gtor ma longs: 'khor 'das dbang du sdud pa'i phrin las mdzod: rgyu bh+yo: byang gi dbang phyug ma bdun gtor ma 'o ngas: ma rig sdig sgrib tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: sbyi bh+yoḥ slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i: bod

༄ga /khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis dang : bran g.yog 'khor bcas bka' yi gtor ma longs: mi mthun bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol: nyams rtogs bsod nams 'phel ba'i sdong grogs mdzod: bcol ba'i phrin las khyod kyis 'grub par mdzod: lnga pa gtor bro brdung ba 'di skad do: lha: phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i phyogs bcu nas: dug lnga 'joms pa'i ye shes lnga ldan gsal: gsal 'tsher sgyu ma'i lha dang lha mos bskor: phyogs bcu bde gshegs ris/sa kyi bro brdungs pas: dug lnga'i mgo la ye shes chems se chem: bro yang ye shes lnga yi snang stong gro: gru yang ye shes lnga yi grags stong glu: ye shes lnga yi glu blangs bro bsdungs pas: rnam rtog mtshan ma'i dgra bgegs rang sar

grol: ma rig nyon mongs ka dag dbyings su gnon: i āḥlha stam+bha ya nan: drug pa bkra shis brjod pa niḥ i chos sku'i bkra shis stong zhing bdag med shog: āḥlongs sku'i bkra shes gsal pa 'dzin med shog: sbyi sprul sku'i bkra shis thugs rje'i rgyun 'byung shog: gzhi yi bkra shis rang rgyud dul bar shog: lam gyi bkra shis gzhan rgyud sbyong bar shog: 'bras bu'i bkra shis gzhi thog smin par shog: ces brjod dbyangs bcas me tog 'thoraḥ bdun pa bsngo ba smon lam ni: na mo 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i dge ba 'dis: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa: sku gsum 'bras bu myur du thob par shog: 'gro ba sems can yongs kyi dpal du shog: lha tshogs gshegs su gsol ba ni: o khyed kyis sems can don kun

༄ga /mdzad: rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol: sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang : slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: badz+ra mu: rjes su rdzogs rim bsgo ma pa niḥ gzugs snang thams cad zhi khro'i lha tshogs gsal: lha tshogs nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar: snang stong gnyis med mtha' bral ngang la bzhag: sgra grags thams cad zhi khro'i lha tshogs gsung : grags stong nam mkha'i 'brug sgra yal ba ltar:grags stong brjod med ngang la mnyam par bzhag: dran bsam thams cad zhi khro'i thugs su shar: shar grol klong thim mkha' la sprin dengs ltar: thugs dgongs ma bcos skye/ med ngang la zhag: a a a: zhi khro rigs brgya 'dus pa'i las byang tshor ba rang grol snying po zhis bya ba rdzogs soḥ sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: grub
thob kurma gling pa'i gter ma'o: skad cig stong gsal chen po'i ngang nyid sogs/
sngag /nyams chags sdig sgrib thams cad baphags pa'i rgyal po na raka dong sprugs bzhugs so:

༄ga /rnal 'byor pas bla ma bde gshegs zhi khro yongs rdzogs rnams: mdun gyi nam mkhar nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la: dbang ngo 'i mngon sum dang 'dra bar zhal lam mer bzhugs par bsam pa'i mdun du lus rdul snyed du sprul te: ngag bshags tshig yid gnong sems dang bcas te dus thams cad du bshags pa/ra bya'o:rjes lta bas kyang gsal gdab cing : dam tshig la bsgrim pa ni dngos grub myur ro: e ma ho: phyogs bcu dus bzhi kun gyi bdas nyid che: bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs dgongs: 'dir gshegs nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs:

༄sha /nyams chags na rag sbyang phyir phyag mchod bzhes: yon tan phun tshogs bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: dmigs med spros bral chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gro mgon cir yang sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: gnas lugs mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: yang dag mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo: nyon mongs zhi mdzad zhi ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: log lta tshar gcod khro bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: thabs mgon tshe bdag 'jam dpal sku la phyag 'tshal loḥ skyon bral sgra sgrogs pad+ma gsung la phyag 'tshal lo: yang dag don ldan badz+ra thugs la phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga nad sel bdud rtsi sman la phyag 'tshal lo: dregs

pa 'joms mdzad phur pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'byung ba lnga bdag ma mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: sa dang lam rdzogs rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: bstan pa srung mdzad dam can rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad sngags bdag tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: rdu: rang rig rang shes 'khrul pa bral: mnyam nyid ngang las ye shes shar: kun tu bzang po yab yum la: yid chos dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: mi rtog dbyer med dgongs pa la: ye shes lnga yi 'od mdangs gsal: rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa la: nyon mongs dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: dbyings kyi ngang las bskyed pa'i rgyu: ye shes lnga yi grogs shar ba: dbyings kyi yum chen lnga rnams la: 'byung ba dag phyir

༄lha /phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes sprul pa mang po'i tshogs: 'gro ba'i don du rang shar ba'i: byang chub sems dpa' brgyad rnams la: rnam shes dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes ngang las yon tan rdzogs: ci 'dod dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad rnams la: yul dus dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: gdug pa 'dul mdzad dpa' bo'i sku: bdag tu 'dzin pa'i skyon dang bral: ta kṛta sgo ba bzhi rnams la: log lta dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang : btang snyoms bzhi yis 'gro don mdzad: sgo skyong khro mo bzhi rnams la: rtag chad dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: rtog pa drug las 'khor ba drug: ma rig dbang gis byung ba rnams: thugs rjes 'dul

mdzad thub drug la: 'khrul pa dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: sbyi: kun tu bzang po rig pa'i rtsalnga: che mchog gtso la phyag 'tshal lo: dug lnga ma spangs mthar phyin pa'i: he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: dbyings las skur bzhengs thabs shes sbyor: khro mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs las sprul pa'i gsang chen mo: khro mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: za byed mche gshog pho nya mo: phra men brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gugs 'dren 'chings sdom dgyes mdzad ma: sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo: 'jig rten cha lugs sprul pa mo: dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo: lha: ya mān+ta ka gshin rje'i gshed: rngams brjid dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: 'jam dpal sku la phyag 'tshalari lo: :: rta mgrin rgyal po dbang

༄sha /gi lha: dbang drag thabs kyi 'khor gyis bskor: pad+ma gsung la phyag 'tshal lo: lha: dpal chen badz+ra he ru ra: rang snang gsal ba'i 'khor gyis bskor: yang dag thugs la phyag 'tshalalo: sbyi: bcom ldan che mchog he ru ku: zhi khro rab 'byams lha yis bskor: yon tan rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo: lha: rdo rje gzhon nu phrin las sku: khro bcu 'bar ba'i 'khor gyis bskor: phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo:sbri: mngon rdzogs rgyal po he ru yi: 'byung ba lnga las grub pa'i 'khor: ma mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: lha: rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal: sa dang lam la gnas pa'i 'khor: rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: rdu: gsang ba'i bdag po gos sngon can: 'jig rten

dregs pa rnams kyis bskor: bstan pa skyong la phyag 'tshal lo: sbyi: stobs ldan nag po mthu rtsal can: drag sngags bdag po mang pos bskor: dgra bgegs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo: de ltar rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: gang gis mtshan thos phyag 'tshal na: dam tshig nyams chags kun byang nas: mtshams med lnga yi sdig pa dag: na rag nas kyang dong sprugs te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags: las kyi rnam par smin pa'i skyon: ngag tu mthol la yid kyis bshags: smri sngags bton la gdung bas sbyangs: mos pas thal mo snying gar sbyar: dad pas brkyang phyag brdabs te btsal: zhi khro'i lha tshogs mtshan nas brjod: rjes su lus lnga tshugs bcas te: rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor

༄yin /bsgoms: na rag dong sprugs snying po bzla: i badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: sogasaḥ āḥ 'di dag dag par dus gcig laḥm yengs brgya rtsa brgyad brjod naḥdus sasum rgyal ba'i sras su skyeḥ hoḥ zhi khro rab 'byams dgongs su gsol: rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i lung : ji bzhin ma spyad 'gal zhing 'khrul: rdo rje slob dpon drin can la: gshe skur btab dang lta ba log: gzung ma mched dang lcam dral la: ngan sems tshig rtsub chags snang byas:brdeg btsog gnod pa dngos su shor: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa rnams: zhi khro'i lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags: yi dam lha dang 'khor ma gsal: 'dzab dang bzlas brjod ma dag chags: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa rnams: rigs lnga zhi khro'i spyan sngar bshags: gsang bcu'i

gnyer gtad dam bcas pa: kun la bsgrags shing dam rdzas bstan: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa rnams: rgyal ba zhi khro'i spyan sngar bshags: shes par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga: rigs lngar ma shes log par bltas: mi spang ba yi dam tshig lnga: ma rig dbang gis dug lngar gol: dang du blang ba'i dam tshig lnga: gtsang rmer bltas dang bag med spyad: sgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga: rang la gnas par ma shes log: spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig lnga: dbye gsal ma shes log par spyad: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa rnams: yi dam lha yi spyan sngar bshags: bsnyen pa sgrub pa'i ting 'dzin g.yel: nya stong dus drug mchod pa chags: le lo g.yeng ba gnyid kyis rmugs: bsog 'jog ser

༄gi /snas rgyu rkyen chung : tshogs kyi spyang khu kha tshar shor: phud nyams lhag ma phri ba dang : bag med spyod pa rtsings pa yis: tshor dang ma tshor nyams pa'i skyon: mkha' 'gro dam can spyan sngar bshags: yid kyi dam nyams lta bas bshags: de yang kun gzhi byang chub sems:yin pa med pa'i lta ba rtogs: min pa med pa'i sgom nyams lon: yin min med pa'i spyod pa rtogs: re dogs med pa'i byang chub sems:rtsa ba yan lag thams cad kyi: chags nyams ma byung ma skyes pa: bshags bya bshags byed gnyis med grol: lha: chos kyi dbyings nyid spros pa med pa la: yod med gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: spros med bde chen klong du bshags

par bgyi: kun tu bzang po bzang ngan med pa la: gtsang dang rme bar lta ba thang re chad: bzang ngan gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs:kun bzang bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi: mnyam pa nyid la che chung med pa la: bdag dang gzhan du lta ba thang re chad: che chung gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: mnyam nyid bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi: byang chub sems la skye shi med pa la: 'di dang phyi mar lta ba thang re chad: skye shi gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: 'chi med g.yung drung klong du bshags par bgyi: thig le chen por grwa zur med pa la: gzugs dang rdzas su lta ba thang re chad: ga zur dbyibs su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: kun nas zlum po thig le'i klong du bshags:

sngag /dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: thog ma tha mar lta ba thang re chad: 'pho 'gyur gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs:dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i klong du bshags: rang byung ye shes rtsol bsgrub bral ba la: rgyu 'bras gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: rtsol bsgrub gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: rang byung rtsol med klong du bshags par bgyi: rig pa ye shes rtag chad bral ba la: gzung 'dzin gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: rtag chad gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: rig pa ye shes klong du bshags par bgyi: chos nyid rnam dag spros pa med pa la: zug rngu gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: mtha' dbus gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: chos nyid rnam dag klong du

bshags par bgyi: gzhal yas khang la yangs dog med pa la: phyi dang nang du lta ba thang re chad: yangs dog gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: gzhal yas yangs dog med pa'i klong du bshags: yum gyi mkha' la mtho dman med pa la: steng dang 'og tu lta ba thang re chad:mtho dman gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: bha sa yangs dog med pa'i klong du bshags: chos kyi sku la gnyis su med pa la: phyi dang nang du lta ba thang re chang: snod ba cud gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i klong du bshags: ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can snying re rje: gzugs med chos la dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin: gang zag 'khrul pa'i sems ni yongs re gol: skye med chos la nga

༄ga /dang bdag tu rtog: snang srid sgyu ma yin par ma shes te: zang zing nor la sems kyi chags pa skyes: 'khor ba rang bzhin med par ma shes pas: gnyen bshes 'khrul pa'i grogs la rtag par 'dzin: mi shes skye bo'i blo 'di yongs re gol: bden pa'i don bor mi dge'i las la brtson: ston pa'i bka' bor mi chos g.yeng bas bslus: rang rig don med g.yeng ba'i las la brtson: 'di 'dra'i don med sems can snying re rje: dbye bsri med pa'i klong du bshags par bgyi'o: ces lta ba'i bshags pa dang : tshogs dang bsgrub pa'i dus skabs su: sman dang rak+ta gtor ma dang : mar me gsal ba'i mdangs kyis bskang : dang po bdud rtsi'i ka pā la: thogs nas 'bul ba'i stabs kyis btegs: 'di skad brjod la bskang mchod 'bul: lhu: ma bcos rang byung chen po'i

rdzas: gdod nas dag pas gtsang rme bral: rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong : rigs lnga rgyal ba sgrub pa'i rdzas: dam tshig skong ba'i sman chen 'dis: 'og min brdal khyab chen po na: rang bzhin bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams: ye shes lnga yi 'od kyis bskang : kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyis bskang : thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang : thugs rje'i sprul pas rigs drug sgrol: thog ma'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur:kun tu bzang po'i thugs dam bskang : rang las ye shes shar ba'i sku: zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs bskang : thugs rje'i sprul pas 'gro don mdzad: rdo rje 'chang nas rim par byon: 'gro ba 'dren pa thams cad kyi: sku dang zhing khams mchod pas bskang : thugs kyi dgongs

༄shi /pa rdzogs gyur cig: dam tshig nyams chags bshags par bgyi: nge nas rak+ta thogs la: sbyi: chos nyid rlan gyi ye shes chu: thugs rje chags pa'i kha dog dmar: srid nga bskyed pa rgyu yi khrag: pad+ma rak+ta rang byung khrag: zhing bcu bsgral ba srog gi khrag: rtsi bcud dmar po 'byung ba'i khrag: thams cad das/ pa dbang gi rdzas: ma dag khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu: he ru ka yi dgongs pa yis: srid gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags bsgral: mchod pa'i rdzas su byin rlabs te: yum chen kun tu bzang mo la: ye shes 'char ba'i don phyir 'bul: khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs rnams la: thugs rje bsku la ba'i mchod par 'bul: ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad la: dam tshig gso ba'i rdzas su 'bul: chos

skyong bka' srung thams cad la: phrin las mdzad pa'i don phyir 'bul: dam tshig bskang las dngos grub stsol: de nas tshogs dang gtor ma thogs:lha la 'bul zhing 'di skad wāPROB PROBPROB PROBPROBPROB gsum gso ba zas kyi rgyu: 'bru dang shing tog ro drug zas: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i phung po'i sha: dza gad dpal bo 'bru yi bcud: zhal zas 'dod yon sna tshogs su: mos pas bsam te mchod par 'bul: chos kyi dbyings su mos pas 'bul: zhi ba'i lha la mdzes par 'bul: khro bo'i lha la brjid par 'bul: bla ma rnams la mnyes par 'bul: mkha' 'gro rnams la dgyes par 'bul:bka' srung rnams la tshim par 'bul: dam tshig skong ba'i rten du 'bul: de nas ma ra me'i kong bu thogs laḥ zhi: rdzas kyi kong bu brgya rtsa ru: gtsang

༄pha /ma'i sdong bu brgya rtsa btsugs: 'byung ba'i bcud mar zhun gyis bskang : gsal ba'i mar me brgya sbar nas: dam tshig nyams chags bskang ba'i phyir: mos pas rgyal ba rnams la 'bul: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas : ye shes 'od lnga dkrag dang ldan: zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang : snying kha chos kyi pho brang na: ye shes sa bon thig le gsal: rang byung zhi ba'i thugs dam bskang ཿ klad pa dung khang pho brang na: rang rtsal drod kyi 'od zer 'bar: rang byung khro bo'i thugs dam bskang : mos gus dad pa'i snang ba la: rig pa rang byung 'gags med gsal: rdo rje slob dpon thugs dam bskang : rtsa rlung thig le dwangs pa la: shes pa rang byung sa ler gnas: ma mo mkha'

'gro'i thugs dam bskang : 'jig rten srid pa yangs pa la: gza' skar 'od kyi thig le gsal: phyi yi dam can thugs dam bskang : dam tshig nyams chags thams cad kun: thugs dam dbang gis dag par mdzod: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rtsol: bskang ba bsdus pa ni:lha: bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bla ma yi dam lha tshogs yongs rdzogs la: rang byung chos kyi dbyings kyi kong bu ru:rig pa'i ye shes mar me gtams te 'bul: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a mṛ ta: sku lnga ye shes yongs rdzogs ma chod par 'bul: gtor gzhong rnam dag dpal gyi gtor mas gtams: 'dod yon yongs su rdzogs pa'i mchod par 'bul: khams gsum 'khor ba yongs sgrol

sngag /mkha' dbyings dag: chags med rak+ta dmar gyi gnyes mchod 'bul: 'bru bcud stong la sbyar ba dpa' bo'i rdzas: gzi byin bskyed phyir dza gad mchod par 'bul: a la la te dgyes par bzhes su gsol: ces gsungs mchod sko nga bsdus pa 'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: na rag bshags sko nga zhi khro gsang ba yongs rdzogs rang shar gnyis las bstan nga phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te bsre slad tshig gcig tsam yang med par lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas pad+ma'i ming can gyi dge gnas su bris pa'o: lag len rgyug byang ni:zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor dang zhi gtor drag gtor sman rag mar me sogs mchod bshams rgyas pa ra bka' brgyad nas bshad pa ltar bya: cho ga gang rung gzhan la brten nas dkyil 'khor sman rag gtor ma rnams rang gzhung de nyid sor bzhag gi steng du mar me brgya rtsa sogs bsham mo: zhi khro'i las byang gzhung bsrang 'dzab bzlas mchod bstod dbang yid len rnams tshar ba'i rjes su bshags skong rnams tshar mang 'don zhing rere lta ra mchod kha gso bran byin gyis brlabs cho ga gzhan la sbyar ba yin na skabs der dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rten brten pa dang bcas pa thams cad ska da cig bis 'og zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhi ba zhe gnyis kyi lha tshogs dang : steng khro dkyil gyi dbus su che mchog la rigs lnga khrag 'thung gis bskor ba: de phyir sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha tshogs: de phyir rim bzhin kau'u rī seng ha sgo ma dbang mo rnams kyis bskor ba'i rnam par

gnas 'gyur ba'i stong 'og bar mtshams rnamang smu su bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sangs rgyas byang sems sogs skyabs gyur ma lus pas bsko ra nas bzhugs par bsams la: ye shes pa spyan drangasapa dang dbyeramed du bzhugs pa'i drung du rang gzhan sems can rnams kyi lus rdul snyed du sprul te phyag 'tshal : yig brgya bshags pa klong bshags skong bzhi bcas 'don zhing grangs bso ga pa sogs byed: de rjes dkyil 'khoragang yin gyi bdag mdun gyi mdun du sngar ltar gsal ba'i ngang nas tshogs bska nga sogs rang gzhung ltar byed pa'o: cho ga dang ma 'brel bar chos spyod rgyan 'don la phyag yig brgya bshags pa klong bshags rnamasa'adon zhing bskang ba rnams bzhag go: ru zung bzhi'i bathags pa la ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba snang yang : 'dir lu sa kyi phyag rgya ngag bi yig brgya: yid rū klong bshags sgo sasu ma tha mi dad kyis dam tshig gso phyirardzogs pa chen po'i lta ba dang bzhi bshags pa ru bzhi dang : de la kha bskang sma na gtor rak+ta mar me'i bsko nga bzhi dang bcas ru zung bzhir nges pa'o: bskang ba 'di la mi 'dra ba rgyas bsdus mang du snang yang :/sbyi sdu/sa hā rdo rdi /ṅga //ra rak+ta mar me'i bskong ba'i ngo 'dis khongs su thams cad kyi ngo bo tshang bar 'dug pa sa nges par mdzod: dbe+e legs dpal 'byor bkra shis nub med nyid du 'bel gyur cig: o su pra tiṣ+ṭha

khogi/gsum pa smon lam gdab pa ni:rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du rig ma rnams rgyan gyis spras shing thod chang thogs:mched lcam rnams kyis lag du mar me dang spos kyi rengs bu thogs te:yid gnyis the tshom med par rdo rje rgyal po yab yum rnams:'phags pa ma rig mun sel mngon sum du bsgom zhing :mos gus kyi gdung shugs bskyed de: dbyangs snyan pos 'di skad do: lha: dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bzhugs pa'i gnas: ma rig mun sel 'phags pa'i lha tshogs dang : ston pa rdo rje rgyal po yab yum rnams: mched dang lcam dral 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma lus thams cad bdag la brtser dgongs nas: byang chub mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs te: bdag gi smon lam 'grub pa'i dpang por mdzod: rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i dpal: rgyal ba'i yum mchog rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum: thugs sprul rgyal sras byang sems bstan pa'i btsas: mched lcam dam tshig gcig pa'i rig 'dzin tshogs: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar: mi 'bral

spyi gtsug rgyan du 'grogs par shog: bdag gis dus gsum kun du sgo gsum yul: tha na rmi lam gnyid du 'breng ba'i tshe: bla ma yab yum mched lcam mthong bar shog: sku gsung thugs kyi dgyes pa kun 'grub cing : dad gus gdung ba'i sri zhus bsten par shog: tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par gyur pa'i tshe: 'chi ba dang po 'od gsal chos kyi sku: ngo shes rtsal rdzogs bstan pa thob nas kyang : chos sku 'od dpag med dang dbyer med par: ka dag chos sku'i dbyings su grol bar shog: rang rig chos sku rang rtsal ma rdzogs nas: bar do'i snang shes rang snang lha shar na: rang sems dag pa'i rtsal du ngo 'phrod de: sgra 'od zer gsum mdangs ldan rang sgrar bcas: lnga ldan longs sku'i zhing du grol bar shog:

༄sha /de ltar rang rig tshad la ma phebs nas: srid pa bar do'i 'khrul pas g.yengs gyur na: rdo rje rgyal po yab yum rjes dran te: snang gsal mar me 'di yis rgyud brtan nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor te: mkha' spyod dag pa'i gnas su grol bar shog:las kyi dbang gis/ rigs drug yul mthong zhing : bag chags dbang gis 'khor ba 'dir 'khyams kyang : bskyed rdzogs zab mo 'di yis 'tshams sbyar nas: dal 'byor bco brgyad ldan pa'i lus thob ste: dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel dang : mar me gcig la bltas pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: mi 'bral tshom bu gcig tu 'tshogs par shog: de tshe 'phags mchog yi dam lhar 'gyur zhing : rdo rje slob dpon

byams pa'i sku drin gyis: thos bsam bsgom gsum yang dag rang rgyud ldan: tshul bzhin spyod la nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing : bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu mthar phyin 'grub par shog: dngos grub rnam gnyis mchog gi nor 'chang zhing : ma dag 'gro ba drug gi khams rnams su: rgyal rigs rje'u rig rmongs rigs bram ze'i rigs: gdol pa bud med khye'u dge sbyong dang : kun tu rgyu dang bslab gnas rig byed mkhan: rigs kyis bskur ba dang ni ma bskur ba: smad dang bstod dang nad pa chos smra dang : bya dang ri dwags grong khyer slong mo ba: gang la gang 'dul de la der mthun du: sna tshogs gzugs kyis 'gro ba 'dul bar shog: sbyin dang snyan smra don mthun don spyod sogs: bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi yi dpung

)sto /grogs bcas: thab sa la mkhas pa'i rnam grangs dpag med kyis: rang skal gang ldan chos kyi char 'bebs shing : pha ma 'gro drug 'khor ba las sgro la zhing : ma rig mun pa'i sgron me byed pa ra shog: snang srid 'khor 'das chos dbyings ye gnas klong : ma rig dag pa rang byung rdo rje mchog: bya rtsol med par 'gro kun phyams gcig tu: rigs bdag yi dam lha dang gnyis med par: gnyis su med pa'i 'bras bu thob par shog: ces smon la ma gdab po: nam mkha'i mtha' thug mtha' yas sems can rnams: ma 'bad bzhin du sku gsum mngon gyur te: pha ma 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa:phyams gcig gdong ma'i sa la phyin par shog:ces smon lam gdab nga ra bya'o:maṅga lo:
༄ga /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las/ rigs drug gnas 'dren bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /
