sngag /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ swā bha was sbya ngas/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ming byang n-i la sa tshe'adas kyi gzugs kyi rnam pa ji lta bar gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa rigs drug sang na gnas pa de la/ phog pas a dkar po gcig tu gyur nas mdun gyi rten byang la thim par gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma sogs yig

wā /brgya tshar gcig brjod/ mṛ yaṃ badz+ra e ku sha dza dzaḥ na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum zhi khro yi/ /byin rlabs thugs rje nus pa'i bden stobs kyis/ /tshe las 'das pa rigs drug gar gnas kyang / /dmigs rten mtshan byang 'di la gnyis med khug /ces lan gsum brjod/ bdag nyid khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis shi gshed thams cad phyir bskrad par dmigs la/ /oṃ sum̐ bha ni sogs brjod pa'i mthar/ risbyi hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: ces lan gsum gyis thun brab/ lha: tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod kyang / /mi lus tshe 'phos 'jig rten snang ba nub/ /nyon mongs las dbang rjes 'brang sdug bsngal spyod/ /skye gnas bzhi por ltung ba'i sar skyes kyang / /brtse gdung yid la gcags pa'i nye 'brel gyis/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum lha la skyabs song dang / /chos

nyid stobs dang lha mchog thugs rje'i stobs/ /sngags 'chang rtse gcig sgrub pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'og min zhing du sangs rgyas skur bskyed phyir / /re dogs med pa'i sems kyis 'dir shog cig /a n-i su tri pre du e ku sha dza: ming byang bzung la kyai ma 'phan phran mdzes pa 'di ni lus/ kyi rten/ /ming yig byang bu 'di ni ngag gi rten/ /me long gsal ba 'di ni yid kyi rten/ /ras phrug gos dang gdugs 'di gzhal yas khang / /phying dkar 'dug gdan smyugs 'di 'ju ba'i shing / /tshe 'das lus rten 'di la gnas par gyis/ /tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya lhan/ ma tshan byang nye 'brel gcis bis bzung la/ kye ma bdag 'dra'i sems can las ngan gyis/ /zhe sdang ser sna gti mug phrag dog dang / /nga rgyal 'dod chags drag ngo/'i la sa dbang

༄sha /gis/ /rigs drug gnas su ltung zhing sdug bsngal myong / /'khor ba'i las ngan 'di las bdag sgrol mdzod/ /ces tshe 'das kyi brjod par dmigs la / bram ze dung phreng gi lo rgyus brjod la 'di ska da do/ /kye ma tshe 'das lus brjes khyod nyid kyis/ /zhe sdang ser sna gti mug phrag dog dang / /nga rgyal 'dod chags bag med spyod pa'i mthus/ /mi dge bcu la longs spyod las ngan bsags/ /de yi rnam smin rigs drug la skyes na/ /'gro drug skyobs mdzad bcom ldan thub pa drug /bzhugs so de la skyabs song tshig 'di smros/ /bzod pa'i chos thob zhe snang rnam par dag /me chu bsil drod dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal sbyong / /chos kyi rgyal po khyed la skyabs su mchi/ /sbyin pa'i chos thob ser sna rnam par dag /rin chen sgom bus yi

dwags bkres skom sbyong / /bcom ldan kha 'bar zhabs la skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab chos thob gti mug rnam par dag /po tis dud 'gro'i glen lkug sdug bsngal sbyong / /bcom ldan seng rab brtan la skyabs su mchi/ /tshul khrims chos thob phrag dog rnam par dag /go mtshon lha min 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal sbyong / /bcom ldan thag bzang ris la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam gtan chos thob nga rgyal rnam par dag /pi wang 'dzin pas 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal sbyong / /bcom ldan brgya byin khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /brtson 'grus chos thob le lo rnam par dag /gseg gshang par bus skye 'chi'i las sgrib sbyong / /bcom ldan shākya thub la skyabs su chi/ /de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ mar me dang khrus bum thogs la/ hūm̐/ tsha grang skyobs

༄ga /mdzad me chu'i dbang / /tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal sgrol/ /na rag sdug bsngal bral bar shog /du da ha da ha sarba na ra ka te he dun hūm̐ phaṭa/ rin chen sgrom bu thogs la/ āḥ rin chen sgrom bu'i bum pa na/ /rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /pre ta'i sdug bsngal che las sgrol/ /yi dwags skye sgo chod par shog /pre pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka te he dun hūm̐ phaṭa / po ti thogs la/ oṃ/ shes rab rig pa'i po ti 'di/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas zhi khro'i gsungs/ /tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas nyid las sgrol/ /tir+ya'i sdug bsngal bral bar shog /tri ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka te he dun hūm̐ phaṭa/ go mtshon thogs la/ hāḥ ral gri

dang ni go cha 'di/ /sgrol dang bsrung ba zhi khro'i chas/ /tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /lha min 'thab rtsod che las sgrol/ /he sa ka yi sdug bsngal bral bar shog /su sarba du la sarba kurma pra we sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ pi waṃ thogs la/ swā/ longs spyod bdud kyi g.yeng 'joms pa/ /pi wang snyan pa'i don byed 'dis/ /tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /ltung ba'i sdug bsngal che las sgrol/ /skye ba gcig gis las rdzogs shog /a sarba ta thā ga ta biston khad kha tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gseg gshang par bu thogs la/ hūm̐/ rin chen par bur lha tshogs bzhugs/ /gseg gshang rgyal ba'i thugs rtags brda / /tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /mi yi sdug bsngal che las sgrol/ /a wā dhu ti'i dbang thob shog /oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐

)za /phaṭa/ glud gtor chang bu drug bi brgyan pa gcig /oṃ āḥlha: lan gsum gyis 'dod yon bsam gyis mi khyab par dmigs te/ hūm̐/ 'dod yon longs spyod tshad med gtor ma 'di/ /tshe 'das 'di yi sngon chad lan chags rigs/ /phyin chad thar pa'i gegs byed gshed bdud rnams/ /gtor ma 'di yis mgu zhing tshim gyis la/ /tshe 'das 'di yi thar ba'i gegs ma byed/ /sarba bisne ba ling ta khā hi khā hi gats+tsha/ de nas brab rdzas thogs la / 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /dkon mchog gsum po dug mi mnga'/ /dkon mchog bden pas dug bcom mo / /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs dug mi mda'/ /rtsa gsum bden pas

dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /sku gsum lha tshogs dug mi mnga'/ /sku gsum bden pas dug bcom mo/ /ma rig 'byung ba lnga po las/ /dug byung dug ni ye nas dag /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug ni 'byung ba'i phugs su dag /khyod kyi dug ni dug med shog /ha la ha la shudhe ā/ ces rtsa sngags dang yig brgya dang rka ka ni brjod pa'i mthar brab pas/ dug dang rigs drug sa bon tham sa cad yang yang bsregs te med par bsam/ de nas khrus bum thogs la mchan byang me long ngos la bkru zhing / hūm̐/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /khong khro'i dri ma sbyong byed pa/ /bzod pa chu yi rjes dgongs la/ /khong khro'i dri ma dag gyur cig /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūm̐ badz+ra satwa so gas / 'di ni

༄gi /sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong byed pa/ /sbyin pa'i chu yi rjes dgongs la/ /'dod chags dri ma dag gyur cig /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e pad+ma satwa sogs/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ /mi shes dri ma sbyong byed pa/ /shes rab chu yi rjes dgongs la / /gti mug dri ma dag gyur cig /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ /phrag dog dri ma sbyong byed pa/ /tshul khrims chu yi rjes dgongs la/ /phrag dog dri ma dag gyur cig /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu//ltung ba'i dri ma sbyong byed pa/ /ting 'dzin chu yi rjes dgongs la/ /nga rgyal dri ma dag gyur cig /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ni

brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu/ /le lo'i dri ma sbyong byed pa/ /spro dga'i chu yi rjes dbongs la/ /the tshom dri ma dag gyur cig /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ni ye shes rang bzhin chu/ /'khrul ba'i dri ma sbyong byed pa/ /ye shes chu yi rjes dgongs la/ /'khrul rtog dri ma dag gyur cig /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa sngags dang yi ge brgya nga mtshams su brjod cing bkrus pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam/ sanas nas drangs pa ni/ kyai ma sa 'di man chad 'khor ba'i gnas/ /rigs drug 'khor ba'i brtson dong yin/ /sdug bsngal mang ldan skyi g.ya'i gnas/ /de la ma chags ma zhen par / /bor ro spongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /sa 'di yan chad thar pa'i zhing / /sdug bsngal ming med gtan bde'i gnas/ /de la mos na bde

༄ga /chen bgrod/ /dengs so gshegs so rigs kyi bu/ /rigs drug 'khor ba'i yul khyim rnams/ /sgyu ma bzhin du rtag brtan med/ /pha ma bu tsha nye drung kun/ /mi rtag 'bral ba'i chos can yin/ /chags na thar pa'i gegs byed pas/ /ma chags gtsang ma'i zhing khams su/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog /ces skye sgo bcad par bsams de nas byang bu nye drung gis bzung / gang zhig sgyu 'phrul zhi khro yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal na/ /nyams chags kun kyang byang gyur te/ /mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang byang / /na rag gnas kyang dong sprugs te/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /de phyir gus pas phyag 'tshol zhig /ces phyag 'tshal du bcug la/ na mo ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyobs pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /

'dren pa bla ma med dge 'dun rin po che/ /mchod gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmigs med chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cir yang sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi bsgrub pa yis/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas yon tan mthar phyin pa'i/ /sku dang ye shes tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta pra na me na bhan+dha na ka ro mi/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ e ma mgon po thugs rje can / /bde chen thar pa'i lam ston 'tshal/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal slob dpon gyis /

jug /kyai ho bu khyod skal ba bzang / /dkyil 'khor 'jug phyir dga' sems gyis/ /ho/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams/ /tshe 'das bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /skyabs gnas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs drung / /mi dge spangs shing dge ba bsgrub/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la/ /rgyun du gnas shing bzung bar bgyi/ /deng bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla med smon 'jug byang chub sems/ /bdag gis bskyed cing bslab par bgyi/ /kun don tshul khrims gsum yang bzung / /dkon mchog gsum dang rigs lnga yi/ /dam tshig mi spangs bsgrub

pa dang / /rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gang / /ma lus bdag gis yongs su bzung / de nas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ tshe las 'das pa skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' gsal bar gyur/ mtshan byang dkyil 'khor shar sgor khyer te/ hūm̐ dkyil 'khor sgo bas sgo phyes shig /phyag 'tshal lha dang mjal bar shog /rig pa'i me tog lha la 'bul/ /'brel ba'i lha la 'bab par shog /pra we sha ya pra tī dza ho/ gsang mtshan btags/ tsak+ṣu pra we sha ya phaṭa/ ces brjod mig dar dbye la/ kye ho tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /sdig las grol zhing rdor sems kyi/ /rigs su skyes te dngos grub thob / /de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐/ rin chen bum pa'i gzhal yas na/ /rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs/ /tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /

༄sha /lha dbang lus la thob par shog /hūm̐ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ i bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ swā rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ āḥpad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ hā kurmā a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ bharnya bdud rtsi thogs la/ hūm̐ gsang ba ye shes bdud rtsi che/ /byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'du gsal/ /rtsa khams bde ba'i rang bzhin la/ /thabs shes zung 'jug dbang thob shog /bo dhi tsit+ta a ho su ka āḥ me long thosas la/ hūm̐/ me long spros bral chos sku zlum/ /shel sgong ltar dag dri med thugs/ /ka dag thugs kyi dbang bskur ro/ /chos dbyings spros bral dbang thob shog /tsit+ta dz+nyā na a bho ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ mnyam ba'ag la gnas nga 'i ngang nas hrī/ ngo bo nyid nas ka dag pa'i/ /rang bzhin nyid ni lhun grub po/ /stong pa chen por bab kyis grub/ /ye shes rtsal gyi dbang thob shog /

dharma dhartu dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ ces rtsal dbang bskur/ rgyas par byed na rang gzhung ltar dbang chen bskur/ kye ho/ tshe 'das thar pa'i lam bgrod la/ /bza' btung gos rgyan la sogs mkho dgu rnams/ /brtse sems can gyis khyod phyir 'phang med bsngo/ /rdo rje slob dpon zag med byin rlabs kyis/ /khyod la bsngos pas 'dod dgu kun thob nas/ /zhen med spyod la bde chen lam du gshegs/ /na ma:sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥsarba takhro uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa hi rma ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ ces 'dod yon bsngo/ tshogs 'khor bskor/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ 'di nas shar lho nub byang dbus dang lnga / /mngon dga' dpal ldan bde chen las rab rdzogs/ /'thug po bkod sogs zhing khams lnga yod pas/ /der sems bskyed la zhing der skye bar shog /mar me

༄sha /bstan la/ hūm̐/ thugs rje'i shugs kyi sgron me 'di bstan pas/ /thar pa'i zhing du 'gro ba'i mun 'khrul rnams/ /ye shes sgron me 'di yis rab bsal nas/ /zhing mchog ye shes lha dang 'phrad par shog / yon 'bul ba ni/ ho bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga la/ /tshe 'das phung lnga yon du 'bul / /yon 'di bzhes la lam 'di ston/ /sems 'di byang chub gnas su drongs/ /rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /tshe 'das sgo gsum yon du 'bul/ /yon 'di bzhes la lam 'di ston/ /sems 'di byang chub gnas su drongs/ /sku gsum 'bras bu thob par shog /bdun tshig nar mar byed na zas bsngo'i mtshams 'di yan byed la/ cho ga rdzogs nas gnas spar sogs bya ste/ thabs kyi gzhu la shes rab mda' bkang ste/ /ye shes thugs rje'i shugs

kyis zhing mchog tu/ /tshe 'das mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog /'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol zhing khams na/ /bde ba can zhes bde skyid yon tan rdzogs/ /zhing der sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la/ /spyan ras gzigs dang byang sems mthu chen thob/ /'jam dpal la sogs byang sems dpag med bskor/ /pad+ma rigs kyi gtso 'khor grangs med bzhugs/ /zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas rab dam pa der/ /tshe 'das bu khyod sangs rgyas de yi sras/ /rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog /phaṭaḥ tshe las 'das pa'i rig pa sems kyi ngo bo hrī/ dmar por gyur nas/ mda' 'phang ba ltar snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyi sbyor gatshams su thim pas rgyal ba'i sras su gyur te sangs rgyas par gyur

༄ṣ+ṭhan /cig /ces mda' rtse nub tu bstan pas dkyil 'khor dbus su 'phang / de nas byang bu bsreg par byed na mar me dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag / oṃ raṃ tshe 'das lus ngag yid gsum la/ /sku gsum ye shes me sbar ro/ /dug gsum sgrib gsum dag gyur cig /sku gsum 'bras bu thob par shog /tshe 'das phung lnga dug lnga la / /sku lnga ye shes me sbar ro/ /phung khams sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sku lnga ye shes lnga thob shog /tshe 'das ma rig 'khrul nyon la/ /ka dag ye shes me sbar ro/ /'khrul nyon bag chags dag gyur cig /kun bzang chen po'i sa thob shog /ces bsregs shing btag grol 'don/ rtsa sngags dang yig brgya rka ka ni bzlas la/ smon lam ci spyogs sadab ste/ byang thal sāts+tsha gdab la dben par bskyal dkyil 'khor rjes kyi bya ba rang gzhung ltar byas la/ dkyil 'khor bsdu/ mi dmigs pas rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /de ltar dbongs pa rang grol gshin chog don/ /mang las nyung dang bsgrigs chog bsdus pa ste/ /blo dman rnams dang spros med rnal 'byor pa/ /gang zhig dgos pa rnams kyi don ched du/ /rdzosas chen rnal 'byor pad+ma rig 'dzin gyis//
bkod pa'i dge 'dis 'khor ba dong sprugs shog /bris pa dge'o/ /

sngag /sbyi: sku gsum dam tshig 'a/sa byung zhing : nyon mongs zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa'i: lha yi bdud rtsi dag pa yis: mi bskyod pa ru dbang bskur ro: lha badz+ra a dharma shu dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa me: rgyu sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid de: nga rgyal rtog pa rnam par 'joms: chags med sbyin pa'i dbu rgyan 'dis: rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro: su rat+na sa man+ta dz+nyā na rat+na swa bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa rmā: rgyu sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang : mi phyed rdo rjes gsang ba la: 'dod chags rtog pa rnam par 'joms: rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ro: i pad+ma pra dz+nyā a bhi ṣiñtsa rma: lha thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yis: 'gro don mnyam med dril bu 'dis: phrag dog rtog pa rnam par 'dzoms: gnyis su med par dbang bskur ro:

ha ri sha a nu te dz+nyā na pa de badz+ra kurma a bhi ṣiñtsa rma: :: rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas: gti mug rtog pa rnam par 'joms: cis kyang mi chod mi shigs pa: rdo rje'i ming ni rab tu grags: i tri tsakra ma du a mi dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa me:gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod:kye ho bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che:bdag cas skal ldan bu rnams la:rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi:lha dbang yongs rdzogs bskur du gsolaḥbhūḥskal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: kun bzang yab yum dbang bskur bas: yid chos rnam par dag pa yi: chos sku rab 'byams dbang thob shog: dharma kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥlha hrī: lha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: rigs lnga yab lnga'i dbang bskur bas: phung po lnga po gnas dag nas: longs sku

༄ga /rab 'byams dbang thob shog: o hūm̐ swā e r+sā: se bho kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: lhu: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: bde gshegs yum lnga'i dbang bskur bas: 'byung lnga ma spangs gnas dag nas: rigs lnga yum lnga'i dbang thob shog: rlu lī rmā r+pā rta: a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: lha skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la:sems dpa' brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas:tshogs brgyad ma spangs gnas dag nas:sems dpa' rab 'byams dbang thob shog: bo rnyi satwa a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: ྈ: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: sems ma brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: yul brgyad ma spang gnas dag nas: sems ma rab 'byams dbang thob shog: a a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: ju skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: thub chen drug gi dbang bskur

bas: nyon mongs drug po gnas dag nas: sprul sku rab 'byams dbang thob shog: nirma kā ya a bho ṣiñtsa ā: rdu: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: sgo ba bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: rtag chad mu bzhi gnas dag nas: phrin las rab 'byams dbang thob shog: shan+ti puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ ma ra ya a bho ṣiñtsa ā: rtsa skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: sgo ma bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: skye gnas bzhi po gnas dag nas: phrin las bzhi yi dbang thob shog: badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha rgyu: badz+ra spo ḍa bo: badz+ra ghar+bhe ho: a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsū skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: che mchog yab yum dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs ma spangs gnas dag nas: khrag 'thung rab 'byams dbang thob shog: ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā gro ti shwa ri a bhi

༄sha /ṣiñtsa stu: sbyi skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: khrag 'thung yab lnga'i dbang bskur bas: dug lnga ma spangs gnas dag nas: khrag 'thung yab lnga'i dbang thob shog: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma kurma bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa :: rtsa skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: dbyings phyug yum lnga'i dbang bskur bas: yul lnga'i rtog pa rang grol nas: gro ti yum lnga'i dbang thob co/ga: gro ti ri'u ri pañtsa a bhi ṣiñtsa lha: sbyi skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la:kau'u rī brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas:tshogs brgyad ma spangs gnas dag nas:mkha' 'gro rab 'byams dbang thob shog:ha a bhi ṣiñtsa sbri:lha skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: seng ha brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: yul brgyad ma spangs gnas dag nas: phra men rab 'byams dbang

thob shog:he a bhi ṣiñtsa ::rdu skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams 'a/:sgo ma bzhi yi dbang bskur bas:skye gnas bzhi po gnas dag nas:phrin las bzhi yi dbang thob shog: dza:lha baṃ hoḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa lha: rdzu skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: dbang phyug nyer brgyad dbang bskur bas: nyon mo ngas rtos/ tshob/sa sanas das/ nas :ma mo rab 'byams dbang thob shog:bh+yo a bhi ṣiñtsa stu:dge'oḥ
sngag /bram ze dung phreng brgyud nga 'i lo rgyus/

jug /bram ze dung phreng brgyud pa'i 'o rgyus/ slob dpon gyi 'gyod tshangs rgyal po'i 'byung khungs/ bram ze dung phreng brgyud pa'i lo rgyus bshad nga ni/ 'o nam ma la' dang ma nyam pa 'i sem sa cad thams cad rdzogs pa 'i sa ngas rgyas thob par bya/ de'i chad du bram ze dung gi phreng ba can zhes bya ba'i slob bu las ngan gyi dbang gi na raka gi gnas su ltung ba las/ dpal kun tu bzang po dang kun rig rnam/ par snang mdzad gnyis kyi thugs ka nas rdo rje sems dpa' dang phyag

khug /na rdo rje gnyis su sprul nas dbang bskur ba dang 'gyod tshangs byed du bcug nas/ rig 'dzin gyi gral du 'khod pa dang / yang sngon sangs 'od mi 'gyur ba zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus su/ rgyal bu dge mthong zhes bya ba sdig pa grangs ma mchis pa byas pa zhig gi dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar mthol bshags byas nas sdig pa las grol ba dang / khyad par du dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnams nyams chags bskang ba'i thabs su bstan pa'i 'gyod tshang gi rgyal po 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang / chos dang 'phrad pa ni u dum wa ra'i me tog dang 'dra ste/ shin tu 'byung bar dka' la/ gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor sgor 'jug pa de bas kyang dkon te 'di lta

bu la zhugs nas bskal pa dpag tu med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dkyil 'khor 'di mthong ba tsam gyis byang 'ing dag par 'gyur na/ sngags 'di la spyod cing tshul la gnas nas bzlas pa byas na myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa la tshegs med de/ rgyud las/ 'jig rten 'di na kun mkhyen dag /re 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam yang ni re 'ga' zhig /ces pa dang / dri med bshags rgyud las/ gal te rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha 'di rnams kyi mtshan rna bar lan gcig thos pa tsam gyis na raka chen por mi ltung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa'i don de la dga' spro khyad par can dang ldan par

khog /mdzod la/ 'di yi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen/ ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'/ gu ru dga' rab rdo rje/ rig 'dzin shrī seng ha/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ grub thob kurma gling pa/ thugs sras nyi zla chos rje / mtshungs med sur+ya tsan+t+ra/ nam mkha' chos kyi rgyal mtsho/ mtshungs med nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan saṅge bha tra/ pha rgo dri med blo gros / chos rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med ma nyis mtshan can/ yongs 'dzin phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ 'dren mchog kurma chos rgyal/sngags 'chang pad+ma dbang drag /thugs chen kurma chags med/ grub thob pad+ma rig 'dzin/ 'dren mchog nam mkha' 'od gsal/ 'gyur med

theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ pad+ma kun grol rnam rgyal/ a ti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' tshe dbang mchog grub/ mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje / mkhan chen pad+ma badz+ra/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar rim par brgyud pa'i zab chos zhi khro'i dgongs pa rang grol gyi sgo nas/ tshe 'das ris drugo si sanas nas drangs thing dbang bsku ra ba lnga / tshe 'dasag nyid kyi sa/so la ba sa/dbas pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

)rdzo /bh+rūṃ bu shwa bi budhe phaṭa dzaḥ lha tshogs zhi ba sogs nas/ las bzhi hūm̐ bzlas bcas grub nas/ bum pa mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs gzhal med khang dbus su/ /lha tshogs kun gsal thugs ku'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs bstidzi ri oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ lha baṃ hoḥ.o badz+ra arnya nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa 'os pas bstod la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros sogs/ las bum bcas bzlas mthar dbyangs gsal byed yig brgya rten 'brel snying ngo bcas lan gsum re brjod/ mchod bstod byed/ o āḥbhū/ lha rnams bde sto nga chen po'i ngo bor zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ze( gcib/ /nge sdomazer/ zhes pa/ 'di yang btsun pa gzhon phan mtha' yas pas bris pa'o/ ༈/gzhan la dbang bskur ba dang 'bral na/ bdag 'jug rdzogs par len pa'am/yang na spros pa 'tshams pa'i phyir/ bdag

nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang rang bzhin dbyer med du bsgom sa nas rig pa'i me tog dor ba nyid don gyis dkyil khor du zhugs pa yi na nga sa/ me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya oṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya māṃ/ tsū badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badz+ra sa ma ya swā/ hā badz+ra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor pa'i sku sasung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par gyur par bas mas te/ 'jug bya'i dkyil 'khor dang dbang gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las te 'bras chos lnga po dbyer med ro gcig tu bsam pa'o/ /na raka dong sprugs sogs/ oṃ badz+ra gro dha sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes sbyar/ o/ ye shes rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas / /phyag rgya chen po bdag sbyor cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bsku la zhing bstem/ dkyil 'khor lha la thal mo sbyar

༄sha /bas btud de/ oṃ/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/ /dzaḥ lha bam̐ hoḥ yig brgya bzla zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo//

༄ga /bh+rūṃ bi shwa bi budhe phaṭa dzaḥ i hūm̐ swā ā+oṃ hā phaṭa dza/ hūm̐ ha he phaṭa bh+yo raṃ phaṭa dzaḥ dam tshig gi 'khor lo las ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas nga/ logs su phye ste bdun gyi na mkhar me ri 'dabs 'byar gyi tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ bdag mdun gyi lha tshogs zhi ba rnams kyi thugs kur sogs/

wā /phyag 'tshal bsdus pa ni/ e ma ho: chos rnams rnam dag ye nas lhun gyis grub: bya ba byed dang yid chos rnam par dag: chos dbyings ye shes mchog la mnga' brnyes pa: kun bzang yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo: chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang : gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal: thabs dang shes rab mchog la mjang brnyes pa'i: rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo: ngo mtshar pho brang bde bar gshegs pa'i yum: das gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed mdzad cing : bde stong zung 'jug yab kyi sku la 'khril: rigs kyi yu ma/ ma chog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: rnam shes phung po dag pa'i sku gsung thugs: bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras ma/chog ste: nyon mongs

spyod pa'i skyon dang bral ba yi: sems dpa' chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: lhag mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar bcas: bdug spos me/ tog mar me dri chab ma: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod pas mnyes mdzad pa'i: mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal 'o : drag shul thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa: bdud bzhi'i dpung dang bgegs tshogs rnam par 'joms: tshad med bzhi ldan sgo bzhi thub par gsungs: ta krita sgo ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo: rtag chad mtha' bzhi gsang ba yum gyi ngang : mi mthun phyogs 'joms rab 'jigs khro mo'i tshul: lcas kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma: ye shes sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo: steng 'os phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten 'dul ba'i sa/tso: nyon mongs drus

jug /'joms rgyu drug dag par sbyongs: 'gro drug 'dren mdzad sprul pa'i skur ston pa: bcom ldan thub pa drug la phyag 'tshal lo: chos sku skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang : gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs skur ston cing : gdug pa 'dul phyir khro chen 'bar ba'i sku: dpal chen hre ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: khro rgyal dbang phyug sku la 'khril mdzad cing : dgyes pa bskyed phyir dung khrag yab la stob: khro mo mi zad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro maḥ kro ti shwa rī yum la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje thabs mkhas ma rungs 'dul mdzad cing : ye shes mtshon chas nyon mongs ma lus gcod: srid gsum bla med dbyings su sgrol mdzad pa: rigs bzhi khrag 'thung tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: khrag 'thung so so'i yab kyi sku la

'khril: khro mo'i gzugs kyis log lta zil gyis non: 'gro rnam/sa thugs rjes 'dren phyir mdzad pa'i yu ma: rigs bzhi khro bo rnams laphyas 'tshal lo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: sgog mo la sogs 'bar ba'i nyams ldan zhing : ye shes sku mchog 'jigs byed brgyan gyis/ brgyan:ska rī khro mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogos/ med cing : 'dod dgu bsgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che: ma sring byams pa'i tshul gyis grogs mdzad ma: seng ha phra men brgyad la phyag 'tshal 'o : rdo rje gdong mo pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi:'gugs dang 'chings bsdoms myos pa'i las kun mdzad: shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi thub par bsrungs: sgo srung khro mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo:

jug /dbyings dang ye shes mnyam sbyor rol ba la: sna tshogs cir yang sprul pa'i skur ston zhing : 'gro drug sems can rnams la dbang rol mdzod: spor byed chen mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badz+ra a ra lbi: mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ma tshogs dbang phyug ma:srin mo'i cha lugs 'jigs pa'i mgo brnyan can:rnal 'byor nyi shu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo:ces phyag 'cha' lo//
sngag /'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po bzhugs so/ /

sngag /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mi tri pra ṇi dhā na ra dza/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa byams pa'i smo na lam gyi rgyal po / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun dga' bo ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' chen po byams pa dam bcas nas sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe nyin la gsum mtshan lan gsum du bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas phus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te

mug /thal mo sbyar nas tshig 'di skad ces smon lam btab bo/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong lha mig ldan pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam/sa dang yang / /nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan 'gro thams cad zlog byed cing / /mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems kyi dbang du gyur pas na/ /bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /bdag gis de dag bshags par bgyi/ /bdag las rnam pa gsum gang gi/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bskyed pa ste/ /bdag gi kun mkhyen sa bon te/ /bdag gi byang chub mi zad shog /phyogs bcu dag gi zhing rnams su/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa

gang byung ba/ /sangs rgyas mkhyen pas yi rang ba/ /de la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /bsod nams kun la/ yi rang ngo / /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni ye shes mchog thob thog /phyogs bcu dag gi phyogs rnams su/ /sa bcu dag la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mchog /'tshang rgya bgyid par bskul ma 'debs/ /byang chub dam par sangs rgyas shing / /sde dang bcas pa'i bdud btul nas/ /srog chags kun la sma na slad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig /chos/ rnga chen ngo/ sgra yis ni/ /sdug bsngal sems can thar bgyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su/ /chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /'dod pa'i 'dam du bying gyur

༄sha /cing / /srid pa'i srad bus dam bcings pa/ /'ching ba kun gyis bcings bdag la/ /rkang gnyis mchog rnams gzigs su gsol/ /sems kyi dri mar gyur pa la/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni smod mi mdzad/ /sems can rnams la byams thugs ldan/ srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs dang / /gang dag 'das dang ma byon pa/ /de dag rjes su bdag slob cing / /byang chub spyad pa spyod gyur cig /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas/ /'gro drug sems can thar bgyis shog /mngon shes drug po mngon bgyis nas/ /bla med byang chub reg gyur cig /ma skyes pa dang mi 'byung dang / /rang bzhin ma mchis gnas ma mchis/ /rnam rig ma mchis dngos ma mchis/ /stong

pa'i chos/ ni rtogasari/ par thog /sangs rgyas drang srong chen po ltar/ /sems can ma mchis srog ma mchis/ /gang zag ma mchis gso myo ra/chis/ /bdag ma mchis pa'i chos rtogs thos/ bdag 'dzin bdag gir 'dzin pa yi/ /dngos po kun la mi gnas par/ /sems can kun la phan slad du/ /ser sna ma myo chis sbyin gtong shog /dngos po dngos por ma mchis pas/ /bdag gi longs spyod lhun grub shog /dngos po thams cad rnam 'jig pas/ /sbyi na pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med kyang / tshul khrimag rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sa 'am yang na chu 'am me/ /rlung gi khams ltar mi gnas shing / /

༄sha /bzod pa'am khro ba ma mchis par/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /gtan spro le lo ma mchis shing / /stobs dang ldan pa'i lus sems kyis/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang / /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang / /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang yang / /rigs gsum mngon sum bgyis pa yis/ /shes rab pha ro'/ phyin rdzogs shog /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa dang / /'od dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /bdag gzhan bsam pa rdzogs gyur

cig /de ltar spyad pa spyod byed cing / /byams pa grags dang ldan pa yis/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas/ /sa bcu spo la rab tu gnas// /'di nas shi 'phos gyur ma thag /dga' ldan skyes nas yid dga' bar/ /myur du byams mgon mnyes byas nas/ /byang chub lung bstan thob pa ra shog /rgya sar gyi ma khan ngo dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te btan la phab pa/
rog /dpal kun tu bzang po'i smoni lam bzhugs so/ /

sngag /hoḥ snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun: gzhi gcig lam gnyis 'bras bu gnyis: rig dang ma/ rig cho 'phrul te: kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyis: thams cad chos dbyings/ pho brang du: mngon nga/rardzogs te 'tshang rgya shog: kun kyi gzhi ni 'dus ma byas: rang byung klong yangs brjod du med: 'khor 'das gnyis ku'i ming med do: de nyid rig na sangs rgyas te: ma rig sems can 'khor bar 'khyams:

murdza /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis: brjod med gzhi don rig par shog:kun tu bzang po nga yis kyang : rgyu rkyen med pa gzhi yi don: de nyid gzhi la rang byung rig: phyi nang sgro kur skyon ma btags: dran med mun pa'i sgrib ma gos: de phyir rang snang skyon ma gos:rang rig so la gnas pa la: srid gsum 'jigs kyang dngangs skrag med: 'dod yon lnga la chags pa med: rtog med shes pa rang byung la:rdos pa'i gzugs dang dug lnga med: rig pa'i gsal cha ma 'gags pa: ngo bo gcis/ la ye shes lnga: ye shes lnga ngo smin pa las: thog ma'i sa ngas rgyas rigs lnga byung : de las ye shes mtha' rgyas pas: sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis byung : ye shes lnga yi rtsal shar bas: khrag

'thung drug ci tham pa byung : de phyir gzhi rig 'khrul ma myong : thog med sangs rgyas nga yin pas/: nga yi smon lam btab pa yis: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can gyis: rang byung rig pa ngo shes nas: ye shes chen po mtha' rgyas shog: nga yi sprul pa rgyun mi chad: bye ba phrag brgya bsam yas 'gyed: gang la gang 'dul sna tshos/tra sto na: nga yi thugs rje'i smon lam gyis: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can kun:risas drug gnas nas 'thon par shog: dang po sems can 'khrul pa rnams: bzhi la rig pa ma shar bas: ci yang dran med thom me ba:de ka ma rig 'khrul pa'i rgyu: de la had kyis brgyal ba las: dngangs skrag shes pa za zi 'gyus: de las bdag gzhan dgrar 'dzin skyes:

༄sha /bas chags rim bzhin brtas pa las: 'khor ba lugs su 'jug pa byung : de las nyon mongs dug lnga rgyas: dug lnga'i las la rgyun chad med: de phyir sems can 'khrul pa'i gzhi: dran med ma rig yin pa'i phyir: sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: kun kyi ris pa rang shes shog: lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa: shes pa dran med yengs pa yin: kun tu btags pa'i ma rig pa: bdag gzhan gnyis su 'dzin pa yin: lhan cig kun btags myo/ rig gnyis : sems can kun kyi 'khrul gzhi yin: sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: 'khor ba'i sems can tham/sa cad kyi: dran med 'thib pa 'i mun pa sangs: gnyas su 'dzin pa'i shes pa dang : rig pa rang ngo shes par shog: gnyis 'dzin

blo ni the tshom ste: zhen pa phra mo skyes pa las: bag chags 'thug por rim gyis brtas: zas nor bos dang gnas dang grogs: 'dod yon lnga dang byams pa'i gnyen: yid 'ong chags pa'i 'dod pas gdungs: de dag 'jig rten 'khrul pa ste: gzung 'dzin las la zad mtha' med: zhen pa'i 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe: rkam chags gdungs pa'i yi dwags su: skye gnas bkres skom ya re nga : sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: 'dod chags zhen pa'i sems can rnams: 'dod pa'i gdung ba phyir ma spangs: 'dod chags zhen pa tshur ma blangs: shes pa rang sor klod pa yis: rig pa rang so zin gyur nas: kun rtog ye shes thob par shog: phyi rol yul gyis snang ba la: 'jigs skrag shes pa phra mo

sngag /'gyus : sdang ba'i bas chags brtas nga/ la: dgrar 'dzin brdeg sasod hrag nga/ skyes: zhe sdang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe: dmyal ba'i btso bsres sdug re bsngal: sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi: zha sdang drag ngo/ skyes nga/'i tshe: spang blang mi bya rang sor klod: rig pa rang so zin gyur nas: gsal ba'i ye shes thob par shog: rang sems khengs par gyur pa la: gzhan la 'gran sems sma da nga/'i blo: nga rgyal drag po'i sems skyes pas: bdag gzhan 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal myong ཿ las de'i 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe: 'pho ltung myong ba'i lha ru skyes: sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: khengs sem/sa skyes nga/'i sems can rnams: de tshe shes pa rang sor

klod: rig pa rang so zin gyur nas: mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs shog: gnyi 'dzin brtas pa'i bag chags kyis: bdag stod gzhan smod zug rngu las: 'thab rtsod 'gran sems brtas pa las: gsod gcod lha min gnas su skye: 'bras bu dmyal ba'i gnas su lhung : sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: 'gran sems 'thab rtsod skyes pa rnams: dgrar 'dzin mi bya rang srod klod: shes pa rang so zin gyur nas:phrinalas thogs med ye shes shog: dran med gtang snyoms yengs pa yi: 'thib dang rmugs dang brjed pa dang : brgyal dang le lo gti mug pas: 'bras bu skyabs med byol song 'khyams: sangs rgyas nga yi smon lam gyis: gti mug bying ba'i mun pa la: dran pa gsal ba'i

)sna /mdangs shar bas: rtog med ye shes thob par shog: khams gsum sems can thams cad kun: kun gzhi sangs rgyas nga dang mnyam: dran med 'khrul pa'i gzhi ru song : da lta don med las la spyod: las drug rmi 'a ma 'khrul pa 'dra: nga ni sangs rgyas thog ma yin:'gro drug sprul pas 'dul ba'i phyir: kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyis: sems can thams cad ma lus pa: chos kyi dbyings su 'tshang rgya shog: a hoḥ phyin chad rnal 'byor stobs can gyis: 'khrul med rig pa rang gsal nas: smon lam stobs can 'di btab pas: 'di thos sems can thams cad kun: skye ba gsum na mngon 'tshang rgya: nyi zla gza' yis zin pa 'am: sgra dang sa g.yos byang ba 'am: nyi ma

ldog 'gyur lo 'pho dus: rang nyid kun tu bzang por bskyed: kun kyis thos par 'di brjo nas: khams gsum sems can dathams cad la: rnal 'byor de yi smon ma gyis: sdug bsngal rim bzhin grol nas kyang : mthar ru sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur: zhes gsungs so/ /rdzogs pa chen ngo kun tu bzang po'i dbongs pa zang thal du bstan pa'i rgyud la sa/ smon lam stobs ngo che btab nga sa sems can thams cad sangs mi rgya ba'i dbang med nga ra bstan pa'i le'u dgu pa khol du phyungs pa'o/

wā/bhad+dha bdud rtsi thogs la/ hūm̐/ gsang ba ye shes bdud rtsi chu/ /byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'du gsal/ /rtsa khams bde ba'i rang bzhin la/ /thabs shes zung 'jug dbang thob shog /bo dhi tsit+ta a hoḥ sa kha āḥme long thogs la/hūm̐/ me long spros bral chos sku zlum/ /shel sgong ltar dag dri med thugs/ /ka dag thugs kyi dbang bskur ro//chos dbyings spros bral dbang thob shog /tsit+ta dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/mnyam bzhag la gnas pa'i ngang nas/hrī/ ngo bo nyid nas ka dag pa'i/ /rang bzhin nyid nas lhun grub bo/ /stong pa chen por bab kyis grub/ /ye shes rtsal gyi dbang thob shog /dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥces rtsal dbang bskur/
rog /gu ru gtso 'khor gsum gyis gsungs pa'i smon lam bzhugs so/ /

༄ga /sangs rgyas kun dngos gu ru pad+ma 'byung / /tshe rabs kun tu bdag gi bla mar shog /mchog thun lam gyi bar chad kun zhi nas/ /'od gsal ngang nas 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /skyabs gnas bslu med pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /mi phyed dad pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog thun dngos grub tshe 'dir stsal du gsol / /sgrib bral rang ngo rang gis shes pa dang / /rang thag rang gis chod pa'i gdeng ldan gyis/ /gzhan

mug /gyi dbang du skad cig mi btang bar/ /rang gi bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par shog /lha 'dre mi gsum bar chad mi tshugs shing / /brtul zhugs drag po'i stobs dang ldan par shog /las rlung drag pos nam yang mi bskyod cing / /mnyam bzhag ting 'dzin brtan pa thob par shog /las shugs drag ngo/'i skyon gyis mi gos shing / /las ngan dbang gis skye ba mi len shog /'di nas shi 'phos skad cig nyid la ni/ /nub phyogs u rgyan zangs mdog dpal gyi ri/ /rig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma'i zhabs drung du/ /'dun pa drag pos skad cig sleb par shog /de 'khor pad+ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi myong / /skad cig g.yo med sgrub la brtson par shog /nga d+ma'i sku gsung thugs dang mnyam gyur nas/ /'gro

drug 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par shog /bdag ni pad+ma'i rjes su bzung gyur nas/ /rdzu 'phrul nus mthu dpag med thob pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa ji snyed kyis/ /mtha' yas sems can bde la 'god par shog /chos dbyings mtha' dbus bral ba'i bden pa dang / /yi dam rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs rje dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /smon lam 'di nyid ska da cig 'grub par shog /na mo ma hā gu ru'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag kyang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /zhing khams dag pa'i pho brang du/ /bla ma 'bral med bsten par shog /mos gus ltem rkyang med pa yis/ /mnyes pa'i zhabs tog 'grub pa dang / /dgongs pa zab mo thugs kyi bcud/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i lung

༄sha /thob shog /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /lus ngag yid gsum smin pa dang / /zab mo'i bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis la/ /dbang thob sgrub pa byed par shog /log rtog bdud kyi tshogs rnams dang / nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang / /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa yis/ /bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog /dur khrod ri khrod gangs khrod sogs/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas nyid du/ /ting 'dzin zab mo'i dgongs bcud la/ /rtag tu sgrub pa byed par shog /sgrub pa byas pa'i 'bras bu yis/ /phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang / /lha srin bran du khol nas kyang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar shog /ston pas gsungs pa'i dam chos rnams/ /rtsol med rgyud la 'char bar shog /mkhyen

pa mchog la mnga' brnyes nas/ /rtogs pa mchog dang ldan par shog /byang chub sems kyi rten 'brel gyis/ /skye 'gro ma lus dbang bsdus nas / /thogs med yid bzhin nor bu'i mthus/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan par shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba'i mthus/ /brgyud 'dzin chos don rgyas pa dang / /'gro kun bde la 'khod nas kyang / /zhing khams thams cad dag par shog /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /gdul bya so so'i blo yul du/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku/ /dpag tu med par 'byung bar shog /mdor na 'khor 'das ma lus pa/ /gu ru nyid dang dbyer med cing / /sku gsum 'di 'bral med pa yis/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob shog /sems can gsol ba 'debs

jug /par shog /bla mas byin gyis rlob par shog /yi dam dngos grub ster bar shog /mkha' 'gros lung bstan byed par shog /chos skyong bar chad sel bar shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /sems cad thams cad bde zhing skyid par shog /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog /rang gzhan dag pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /'khor ba ngan song dong sprugs nas/ /srid mtshor slar yang mi gnas shing / /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod/ /bla med mchog gi bstan pa 'di/ /ji ltar mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /rgyal khams yongs la dar rgyas shog /mdor na bdas gi dge rtsa 'dis/ /dge

gzhan mtha' dag gcig bsdus nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yi/ /thugs dgongs yongs/ su rdzogs par shog /mkhyen brtse nus gsum mthar phyin te/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par shog rdzu /na mo pad+ma sam+bha wa/ /rnam dag gdams zab ston pa'i bla ma dang / /dngos grub 'dod dgu stsol ba'i yi dam lha/ /bar chad ma lus/ se' ba'i mkha' gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so brtse bas bzung du gsol/ /bdas ni 'chi bar gyur pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /tshe 'dir zhen pa'i snang ba mi 'byung zhing / /zhing khams gzhan du 'pho ba'i dran 'dzin gyis/ /lus sems 'bral ba'i sdug bsngal med par shog /tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par gyur pa'i tshe/ /'ja' 'od gdugs dang me tog char pa 'babs rol mo

༄sha /dbyangs snyan glu gar tshogs mchod kyis/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mdun nas bsu bar shog /de tshe dran pa ma yengs bskyed rim gsal/rdzogs rim ting 'dzin snying po mngon gyur nas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi skur bzhengs te/ /ma nor lam la bdag nyid 'jug par shog /gal te las kyis 'khor bar ltung gyur na/ /dmyal ba'i sa phyogs yid 'ong gzhal yas khang / /dmyal srung rnams kyang snang stong lha yi sku/ /mnar med sdug bsngal bde bar 'char bar shog /rig 'dzin bla ma rnams kyis mtha' nas bsten/ /yi dam lha yis rgyab nas srog skyob cing / /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis phyi nas skyor/ /sanas gsum mkha' 'gros mdun nas bsu bar shog /nub phyogs u rgyan zangs mdog dpal

gyi ri/ /pad+ma 'od kyi spras pa'i gzhal yas su/ /rig 'dzin bla ma bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog der/ /pad+ma'i sbubs la rdzus te skye bar shog /skyesam thag tu rgyal sras pad+ma 'byung / /mngon sum zhal mjal yin par ngo shes nas/ /bcos ma min pa'i mos gus drag po yis/ /'bral med ting 'dzin rjes su 'dzin par shog /de tshe rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sras su bdag gyur nas/ /mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog /khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa/ /sdug bsngal chu bo che las myur sgrol nas/ /rnam grol thar ba'i gling du khrid nus pa'i/ /ded dpon thams cad mkhyen pa bdag gyur cig /bslu

༄lha /med dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi nus mthu dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus / /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas der 'grub par shog /dus gsum bde gshegs sangs rgyas ma lus pa/ /chos nyid mngon sum rang snang rdo rje'i sku/ /'ja' 'od thig le lug rgyud ye shes lnga/ /ma nor dran 'dzin rang snang chos kyi sku/ /'od gsal ma bu rang ngo 'phrod par shog /'di nas shi 'phos pho brang pad+ma can/ /o rgyan pad+ma'i zhabs drung der skyes nas/ /zab mo chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /'gro rnams bde la 'god par byin gyis rlobs/ /gu ru pa/da 'byung khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams sogs/ /khyed kyi mtshan mchog
bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog /
rog /bde ba can gyi smon lam zab lam dbang gi cha lag bzhugs so/ /

༄ga /bcom ldan shākya'i rgyal po'i zhing 'di nas: nub phyos gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed: rdzogs sangs rgyasakyi zhing khams bde ba can: khrag khrig phrag brgya 'das pa'i pha rol na: zhing khams skyon med rnam dag bde ba can: sa gzhi thams cad rin chen rang bzhin te: lag mthil ltar mnyam gcong rong med pa'i gnas: me tog pad+ma'i tshogs kyis rab brgyan zhing : blta bas mi ngoms mdzes shing yid du 'ong : zhing

mug /mchog de na lha mi'i ston pa ni: sku tshe dpag med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs: nyon mongs spangs shing smon lam dag nga/'i gnas: bdag dang 'gro kun zhing der skye bar shog: dag gsal bkra ba'i zhing khams bde ba can: rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'byin: 'tsho ba'i yo byad ji ltar bsam pa bzhin: 'bad rtsol med par legs par 'byung ba'i gnas: zhing mchog de na sems can ngan song dang : lha ma yin dang gshin rje'i ming yang med: de na phal ba'i bud med yod ma yin: mngal na gnas pa'ang yod pa ma yin no: rin chen rnams kyi me tog pad+ma las: brdzu sa te skye ba'i rang bzhin sha stas go: mi dge spangs shing smon lam dag pa'i gonas:

bdag dang 'gro kun zhing der skye bar shog: rnam dag 'od gsal zhing khams bde ba can: zhing der skyes pa'i sems can thams cad la:na tsha la sogs sdug bsngal gtan mi 'byung : zhing der skyes nas ngan song ltung mi srid: mi khom gnas su skye ba'ang mi srid do: zhing der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams: tshe lo dpag tu med par sku bzhugs nas: skye ba du mar byang sems sar gnas te: spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad bzhed ma gtogs pa: skye ba gcig rjes rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cig: tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs smon lam dag pa'i zhing :bdag dang 'gro kun zhing der skye bar shog /thub pas bsngags pa'i zhing khams khyad par can: bde ba can gyi rin chen pho brang na: sku tshe

mug /dpag med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs: tshe dpag med mgon g.ya sa na spyan ras gzigs: byams dang snying rjes 'gro ba kun la gzigs: mgon po'i g.yon na byang sems mthu chen thob: dri med bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad: rgyal ba'i 'khor gzhan yon tan phun tshogs shing : ye shes cher rgyas bams gyis mi khyab bzhugs: bdag ni nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnas ngan rnams su nam yang mi gol bar: lha ma/chog khyed kyi zhal mthong sngon bsus nas: bde ba can gyi zhing der skye bar shog: pad+ma las 'khrungs dam chos nyan gyurazhing : rgyal bas lung bstan mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thob: sems can thams cad zhing mchog dam pa der: bdag gis 'dren pa'i rten

'brel 'grig par shog: de ltar bdag gi smon lam bzang po 'di: bla ma mchog dang mgon po spyan ras gzigs: 'khor bcas la sogs rgyal dang rgyal ba yi: sras mchog rnams kyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol: nub zangs mdzod dmar ngo nas/sprul sku rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyi sater ma'o//sa rba maco lo/
tshog /rigs lnga'i zhing khams su smon lam 'debs pa bzhugs so/ /

༄sha /shar phyogs mngon pa dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod rgyal po 'od dpag med/ /bdag gzhan 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /mi bskyod rgyal po'i zhabs drung skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu sa bcur rab bsgrod nas/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog /lho phyogs rin chen brtsegasapa'i zhing khams su/ /bcom ldan rin 'byung rgyal po 'od dpag med/ /bdag gzhan 'di nas tshe 'phos

༄ga /gyur ma thag /rin 'byung rgyal po'i zhabs drung skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab bsgrod nas/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shos /nub phyogs pad+ma brtsegs pa'i zhing khams su/ /bcom ldan snang mtha'i rgyal po 'od dpag med/ /bdag gzhan 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /snang mtha'i rgyal po'i zhabs drung skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab bsgrod nas/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog /byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams su/ /bcom ldan don grub rgyal po 'od dpag med/ /bdag gzhan 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /don grub rgyal po'i zhabs drung skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab bsgrod nas/ /sprul pas phyogs

bcur gzhan don byed par shog /dbus phyogs g.yo ba med pa'i zhing khams su/ /bcom ldan rnam snang rgyal po 'od dpas med/ /bdag gzhan 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /rnam snang rgyal po'i zhabs drung skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab bsgrod nas/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog /spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan stengs su/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po tshe dpag med/ /bdag gzhan 'di nas tshe 'phros gyur ma thag /bka' brgyud bla ma'i zhabs drung skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu sa bcu rab bsgrod nas/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas/

tshog /rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /de yang bdag gis lung bstan rab thob nas/ /sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /blo yis stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang / /sems can rnams la phan pa mang byed shog /
sngag /mdo nas gsungs pa'i smon lam rkang gnyis ma bzhugs so/ /

༄ga /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyobs pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /tshul khrims

༄sha /pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// /ji ltar bcom ldan tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ /bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /bzod nga 'i pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan bzod pa'i pha rol phyin/ /bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan bsam gtan pha rol phyin/ /bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar

shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan shes rab pha rol phyin/ /bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /thabs kyi pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan thabs kyi pha rol phyin/ /bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /stobs kyi pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan stobs kyi pha rol phyin/ /bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /smon lam pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan smon lam pha rol phyin/ /bdag

༄ga /gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /ye shes pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan ye shes pha rol phyin/ /bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /chos sku'i pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan chos sku'i pha rol phyin/ /bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar smon bzhin 'grub gyur cig /༵༵ kārdo ༵ dkon ma chog brtsegs pa chen po chos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las le'u bcu gcig pa/ 'phags pa 'od zer kun tu bkye ba bstan pa zhes bya ba nas bshad nga 'i smon lam las byungs pa 'o/
sngag /zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las:sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ra mda' sbran pa'i smon lam 'jigs pa rang grol bzhugs so:

jog /rang 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe'am nam yang bya ste: sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnam ra ma da' sbran pa ni: dkon mchog gsu ma la dngos su 'byor pa dang : yid kyis sprul nga 'i mchod pa 'bul: lag tu spos dri zhim po thogs te: gdung ba'i shugs drag ngo sa 'di ska da do: (1gas bcu na bzhu/gas pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje dang ldan pa: mkhyen pa dang ldan pa: spyan dang ldan pa: brtse ba dang ldan pa: 'gro ba'i skyabs su gyur pa rnams thugs rje'i dbang bis gnas 'dir byon

༄sha /cig: dngos su 'byor pa dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa bzhes shig: thugs rje can khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes: brtse ba'i thugs rje: mdzad pa'i phrin lasaḥ skyobs pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ thugs rje can khyed rnams kyis che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di ni:'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du ni 'gro: 'jig rten 'di ni bor: skyes chen po ni 'degs: grogs ni med: sdug bsngal ni che: skyabs ni med: mgon ni med: dpung gnyen ni med: tshe 'di'i snang ba ni nub: 'gro ba gzhan du ni 'gro: mun nag 'thug por ni 'jug: g.yang sa chen por ni lhung : nags khrod 'thug por ni 'jug: las kyi dbang gis ni ded: dgon pa chen por ni 'gro: rgya

mtsho chen pos ni khyer: las kyi rlung gis ni bdas: sa tshugs med pa'i phyogs su ni 'gro: g.yul ngor chen por ni 'jugaci ngagadon che na pos ni zin: gshin rje'i pho nya la ni 'jigs shing skrag: las kyi srid na yang srid pa la ni 'jug: dbang ni med: gcig pur grogs med par 'gro dgos pa'i dus la bab na: thugs rje can khyed rnams kyis/ che be+e mo skyabs med pa 'di la skyabs mdzod cig: mgon mdzod cig: dpung gnyen mdzod cig: bar do'i mun nag chen po las skyobs shig: las kyi rlung dmar chen po las zlog cig: gshin rje'i 'jigs skrag chen po las skyobs shig: bar do'i 'phrang ring chen po las sgrol cig: thugs rje can khyed rnams thugs rje ma chung zhig: ra mda' mdzod cig:

༄ho /ngan song gsum du ma gtong zhig: sngon gyi dam bca' ma g.yel bar thugs rjes shugs myur du phyungs shig: sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams che ge mo 'di la thugs rje thabs dang nus pa ma chung zhig: thugs rjes zungs shig: sems can las ngan pa'i dbang du ma btang zhig: dkon mchog gsum gyis bar do'i sdug bsngal las bskyab tu gsol: zhes mos gus drag po'i sgo nas bdag gzhan thams cad kyis lan gsu ma dubya'o: de nas bar do thos grol dang : bar do 'phrang sgrol ma dang : 'jigs skyobs ma'i smon la ma rnams btab par bya'o: sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnam sa ra mda' spran pa'i smon la: 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du ma rdzogs so: sa ma ya: zhes o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad de: mtsho rgyal gyi zin bris su bris nas kurma gling pas sgam ngo dpal gyi ri bo nas gdan drangs pa'o:
tshog /zabs chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: bar do drug gi rtsa tshig bzhugs so/ /

jug /kye ma bdag la skye gnas bar do 'char dus 'dir: tshe la long med le lo spangs byas nas: thos bsam sgom gsum ma yengs lam la 'jug: snang sems lam slong sku gsum mngon gyur bya: mi lus lan gcig thob pa'i dus tshod 'dir: yengs ma lam la sdod pa'i dus tshod min: kye ma: bdag la rmi lam bar do 'char dus 'dir: gti mug ro nyal bag med spangs byas nas: dran pa yengs med gnas

tshog /lugs ngang la 'jug: mi lam bzung nas sprul bsgyur 'od gsal sbyang : dud 'gro bzhin du nyal bar ma byed cig: gnyid dang mngon sum 'dres pa'i nyams len mdzod: kye ma: bdag la bsam gtan bar do 'char dus 'dir: rnam g.yengs 'khrul pa'i tshogs rnams spangs byas nas: yengs med 'dzin med mtha' bral ngang la 'jog: bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brtan pa thob par bya: bya ba spangs nas rtse gcig bsgom dus 'dir: nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i dbang du ma gtang zhig: kye ma: bdag la 'chi kha bar do 'char dus 'dir:kun la chags sems zhen 'dzin spangs byas nas: gdams ngag gsal ba'i ngang la ma yengs 'jug: rang rig skye med nam mkha'i dbyings

su 'pho: 'dus byas sha khrag lus dang bral la khad: mi rtag sgyu ma yin par shes par bya: kye ma: bdag la chos nyid bar do 'char dus 'dir: kun la sngangs skrag 'jigs snang spangs byas nas: gang shar rang snang rig pa ngo shes 'jug: bar do'i snang tshul yin par shes par bya: don chen 'gags la thug pa'i dus shis/ 'ong : rang snang zhi khro'i tshogs la ma 'jigs shig: kye ma: bdag la srid pa bar do 'char dus 'dir: 'dun pa rtse gcig sems la bzung byas nas: bzang po las kyi 'phro la nan gyis mthud: mngal sgo dgag nas ru los dran par bya: snying rus dag snang dbos pa'i dus shig yin: mig ser spangs la bla ma yab yum bsgom: 'chi ba 'ong snyam med pa'i blo ring

༄gi /po: don med tshe 'di'i bya ba bsgrub sgrubs nas: da res stong log byas na shin tu 'khrul: dgos ngo shes pa dam pa'i lha chos yin:da lta nyid du lha chos mi byed dam: drin chen bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs: bla ma'i gdams ngag sems la ma bzhag na: rang gis rang nyid bslu bar mi 'gyur ram: zhes gsungs so: bar do thos grol rtsa tshig 'di: 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du ma rdzogs so:
rog /zabs chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi smon lam bzhugs so/ /

༄gi /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: brtse ba chen pos lam sna drang du gsol: bdag ni 'khrul pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: thos bsam sgom gsum ma yengs 'od lam la: bka'abargyud bla ma rnams kyis lam sna drongs: yum mchog mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: gti mug drag

༄ga /po'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: chos dbyings ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad lam sna drongs:yum mchog dbyings phyug ma yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: zhe snang drag po'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: me long ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas lam sna drongs: yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan mas rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: nga rgyal drag po'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rin chen 'byung

ldan lam sna drongs: yum mchog mā ma ku yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: 'dod chags drag po'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: sor rtogs ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas kyis lam sna drongs: yum mchog gos dkar mo yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: phrag dog drag po'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan don yod grub pas lam sna drongs: yum mchog dam tshig sgrol mas rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol:

༄sha /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: bag chags drag po'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: lhan skyes ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: dpa' bo rig 'dzin rnams kyis lam sna drongs: yum mchog mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: 'khrul snang drag po'i 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: dngangs skrag 'jigs snang spangs pa'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan zhi khro'i tshogs kyis lam sna drongs: dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las/ bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: kye ma: nam mkha'i khams rnams/

dgra ru mi ldang zhing : sangs rgyas mthing kha'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: chu yi khams rnams dgra ru mi ldang zhing : sangs rgyas dkar po'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: sa yi khams rnams dgra ru mi lda nga zhing : sangs rgyas ser po'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: me yi khams rnams dgra ru mi ldang zhing : sangs rgyas dmar po'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: rlung gi khams rnams dgra ru mi ldang zhing : sangs rgyas ljang khu'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: 'ja' tshon khams rnams dgra ru mi ldang zhing : sangs rgyas sna tshogs zhing khams mthong bar shog:sgra 'od zer gsum dgra ru mi ldang zhing : zhi khro rab 'byams zhing khams mthong bar shog: sgra rnams thams cad rang sgrar shes nga/ra shog:

༄sha /'od rnams thams cad rang 'od shes par shog: zer rnams thams cad rang zer shes par shog: bar do rang ngo rang gis shes par bye/gā spya: sku gsum zhing khams mngon du 'gyur bar shog: bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi smon lam zhes bya ba o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa : 'khor ba ma stong bar du ma
tshog /zabs chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol las: bar do'i smon lam 'jigs skyob ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

sngag /kye ma: bdag ni tshe yi 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe: 'jig rten 'di nas nye dus mi stong ste: rang nyid gcig pur bar dor 'khyams tsa na: rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs rje'i shugs phyungs nas: ma rig mun pa'i smagarum sel bar shog: dga' ba'i grogs dang bral nas gcig pur 'khyams: rang snang stong pa'i gzugs brnyan 'char dus der: sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs rje'i shugs phyungs nas: dngangs skrag bar do'i

sngag /'jigs pa mi 'byung shog: ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lnga 'char dus der: mi 'jigs mi skrag rang ngo shes par shog: zhi dang khro bo'i sku gzugs 'char dus der: mi 'jigs gdeng thob bar do ngo shes shog: las ngan dbang gi sdug bsngal myong tsa na: rgyal ba zhi khro'i sdug bsngal sel bar shog: chos nyid rang sgra 'brug stong ldir tsa na: theg chen chos kyi sgra ru 'gyur bar shog: skyabs med las kyi rjes su 'brang dus der: rgyal ba zhi khro'i bdag sogs bskyab tu gsol: bag chags las kyi sdug bsngal myong tsa na: 'od gsal bde ba'i ting 'dzin 'char bar shog: srid pa bar dor brdzus te skyes tsa na: phyir log bdud kyi lung bstan mi 'byung shog: gang du bsam pa dbang gis sleb

tsa na: las ngan 'khrul pa'i 'jigs skrag mi 'byung shog: gcan gzan khro bo'i ngar skad 'don pa'i tshe: yi ge drug pa'i chos sgrar 'gyur bar shog: kha char rlung dang mun pas ded pa'i tshe: ye shes gsal ba'i lha mig mthong bar shog: rigs mthun nang tshan bar do'i sems can rnams: mig ser med cing mtho ris skye bar shog: shin tu nyon mongs bkres shing skom pa'i tshe: ltogs skom tsha grang sdug bsngal mi 'byung shog: phyi ma pha ma'i 'di 'phrod mthong tsa na: rgyal ba zhi khro yab yum nyid mthong shog: gar skyes rang dbang thob nas gzhan don du: mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lus mchog thob pa shog: bdag nyid skyes pa'i lus mchog thob gyur nas: mthong thos thams cad myur du

)sto /grol bar shog: las ngan thams cad rjes su mi 'brang zhing : bsod nams gang yod 'phel zhing rjes 'brang shog: gang dang gang du skye ba de dang der: tshe rabs yi dam lha dang mjal bar shog: skyes ma thag tu smra zhing 'gro shes te: skye ba dran cing mi brjed gzungs thob shog: yon tan che chung 'bring dang sna tshogs pa: thos bsam mthong ba tsam gyis shes gyur cig: gang du skye ba'i yul der bkra shis shog:sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig: rgyal ba zhi khro khyed sku ci 'dra dang : 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang : khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba: de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog: kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams thugs rje dang : chos nyid

rnam par dag pa'i bden stobs dang : sngags 'chang rtse gcig bsgrub pa'i byin rlabs kyis: smon lam btab pa de bzhin 'grub gyur cig: bar do'i smon lam 'jigs skyobs ma zhes bya ba 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du ma rdzogs so: maṅga lo:
sngag /zhi khro'i dbang sogs kyi mtshams sbyor puṇ+ḍa ri ba'i do shal bzhugs so/ /

sngag /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las r+ghaṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du khaṃ las gshin bdud lan chags kyi gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ o āḥtsū hoḥ lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bhu ta a kun ya dzaḥ lan gsum / zhi drag spel mar bcas bsngo bas btang / na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs khyad par sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs

༄gi /sprul pa yang sprul bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa la brten nas/ deng 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la rigs drug gnas 'dren gyi dbang dang / yon tan yar ldan gyi dbang bskur zab mo skur bar byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po dam sri gnod byed kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad/ deng 'dir dmigs yul tshe dus las 'das pa 'di gson gyi dus na gnas byed kyi tshe srog la bar du gcod cing gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyang ba dang sa dang lam la bar du gcod pa'i srog gcod kyi gshed ma 'chi khar dbugs sdud cing phung po la bdag tu 'dzin pa gshin po gnas mi bde zhing gson po

bkra mi shis par byed pa yar mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs byed cing / mar 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sna 'dren pa/ bar rigs drug gi g.yang sa nyam nga bar skyur ba'i gting rdo byed pa'i za 'dre shi gshed srog gcod dbugs len shi mig gson la lta bar byed pa khyed rnams 'dir ma gnas par rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro na bdag nyid 'khor 'das kun gyi spyi dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi khro mtshon 'jigs rung bzod par dka' ba'i tshogs chen po 'phros pas khyod rang gi lnga phung nyams nyes su gyur ta re/ drag sngags gu gul bdug cing thun gyis gzir la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badz+ra tsakra dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa ha la ha la hūm̐/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs kyi rjes su/ srog gcod gshed ma'i rigs su

༄sha /gyur pa thams cad phyir bskrad/ 'od zer dang khro tshogs rnams tshur 'dus/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad gur thabs su 'khrigs pa'i mi phyed rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba de'i nang du tshe dus la sa 'das pa ming gzugs dri ma'i rten la rnam par shes pa bag phebs te chos nyan par gyur/ 'o/ 'jig rten 'di nas/ pha rol du tshe dus las 'das pa khyod shi ba yin no/ /de'ang khyod gcig pu shi'am snyams na ma yin te/ phyi snod gyi 'jig rten gling bzhi gling pon brgyad/ lhun po nyi zla dang bcas pa'ang mi rtag cing 'jig dgos pa dang / nang bcud kyi sems can srid pa'i rtse mo nas mnar med pa'i bar rgyu ba 'di thams cad mi rtag cing 'chi dgos pa ni/ mdo rgya che

rol pa las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ma'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi ga ral lta dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste / /ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro/ /zhes gsung zhing spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang / bye brag bsod nams dang ye shes las grub pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i sku brnyes pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa de yang mthar mi rtag pa'i tshul ston pa dang / khams gsum gyi 'ching ba'i dgra thams cad bcom pa nyan thos dang rang rgyal chen po rnams kyang mi rtag pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yang mi rtag na/ rang cag gi chur bur lta bu'i lus 'di 'jig pa la lta ci smos/ ji

sngag /ltar mi rtag na/ mdza' ba'i bshes/ rtsig pa'i mkhar/ 'brel ba'i gnyen/ bsags pa'i nor/ gang gis kyang mi phan par 'chi dgos/de lta bu'i 'chi ba'i go rim ni ji ltar 'ong snyam na/ bdag cag gi mi tshe'i nyi ma ni yun thung / 'chi bdag gi bdud po ni bang mgyogs/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ngan ni grangs mang ma tshor yengs ma lam gyi ngang du 'chi ba zhes bya ba nam mkha'i thog mgo thog tu bab pa bzhin du 'gyur la/ de thabs gang gis bzlog pa'i mthu med de/ srog gcod kyi nad de 'tsho byed sman pas mi sos/ 'chi bdag gi gshin rje ni gza' khyab 'jug gi mdung thung gis mi zlog /las kyi rnam par smin pa ni dpal phyag na rdo rje'i nus pas mi khog /de ltar 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa na/ zas kyi

za 'phro/ gos kyi gon 'phro/ las kyi byed 'phro/ nyal mal du gces pa'i sgyu lus dang bcas pa dbang med du bsgyur/ brtse ba'i pha/ byams pa'i ma / snying sdug gi bu/ tshe rog gi chung ma/ bsags pa'i nor thams cad la'ang mig gi lta ba'i dbang tsam yang med par 'chi dgos pa khyod kyi thog tu babs pas go bar gyis shig /de'ang 'chi ba'i rtags kyi 'khrul snang ni 'di ltar 'byung ste/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/'byung ba log pa'i sgra bzhi 'jigs snang gsum/ /ma nges rtags rnams sna tshogs 'char ba'i tshe/ /zhes gsungs pas phyi ltar sa chu la thim nas/nang gzugs sgra la thim pas mig gi gzugs mi mthong / lus bsgul bskyod mi nus/ chu me la thim pas phyi nang gi gsher ba'i cha thams cad

༄sha /skam/ rna bas sgra mi thos/ me rlung la thim pas lus kyi drod yal/ snas dri mi tshor/ rlung rnam shes la thim pas spyi bo nas khams dkar po thur du babs pas phyir rtags su zla ba lta bu'i dkar lam pa dang / zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa so gsum 'gags/ lte 'og nas rak+ta gyen du phyur bas nyi ma lta bu'i dmar lam pa dang / 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gags/ dkar dmar snying gar 'dres pas mun nag stug po lta bu'i nag lam pa dang / gti mug gi rtogs pa bdun 'gags/ de nas rnam shes dbu mar thim pas rtog med du lhan gyis 'gro ba la / 'khrul rtog ma skyes kyi bar goms 'dris yod med gnas cha ring thung la rag las so/ /de nas brgyal ba las sangs ba tsam na 'khrul snang

gi mgo 'dzugs pa yin no/ /de yang rang ngo ma shes pas slar yang bar do'i lus blangs te shi ba ni mi shes/ nye 'brel shul mi rnams kyi mya ngan dang du chom byas pas ni ma bzod/ de dag gi drung du phyin nas gtam smras kyang mi mthong mi thos/ slar yang sdug bsngal gyis ni gdung / nyi zla dang skar ma la sogs pa rnams kyi gzugs dang 'od mi mthong phyogs thams cad bskal pa'i mun nag lta bus khyab pa mthong / las kyi rlung dmar drag pos ni rgyab nas ded/ gshin rje'i skyes bu rnams kyis mdun nas bsu/ sod cig rgyob cig gi sgra drag po ni thos/ mtshon cha'i char pa ni skar mda' 'khrug pa ltar babs/ 'jigs skrag gi sdug bsngal chen po ni mthong / mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen ni med/ rten

)sto /med gnas med du 'khyams/ zas nor dang nye 'brel rnams la chags/ sngon gyi khang khyim la sogs pa rnams su rmi lam bzhin du 'khyams nas zas nor rnams bzhan gyis spyod pa mthong bas zhe snang drag po me ltar 'bar/ yid kyi lus dang dri tsam gyi zas la brten cing gnas nges med du 'khyams/ ci zhig na 'jigs skrag gis bskyod de rang dbang med par 'gro/ gzhan yang ri rab bsnyil ba dang / rgya mtsho chen po 'phyo ba dang / bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba lta bu'i 'ur sgra dang / bskal pa'i 'thor rlung drag po g.yo ba lta bu'i nyams dang / bar bar du dug gsum gyi rang gzugs las grub pa'i 'khrul snang skya chad de ba/ dmar zeng nge ba/ nag ngam me ba sogs 'char yang / de rnams

'khrul snang kho na ma gtogs bden par grub pa cung zad tsam yang med pa ni/ rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med pas gang la'ang ma/ 'jigs ma skrag par tshe 'di'i pha ma/ spun zla/ mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun/ rgyu zas longs spyod gang la yang chags zhen gyi 'khri ba rbad kyid chod la/ bslu med dkon mchog gsum dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs la blo rtse gcig tu gsol ba thob cig /khyod rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i 'ja' 'od kha dog lnga ldan gyi dbus na sku mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi rang bzhin lham me/ gsung grags stong rdo rje'i chos sgra lhang nge / thugs gsal stong ye shes rnam

༄sha /mkhyen gyi rang bzhin lhan ner khyod rang la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs par mos la gsol ba rtse gcig tu thob cig /de nas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ swā bha wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las o las rin po che'i snod du baṃ las 'dod yon glud kyi gtor ma rigs drug so so'i gang la gang 'dod kyi longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po gcig tu gyur/ oṃ āḥlha/ sbri: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga so gas/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du yi dam sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ sa bzhi spos chus sogs de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du sa/sol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ e ma/ mgon po thugs rje can: bdag 'dra'i sem/sa can 'khor

bar 'khyams: log pa'i lam du zhugs lags pas: bde chen thar pa'i lam ston 'tshal: dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug tu gsol: de skad sasol ba btab rjes slob dpon gyis: kye ma tshe 'das bu khyod legs par nyon: 'khor ba'i gnas nas thar pa'i grong 'jug na: tshe 'di'i 'bras bu don du gnyer mi bya: 'jig rten tshe 'di'i don du gnyer bas na: pha rol thar pa'i 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur: 'jig rten pha rol gzhan don gnyer bas na: 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras rang don 'grub: de phyir pha rol gzhan don gnyer bar gyis: ces gsungs slar yang gsol ba gdab pa ni: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang : rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gang : byang chub sems kyang bdag la

༄sha /stsol: thun mong dang ni khyad par gyi: skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol: rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du: mgon pos bdag ni 'jug tu gsol: de skad zhus pa'i lan du slob dpon gyis: rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni: shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon:brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs: dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin mi rlobs: zhes nga sa nyan nga ra brtul nas spro ba bskyed: bu khyod shin tu skal ba bzang : gang gi sgyu 'phrul zhi khro yi: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal na: nyams chag kun kyang byang bar 'gyur: mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang byang : na raka gnas kyang dong sprugs te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags: rang bzhin sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor la: gang

zhig gus pas phyag 'tshal na: nyams chag kun kyang byang bar 'gyur: dam tshig skongs nas dngos grub thob: de phyir spro ba'i sems kyis legs par nyon: de nas skyabs su 'gro ba la/ de yang chos la 'jug pa'i rtsa ba ni skyabs su 'gro ba yin pas med du mi rung zhing thog mar bla ma dang sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad snang stong gnyis med kyi rang bzhin du gsal la skyid sdug legs nyes mtho dman cir 'gyur yang yid khyed shes kyi dad pas 'di bzhin du rjes zlos mdzod / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams: tshe 'das bdag la dgongs su gsol: rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang : zhi ba

༄ga /chags bral dam pa'i chos: tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la: 'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa khyad par skyabs su 'gro ba ni: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: 'di bzung bla med byang chub bar: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: dpa' bo dpa' mo chos skyong bcas: byang sems rdo rje slob dpon la: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ de lta bu'i skyabs su song ba'i phan yon ni/ lung las/ skyabs song 'di la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha' 'di yang snod du chung / /rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter / /phul la ga6nal bas zad mi nus/ /thenis gsungs so/ /de skad brjod pa'i rjes la sdom pa bzung / thog mar so thar sdom pa bzung ba niḥ sems bskyed ldan pas bdas gis

rjes zlos mdzod: de nas rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir phyi so sor thar pa'i sdom pa bzung ba dang / nang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa smon pa dang 'jug pa'i rim pa rnams tshul bzhin du bzung ngo snyam du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma kun bzang spyan snga ru: lus ngag yid kyis gzhan rnams la: gnod pa las zlog dge ba sgrub: dge tshul dge slong byang chub sems: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la: rgyun du gnas shing dge ba bsgom: sdom pa yongs su bzung bar bgyi: ces pas lan gsum so thar sdom pa bzung ba ni: de nas smon nga sems bskyed blang bya ste: hoḥ bla ma kun bzang dgongs su gsol: 'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar: 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: ma dang bu yis 'du shes kyis: ma bsgral ba

༄ga /rnams bsgral ba dang : ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang : dbugs ma phyungs rnams dbugs dbyung phyir: smon pa byang chub sems bskyed do: de rjes 'jug pa'i sems bskyed blang ba niḥ sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang : sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar: 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs bar: bla med 'jug pa'i byang chub sems: tshe 'das bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: phar phyin drug la bslab cing bsgrub: brtson 'grus dag gis thams cad bsgral: kun don tshul khrims gsum yang bzung : bdag gis sems bskyed sdom bzung nas: ma grol dgrol dang ma bsgral bsgral: dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god: ces brjod de rjes dam tshig blang ba ni: de nas gsang ba rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig la rigs lnga spyi

dang so so'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du blangs la bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos ma/dzod: dkon mchog gsum ni mi spang ngo : rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang : byang chub sems ni spangs mi bya: rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu: sbyin pa rnam/ bzhi rtag tu sbyin: pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu: theg pa gsum gyi chos rnams bshad: las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu: 'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya: de bzhin rigs kyi dam tshig tu: dkyil 'khor gsum dang 'bral mi bya: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun: ma lus bdag gis yongs su bzung : ces pa sa dam tshig sdom pa 'bogs rnams suḥde nas tshe 'das lha ru bskyed pa ni:ro'am rus pa'am ni mtshan byang la: o dz+ra shrī he ru ka u tsa ta ya phaṭa: ces brjod bgegs

༄sha /baspa da de nas skad cig gis: slob ma'i chas 'dzin mtshan byang rdor sems kyi: thugs kur zla steng hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor: yig brgya bzlas pas sdig sgrib dag pazag bas34: spun bajo( satwa sa myos sogs/ de nas bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor khri mthon po la rgyan gyis brgyan la bzhugs: slob ma mu ge'i bskal nga las thar bu'i phyir 'bru lnga'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul la zhu ba ni: kye hoḥbla ma 'gro ba'i mgon: bdag cag skal ldan bu slob la: dkyil 'khor chen ngo/'i shar phyogs su: bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol: zhes lan gsum zhu: der bla mas/zhes gsol ba btab pas la skongs te skal ba dang lda na pa khyod la 'bod do gnang ba sbyin pa ni: dzagrir shog ṭaḥr shog rigs kyi bu: da ni bdag gis khyod smin bya: zhes brjod: de nas skabs 'dir rigs mthun gyi 'gros ltar dbang gi sdod rung du bya ba ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ 'o/ khyed rang la ye

shes pa phab pa'i don ni/ rtsal rdzogs chen po'i rgyud las/ gsang sngags seng ge'i 'o ma 'dra/ /rin chen gser snod ma lags pas/ /snod gzhan phal par blug gyur na/ /snod kyang chag la bcud kyang zag /snod bcud gnyis ka ma rang 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa ma sbyang bar gsang sngags zab mo'i dbang bskur du mi rung zhing bskur yang mi chags pas/ ye gdod ma nas snod gzhal yas khang dang bcud yi dam gyi lha tshogs rtog tshogs chos nyid kyi rol par gnas pa yin te/ de ltar ma shes pa'i gang zag la yin tshul ngo sprod pa'i phyir dam tshig ye shes gnyis med du rgyas gdab pa ni ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum chu 'thor zhing / oṃ

༄sha /badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bha wa sosas/ slob dpon kun bzang rdor sems zhi khro rab 'byams kun 'dus kyi thugs ma'i 'od kyis slob ma'i lurme sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin chen khri rkang pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpa' dkar gsal zhal gcig 'dzum bcas bzhad pa phyag gnyis g.yas rig stong rdo rje thugs kur 'dzin cing g.yon snang sto nga dril bu dkur brten pa/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan sogs longs spyod rdzogs skur dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyangs g.yon skum rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i thugs chos dbyings khyab gdal gyi klong du rang sems ka dag

rigs mdangs zhal phyag gi rnam pa kun bzang yab yum la 'khor ye shes lnga yi rang 'od rigs lnga yab yum bcu/ sems dpa' brgyad/sems ma brgyad/ thub pa drug /sgo ba yab yum brgyad dang bcas pa'i rtsal mdangs las klad pa dung khang 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang 'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i klong du che mchog yab yum la khrag 'thung khro bo yab yum bcu/ kau rī ma brgyad/ seng ha ma brgyad/ sgo ma bzhi/ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad sogs zhi khro la sa rigs brgya dang / mgrin par rig 'dzin dpa' bo yab yum bcu rnams gsal ba'i sku'i gnas gsum du o āḥlha gsum dang rang rang gi thugs srog sa bon 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams thams

༄sha /cad char sprin gtibs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib du thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ lhaḥ chos dbyings ka dag pho brang nas: kun bzang yab yum byin gyis rlobs: 'og min spros bral pho brang nas: rdo rje sems dpas byin gyis rlobs: snang shar mdzes pa'i pho brang nas: dga' rab rdo rjes byin gyis rlobs: pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: o/ rgyan pad+mas byin gyis rlobs: mchims phu bre gu'i brag phug nas: mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal byin gyis rlobs: gar bzhugs chos kyi pho brang nas: rtsa ba'i bla mas byin gyis rlobs: rang snang rtsa yi pho brang nas: rgyal ba zhi khros byin gyis rlobs: mkha' spyod rnam dag pho brang nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs: gdug pa 'dul/ ba'i
