pho brang nas: chos skyong dam can byin gyis rlobs: sgam po gdal ri'i gter gnas nas: gter bdag gter srung byin gyis rlobs: yi dam lha tshogs ya la la: mkha' 'gro ma tshogs thibs se thib: byin rlabs na bun ya la la: dngos grub char bzhin si li li: nyams dang rtogs pa 'u ru ru: snang ba shes pa ban ma bun: rig pa ye shes sha ra ra: gnas lugs rtogs pa shigs se shig: ka dag chen por byin gyis rlobs: rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: dzaḥbhū baṃ hoḥsanyis su med par bsgom/ oṃ āḥrgyu gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī sarba sirnyi pha la :: ces dang / o āḥsbyi bo dhe tsit+ta sogs dzab bzlas/ e ma hoḥbla ma kun bzang rigs

༄sha /lnga'i tshogs: sogs nas baṃ hoḥbar/ byin phab pa'i ye shes pa rnams ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du gnyis med ro gcig tu brtan par gyur cig /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swa hā/ de nas dkyil 'khor dal du 'jug pa ni: mtshan byang dkyil 'khor gyi sgor khyer la: de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba gnyis pa zhig chad de khyod rang gi lag pa nas bzung ste khrid nas shar sgo nas rim pa bzhin du rigs so so la mi phyed pa'i dad pas phyag dang skor ba byed pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /hūm̐ dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar gyi sgo: sogasanas / sha ya phaṭaḥ bar ro/ /de nas mtshan byang dar gyis gdong sayogs cing : lag tu cod paṇa thogs la 'di skad do: 'o 'di na bde gshegs zhi khro'i mkha' 'gro'i dkyi'

'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad ye shes rang snang las grub pas bzang ngan blangs dor ma mchis kyang rang gi rigs kyi lha/ las 'brel gang la phog pa de dag la thog med du dbab par bsam mo/ /de'i dgos pa ni/ slob dpon bi shwa mi tras/ mnyes dka' ma yin bkur gnas kyi/ /'jig rten mgon po'i chos lugs phyir/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar lha la phyag rten du rten 'brel gyi me tog dor zhig /lha: bdag cag rig pa'i me tog 'di: yi dam zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: sngon nas las 'phro gang yod pa'i: yi dam lha la 'bab par shog: pra ti dza hoḥ 'o de ltar rigs gang la phog pa'i lha las dras pa'i ming btags te me tog de nyid rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi cod paṇa du gyur nas khyod kyi

༄sha /ma go la bcings te ye shes lngas rgyas btab nas rigs gang yin pa de dag gi ngo bor sangs rgya ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /de nas mig dar dbye ba 'di skad do/ /'o khyod rang de sngon ma rig gnyis 'dzin gyis ldong ba de dag mtshon byed kyi mig dar 'di nyid bsal ba dang /mnyam du gnyis 'dzin ma rig pa srog tu bsal nas rig pa ye shes ngo bo ji lta bar gsal ba'i mos pa mdzod cig /kun bzang rigs lnga rdo rje sems: khyod kyi ma rig ldongs pa'i mig: ye shes spyan du dbye bar bya: de bzhin khyod kyis 'gro ba rnams: ye shes spyan tu dbye bar shog: o dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ ces brjod la mig dar bsal: de yi rjes la 'di skad brjod par bya:'o/ 'di ni ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i 'khor lo sgyu

'phrul zhi khro rol pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin shar ba yin te/ de'ang cung zad dbye na rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum klong rnam par dag pa 'og gzhi 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang rgyu rin po che sna lnga las grub pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi log brgyad rtsig pa rim pa lnga 'dod rnams pha gu drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab chos 'khor ri dwags gdugs dang bcas pa byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gzhal yas khang gi rnam par shar ba'i nang drag po'i gzhal yas khang lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad la sogs pa'i ka gdung dral phyam dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/

༄sha /yid ches rnam par dag pa kun bzang yab yum gnyis/ shar du rdo rje rigs kyi tshom bu drug /lhor rin chen rigs kyi tshom bu drug /nub tu pad+ma rigs kyi tshom bu drug /byang du las kyi rigs kyi tshom bu drug /phyogs bzhi steng 'og gnyis su 'gro 'dul gyi thub pa drug rnams rang rang si rtags dang mtshan mas gtso bo yab yum la zhal gzigs te bzhugs pa sgo bzhir sgo ba yab yum brgyad rnams zhal phyir gzigs te bar chad bsrung ba'i tshul mdzad pa ste/ de ltar rdo rje dbyings kyi lha zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis 'ja' 'od kha dog lnga ldan gyi dbus na bzhugs shing / steng gi nam mkhar chos dbyings me ri 'bar ba'i dbus su dpal chen po che mchog he ru ka la sogs pa ste 'bar ba khrag

'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad rnams khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa 'ja' 'od med dpung 'dres mar mched pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa 'di dag khyod rang gi tshe rabs las kyi 'brel ba'i lha yin pas ma sgom kyang skye ba bdun tshun chad la yi dam lha yi ngo bor 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyu yin pas spro bar gyis la dkyil 'khor la gzigs shig /kye ma tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: khyod ni sdig pa kun las grol:dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos: lus ngag yed kyis dad pa bskyed: rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs su skye: sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs: dngos grub thams cad khyod kyis thob: dam tshig sngags la brtson par gyis: bum dbang ni: slar yang bum dbang dngos zhu ba'i don du

༄sha /gsol 'debs rjes zlos mdzod/ kye hoḥ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che: bdag cag skal ldan slob bu la: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi:bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol: lan gsum/ 'o/ de yang spros bcas bum pa'i dbang chen po bskur ba la/ bum dbang gi brda don ni/lo paṇa bka' thang las/ bum ni snying ngo/ 'od kyi bum/ /pa ni chos dbyings skye ba med/ /byed las sems can don byed cing / /ma 'gags sprul sku rgyun mi chad/ /zhes gsungs/ spyir bum pa la chos dbyings mi 'gyur ba'i bum pa kun rdzob mtshan ma'i bum pa/ 'dus byas rtags kyi bum pa/ btags pa ming gi bum pa dang bzhi yod pa las 'dir 'dus byas rtags kyi bum pa la brten te/ don chos dbyings mi 'gyur ba'i

rgyas 'debs pa yin pas/ de ltar dbus kyi rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba spyi bor bzhag la/ sbyi: bum pa 'di ni gzhal yas khang : nang na zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog rnams: slob bu khyod la phab pa yis: phung khams lha dang lha mor gyur: bskyed rim lha dbang thob par shog: o āḥbhū sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa sa: i āḥtsū hri swā hāḥ'o rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la bum pa 'dis dbang bskur bas: phyi snod thams cad gzhal yas khang du shes pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: bum chus dbang bskur bas nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad lha dang lha mor shes pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: phyag

༄sha /mtshan lngas dbang bskur bas bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: kha rgyan gyis dbang bskur bas 'bras bu myur du smin pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: mgul chings kyis dbang bskur bas gzhan don 'bad med 'grub pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: gzungs thag rdo rjes dbang bskur bas sdom pa gsum dang dam tshig mthar phyin pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: bum chus dbang bskur bas rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi khams dag nas bskyed rdzogs zung du 'brel ba'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: 'o ma bum rdzas dang bcas pas dbang bskur bas rang don mthar phyin nas gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyis bskal pa ma stongs kyi bar du

'gro ba sems can thams cad 'dren pa'i dpal mgon dam par gyur cig: gzungs thag rnam lngas dbang bskur bas sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i sdug bsngal las skyobs par gyur cig: bum chu gtsang mas dbang bskur bas thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i chu rgyun mi chad cing stong nyid snying rje dang 'brel ba'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig: bum pa rgyan bkod pa gzi byin can/ bla ma yab yum rol mo rgyan dang bcas pas dbang bskur ba la brten nas zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin pa'i dbang dang dngos grub dam pa thob par gyur cig: dbang bar gyur cig: gsal bar gyur cig: mched par gyur cig: 'bar bar gyur cig: rgyas par gyur cig: dbang

sngag /du gyur cig: smin grol reg cing rtogs par gyur cig: brtan par gyur cig: grol bar gyur cig: me tog gang la phog pa'i lha gang yin pa de dang dbyer med du sangs rgyas par gyur cig: ces smon lam dang bkra shis brjod/ me tog gtor/ de nas thun mong rig pa 'i dbang lnga bskur ba ni/ de yang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu rkyen phung po la bdag tu bzung zhing dug lnga rang khar yin te 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud du gyur pa la brten nas sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor 'phyan pa yin la/ de dag par byed pa rigs lnga'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rig pa'i dbang lnga la brten dgos te/ rgyud las/ zhe sdang me gsod chu yi dbang : nga rgyal ri bsnyil dbu rgyan dbang : 'dod chags dug 'joms rdo rje'i

dbang : phrag dog zhags bgrol dril bu'i dbang : gti mug mun sel ming gis dbang : zhes dang / chu dang cod paṇa rdor dril ming : bu khyod rnams la sbyin par bya: ces pas/ dang po mi bskyod pa'i chu'i dbang ni/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ bum chu spyi gtsug tu reg cing 'di skad do: lha: sku gsum dam tshig las byung zhing : nyon mongs zhe sdang 'joms mdzad cing : lha yi bdud rtsi dag pa yis: mi bskyod pa ru dbang bskur ro: lha badz+ra a dharma shudz+nyā ta dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa mo: zhes mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa zhe snang sbyang / rnam shes kyi phung po gnas su dag /me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i sku lhun gyis grub/ sangs rgyas rdo rje rigs kyi zhing khams la dbang bsgyur nas sems can

racan /gyi don thogs pa med pa byed nus par gyur cig /gnyis pa rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: dbu rgyan mgo la bkon/ rna ltag g.yas su bum pa bzhag la/lha: sa ngas rgyas kun kyi rgyal srid de: nga rgyal rtog pa rnam/ par 'joms: chags med sbyin pa'i dbu rgyan 'dis: rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro: swā rat+na sa man+ta dz+nyā na rat+na swa bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa nga rgyal sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas su dag /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sku lhun gyis grub/lho phyogs rin chen rigs kyi zhing khams la dbang bsgyur nas sems can gyi don thogs pa med pa byed nus par gyur/ gsum pa sna nga ba mtha' yas rdo

rje'i dbang ni/ rdo rje ma bo thog tu bzhag /mthar la ga tu gtad/ bum pa ltag par bzhags la/ lha: sangs rgyas kun kyi rdo rje dbang : mi phyed rdo rje'i gsang ba la: 'dod chags rtog pa rnam par 'joms: rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ro: e pad+ma pradz+nyā a bhi ṣiñtsa mo: snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas /nyon mongs pa 'dod chags sbyangs/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas su dag /so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ gsu/nga snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku lhun gyis grub/ sangs rgyas pad+ma rigs kyi zhing khams la dbang bsgyur nas sems can gyi don thogs pa med pa byed nus par gyur/ bzhi pa don yo da grub pa sa dri bu'i dbang niḥ bum pa rna ltag g.yon du bzhag: dril bu gsil zhing la ga du gtad la : lha: thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yi: 'gro don mnyam med dril

sngag /bu 'dis: phrag dog rtogs pa rnam par 'joms: gnyis su medapa ra dbang bskur ro: nā ri sha a nu te dz+nyā na pa de kurma a bhi ṣiñtsa mo: don yod grub pa dril bus dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa phrag dog sbyangs/ 'du byed kyi phung po gnas su dag /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ phrin las don yod grub pa'i sku lhun gyis grub/ sangs rgyas phrin las rigs kyi zhing khams la dbang bsgyur nas sems can gyi don thogs pa med pa byed nus par gyur cig /lnga pa rnam par snang mdzad ming gis dbang bskur ba niḥ bum chu dpral bar bzhagaḥ rnam snang gi sku bstanaḥ gsang mtshan btags laḥ:: rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas: gti mug rtog pa rnam par 'joms: cis kyang mi chod mi shigs nga/: rdo rje'i ming ni rab tu grags:

oṃ tre tsakra ma du a mi dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mo: de ltar rnam par snang mdzad ming gis dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa gti mug sbyangs/gzugs kyi phung po gnas su dag chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku lhun gyis grub/ sangs rgyas bde gshegs rigs kyi zhing khams la dbang bsgyur nas sems can gyi don thogs pa med pa byed nus par gyur/ 'o/ de ltar thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bas/ dug lnga dang phung po lnga gtan nas dag nas/ ye shes lnga dang sku lnga lhun gyis grub cing zhing khams la lnga la dbang bsgyur nas sems can gyi don thogs pa med par byed nus pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig /ces brjod nas/ 'o/ de dag gi phyi mtshan ma'i bum dbang le

tshog /lag dang bcas pa song na/ gnyis pa nang phyag rgya sku'i dbang la brten nas mtshan dpe'i de kho na nyid ngo sprod kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kye hoḥ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che: bdag cag skal ldan bu rnams la: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi: lha dbang yongs rdzogs bskur du gsol: lan gsum rjes/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas zhi khro rigs brgya'i lha dbang bskur ba la brten nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las lha gnyis pa re mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon nas slob ma'i lus gnas so so la thim pas phung khams skye mched kyi rten thams cad sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rab 'byams kyi 'khor lor smin cing lha de dang de'i yon tan dang

nus pa thams cad thob par mos la/ lha: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: kun bzang yab yum sogs nas/ dus mnyam du 'ong ngo : bar ro/ /de ltar lha tshogs rnams khyed rang gi gnas so sor thim pas snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos so cog thams cad rigs brgya zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor chen por yongs su dag par thor nas zhi ba dang khro bo'i sku rnam 'gyur gang dang gang gis 'dul bar de dang de'i rnam rol 'gag med snang stong chu zla'i rol gar bzhin spyod pa'i mthu thob par byas pa yin no/ /de ltar phyi mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor du spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob / lus kyi dri ma dag /yul snang stong du rtogs/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang / tshogs lam nas sa brgyad pa man chad kyi nus pa

rog /rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /bharnya bdud rtsi thogs la/ de nas gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo longs spyod rdzogs sku bla ma kun bzang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' bzhis drangs pa'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu ba mkha' gsang nas brgyud de thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang lhan gcig tu lce la bzhag ste myang bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi shel ltar dwangs shing bde ba khyad par can bde stong dbyer mi phyed pas lus thams cad gang /gsal stong nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin rgyud la skyes par mos la/ lha: gsang ba ye shes bdud rtsi che: byang chub sems kyi sogs nas/

su ka āḥ bar/ de ltar bla ma yab yum dang yi ge chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor du spros med gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /sems gsal stong brjod bral du rtogs/ lam rtsa rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang sngags bzla ba la dbang / sgom lam sa dgu'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /de nas thugs rdo rje chos sku'i ngo bo bla mas shes rab mtshon byed me shel/ ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum gyi bdag nyid can snying gar bzhag pa la brten nas so so rang rig bde stong spros dang bral ba nyid cig car du rgyud la skye bar mos shing de'i ngang la mnyam par zhogs shig /sbyi: me long spros bral chos sku zlum: sogs nas/

sngag /ṣiñtsa lha: bar/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems mtshon byed me long gi dkyil 'khor du shes rab mtshon byed shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /rang rig bde stong brjod bral du rtogs/ lam thig le dang phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang / mthar lam rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi sa thob pa'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /de nas ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku'i rang bzhin can gyi bla mas dbang bzhi pa dpes mtshon du med pa'i ye shes nyid tshig tsam gyis brdas ngo sprad pa ste/ de'ang sems kyi gshis lugs gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong nyid spros bral ka nas dag pa de nyid rang gdangs 'gag med bde ba chen

po rnam rol sku dang ye shes kyi yon tan thams cad ye nas lhun grub tu rdzogs pa snang stong dbyer med zung 'jug so so rang rig gdod ma'i gnas lugs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rang ba'in gyi ngang ba3glung ba ni de kho na nyid kyi dbang yin pas rang babs su ma bcos par zhog cig /hrīḥngo bo nyid nas ka dag pa'i: sogs nas/ ṣiñtsa āḥ bar/ de ltar don dam byang chub kyi sems bla ma'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan brjod bral du rtogs lam rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa la dbang / bcu gsum ye shes bla ma'e sa thob pa'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku thob

༄ga /pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /'khor lo rin po che'i dbang bskur bas 'khor ba lu gu rgyud du 'khrul pa'i rgyu bdag 'dzin gnyis snang gi bag chags rtsad nas bcad de bdag don du dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sku ma/ngon du byas/ gzhan don du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor nas 'gro ba'i don bla na med par byed nus pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /:: 'khor lo rin chen rnams sogs nas/ aḥ bar/ btsun mo rin po che'i dbang bskur bas/ thabs rmongs pa ma rig pa'i rgyun bcad de zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don rtogs pas/ thabs snang ba'i cha gang du'ang ma spangs shing / ci yang ma bsgyur bar shes rab ye shes kyi de kho na nyid la dbang 'byor nas/ snang sems dbyer med du dag /phyi kun

rdzob la mnyam par sbyar bas dga' bzhi lugs 'byung ldog gi rtsal sbyangs a wa dhu ti'i rtsa mdud nyi shu rtsa gcig grol te/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /:: btsun mo rin chen sogs nas/ āḥ bar/ nor bu rin po che'i dbang bskur bas/ kun rdzob tu zang zing gi ngo bo gya rnam pa dang / don dam du yang dag dang ltar snang 'byed pa'i blo gros kyi mthu bkres shing phongs pa dag bsal nas 'phags nor bdun la sogs pa'i 'byor pas phyug ste/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /sbyi: nor bu rin che mchog gsum ldan: sogs nas/ āḥ bar/ khyim bdag rin po che'i dbang bskur bas/ phyi sku rgyud bskyed

༄sha /pa ma hā yo ga /nang gsung rgyud lung a nu yo ga /gsang ba thugs kyi rgyud rdzogs chen a ti yo ga ste/ theg pa gsum gyi don la ma rmongs shing / de kho na nyid blo bral bsam las 'das pas bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel bar byed pa'i yon tan can du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /:: khyim bdag rin chen sna bdun ldan: sogs nas / āḥ bar/ dmag dpon rin po che'i dbang bskur bas/ rnam rtog phal pas ye shes la rgol ba'i dgra bo rtsad nas bcad/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las rgyal te/ gang la'ang bsnyings 'khrigs dang bral ba phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pas stag mo ri su/la 'grim pa lta bu'i 'gro don phyogs med du spyod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ lha: blon po rin chen

dmag dpon mchog: sothos nas/ āḥ bar/ rta mchog rin po che'i dbang bskur bas/ tshogs lam chen pos rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i shugs thob cing / sbyor lam dang mthong lam gyi rim pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i gom stabs chen pos skad cig nyid la brgal nas bsgom lam dang mi slob pa'i lam mngon du gyur te myur du sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bgrod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ :: rta mchog rin chen sa lam bgrod: so gas nas/āḥ bar/ glang po rin po che'i dbang bskur bas/ mu stegs kyi rtag chad dang nyan thos kyi dngos zhen la sogs theg dman gyi lta ngan ri dwags phal pa zil gyis mnan nas bla med rdo rje theg pa'i glang po la zhon te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong du thogs pa med par bgrod pa'i

sngag /mos pa mdzod/ lha: glang po rin chen theg pa che: sogs nas/ thob par gyur cig:bar ro/ /'o/ rigs kyi bu dngos su gzugs brnyan las grub pa'i ye shes kyi rtsal mdangs las sprul pa'i gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can 'phur lding g.yo la rin po che in+t+ra ni la'i tog gis mdzes pa dbu'i steng dang / gser nya g.yu'i gshog pa can mnyen zhing lcug pa spyan la/ 'dab stong rnam par g.yo zhing dri dang ldan pa'i chu skyes kyi pad+ma ljags la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams srid pa bzung ba'i bkra shis kyi chos dung dkar po g.yas 'khyil tshem sa la/ 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bum pa dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan mgul la/ yid bzhin rin po che'i 'byung khungs rin po che'i dpal be'u thugs la/

bstan pa mi nub pa'i chos kyi rgya mtshan mchog rin thang dang bral ba sku la/ srid pa'i drwa ba nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin can rtsad nas gcodapa'i 'khor lo zhabs rnams la dbul zhing dbang bskur bas bkra shis rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /:: ji ltar sngon sogs nas/ sbyi: gdugs dang gser nya sogs nas/ lhaḥ skyobs pa gser gdugs sogs rnams brjod/ de nas oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ swa bha wa sogs kyisasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phroṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥlha las byung ba'i 'dod yon gyi ngo bo gzugs sdug pa/ dbyangs snyan pa/ dri bzang ba/ ro mnga' ba/ reg bya phun sum tshogs pa mi zad pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi longs spyod chen por gyur/
tshog /oṃ āḥlha/ mkha' mnyam zhing na sogs brjod do//
